title: Migration and The COVID-19 Pandemic in the Gulf: A Study of Foreign Expatriate Worker Communities' Coping Attitudes, Practices, and Future Prospects in Dubai and Jeddah
affiliations: King Faisal Center for Research and Islamic Studies and

detail.title: Migration and The COVID-19 Pandemic in the Gulf: A Study of Foreign Expatriate Worker Communities' Coping Attitudes, Practices, and Future Prospects in Dubai and Jeddah

publicationDetails.detailsText: Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung e. V. Policy Report No. 15 – October 2020

detail.abstract: Since March 2020, the massive global outbreak of novel coronavirus (COVID19) pandemic has disrupted the Gulf industries, severely impacting the living and working conditions of the vast majority of foreign expatriates in the urban Gulf. 1 By closely examining the two key Gulf economic centres-Dubai and Jeddah-during the initial wave of COVID19 pandemic (March-August 2020) via a mixed-method approach (n=117), the study aims to analyze the complex and multilayered effects of COVID19 pandemic on the three largest foreign expatriate communities in these selected Gulf cities, specifically Filipinos, Egyptians, and Pakistanis. 2 The study specifically explores how COVID19 has affected foreign workers' economic and welfare status in both Gulf cities mainly on the following thematic areas: working conditions, living conditions, access to medical services and dispute resolution system, remittance contribution, and current and future employment and security perceptions both in the Gulf and home country labour markets. 3 Key highlights of the study include the following:-Unemployment among foreign workers across various industries (except healthcare, pharmaceutical, selected food delivery, and digital sectors among others) has become pervasive during the initial wave of COVID19 pandemic, which has significantly impacted both of their income levels and remittance contributions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法（n=117）考察了2020年3月至8月COVID-19疫情初期对迪拜和吉达两个海湾经济中心的外籍劳工社区（菲律宾人、埃及人、巴基斯坦人）经济与福利状况的多层次影响，涵盖工作条件、生活条件、医疗服务获取、纠纷解决、汇款贡献及就业感知等主题。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情初期如何影响迪拜和吉达两大海湾城市中菲律宾、埃及和巴基斯坦三大外籍劳工社区的经济与福利状况？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情对海湾地区（Gulf）外籍劳工群体造成了严重冲击，但现有研究缺乏对该地区外籍劳工社区在疫情期间具体影响的系统性分析，尤其是对迪拜和吉达两大经济中心的多层次比较研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于疫情冲击下的外籍劳工经济学与福利研究框架，分析移民劳工在危机情境下的经济脆弱性与社会支持体系。
AI.method: 混合研究方法（mixed-method approach），样本量n=117，聚焦迪拜和吉达两地三大外籍劳工社区（菲律宾人、埃及人、巴基斯坦人）。
AI.findings: 疫情初期外籍劳工在各行业（除医疗、制药、部分食品配送和数字行业外）普遍失业，严重影响了其收入水平和汇款贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解流行病疫情对海湾地区外籍劳工经济脆弱性和福利保障的系统性影响提供了实证依据，丰富了移民劳工危机应对研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为海湾国家及原籍国政府制定疫情及危机情境下外籍劳工保护政策提供参考，有助于改善外籍劳工的就业保障、医疗服务获取和纠纷解决机制。

title: Bangladesh: Between Economic Miracle and Graduation Crisis A Macroeconomic and Sociological Synthesis

detail.title: Bangladesh: Between Economic Miracle and Graduation Crisis A Macroeconomic and Sociological Synthesis
detail.abstract: This study conducts a comprehensive empirical synthesis and theoretical integration of Bangladesh's macroeconomic trajectory as it prepares to formally graduate from the United Nations Least Developed Country (LDC) category on November 24, 2026. While aggregate growth over the past five decades has been heralded as a developmental "miracle"marked by a sevenfold increase in per capita income and significant improvements in life expectancy-this paper exposes severe, systemic vulnerabilities that threaten to undermine these achievements. We analyze the dual growth engines of Readymade Garments (RMG) and migrant remittances, evaluating the impending "tariff cliff" of 2029 when preferential access to the European Union market expires. To understand these macro-micro disparities, we integrate advanced empirical and theoretical frameworks from Al Mayen (2026a, 2026b, 2026c, 2026d). Using fixed-effects panel econometrics, we formalize a consumption-inflation model proving that unanticipated CPI inflation operates as a highly regressive shock, compressing annual household consumption per capita by $42.56 (p ¡ 0.001). Furthermore, we model income inequality (the Gini coefficient) as a developmental "friction coefficient" that severely degrades the translational efficiency of GDP growth into human welfare (β =-0.28, p ¡ 0.001), shedding light on the structural rot that fueled the siphoning of $234 billion in capital flight and the spike in system-wide non-performing loans (NPLs) to a world-record 35.73%. We examine the student-led July 2024 Revolution through a sociological critique of the "false promises of social mobility," showing how a rigid public-sector quota system shattered the meritocratic expectations of a generation suffering from a 30% youth NEET rate. Finally, we implement an interactive epidemiological model showing that economic crises account for a 34.3% Population Attributable Risk (PAR) of clinical depression, demonstrating that public Active Labor Market Program (ALMP) spending can completely neutralize recession-induced suicide mortality once it crosses a critical threshold of $208.42 per capita. We outline a comprehensive policy roadmap for newly elected leader T.K. Rahman to navigate the post-graduation transition and stabilize the fragile state.

AI.tldr: 本研究对孟加拉国即将于2026年从联合国最不发达国家（LDC）类别毕业的宏观经济轨迹进行了综合实证分析与理论整合，揭示了其表面"增长奇迹"背后存在的系统性脆弱性。研究发现：不可预期的CPI通胀是高度累退性的冲击（每压缩人均家庭消费42.56美元）；收入不平等作为"摩擦系数"严重降低GDP增长转化为人类福祉的效率（β=-0.28）；经济危机对临床抑郁症的总体归因风险（PAR）达34.3%；积极的劳动力市场计划（ALMP）支出超过人均208.42美元的关键阈值后，可完全中和衰退引发的自杀死亡率。论文为当选领导人T.K. Rahman提供了全面的政策路线图。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国在2026年从最不发达国家类别毕业之际，其宏观经济"增长奇迹"背后存在哪些系统性脆弱性？这些脆弱性如何威胁其发展成果的可持续性？
AI.motivation: 尽管孟加拉国过去五十年被标榜为发展"奇迹"（人均收入增长七倍、预期寿命显著改善），但该研究揭示出严重的系统性脆弱性，包括即将到来的2029年欧盟优惠市场准入到期所引发的"关税悬崖"、世界纪录级的35.73%不良贷款率、2,340亿美元的资本外逃、学生革命暴露的社会流动假象以及30%的青年NEET率等问题，亟需系统性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了Al Mayen（2026a-d）的先进实证与理论框架，包括：（1）消费-通胀模型（消费与不可预期通胀的关系）；（2）将收入不平等（基尼系数）概念化为经济发展的"摩擦系数"；（3）社会流动性的社会学批判理论（"社会流动的虚假承诺"）；（4）交互式流行病学模型（经济危机与抑郁症的关系）。
AI.method: 采用固定效应面板计量经济学方法，具体包括：（1）形式化消费-通胀模型以检验不可预期CPI通胀对家庭消费的累退效应；（2）将基尼系数建模为发展"摩擦系数"以评估其对GDP增长向人类福祉转化效率的影响；（3）实施交互式流行病学模型评估经济危机对临床抑郁症的总体归因风险（PAR）；（4）通过社会学批判分析2024年7月学生革命。
AI.findings: （1）不可预期的CPI通胀每发生一个单位变动，人均家庭年消费被压缩42.56美元（p<0.001），证明通胀是高度累退性的冲击；（2）基尼系数作为"摩擦系数"显著降低GDP增长向人类福祉转化的效率（β=-0.28，p<0.001）；（3）结构性腐败导致了2,340亿美元资本外逃和创世界纪录的35.73%不良贷款率；（4）僵化的公共部门配额制度破坏了千禧一代的精英统治期望；（5）经济危机对临床抑郁症的PAR为34.3%；（6）ALMP支出超过人均208.42美元阈值后，可完全中和衰退引发的自杀死亡率。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）形式化了消费-通胀模型，定量证明了通胀的累退性特征；（2）创新性地将基尼系数概念化为"摩擦系数"，为理解不平等如何降低增长-福利转化效率提供了新框架；（3）通过交互式流行病学模型建立了经济危机与心理健康之间的定量联系；（4）整合多学科理论（经济学、社会学、流行病学）构建了对发展中国家"毕业"转型期的综合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为孟加拉国新当选领导人T.K. Rahman提供了全面的政策路线图，以应对后毕业期的转型挑战；（2）识别了2029年"关税悬崖"风险，为RMG产业转型提供预警；（3）提出ALMP支出的关键政策阈值（人均208.42美元），为公共心理健康干预提供量化政策依据；（4）揭示了公共部门配额制度的弊端，为改革就业政策提供实证支持；（5）明确了通胀管理的福利分配维度，为货币政策制定提供参考。

title: Economic Sovereignty and the Agentic Paradigm

detail.title: Economic Sovereignty and the Agentic Paradigm

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no conflicts
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research does not involve human participants, patient data, or personal data of identifiable individuals. All data used are publicly available macroeconomic and historical statistics.
declarations.funderStatement: independent researcher

detail.abstract:
Working paper / preprint — not peer-reviewed. This paper proposes a theoretical policy framework and is not an empirical study. Drafting and formatting were AI-assisted; some figures and country-specific statistics have not been independently re-verified and may contain errors. Findings are conditional on the framework's stated assumptions and should be read as structural illustrations, not real-world predictions or forecasts. This is not financial, investment, or legal advice. Corrections, critique, and independent replication are welcome — contact mo_barakatm@yahoo.com.

The global financial system relies overwhelmingly on interest-bearing debt. With global public debt exceeding $102 trillion, this paper examines whether debt-compounding dynamics are a structural feature of interest-based finance, and proposes an alternative architecture — "Economic Sovereignty" — built on interest-free financing.

The framework rests on four pillars. First, a zero-interest policy intended to remove the compounding-debt mechanism as a driver of cost-push inflation. Second, profit-and-loss-sharing (PLS) finance, which replaces debt contracts with equity-style investment, so that financial returns are tied to real economic performance rather than fixed obligations. Third, a 2.5% asset-based tax replacing income and corporate taxation, designed to discourage capital hoarding and encourage productive circulation. Fourth, a dynamic monetary stability mechanism intended to anchor money supply to the real economy and absorb supply-side shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论性政策框架，主张全球金融体系以付息债务为结构性特征，并提出"经济主权"（Economic Sovereignty）的替代架构——基于无息融资、盈亏共享（PLS）、资产税和动态货币稳定机制四大支柱，旨在消除复利债务机制、抑制成本推动型通胀并促进资本生产性循环。
AI.research_question: 债务复利动态是否是利息型金融体系的结构性特征？如果是，如何设计一个替代性的无息金融架构来解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 全球公共债务超过102万亿美元，利息型金融体系依赖付息债务，复利累积机制可能驱动成本推动型通胀并加重系统性金融脆弱性，亟需探索替代性的金融架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利息型金融的债务复利理论；利润与亏损分担（PLS）金融理论；基于资产的税收理论；货币供给锚定实体经济的动态稳定理论。
AI.method: 理论性政策框架研究（非实证研究），通过提出四大支柱构建替代性金融体系架构。
AI.findings: 提出"经济主权"框架包含四大支柱：（1）零利率政策以消除复利债务机制驱动成本推动型通胀；（2）PLS金融以股权式投资替代债务合约，使金融回报与实体绩效挂钩；（3）2.5%资产税替代所得税和公司税，抑制资本囤积并鼓励生产性流通；（4）动态货币稳定机制将货币供给锚定实体经济并吸收供给侧冲击。研究结论以框架假设为条件，属于结构性说明而非真实预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合性的无息金融替代架构理论，将零利率、PLS金融、资产税和货币稳定机制整合为一个连贯的政策框架，挑战了传统利息型金融体系作为默认范式的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一个可操作的替代金融体系设计方案，涵盖货币、税收、信贷与稳定机制四个维度，为探索脱离债务复利困境的金融改革路径提供了参考。

title: Simulation Study & Validation Analysis

detail.title: Simulation Study & Validation Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research does not involve human participants, patient data, or personal data of identifiable individuals. All data used are synthetic simulation outputs and publicly available macroeconomic and historical statistics.
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

keywords: Real-world calibration for 16 countries (IMF / WB / BIS)

detail.abstract:
Working paper / preprint — not peer-reviewed. This is a companion simulation study to Aly (2026), Economic Sovereignty: Engineering the Interest-Free System [https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=7253121]. Simulation code and validation modules were AI-generated; the economic framework under test is the author's original work. All results are conditional on the model's specific parametric assumptions and should be read as structural properties of a stylised theoretical model, not empirical predictions about real-world economies.

This paper presents a comparative macro-simulation of two financial architectures — a conventional interest-based system ("Legacy") and a profit-and-loss-sharing system ("Sovereign") — across ten macroeconomic stability tiers, using a Monte Carlo framework (200 runs per tier, 4,000 total paths, 30-year horizon, seed=42 for full reproducibility). Two metrics are introduced: the Kinetic Efficiency Index (KEI), integrating growth, inflation deviation, and debt burden, and a state-space Divergence Metric, D(t), quantifying structural separation between the regimes over time.

Under the model's parameterisation, the Sovereign architecture shows lower debt-crisis probability in low-to-moderate stress environments, while both architectures converge toward high failure rates under severe stress, with the Sovereign system's primary vulnerability shifting to a money-velocity-driven inflation channel above moderate stress levels. An internal validation exercise (formula verification, ±25% sensitivity analysis, cross-model comparison against Domar, Fisher, Taylor-rule, and stock-flow-consistent frameworks) is reported alongside the main results, including limitations: the model's policy-rate rule is intentionally sub-stabilising relative to the Taylor principle, shock sequences are not strictly identical across regimes in a given run, and the transition simulation assumes a frictionless institutional shift not present in real-world monetary reform. These limitations are discussed in full in the paper's validation appendix.

Corrections, critique, and independent replication are welcome — contact mo_barakatm@yahoo.com.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过蒙特卡洛模拟（4000条路径、30年期限、10个宏观稳定性层级），对比了传统基于利息的金融体系（Legacy）与基于损益分享的金融体系（Sovereign）的宏观表现。引入了动能效率指数（KEI）和状态空间发散度量D(t)两个新指标。结果显示在低至中度压力环境下，Sovereign体系债务危机概率更低，但在严重压力下两者均趋于高失败率，且Sovereign体系的主要脆弱性在中等以上压力水平转为货币流速驱动的通胀渠道。
AI.research_question: 在零利息（损益分享）金融架构与传统利息金融架构之间，哪种体系在不同宏观稳定性压力层级下表现更优？两大体系在宏观经济韧性上是否存在结构性差异？
AI.motivation: 现有宏观经济理论大多基于利息金融体系假设，缺乏对无息（损益分享）金融体系的系统性比较研究。作者旨在通过模拟实验为"经济主权"框架提供定量证据，检验零息体系在宏观稳定性方面的理论优势与脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于损益分享（PLS）的零利息金融架构理论；Domar债务动态、Fisher方程、Taylor规则、存量-流量一致（SFC）框架等作为交叉验证的参照理论模型。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟框架：200次运行/层级×10个稳定性层级=2000次运行，4000条总路径，30年时间跨度，固定随机种子（seed=42）确保完全可复现。引入两个新度量指标：动能效率指数（KEI，整合增长、通胀偏离和债务负担）和状态空间发散度量D(t)（量化两体系随时间的结构分离程度）。内部验证包括公式验证、±25%敏感性分析和跨模型比较。
AI.findings: 在低至中度压力环境下，Sovereign（损益分享）体系显示出更低的债务危机概率；在高压力环境下，两大体系均趋于高失败率；Sovereign体系在中等以上压力水平下的主要脆弱性转移到货币流速驱动的通胀渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了两个新的分析指标（KEI和状态空间发散度量D(t)），为比较金融架构提供了量化工具；将零利息金融体系纳入可检验的理论模拟框架，揭示了该体系在不同压力层级下的结构性特征与脆弱性转换机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为无息金融体系改革提供了模拟层面的证据基础；指出Sovereign体系在特定压力场景下的通胀风险管理需求；对货币改革政策制定者提供了关于体系切换摩擦、政策利率规则设计等方面的局限性和注意事项。

title: A Machine Learning Framework for Comparative Housing Valuation and Listing Price Fairness Assessment
affiliations: K. N. Toosi University of Technology

detail.title: A Machine Learning Framework for Comparative Housing Valuation and Listing Price Fairness Assessment
detail.abstract: Deciding whether a listed housing price is fair, relatively high, or relatively low is an important practical problem for buyers and sellers. Conventional automated valuation approaches typically frame housing valuation as a price-prediction task, producing an estimated price from a property's characteristics. This paper instead considers the complementary problem of assessing an observed listing price relative to a model-implied reference value. A polynomial regression estimator is used to estimate a reference housing price from property characteristics, with particular attention to the methodological risks associated with encoding location-based variables. The resulting reference value is compared with the observed listing price through a Price Deviation Index (PDI), which measures the relative difference between the two values. The framework therefore provides a simple data-driven mechanism for identifying listings whose asking prices are relatively higher or lower than the estimated market-consistent value of comparable properties. The proposed approach is intended as an interpretable complement to conventional housing price prediction and comparative market analysis rather than as a substitute for professional property appraisal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估挂牌房价是否公平的框架，通过多项式回归估计参考房价，并与挂牌价比较计算价格偏差指数（PDI），以识别定价偏高或偏低的房产，作为传统房价预测的补充工具。
AI.research_question: 如何判断挂牌房价相对于市场一致参考值是公平、偏高还是偏低？
AI.motivation: 传统自动估值方法仅将住房估值视为价格预测任务，产生估计价格，但未能回答挂牌价相对于模型隐含参考值是否公平的问题，这对买卖双方具有重要的实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多项式回归估计与价格偏差指数（Price Deviation Index, PDI）框架
AI.method: 使用多项式回归估计器从房产特征中估计参考房价，特别关注编码基于位置的变量所带来的方法论风险；将估计的参考值与实际挂牌价通过价格偏差指数（PDI）进行比较，衡量两者之间的相对差异。
AI.findings: 该框架提供了一种简单的数据驱动机制，用于识别挂牌价相对于可比较房产的市场一致估计值偏高或偏低的房源。
AI.theory_contributions: 将住房估值从单纯的价格预测任务扩展为价格公平性评估任务，提出了价格偏差指数作为衡量挂牌价相对合理性的理论工具，并强调了位置变量编码的方法论风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为买卖双方提供可解释的、数据驱动的挂牌价公平性判断工具，可作为传统房价预测和比较市场分析的补充，而非替代专业房产评估。

title: Socioeconomic and Behavioural Determinants of Social Disconnectedness: Evidence from India
affiliations: Amity University, Kolkata,  and Amity University Kolkata

detail.title: Socioeconomic and Behavioural Determinants of Social Disconnectedness: Evidence from India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Written Consent was obtained.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Social disconnectedness has emerged as a critical public health and socioeconomic challenge with farreaching implications for mental and physical health, labour productivity, social cohesion, and overall wellbeing. Although a growing body of literature documents its adverse consequences, comparatively little empirical evidence examines the demographic, socioeconomic, and behavioural factors that shape social disconnectedness, particularly in developing countries such as India. Existing studies have largely adopted psychological or public health perspectives, with limited attention to the role of socioeconomic conditions and digital behaviour within an integrated analytical framework. This study investigates the determinants of social disconnectedness using primary survey data collected from 150 adults in India. Social disconnectedness is measured using the Social Connectedness Scale developed by Lee and Robbins (1995), with responses reverse-coded to construct a Social Disconnectedness Score. Guided by Social Capital Theory, the Capability Approach, and Behavioural Economics, the study employs Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression to estimate the association between demographic characteristics, socioeconomic status, digital engagement, and social disconnectedness. The findings indicate that age, religion, place of residence, family size, household income, occupation, and daily screen time are significant determinants of social disconnectedness. Respondents aged 20-60 years, individuals from larger households, urban residents, and those belonging to higher-income households exhibit significantly lower levels of social disconnectedness. Conversely, business owners, homemakers, respondents from minority religious groups, and individuals reporting four to six hours of daily screen time experience higher levels of social disconnectedness. Gender, caste, disability status, educational attainment, and mere social media presence do not demonstrate statistically significant associations after controlling for other explanatory variables. The study contributes to the emerging interdisciplinary literature by shifting the focus from the consequences of social disconnectedness to its underlying determinants within the Indian context. By integrating demographic, socioeconomic, and behavioural perspectives into a unified econometric framework, it demonstrates that social disconnectedness is shaped by structural inequalities, family and occupational circumstances, and patterns of digital engagement. The findings provide important policy insights for designing interventions that strengthen social capital, promote healthy digital behaviours, enhance community participation, and reduce socioeconomic barriers to social inclusion.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用印度150名成年人的原始调查数据，通过社会资本理论、可行能力方法和行为经济学的整合框架，采用OLS回归分析社会脱节的决定因素，发现年龄、宗教、居住地、家庭规模、家庭收入、职业和每日屏幕时间是显著影响因素，并提出了促进社会融入的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 哪些人口统计学、社会经济和行为因素决定了印度的社会脱节（social disconnectedness）？
AI.motivation: 社会脱节已成为重要的公共卫生和社会经济挑战，但现有文献大多关注其负面后果，较少实证研究其决定因素，尤其在印度等发展中国家。且已有研究多从心理学或公共卫生视角出发，缺乏将社会经济条件和数字行为纳入统一分析框架的整合性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论（Social Capital Theory）、可行能力方法（Capability Approach）和行为经济学（Behavioural Economics）
AI.method: 采用印度150名成年人的原始调查数据，使用Lee和Robbins（1995）开发的社会连接量表（Social Connectedness Scale）反向编码构建社会脱节得分，运用普通最小二乘法（OLS）回归估计人口特征、社会经济地位和数字参与与社会脱节的关联。
AI.findings: 年龄、宗教、居住地、家庭规模、家庭收入、职业和每日屏幕时间是社会脱节的显著决定因素。20-60岁受访者、大家庭成员、城市居民和高收入家庭表现出更低的社会脱节水平；而企业主、家庭主妇、少数宗教群体成员及每日屏幕时间4-6小时者表现出更高的社会脱节。性别、种姓、残疾状况、教育程度和单纯社交媒体存在与否没有显著统计学关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会脱节的研究焦点从后果转向其底层决定因素，整合人口统计学、社会经济和行为视角于统一计量经济学框架，证明社会脱节由结构性不平等、家庭与职业境况以及数字参与模式共同塑造，拓展了跨学科文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计增强社会资本、促进健康数字行为、提升社区参与和减少社会融入的社会经济障碍的干预措施提供了政策启示。

title: Responsibility for the Future: Hans Jonas and the Philosophical Foundation of the Precautionary Principle
affiliations: NATIONAL KAPODISTRIAN UNIVERSITY OF ATHENS

detail.title: Responsibility for the Future: Hans Jonas and the Philosophical Foundation of the Precautionary Principle
detail.abstract: Hans Jonas's ethics of responsibility is among the most influential philosophical attempts to respond to the unprecedented temporal and spatial reach of modern technological power. This study examines whether, and in what sense, Jonas can provide a philosophical foundation for the precautionary principle in environmental law. It argues that Jonas should not be treated as the author of a legal precautionary rule. Rather, his work supplies a normative grammar for precaution: the expansion of responsibility beyond contemporaries, the priority accorded to avoiding irreversible catastrophe, the epistemic significance of uncertainty, and the duty to preserve the conditions for genuine human life. The study compares this philosophical structure with Principle 15 of the Rio Declaration and Article 191(2) TFEU, while addressing objections concerning indeterminacy, paralysis, proportionality and conflicts with present interests.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨汉斯·约纳斯的责任伦理是否为环境法中的预防原则提供哲学基础。作者认为约纳斯不应被视为法律预防规则制定者，但他的工作为预防原则提供了规范性文法：责任超越当代人的扩展、避免不可逆灾难的优先性、不确定性的认识论意义，以及维护真正人类生活条件的义务。研究将该哲学结构与《里约宣言》原则15及《欧盟运行条约》第191条第2款进行比较，并回应了关于不确定性、瘫痪、比例原则及与当前利益冲突的质疑。
AI.research_question: 约纳斯的责任伦理能否以及在何种意义上为环境法中的预防原则提供哲学基础？
AI.motivation: 现代技术力量在时间和空间上的空前扩展带来了前所未有的风险，需要哲学层面的回应；同时预防原则在环境法中缺乏坚实的哲学基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约纳斯的责任伦理（ethics of responsibility）
AI.method: 哲学分析比较法：将约纳斯的责任伦理哲学结构与《里约宣言》原则15及《欧盟运行条约》第191条第2款进行比较分析，并回应反对意见。
AI.findings: 约纳斯不应被视为法律预防规则的直接作者，但他的工作提供了预防的规范性文法——包括责任的时间性扩展、避免不可逆灾难的优先性、不确定性的认识论重要性，以及维护人类生活条件的义务——这些要素为环境法中的预防原则提供了哲学支撑。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了约纳斯责任伦理与环境法预防原则之间的理论关系，将约纳斯定位为提供"规范性文法"而非具体的法律规则，弥合了哲学伦理与法律原则之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境法中预防原则的哲学辩护提供依据，回应了关于不确定性、决策瘫痪、比例原则和与当前利益冲突等实践性异议，有助于环境法律与政策的制定。

title: Does the Equity Term Structure Respond to Monetary Policy Shocks?
affiliations: and

detail.title: Does the Equity Term Structure Respond to Monetary Policy Shocks?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
A long-standing body of research, inspired by Bernanke and Kuttner (2005), has documented the effects of Fed interest rate surprises on stock markets. While stock markets provide valuable information about the investor risk premium and dividend growth expectations, researchers have only recently developed more comprehensive tools to estimate the term structure of equity risk premia and dividend growth expectations across a broad range of maturities. In this post, we investigate the impact of monetary policy surprises (or shocks) on short- and long-term estimates of risk premia and growth expectations through the lens of the Giglio, Kelly, and Kozak (2024) model

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/08/does-the-equity-term-structure-respond-to-monetary-policy-shocks/

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Giglio, Kelly和Kozak（2024）的模型，探讨美联储利率意外变动（货币政策冲击）对股票期限结构中短期和长期风险溢价与股息增长预期的影响。
AI.research_question: 货币政策冲击如何影响股票期限结构中的短期和长期风险溢价及股息增长预期？
AI.motivation: 已有文献（如Bernanke和Kuttner, 2005）记录了美联储利率意外变动对股票市场的影响，但此前缺乏全面工具来估计股票风险溢价和股息增长预期的期限结构。近期才发展出更全面的工具来估计跨期限的股权风险溢价和股息增长预期。
AI.theoretical_framework: Giglio, Kelly和Kozak（2024）模型，用于估计股票风险溢价和股息增长预期的期限结构。
AI.method: 运用Giglio, Kelly和Kozak（2024）模型估计股票期限结构，并通过该模型视角分析货币政策意外（冲击）对短期和长期风险溢价及增长预期估算的影响。
AI.findings: 货币政策冲击对短期和长期的风险溢价和增长预期估算产生不同影响（具体结果需查看完整文章）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币政策的股票市场影响分析从整体市场层面扩展到期限结构维度，区分短期和长期的不同反应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供货币政策冲击如何通过不同期限的股权风险溢价和增长预期传导至股票市场的洞察。

title: Air Pollution Through History: From Ancient Smoke to the Age of Multi Pollutant Governance

detail.title: Air Pollution Through History: From Ancient Smoke to the Age of Multi Pollutant Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. Concern about the unknown surroundings we are living in.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

keywords: Air Pollution Through History: From Ancient Smoke to the Age of Multi-Pollutant Governance Author: SAMUELSON G Affiliation: Independent researcher Air pollution

detail.abstract: Air pollution has a deep history that predates industrialisation, yet its causes, chemistry, and governance have changed profoundly over time. This review synthesises evidence from environmental history, palaeo-environmental reconstruction, emissions inventories, epidemiology, and policy analysis to examine air pollution from ancient to modern eras. The paper traces the development of atmospheric contamination from early metallurgical lead and urban smoke in antiquity through medieval coal regulation, the coal-smoke crisis of industrial Europe, catastrophic twentieth-century smog episodes, and the contemporary era of fine particulates, nitrogen oxides, ozone, agricultural ammonia, and transboundary haze. It argues that air pollution history is best understood as a sequence of socio-technical regimes in which dominant fuels, economic activities, and state capacity determine pollutant mixtures and exposure patterns. Recent scholarship has pushed the chronology of anthropogenic pollution further back than previously assumed, while modern burden-of-disease research shows that air pollution remains one of the largest global health risks. At the same time, historical and contemporary case studies demonstrate that strong regulation, cleaner fuels, emissions-control technologies, monitoring, and international agreements can drive major reductions. The review finds continuity in three respects: first, the tight link between combustion and poor air quality; second, the unequal distribution of exposure and harm; and third, the recurring lag between scientific warning and political action. It concludes that the history of air pollution is not a linear story of inevitable improvement, but a contested process in which gains are real, reversible, and often unevenly shared across places and populations.

AI.tldr: 本文从环境史、古环境重建、排放清单、流行病学和政策分析等多学科视角，系统综述了从古代到现代的空气污染历史，提出将空气污染史理解为一系列"社会-技术体制"的更替，并归纳出燃烧与污染的关联、暴露与危害的不平等、科学警示与政治行动的滞后三大连续性特征，强调空气污染历史并非线性改善的故事，而是一个充满争议、成果可逆且分配不均的过程。
AI.research_question: 如何从跨学科视角理解空气污染从古代到现代的历史演变？空气污染历史中是否存在持续的规律性特征？
AI.motivation: 空气污染虽早于工业化而存在，但其成因、化学特征和治理方式随时代发生了深刻变化，现有研究分散于多个学科，缺乏整合性的历史综述来系统梳理其演变脉络并提炼规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会-技术体制（socio-technical regimes）理论框架，该框架认为主导燃料、经济活动和国家能力共同决定污染物混合特征与暴露模式。
AI.method: 跨学科文献综述与综合分析方法，整合环境史、古环境重建、排放清单、流行病学及政策分析等多学科证据。
AI.findings: （1）空气污染的历史可划分为古代冶金铅污染与城市烟雾、中世纪煤炭监管、工业欧洲煤烟危机、二十世纪严重烟雾事件、当代细颗粒物与氮氧化物等复杂污染时期；（2）近年研究将人为污染的时间线大幅前推；（3）现代疾病负担研究表明空气污染仍是全球最大健康风险之一；（4）强监管、清洁燃料、排放控制技术、监测和国际协定能显著降低污染；（5）历史存在三大连续性：燃烧与污染的紧密关联、暴露与危害的不平等分配、科学警示与政治行动的反复滞后。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出以"社会-技术体制"序列理解空气污染史的理论视角，挑战了"空气污染历史是线性改善"的传统叙事，揭示污染治理成果的可逆性与不均等性。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过历史与当代案例的比较，证明强监管、清洁燃料转型、排放控制技术和国际合作的有效性，为各国空气污染治理政策和污染防治策略提供历史经验借鉴。

title: The Note-Chord-Voice Framework: Structured Source Separation and Causal Inference for EV Charging Data
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology and Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Imperial College London

detail.title: The Note-Chord-Voice Framework: Structured Source Separation and Causal Inference for EV Charging Data
detail.abstract: Real-world EV charging data exhibit three interlocking pathologies: hardware fragmentation (network timeouts and billing resets split sessions), physical violations (independent energy/duration models produce impossible states like 50 kWh in 10 min on a 7 kW charger), and collider bias (clustering on post-treatment outcomes opens backdoor paths for price elasticity). We propose the Note-Chord-Voice framework, a music-inspired, axiom-driven pipeline that separates data cleaning (Repair Chords), structural pattern discovery (Harmonic Chords), descriptive source separation (NMF Voices), and causal inference into distinct, falsifiable stages. Key innovations: (i) falsification gates (A1-A5, G3, G10) that test data suitability before modeling; (ii) Gamma-initialized NMF with input rescaling for convergence stability from STL decomposition; (iii) tag-based coupon grading (A/B/C/D) to isolate quasi-random treatment from night-time confounders and targeted promotions; (iv) separate per-voice OLS to avoid simplex collinearity; (v) Foote novelty curves for structural regime detection. Applied to the Jiangmen dataset (495,707 sessions, 20 stations, July 2024-fMarch 2025), all core axioms pass except G3 (no strong 168 h cycle). NMF achieves R^2=0.9921; the physically constrained duration model yields aggregate R^2=0.5409. Two voices are price-sensitive (beta = -11 to -14 min, p<0.001), of which one is stable (Voice 3, beta=-14.16) and one treatment-driven (Voice 1, beta=-11.10); only the stable voice supports causal claims. Counterfactual simulation shows targeting discounts to price-sensitive voices recovers 52.8% of discount expenditures (~0.85M CNY/year); restricting to the single stable price-sensitive voice yields a more conservative estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出音乐启发的Note-Chord-Voice框架，用于处理电动汽车充电数据中的硬件碎片化、物理违规和collider偏差三大病理问题。通过分离数据清洗、结构发现、源分离和因果推断阶段，并引入falsification gates、Gamma初始化的NMF等创新方法，在江门数据集上实现了高精度建模，识别出价格敏感用户并估算优惠券策略可回收52.8%的折扣支出（约85万元/年）。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地解决现实世界EV充电数据中存在的硬件碎片化、物理违规和collider偏差问题，并可靠地估计充电需求的价格弹性以支持优惠券定价策略？
AI.motivation: 现实EV充电数据存在三种相互交织的病理问题（硬件碎片化、物理违规、collider偏差），现有方法缺乏系统化处理框架，导致因果推断（如价格弹性估计）不可靠。
AI.theoretical_framework: Note-Chord-Voice框架（音乐启发）、collider bias理论、axiom-driven falsification方法、NMF（非负矩阵分解）、STL分解、物理约束建模
AI.method: 将分析流程分为四个独立阶段：数据清洗（Repair Chords）、结构发现（Harmonic Chords）、NMF源分离（Voices）、因果推断。核心创新包括：falsification gates（A1-A5, G3, G10）前置验证、Gamma初始化NMF、基于标签的优惠券分级（A/B/C/D）隔离准随机处理、分voice OLS避免simplex共线性、Foote novelty曲线进行结构检测。
AI.findings: 在江门数据集（495,707次会话、20个站点）上，所有核心公理通过（除G3：无强168小时周期）。NMF R²=0.9921；物理约束时长模型聚合R²=0.5409。识别出两个价格敏感voice（beta=-11至-14分钟，p<0.001），其中仅Voice 3（beta=-14.16）稳定支持因果声明。反事实模拟显示定向优惠券可回收52.8%折扣支出（约85万元/年）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了音乐启发的Note-Chord-Voice四阶段分析框架，将数据清洗、结构发现、源分离和因果推断整合为可证伪的独立阶段；引入falsification gates概念作为因果推断前的数据适宜性检验机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为EV充电运营商提供了可操作的优惠券定价策略：识别价格敏感细分用户群体并定向投放折扣，可回收约52.8%的折扣支出（约85万/年），同时提供保守和激进两种估计方案。

title: Secondary Gain: The Economics of the Symptom: Freud, Erickson, Andreas, and the Batesonian Antipode
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Secondary Gain: The Economics of the Symptom: Freud, Erickson, Andreas, and the Batesonian Antipode
detail.abstract: Freud's concept of secondary gain, the advantage a symptom acquires once it exists, was captured by the medico-legal apparatus of the twentieth century and degraded into a polite word for malingering. This paper attempts a rehabilitation. Secondary gain is not a moral category but an identification problem: the observer sees costly behavior, infers irrationality, and misses that the agent is optimizing against an unobserved objective. Resistance is then fidelity to a hidden constraint rather than opposition to treatment, and the clinical task is to recover the latent objective and enlarge the feasible set, the logic of Erickson's utilization principle and of the reframing technology systematized by Steve Andreas. I argue that Bateson's double bind is the formal opposite of secondary gain. Secondary gain is a non-empty feasible set with a concealed objective; the double bind is an empty feasible set with a concealed meta-constraint. One is pathological coherence, the other pathological incoherence, and Dansak's neglected third term, tertiary gain, is the hinge between them: an unspeakable third-party incentive takes the form of a bind, and the bind manufactures the symptom that supplies it. Two further results follow. The latent objective is endogenous to institutional design, so the medico-legal use of the concept is self-undermining. And under pooling, honest claimants must signal through the very behaviors under scrutiny, so an assessment regime organized to detect secondary gain manufactures its own confirmation from the innocent. A closing section reads the structure through Advaita Vedānta and Vivekananda's practical Vedānta, where the pathology turns out to be not duality of motive but concealment of its second term, and the resolution is the cutting of the hṛdaya-granthi, a knot both tight because it holds something and unyielding because it has no free end.

AI.tldr: 本文试图对弗洛伊德的"继发性获益"概念进行理论上的"平反"，将其从一个被法医体系降格为"诈病"代名词的道德范畴，重新诠释为一个识别问题：观察者看到昂贵行为就推断非理性，却忽略了行为主体其实是在针对一个未观察到的目标进行优化。论文提出继发性获益是"非空可行集+隐藏目标"（病理性一致），与贝特森的双重束缚（"空可行集+隐藏元约束"）形成形式上的对立，并以Dansak被忽视的"第三级获益"作为二者之间的枢纽。文章进一步论证：潜在目标内生于制度设计，使法医使用该概念自我瓦解；在混同均衡下，诚实主张者必须通过被审查的行为本身来发出信号，导致检测机制自我制造"确认证据"。结尾以Advaita Vedānta和Vivekananda的实践哲学重新解读这一结构。
AI.research_question: 如何对弗洛伊德的"继发性获益"概念进行理论重建，将其从道德谴责（诈病）转化为识别问题，并阐明其与双重束缚的逻辑关系？
AI.motivation: 继发性获益概念在20世纪法医体系中从弗洛伊德的临床洞察被降格为"诈病的委婉说法"，成为一种道德范畴而非分析工具。作者认为这种退化遮蔽了概念本身的解释力，需要对其进行理论上的"康复"（rehabilitation），恢复其作为识别问题的本来面目。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弗洛伊德的继发性获益概念；贝特森的双重束缚理论；Erickson的运用原则与Steve Andreas的重新框定技术；Dansak的第三级获益概念；博弈论（隐藏目标/不可观测目标的优化）；信号理论（混同均衡下的信号传递）；Advaita Vedānta哲学
AI.method: 理论分析与概念重建（conceptual analysis），通过形式化对照（继发性获益 vs. 双重束缚）构建对立框架，结合临床技术（Erickson运用原则、reframing）进行论证，并进行制度分析（法医评估制度的自反性）与哲学诠释（Vedānta视角）
AI.findings: （1）继发性获益不是道德范畴而是识别问题：观察者误将隐藏约束下的优化行为判为不理性；（2）继发性获益与双重束缚是形式上的对立：前者是"非空可行集+隐藏目标"（病理性一致），后者是"空可行集+隐藏元约束"（病理性不一致）；（3）第三级获益是二者之间的枢纽：不可言说的第三方激励以束缚的形式出现，束缚制造了供应该激励的症状；（4）潜在目标内生于是制度设计，法医使用该概念自我瓦解；（5）在混同均衡下，诚实者必须通过被审查行为本身发信号，检测继发性获益的评估制度会从无辜者身上制造自我确认。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将继发性获益从道德范畴重新定位为识别问题/优化问题，实现概念的理论"平反"；（2）以可行集和目标/元约束的二元维度形式化了对立：继发性获益 vs. 双重束缚；（3）重新激活Dansak被忽视的"第三级获益"概念，将其定位为继发性获益与双重束缚之间的枢纽机制；（4）揭示继发性获益概念在法医制度中使用时的自反性悖论；（5）通过信号理论解释评估制度如何制造自己的确认证据。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为临床治疗提供指导：抵抗不应被视为对治疗的反对，而是对隐藏约束的忠诚，临床任务在于恢复潜在目标并扩大可行集（Erickson运用原则与reframing技术的逻辑依据）；（2）对法医评估制度提出警示：检测继发性获益的评估制度存在结构性缺陷，会从无辜的诚实主张者身上制造出所需证据，因此制度设计需要重新审视；（3）提供跨文化哲学视角，以Advaita Vedānta的"心结"（hṛdaya-granthi）概念为临床与理论提供新的理解维度。

title: The Asymmetric Partition of the Balance of Payments: Demographics Own the Surplus, Class Owns the Financing

detail.title: The Asymmetric Partition of the Balance of Payments: Demographics Own the Surplus, Class Owns the Financing
detail.abstract: Who saves and who lends are two different questions, and the debate over global imbalances has mostly asked only the first. The demographic explanation is an account of saving: holding income constant, aging pushes rich economies toward current-account surpluses and poor ones toward deficits. Its main rival is an account of inequality, in which suppressed household income forces up national saving. This paper tests the two against each other on both sides of the balance of payments. On the saving side, using a 185-country panel (1990-2024) and pooled GLS with AR(1) errors, inequality does not displace demographics. Adding the labour share, Michael Pettis's central measure of wage suppression, leaves the demographic-by-income interaction (Z₁ × log GDP per capita) at +0.98 (p = 6×10⁻⁵). Among net creditors, the countries the argument is really about, the labour share loses significance (p = 0.84) while the demographic term keeps it. Entering all four of Pettis's transfer channels together still leaves the interaction at +1.38 (p < 0.05). Demographics own the saving side. The financing side reverses. Using a new panel of foreign holdings of US securities by source country (IMF CPIS, 2001-2024, which excludes official reserves), a country's top-10% income share predicts how much of its portfolio goes to the United States: +0.60*** on the US share of a source's outward portfolio, and +0.11*** on log US holdings. That is the same inequality measure that shows nothing on the current account. Source aging, net of income, carries the opposite sign, which is what globally diversified older creditors look like. Inequality owns the financing tilt. The contest therefore resolves asymmetrically: age structure decides who saves and who the large creditors are, while the distribution of income decides where that money goes. Two questions are left open rather than answered. The first is whether China's post-COVID real depreciation is warranted by its demographics, which depends on the specification and is treated here as a policy question. The second is how soon the demographically predicted US swing to surplus would arrive if private financing of the deficit proves durable.

AI.tldr: 本文通过区分"谁储蓄"和"谁放贷"两个不同问题，利用185国面板数据（1990-2024）和IMF CPIS美国证券持有数据（2001-2024），检验了人口结构假说与不平等假说在全球失衡中的相对解释力。结果发现：人口结构决定谁储蓄（经常账户盈余），而不平等决定资金流向（谁向美国放贷），形成不对称的竞争解决。
AI.research_question: 在全球失衡的争论中，人口结构解释与不平等（工资压制）解释，哪一方更能解释储蓄端（经常账户），哪一方更能解释融资端（资本流向）？
AI.motivation: 既有关于全球失衡的争论主要关注"谁储蓄"这一问题，而忽略了"谁放贷"这一独立问题。人口结构假说解释储蓄端，不平等假说（Michael Pettis的工资压制理论）也声称解释储蓄端，两者在同一维度上竞争，但融资端的解释力尚未被系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口结构假说（demographic explanation）：在收入不变条件下，老龄化推动富裕经济体走向经常账户盈余、贫穷经济体走向赤字。不平等/工资压制假说：被压制的家庭收入推高国民储蓄率（Michael Pettis的中央度量是劳动收入份额）。
AI.method: 两组实证检验：（1）储蓄端：185国面板（1990-2024），使用带AR(1)误差的合并GLS回归，检验人口结构×收入交互项与劳动份额及其他转移渠道的竞争。（2）融资端：新构建的IMF CPIS（2001-2024）外国对美国证券持有来源国面板数据，用顶层10%收入份额预测美国证券在对外组合中的占比。
AI.findings: 储蓄端：不平等指标无法取代人口结构。加入劳动份额后，人口结构×收入交互项仍为+0.98（p=6×10⁻⁵）。在净债权国中，劳动份额失去显著性（p=0.84）而人口结构项保持显著。融资端：顶层10%收入份额显著预测美国证券占比（+0.60***）和log美国持有量（+0.11***），而来源国老龄化（排除收入效应）符号相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 将全球失衡争论从单一维度（储蓄）拓展为不对称的两维竞争：年龄结构决定谁储蓄及主要债权国是谁，收入分配决定资金流向哪里。为人口结构假说与不平等假说划定了各自的解释边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策讨论提供实证依据：（1）中国的疫情后实际贬值是否被人口结构证明合理，取决于模型设定，属政策问题；（2）如果私人融资缺口持续，人口结构预测的美国转向盈余何时到来需要进一步评估。

title: Climate Risk Exposure, Cross Border, Commuting Resilience, and the Spatial Reallocation of Human Capital in the Greater Luxembourg Region

detail.title: Climate Risk Exposure, Cross Border, Commuting Resilience, and the Spatial Reallocation of Human Capital in the Greater Luxembourg Region

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any individual or organization that could be perceived to have influenced this study. This is independent academic research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a desk-based research and policy-analysis paper drawing exclusively on publicly available institutional statistics, government reports, and published data (STATEC, IGSS, LISER, Eurostat, Copernicus EMS). It does not involve human participants, patient data, primary surveys, or interviews, and therefore no ethics approval or participant consent was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding, grant, or institutional financial support. It was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: The Greater Luxembourg Region (GLR) is one of Europe's most pronounced examples of cross-border labour-market integration: at the end of 2025, roughly 233,000 cross-border workers — 47 percent of Luxembourg's 494,000 salaried employees — commuted daily into the Grand Duchy from France, Germany, and Belgium (STATEC, 2026; status.lu, 2026). This paper examines the intersection of climate-risk exposure and the resilience of this cross-border commuting system, and asks how extreme weather events and the regulatory architecture governing remote work jointly shape the spatial reallocation of human capital across the GLR. Drawing on real, publicly documented data from Luxembourg's National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (STATEC), the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER), the Inspection Générale de la Sécurité Sociale (IGSS), the Department of Spatial Planning (DATer), the Copernicus Emergency Management Service, and Luxembourg's national railway operator (CFL), the paper documents how the July 2021 floods — which caused an estimated EUR 32 billion in regional damage — flooded the CFL relay station at Bettembourg and severed direct rail service on the Luxembourg–Thionville line, the country's busiest cross-border corridor, for several days. It further documents that cross-border telework remains capped at 34 tax-tolerance days per year under Luxembourg's bilateral treaties with France, Belgium, and Germany, constraining the primary non-transport adaptation margin available to commuters facing corridor disruption. Combining these institutional and hazard data with LISER's 2026 LUXTALENT study — which shows that 15,200 new cross-border workers entered the Luxembourg labour market for the first time in 2024, that foreign-born and cross-border entrants together account for over 90 percent of new labour-market entrants, and that roughly 30 percent of new arrivals exit the Luxembourg labour market within a year — the paper develops a conceptual framework linking climate-hazard exposure, transport-corridor redundancy, and telework regulation to patterns of human-capital selection and turnover in the cross-border workforce. A 2026 LISER policy brief projects an 18 percent increase in total Greater Region travel demand by 2040, with French-origin commuting potentially rising by more than 60 percent, a trajectory that the paper argues constitutes a structural stress test for regional mobility precisely as Luxembourg's own July 2026 national climate-adaptation strategy — 152 measures across seventeen policy areas, adopted 22 April 2026 — acknowledges that flooding, heatwaves, and precipitation variability are among the country's principal climate vulnerabilities. The paper concludes with policy recommendations on infrastructure redundancy investment, telework-threshold reform, climate-adaptive spatial planning, and cross-border coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文考察大卢森堡地区跨境通勤系统在气候风险暴露下的韧性，结合2021年洪水事件、跨境远程办公税务限额制度以及劳动力流动数据，构建了一个连接气候灾害暴露、交通通道冗余性和远程办公监管与人力资本选择及流动模式的概念框架，并提出基础设施投资、远程办公改革等政策建议。
AI.research_question: 极端天气事件与远程办公监管架构如何共同塑造大卢森堡地区跨境人力资本的空间再配置？
AI.motivation: 大卢森堡地区是欧洲跨境劳动力市场一体化的最典型案例之一（约23.3万跨境通勤者占卢森堡受薪雇员47%），但该跨境通勤系统面临着日益加剧的气候风险（如2021年洪水造成320亿欧元损失并切断关键铁路线）与远程办公税务限制（每年仅34天）的双重挤压，亟需系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念框架整合了气候灾害暴露、交通通道冗余性与远程办公监管三个维度，用于解释跨境劳动力市场中人力资本的选择与流动（进入与退出）模式。
AI.method: 采用多源公共数据整合与案例分析方法：使用STATEC、LISER、IGSS、DATer、Copernicus应急管理服务及卢森堡国家铁路公司（CFL）的实际公开数据，结合2021年7月洪水事件案例及LISER 2026年LUXTALENT研究报告进行综合分析。
AI.findings: （1）2021年洪水淹没Bettembourg中继站，数日中断卢森堡-蒂永维尔线这一最繁忙跨境走廊的直达铁路服务；（2）跨境远程办公受限于每年34天税务容忍上限，制约了通勤者应对走廊中断的主要非交通适应手段；（3）2024年有15,200名新跨境工人首次进入卢森堡劳动力市场，外国出生及跨境进入者占新劳动力市场进入者90%以上，约30%的新进入者在一年内退出；（4）LISER预测至2040年大区交通需求将增长18%，法国来源通勤可能增长超60%，构成结构性压力测试。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了连接气候灾害暴露、交通通道冗余性与远程办公监管到人力资本选择与流动模式的概念框架，填补了跨境劳动经济学与气候韧性研究交叉领域的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四项政策建议：基础设施冗余投资、远程办公税务门槛改革、气候适应性空间规划以及跨境协调机制，为卢森堡及类似跨境劳动力市场区域应对气候风险提供可操作的决策参考。

title: Outlier Models, Mixture Kalman Filters, and the Score of the Marginal
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Outlier Models, Mixture Kalman Filters, and the Score of the Marginal
detail.abstract: West [1984] models regression outliers by writing the error density as a scale mixture of normals, so that inference is Gaussian conditional on a latent scale and the marginal posterior is a mixture over that scale. Chen and Liu [2000] propose the mixture Kalman filter for conditional dynamic linear models, in which the system is linear and Gaussian conditional on a latent indicator path and the filtering distribution is a random mixture of Kalman posteriors. We argue that these are one construction seen twice. West's outlier model is a conditional dynamic linear model with a static state; the mixture Kalman filter is West's outlier model run forward in time. The unifying object is Rao-Blackwellization, and the unifying diagnostic is West's weight w(e) = E(λ | e), the negative score of the marginal density divided by the residual. We show that in the static limit this weight coincides exactly with the perfectly adapted mixture Kalman filter proposal, and that the same identity reappears as Tweedie's formula when the mixture is placed on the prior rather than the error scale, so that global-local shrinkage models are conditional dynamic linear models as well. A simulation study against an exact grid filter quantifies the correspondence. The mixture Kalman filter recovers the exact non-Gaussian filter to within Monte Carlo error while a variance-matched Kalman filter is twenty-three times further away; Rao-Blackwellization buys an order of magnitude in variance over a bootstrap particle filter in one dimension and a factor approaching eight hundred in sixteen; the adapted draw buys a further factor of two, concentrated entirely at the outlying observations; the degrees of freedom are pinned down against the Gaussian within a few dozen observations but remain uncertain over a wide interval indefinitely; and mixing on both the observation and the evolution scale, though best on average, is dominated at each individual pathology by the filter specialised to it, because the two latent scales are not separately identified from a single forecast error.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了West的回归异常值模型和Chen & Liu的混合卡尔曼滤波器本质上是同一种构造的两种表现形式：前者是静态状态的条件下动态线性模型，后者是前者在时间上的推进。统一的数学工具是Rao-Blackwellization，统一的诊断量是West权重w(e)=E(λ|e)，即边际密度负得分除以残差。该权重在静态极限下与完全自适应的混合卡尔曼滤波器建议分布完全一致，并在先验尺度上退化为Tweedie公式，从而将全局-局部收缩模型也纳入这一统一框架。模拟研究验证了混合卡尔曼滤波器能以蒙特卡洛误差精度恢复精确的非高斯滤波器，且Rao-Blackwellization在方差上带来数量级改进。
AI.research_question: West的回归异常值模型、Chen & Liu的混合卡尔曼滤波器和全局-局部收缩模型之间是否存在统一的数学结构？其统一的分析工具和诊断量是什么？
AI.motivation: 这些方法分别出现在不同领域（回归稳健性、动态线性模型、贝叶斯收缩），但可能共享相同的底层构造。识别这一统一结构有助于更深入理解各方法的性质、改进算法效率，并揭示看似不同的方法之间的内在联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件动态线性模型（CDLM）、Rao-Blackwellization定理、Tweedie公式、尺度混合正态分布、混合卡尔曼滤波、粒子滤波
AI.method: 理论推导统一三种模型（West异常值模型、混合卡尔曼滤波器、全局-局部收缩模型）的数学结构；通过模拟研究比较混合卡尔曼滤波器、方差匹配的卡尔曼滤波器、bootstrap粒子滤波器的性能；在1维和16维条件下进行精确网格滤波器对照实验。
AI.findings: （1）West权重w(e)=E(λ|e)在静态极限下与完全自适应的混合卡尔曼滤波器建议分布精确一致；（2）混合卡尔曼滤波器恢复精确非高斯滤波器的误差仅为蒙特卡洛误差水平，而方差匹配的卡尔曼滤波器误差是其23倍；（3）Rao-Blackwellization在1维中带来一个数量级的方差改进，在16维中改进因子接近800；（4）自适应抽取额外带来两倍改进，且完全集中在异常观测上；（5）自由度参数在几十个观测内即可与高斯分布区分，但在宽区间内长期不确定；（6）在观测尺度和演化尺度同时混合虽平均最优，但在每个特定异常情景下被专门化的滤波器主导，因为两个潜在尺度无法从单一预测误差中单独识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了West异常值模型、混合卡尔曼滤波器和全局-局部收缩模型之间的统一数学框架，证明它们是同一构造的不同表现；揭示了West权重、混合卡尔曼建议分布和Tweedie公式之间的深刻联系；将Rao-Blackwellization确立为统一的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为混合卡尔曼滤波器的设计和诊断提供了统一的权重公式；量化了Rao-Blackwellization在不同维度下的方差改进幅度；指出了同时混合观测和演化尺度的局限（两个尺度不可分别识别），为实际应用中滤波器选择提供了指导；提供了在几十个观测内识别异常值分布自由度的方法。

title: Federal Penalty Patterns Across Medicare-Certified Nursing Homes: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of 14,695 Facilities

detail.title: Federal Penalty Patterns Across Medicare-Certified Nursing Homes: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of 14,695 Facilities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of zReports.org, which publishes consumer-facing applications of this research. The analysis uses only publicly available federal data from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Provider Data Catalog.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study analyzes publicly available, de-identified federal administrative data from CMS. No human subjects were involved and no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded by the zReports Research Institute. No external funding.

publicationDetails.detailsText: zReports Research Institute™ · Working Paper WP-2026-05

detail.abstract: Medicare-certified nursing homes in the United States are subject to federal inspection, enforcement, and penalty regimes administered by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). Using data from the CMS Provider Data Catalog as normalized in the zReports Consumer Records Database™, this paper presents a cross-sectional analysis of federal penalty and deficiency patterns across all 14,695 active Medicare-certified nursing homes. We find that 46% of facilities carry at least one federal civil money penalty on the current record and 99.6% have at least one inspection deficiency on file. We examine penalty distribution by ownership type and state, and document the systematic divergence between federal enforcement records and consumer-facing review scores.

AI.tldr: 本文使用CMS Provider Data Catalog数据，对美国全部14,695家Medicare认证养老院进行了联邦罚款和检查缺陷的横截面分析，发现46%的机构存在联邦民事罚款记录，99.6%的机构至少有一项检查缺陷，并揭示了联邦执法记录与消费者评论分数之间的系统性差异。
AI.research_question: 美国Medicare认证养老院的联邦罚款和缺陷模式如何分布？联邦执法记录与消费者评价之间是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 养老院质量监管是美国公共健康领域的重大议题，但缺乏对联邦执法记录全貌的系统性横截面分析，且消费者评价与官方执法记录之间的关系尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管执法理论、质量评估与消费者信息不对称理论
AI.method: 使用CMS Provider Data Catalog数据（经zReports Consumer Records Database™标准化处理），对全部14,695家活跃Medicare认证养老院进行横截面统计分析，按所有权类型和州别考察罚款分布，并比较联邦执法记录与消费者评论分数。
AI.findings: 46%的养老院至少有一项联邦民事罚款记录，99.6%的机构至少有一项检查缺陷记录；联邦执法记录与消费者评论分数之间存在系统性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了养老院联邦执法记录的全景式实证描述，揭示了监管执法与消费者感知之间的结构性脱节，为信息不对称和质量信号理论提供新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估CMS监管效能提供基础数据，为消费者在养老院选择中理解执法记录与评论分数的差异提供参考，有助于改进养老院质量信息披露机制。

title: Economic and Behavioural Determinants of Labour Underutilisation and Unemployment in Türkiye

detail.title: Economic and Behavioural Determinants of Labour Underutilisation and Unemployment in Türkiye
detail.abstract: This study examines the Turkish labour market in the context of the recent increase in labour underutilisation. The labour underutilisation rate is analysed alongside the unemployment rate to investigate whether these two indicators respond differently to economic and behavioural factors. To this end, separate regression models are estimated for the unemployment rate and the labour underutilisation rate. The models incorporate variables representing production, domestic demand, foreign trade, real exchange rate movements, expectation indicators, and dummy variables capturing the COVID-19 pandemic period. The findings suggest that the unemployment rate is primarily driven by production and demand conditions, whereas the labour underutilisation rate is more closely associated with expectations and labour market withdrawal behaviour. Overall, the results indicate that labour underutilisation captures hidden slack in the labour market and therefore provides valuable information beyond that conveyed by the conventional unemployment rate.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察土耳其劳动力市场在劳动力利用不足率上升背景下的表现，通过分别对失业率和劳动力利用不足率建立回归模型，发现失业率主要由生产和需求条件驱动，而劳动力利用不足率与预期和劳动力退出行为更密切相关，表明劳动力利用不足能够捕捉隐性劳动力市场闲置，提供超越传统失业率的额外信息。
AI.research_question: 失业率与劳动力利用不足率是否对经济和行为因素有不同的响应？劳动力利用不足是否能捕捉传统失业率无法反映的隐性劳动力市场闲置？
AI.motivation: 近年来土耳其劳动力利用不足率上升，但传统失业率可能未能完全反映劳动力市场的真实松弛状况，需要考察这两个指标是否存在差异化响应以更好地理解劳动力市场动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场指标理论、劳动力利用不足概念（包含隐性失业和劳动力退出行为）、失业决定因素理论（生产、需求、外贸、汇率、预期等因素）。
AI.method: 分别对失业率和劳动力利用不足率估计独立的回归模型，模型包含生产、国内需求、对外贸易、实际汇率变动、预期指标以及COVID-19疫情时期虚拟变量。
AI.findings: 失业率主要由生产和需求条件驱动，而劳动力利用不足率与预期和劳动力市场退出行为更紧密相关。劳动力利用不足能够捕捉隐性劳动力市场闲置，提供超越传统失业率的额外信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 研究表明劳动力利用不足率与失业率在驱动因素上存在系统性差异，丰富了劳动力市场指标的理论理解，强调劳动力利用不足率作为失业率补充指标的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更全面的劳动力市场状况评估工具，提示仅依赖失业率可能低估劳动力市场松弛程度，需结合劳动力利用不足率制定更精准的就业政策。

title: Education, Health and Social Systems European Mountain Series Forecasting
affiliations: and CBM International University

detail.title: Education, Health and Social Systems European Mountain Series Forecasting
detail.abstract: The article represents a plea for the regenerative development of education, health and the mountain social system. The paper analyzes these sectors at the European level, specifically for the studied countries such as Austria, Bulgaria, Czechia, Croatia, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Sweden. The research was carried out by applying the Tukey-Hamming model, using spectral analysis of forecasting for 2021-2025. The analyzed indicators can be found in supplementary data on the page https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14713867. The results of the study demonstrate the importance of developing new businesses in the researched sectors, which support the degree of employability in mountain areas. The article shows that in the coming period, rapid interventions are necessary at the level of the analyzed countries so that the entrepreneurial situation does not deteriorate in the related mountain areas.

AI.tldr: 本文呼吁教育、健康和山地社会系统的再生发展，对15个欧洲国家在2021-2025年期间运用Tukey-Hamming模型和频谱分析进行预测研究，结果表明这些部门新业务的发展对山地地区就业率至关重要，未来需要快速干预以防止创业状况恶化。
AI.research_question: 欧洲山地地区教育、健康和社会系统中新业务发展如何影响就业率？未来五年这些部门的发展趋势如何？
AI.motivation: 山地地区面临人口流失和社会经济衰退的挑战，需要再生发展策略来维持这些地区的活力，而教育、健康等相关部门的创业活动被认为是支撑就业的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tukey-Hamming模型（基于Tukey检验和Hamming距离的预测框架）、频谱分析（spectral analysis）
AI.method: 对15个欧洲国家（奥地利、保加利亚、捷克、克罗地亚、德国、希腊、西班牙、法国、意大利、波兰、葡萄牙、罗马尼亚、斯洛文尼亚、斯洛伐克、瑞典）应用Tukey-Hamming模型，结合频谱分析方法对2021-2025年进行预测，数据来源为Zenodo补充数据。
AI.findings: 研究结果表明，教育、健康和社会系统部门新业务的发展对于支撑山地地区的就业率具有重要意义；未来一段时期内，各分析国需要采取快速干预措施，以防止相关山地地区的创业状况恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Tukey-Hamming模型与频谱分析相结合应用于欧洲山地地区教育、健康和社会系统的预测研究，为山区再生发展的定量分析提供了新的方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为15个欧洲国家在山地地区教育、健康和社会系统领域的政策制定提供实证依据，指出这些国家需要在近期采取快速干预措施以维持和改善山地地区的创业和就业状况。

title: Grid Lock-in and the Geography of AI
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), Department of Economics and National University of Singapore (NUS), Department of Economics

detail.title: Grid Lock-in and the Geography of AI
detail.abstract: An electricity-intensive industry that arrives first can lock in scarce local grid capacity and foreclose the next. We study this grid lock-in between cannabis cultivation and the data centers that host cloud and AI computing. Using close recreational cannabis ballots in a difference-in-discontinuities design and measuring cultivation with a new satellite detection algorithm, we find that legalization raises detected indoor cultivation by 3.7 times the sample mean within five years. Retail electricity prices rise where cultivation expands. The active data center stock falls by 0.70 facilities per county and operating capacity by 16.2 megawatts. Data centers respond by avoiding these counties, anticipating higher future prices and longer interconnection queues. The effect propagates through the shared utility grid, reaching same-grid counties even in neighboring states, which also lose data centers. Competition for shared labor is absent. A discrete-choice model of siting implies that without legalization, operators would site more capacity in the narrowly passing states, and annual electricity bills there would be 15.6 billion dollars a year lower. Slow-adjusting grids let the industry that arrives first shape where the next can build, making grid capacity a determinant of the geography of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"电网锁定效应"：首先到达的高耗电行业（大麻种植）会锁定稀缺的本地电网容量，从而排挤后来的行业（数据中心）。利用娱乐性大麻合法化公投的近似断层设计和卫星检测算法，发现合法化使室内大麻种植五年内增至样本均值的3.7倍，零售电价上涨，数据中心活跃库存每县减少0.70个设施、运营容量减少16.2兆瓦。数据中心会主动规避这些县，且效应通过共享电网传播到邻州同电网县。若无合法化，运营商会在通过州建设更多容量，年电费将低156亿美元。
AI.research_question: 首先到达的高耗电行业是否会锁定稀缺的本地电网容量，从而排挤后来的行业（如数据中心）？具体而言，大麻合法化带来的室内种植扩张如何影响数据中心的空间选址和运营。
AI.motivation: 电网容量是稀缺且调整缓慢的资源，人工智能时代数据中心的扩张对电力需求激增。理解哪些因素决定数据中心的区位分布（特别是电网容量这一决定因素）对产业政策和城市规划具有重要价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电网锁定效应（grid lock-in）理论：在电网容量调整缓慢的约束下，先到达的高耗电用户会占用稀缺容量并提高电价和排队时间，形成对其他潜在用户的排挤效应。
AI.method: 采用近似的娱乐性大麻合法化公投结果进行断点回归（difference-in-discontinuities设计）；使用新的卫星检测算法测量室内大麻种植；构建离散选择模型分析数据中心选址。
AI.findings: （1）合法化使室内大麻种植五年内增至样本均值的3.7倍；（2）种植扩张推高零售电价；（3）数据中心活跃库存每县减少0.70个设施，运营容量减少16.2兆瓦；（4）数据中心主动规避这些县，预期未来更高价格和更长并网排队；（5）效应通过共享电网传播至邻州同电网县；（6）竞争劳动力不是机制；（7）反事实估计：若无合法化，运营商会在通过州多设点，年电费低156亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证验证了"电网锁定效应"这一概念，将电网容量确立为决定AI数据中心地理分布的重要决定因素，拓展了产业区位理论和基础设施经济学。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于电网规划、行业进入次序和产业竞争的实证依据；提示在大规模AI部署背景下，电网容量管理成为产业布局的关键政策杠杆。

title: Free Disposal with Costly Access
affiliations: , Virginia Tech and Virginia Tech - Department of Economics

detail.title: Free Disposal with Costly Access
detail.abstract: We study when richer information environments fail to preserve free disposal. Standard Blackwell logic applies once an experiment is available: additional information cannot hurt because it can be ignored or garbled. We study an earlier stage in which an agent must recover an experiment from a collection of raw objects. We define the access cost of a target experiment and show that preserving these costs is equivalent, under regularity, to ensuring that no Bayesian decision maker is worse off. In a ranked-validation model, access costs consist of the unavoidable cost of validating relevant objects and an overhead from screening irrelevant ones. As environments grow, access may be restored, remain persistently costly, or fail. An environment can preserve every fixed target while failing to support growing targets. Applied to knowledge production, this can redirect research, reduce growth, and create congestion externalities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了信息环境在更大时如何可能无法保持自由处置（free disposal）性质。与标准Blackwell逻辑不同（一旦实验可得，额外信息不会造成伤害），本文关注更早阶段：代理人需要从原始对象集合中恢复（recover）一个实验。文章定义了目标实验的获取成本（access cost），并证明在正则条件下，保持这些成本等价于确保没有任何贝叶斯决策者变得更糟。在排序验证模型中，获取成本由验证相关对象的不可避免成本和筛选无关对象的额外开销组成。随着环境扩大，获取可能被恢复、持续昂贵或完全失败。一个环境可以保持每个固定目标却无法支持不断增长的目标。应用于知识生产时，这会重新引导研究方向、降低增长并产生拥挤外部性。
AI.research_question: 更丰富的信息环境在何种条件下无法保持自由处置性质？当代理人需要从原始对象中恢复实验而非直接获得实验时，获取成本如何变化，以及这种变化如何影响决策者的福利和知识生产？
AI.motivation: 标准的Blackwell信息经济学逻辑认为更多信息永远不会伤害决策者，因为额外的信息可以被忽略或加噪处理。然而现实中，信息往往不是直接可得的，而是需要从原始的原始对象（raw objects）中恢复。当信息环境变得更大更复杂时，获取目标信息可能变得困难甚至不可能，这挑战了"信息越多越好"的传统假设。作者希望通过建模信息的恢复过程来理解这一局限性及其后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于Blackwell信息比较理论，对其进行扩展以涵盖信息的恢复阶段。引入了获取成本（access cost）的概念，并建立其与贝叶斯决策者福利之间的等价关系。在排序验证（ranked-validation）模型中，获取成本被分解为验证相关对象的不可避免成本与筛选无关对象产生的额外开销两部分。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学分析。作者构建了信息恢复的形式化模型，定义了目标实验的获取成本，证明了保持获取成本与保障贝叶斯决策者福利的等价性定理。在排序验证模型下，对获取成本进行了结构分解，并分析了环境规模扩大时的三种可能结果（恢复、持续昂贵、失败）。
AI.findings: （1）在正则条件下，保持获取成本的等价于确保没有贝叶斯决策者变得更糟；（2）排序验证模型中，获取成本=验证相关对象的不可避免成本+筛选无关对象的额外开销；（3）环境扩大时，获取可能被恢复、持续昂贵或完全失败；（4）环境可以保持每个固定目标但无法支持不断增长的目标；（5）在知识生产中，这会导致研究方向的重新定向、增长减缓以及拥挤外部性。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将Blackwell信息比较理论从"实验可得"阶段扩展到"实验恢复"阶段，弥补了传统理论忽略信息获取成本的缺陷；（2）建立了获取成本与贝叶斯决策者福利之间的一般等价性定理，为信息环境评估提供了新的理论基础；（3）揭示了"局部保持"与"全局保持"之间的非等价性——环境可以保持所有固定目标却无法支持增长目标；（4）为信息经济学中"信息越多越好"的传统直觉提供了重要限定条件。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为信息环境设计（如数据库、科研基础设施、知识平台）提供了评估框架，帮助理解何时扩展信息环境可能会适得其反；（2）在知识生产领域，揭示了信息过载可能导致研究方向被重定向、创新增长减缓以及拥挤外部性问题，对科研政策制定有重要启示；（3）为理解个体在信息筛选上的成本提供了定量方法，有助于设计更高效的信息检索与验证系统。

title: Innovativeness, A Focal Reference for Mountain Entrepreneurship in Construction. European Mountain Series Analysis (9)
affiliations: Universitatea din Oradea, CBM International University, Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy, Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy, , Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy, Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy and University of Oradea

detail.title: Innovativeness, A Focal Reference for Mountain Entrepreneurship in Construction. European Mountain Series Analysis (9)
detail.abstract: This study analyzes the dynamics of entrepreneurial activity in the mountain construction sector in Europe, focusing on the years 2021 and 2022, with extrapolation for 2025. Using a quantitative approach, the research adopts a mixed research design that includes both longitudinal and cross-sectional elements. Data were collected from official European sources, primarily Eurostat, and analyzed using advanced statistical techniques, including descriptive statistics, t-tests, ANOVA, regression, and factor analysis. The aim of the research is to provide a comprehensive understanding of trends, survival rates, business fluctuations, and employment patterns in mountain construction enterprises. During the analyzed period, the mountain entrepreneurship sector in construction across Europe recorded a moderate increase in the average of most financial and operational indicators (notably a general upward trend, high dispersion, positively skewed distributions, and performance polarization), despite persistently high levels of variation and marked positive skewness, indicating a concentration of performance among a limited number of entities. The results suggest a stable and moderately growing sector, characterized by small-sized enterprises with a steady survival rate and limited expansion. The study provides valuable insights for the formulation of policies aimed at supporting the long-term sustainable development of this sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2021-2022年欧洲山区建筑行业创业活动的动态，并外推至2025年。采用定量混合研究设计（纵向与横断面结合），基于Eurostat官方数据，运用描述性统计、t检验、ANOVA、回归和因子分析等高级统计技术。研究发现该行业指标温和增长，但分布高度离散且正偏斜，绩效集中于少数企业，呈现稳定但增长受限的小型企业特征。
AI.research_question: 欧洲山区建筑行业创业活动的动态趋势如何？具体包括企业生存率、商业波动和就业模式在2021-2022年及外推至2025年的演变特征。
AI.motivation: 山区建筑行业在欧洲具有重要的经济与区域发展意义，但缺乏对其创业动态的系统性实证研究，亟需基于官方数据提供全面理解，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业动态理论、企业生存与绩效分析框架、区域经济发展理论
AI.method: 定量研究方法，混合研究设计（结合纵向与横断面分析），数据来源于Eurostat等欧洲官方统计机构，采用描述性统计、t检验、ANOVA、回归分析及因子分析等统计技术。
AI.findings: 欧洲山区建筑创业行业在分析期间多数财务和运营指标呈现温和增长（普遍上升趋势、高离散度、正偏态分布、绩效极化），变化程度持续偏高且正偏态明显，表明绩效集中于少数企业。整体呈现稳定且适度增长的行业特征，以小型企业为主，生存率稳定但扩张有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 为山区建筑行业创业动力学的实证研究提供了系统性证据，揭示了该特殊地理区域创业活动的绩效分布特征与发展模式，丰富了山区创业与区域经济发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了支持山区建筑行业长期可持续发展的政策建议依据，有助于理解该行业的生存率、增长模式与就业结构，从而制定更具针对性的产业扶持政策。

title: Join or Wait? Seller Capability Development and Dynamic Platform Pricing
affiliations: Michigan State University - Department of Economics, Tsinghua University - Institute of Economics, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of International Trade and Economics and Department of Economics, Michigan State University

detail.title: Join or Wait? Seller Capability Development and Dynamic Platform Pricing
detail.abstract: Platforms use fee concessions to recruit sellers and costly support to build their capability. We develop a two-period model of a monopoly platform in which heterogeneous sellers choose when to enter, only early entrants acquire capability, and the platform cannot commit to future fees. Future entrant fees determine the value of waiting and hence the concession required for early entry. As the return to early capability rises, the unique limited-commitment equilibrium passes through four regimes: positive late entry, a zero-late-entry plateau, renewed early recruitment, and seller saturation. The plateau arises because recruiting an additional early seller lowers the waiting concession paid to the entire early cohort, a saving that disappears when late entry closes. At that boundary, the marginal early seller would earn no rent by waiting, yet the platform still subsidizes early entry to expand buyer-side revenue. With active late entry, greater capability front-loads seller entry yet expands period-2 participation on both sides. When the platform and sellers discount the future at the same rate, full commitment eliminates late entry but can reduce early recruitment. Whenever allocations differ across commitment regimes, full commitment raises platform profit while reducing period-2 participation on both sides and lowering social welfare, even though support intensity is unchanged. Thus, resolving the platform's time-inconsistency problem can benefit the platform at the expense of market development.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个垄断平台的两期模型，研究平台在无法承诺未来费用的情况下，如何通过费用优惠招募早期卖家并投资培养其能力。研究发现有限承诺均衡存在四个阶段，且解决平台的时间不一致问题虽能提升平台利润，却可能损害市场发展和社会福利。
AI.research_question: 垄断平台在无法承诺未来费用的条件下，如何通过费用优惠招募早期卖家以实现能力培养？不同承诺能力对平台利润、市场参与和社会福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 平台普遍面临时间不一致问题：前期为吸引卖家进入给予费用优惠，后期可能收取更高费用。现有文献对平台在无承诺能力下招募卖家的动态策略及其福利含义研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期垄断平台模型；有限承诺均衡；时间不一致性；异质性卖家进入决策理论
AI.method: 构建两期垄断平台理论模型，异质性卖家选择进入时机，仅早期进入者获得能力，平台无法承诺未来费用，通过均衡分析刻画有限承诺均衡的阶段特征。
AI.findings: （1）有限承诺均衡随早期能力回报上升经历四个阶段：正晚期进入、零晚期进入平台期、早期招募恢复、卖家饱和；（2）平台期的出现是因为招募额外早期卖家可降低支付给整个早期群体的等待优惠，这一节省在晚期进入关闭时消失；（3）在平台期边界，边际早期卖家等待无租金，但平台仍补贴其早期进入以扩大买家侧收入；（4）晚期进入活跃时，能力提升会前置卖家进入并扩大两期的双边参与；（5）完全承诺消除晚期进入但可能减少早期招募；（6）当分配在两种承诺制度间有差异时，完全承诺提升平台利润但减少第二期双边参与和社会福利，且支持强度不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了平台有限承诺下招募早期卖家的四阶段均衡结构；揭示了"等待优惠"的经济机制；阐明了承诺能力与市场发展之间的权衡关系；拓展了平台经济学中时间不一致性理论的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台制定卖家招募与费用策略提供理论指导；揭示平台增强承诺能力（如长期合约）可能损害市场发展和卖家参与；为监管者理解平台补贴卖家行为的福利后果提供分析框架。

title: Insuring the Fallback: Capacity, Monitoring and the Third Audience in Competence Signalling under Improving AI

detail.title: Insuring the Fallback: Capacity, Monitoring and the Third Audience in Competence Signalling under Improving AI
detail.abstract: When generative AI makes the deliverable uninformative, what a professional services provider can still certify is the preserved human capability to catch the machine's error, and the instrument that certifies it is a liability pledge whose expected cost falls in that capability. The pledge is credible only up to what the provider can stand behind, and in practice that ceiling is supplied by an underwriter. We make the underwriter a strategic third actor who chooses how much of the pledge to bear and how precisely to monitor the insured's engagement policy. Two objects govern everything: the informational retention ψ = r + (1 + λ)(1-r)m, the share of the pledge's expected cost that varies with the provider's type, and the pooled load ξ = (1 + λ)(1-r)(1-m), the share that does not. Single crossing survives if and only if ψ > 0, so full cover from a blind underwriter destroys separation outright. We then prove a capacity-illusion result: the largest ticket that can be served under separation is proportional to the effective informational capacity Ĉ = ψ L, and max r Ĉ = W + (1 + λ)mK at a retention r * = W/(W + K) that does not depend on m. With a blind underwriter this collapses to the provider's own capital W exactly: third-party capacity is informationally worthless, however large. Monitoring is what converts capacity into credibility, and it does so at a linear rate. Two further results follow. Cover erodes the fallback stock it insures only when the underwriter is blind: the engagement abandonment threshold shifts by 43% of its uninsured value at m = 0 and by 1.0% at m = 1. And because a monitoring underwriter partly reveals what the pledge was meant to signal, the demand for client-facing certification is hump-shaped in monitoring precision whenever underwriting information is disclosed. A stochastic market with censored verification records confirms that incentive compatibility survives noisy beliefs, with the deviation from truth-telling falling at rate n-1/2 .

AI.tldr: 本文研究在生成式AI使交付物无信息量的情况下，专业服务提供商如何通过责任承诺（liability pledge）来认证其保留的"捕捉机器错误"的人类能力。研究引入承保人作为战略第三方，分析了信息保留度和池化载荷如何决定分离均衡的存在性，并证明了"能力幻觉"结果与监控在将能力转化为可信度中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI使交付物缺乏信息量的背景下，专业服务提供商如何通过责任承诺和承保机制来可信地认证其人类能力？承保人的监控与承保比例如何影响分离均衡的存在性和服务能力上限？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI使得专业服务的交付物本身不再具有信息区分度，传统基于交付质量的信号机制失效。此时服务提供商能认证的是其发现机器错误的能力，而这种认证工具是责任承诺。但承诺的可信度受限于提供商自身的资本，实践中需要承保人参与。本文旨在理论上刻画这一新型认证机制的经济学结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学中的信号传递理论（signaling theory）、分离均衡（separating equilibrium）、责任承诺/担保机制（liability pledge）、保险与再保险理论中的承保与监控框架。
AI.method: 本文采用博弈论建模方法，构建包含提供商、客户和承保人三方参与的理论模型。模型引入两个核心参数：信息保留度ψ和池化载荷ξ，分析单交（single crossing）条件、分离均衡的存在性与特征，并通过随机市场模型（含截断验证记录）验证激励相容性的稳健性。
AI.findings: （1）单交条件成立当且仅当ψ>0，意味着承保人全额承保且不监控会完全摧毁分离；（2）能力幻觉结果：分离下最大可服务规模正比于有效信息容量Ĉ=ψL，且保留率r*=W/(W+K)与监控精度m无关；盲目承保下第三方能力在信息上完全无价值；（3）监控以线性速率将能力转化为可信度；（4）承保侵蚀备付存量仅在承保人盲目时发生，放弃阈值在m=0时偏移43%，m=1时仅1.0%；（5）客户面向的认证需求随监控精度呈驼峰形；（6）随机市场中激励相容在噪声信念下仍成立，偏离真实报告的概率以n^(-1/2)速率衰减。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文扩展了信号传递理论，引入承保人作为战略第三方，刻画了"责任承诺+承保监控"的新型认证机制。提出信息保留度与池化载荷作为统一分析框架的双核心参数，证明了"能力幻觉"定理，并揭示了监控在信息转化中的线性作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专业服务行业在AI时代提供认证策略指导：承保人的监控精度对服务商的可信度建设至关重要；盲目承保不仅无益反而有害；认证需求随监控精度呈驼峰形意味着存在最优监控精度选择；为AI辅助下的专业服务定价和风险分担提供理论依据。

title: Innovativeness, A Focal Reference of Mountain Entrepreneurship in Construction. European Mountain Series Forecasting (9)
affiliations: Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy, CBM International University, Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy, Universitatea din Oradea, , Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy, Centre for Mountain Economy of the Romanian Academy and University of Oradea

detail.title: Innovativeness, A Focal Reference of Mountain Entrepreneurship in Construction. European Mountain Series Forecasting (9)
detail.abstract: Mountain entrepreneurship in the European construction sector faces significant challenges, stemming from the natural, geographical, and economic difficulties of high-altitude areas, particularly in Southeastern Europe. This article investigates the dynamics of mountain construction enterprises and identifies the factors of sustainability, vulnerability, and competitiveness that influence their performance. The study is based on substantial quantitative analysis, applying ARIMA models to a set of economic indicators collected from European databases (Eurostat), complemented by a synthesis of relevant literature. The results highlight high levels of forecasting uncertainty, reflecting the inherent volatility of these regions and countries. Nevertheless, certain trends related to firm survival, their size, and their impact on employment can be anticipated. The study emphasizes the importance of political support, entrepreneurial education, and innovation in enhancing the resilience of mountain SMEs. The paper proposes an integrated approach combining public policies, infrastructure, education, and digitalization to transform the mountain construction sector into a viable pillar of sustainable local, regional, national, and European development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧洲建筑行业中山区创业面临的挑战，特别是在东南欧高海拔地区。通过定量分析（ARIMA模型）和文献综述，识别了影响山区建筑企业绩效的可持续性、脆弱性和竞争力因素，并提出了综合性的政策支持框架。
AI.research_question: 欧洲建筑行业中的山区企业如何实现可持续发展？影响其绩效的可持续性、脆弱性和竞争力因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 山区建筑行业面临自然、地理和经济等多重困难，尤其在东南欧地区，但这些企业的生存和发展动态尚未得到充分研究。理解这些企业面临的挑战和机遇，对于促进区域可持续发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可持续性、脆弱性和竞争力三个维度的理论框架，结合山区创业的特殊情境进行分析。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，对来自Eurostat的经济指标数据应用ARIMA模型进行预测，同时辅以相关文献的综合综述。
AI.findings: 预测不确定性较高，反映了这些地区和国家的内在波动性。但企业生存、规模和就业影响方面存在可预测的趋势。政治支持、创业教育和创新对增强山区中小企业的韧性至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将山区创业视为独特的分析情境，丰富了创业和企业韧性理论在特殊地理环境下的应用，提出了山区中小企业可持续性的综合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种综合性方法，结合公共政策、基础设施、教育和数字化，将山区建筑行业转变为可持续的地方、区域、国家和欧洲发展的可行支柱，为政策制定者提供实践指导。

title: Semiconductor Industry Development in Taiwan and the Philippines Comparative Insights for the Global South
affiliations: National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies (GRIPS), University of the Philippines and University of the Philippines Diliman

detail.title: Semiconductor Industry Development in Taiwan and the Philippines Comparative Insights for the Global South
detail.abstract:
Main argument: We argue that the contrasting fortunes of the Taiwan and Philippine semiconductor industries are best explained by the differences in how their respective states deployed industrial policies and institutions in shaping development outcomes, particularly across four key areas: public R&D institutions, industrial governance and strategy, industrial clustering and state business-academia relations, and scientific and technical human capital policies.

Policy landscape: Today, semiconductors are the leading exports for these two political economies. Both their industries started at a more or less similar footing, tracing their origins as assembly, testing, and packaging (ATP) hubs back to the late 1960s. Their paths have since diverged: Taiwan was able to build a fully integrated ecosystem that spans design, fabrication, and advanced packaging and testing, while the Philippines remains largely confined to low-value ATP with no domestic fabrication capacity to date.

Methods: The study compares Taiwan and the Philippines as cases that shared a relatively similar starting point in labor-intensive ATP in the late 1960s but diverged in outcomes. We examine the policies and institutional arrangements each deployed, particularly during the critical period from the 1970s to the 1990s, when the foundations of their respective industries were laid.

Findings: Taiwan's ascent to global leadership in semiconductor manufacturing was neither haphazard nor simply the outcome of unfettered market forces, but the result of industrial vision combined with strategic orchestration of public R&D (most notably ITRI), industrial clustering in the Hsinchu Science Park, and an educational system tailored to the industry's needs — a purposeful symbiosis of the state, academia, and industry that produced a self-reinforcing ecosystem conducive to industrial upgrading. The Philippines' experience, by contrast, underscores the consequences of fragmented governance, risk-averse public R&D, and an educational system insufficiently oriented towards industrial priorities. 

Policy recommendations: We propose that developing countries (1) rethink the mandate of public R&D institutions to allow calculated risktaking and a tolerance for failure; (2) have the state co-invest with the private sector in capital-intensive, strategically important segments of the value chain, socializing not only the risks but also the rewards of public investment; (3) strengthen governance arrangements and expert advisory platforms to overcome information asymmetry and coordination failures; (4) place equal emphasis on building firms' absorptive capacities along with frontier R&D; (5) anchor human capital development explicitly in industrial strategy, including TVET reform and the mobilization of diaspora professionals through "brain circulation"; (6) pursue industrial clustering as a deliberate and coordinated strategy rather than a passive by-product of investment promotion; and (7) strategically leverage the evolving geopolitical landscape to extract developmental concessions, such as technology transfer.

Conclusion: For the Philippines and similarly situated economies in the Global South, moving up the technological ladder will require a more proactive approach to industrial policy, institutional reconfiguration, and a fundamental rethinking of how development is understood and pursued.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比台湾与菲律宾半导体产业截然不同的发展路径，论证国家工业政策和制度安排在塑造产业发展结果中的关键作用。台湾凭借公共R&D机构（尤其是工研院）、新竹科学园的产业集聚、以及面向产业需求的教育体系，构建了从设计到制造再到先进封测的完整产业生态；而菲律宾因治理碎片化、公共R&D风险规避和教育体系与产业脱节，至今仍困于低附加值封测环节。研究提出了七项针对发展中国家的政策建议，强调国家在产业升级中的积极角色。
AI.research_question: 为什么起点相似的台湾和菲律宾半导体产业在发展结果上出现了巨大分化？国家工业政策和制度安排在塑造这一差异化结果中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 台湾和菲律宾的半导体产业均起源于20世纪60年代末的劳动密集型封装测试（ATP）环节，但此后发展路径截然不同——台湾建成了涵盖设计、制造和先进封测的完整产业生态，而菲律宾至今仍局限于低附加值ATP且无本土制造能力。理解这一分化对于全球南方国家制定产业升级战略具有重要启示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文以发展型国家理论和产业政策理论为分析框架，强调国家在产业升级中的战略协调和制度设计作用，涉及公共R&D制度、产业治理、产业集聚、政产学关系及科技人力资本等理论维度。
AI.method: 采用比较案例研究方法，以台湾和菲律宾为对照案例，二者在20世纪60年代末拥有相似的劳动密集型ATP起点但结果分化。研究重点考察1970年代至1990年代关键时期两国各自部署的政策和制度安排。
AI.findings: 台湾的半导体崛起是产业愿景与国家战略协调的结果，包括工研院为代表的公共R&D机构、新竹科学园的产业集聚、以及面向产业需求的教育体系——形成了国家、学术界与产业界的共生关系，产生了自我强化的产业升级生态系统。相比之下，菲律宾因治理碎片化、公共R&D风险规避、教育体系与产业需求脱节而受限。
AI.theory_contributions: ①通过系统比较两个起点相似但结果迥异的案例，为发展型国家理论提供了新的经验证据；②将国家角色从简单的市场干预拓展为制度设计者、生态构建者和战略协调者；③强调产业政策的系统性，而非单一政策工具的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了七项针对发展中国家的政策建议：改革公共R&D机构授权以允许风险承担；国家与私营部门共担资本密集型关键环节的投资风险与回报；加强治理安排和专家咨询平台以克服信息不对称；均衡发展企业吸收能力与前沿研发；将人力资本发展与产业战略挂钩（含职教改革和"人才环流"）；将产业集聚作为有意协调的战略而非被动副产品；战略利用地缘政治格局获取技术转移等发展性让步。

title: The Value of Voting and Political Polarization: A Spatial Model with Costly Turnout
affiliations: Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE)

detail.title: The Value of Voting and Political Polarization: A Spatial Model with Costly Turnout
detail.abstract: Political polarization in the United States has risen steadily, at odds with the classical prediction that vote competition pushes candidates toward the center. We present a spatial competition model that explains this without changing what candidates want: they only care about winning. Voting is costly, so a candidate who moves toward the center to win undecided voters also weakens her own supporters' incentive to turn out, since turnout falls with distance from her platform. This trade-off, absent from the classical model, keeps candidates from converging to the median voter. Polarization is governed by an interpretable variable: the mean net value of voting, i.e., how much the average voter gains from voting, net of its cost. As this value falls, mobilizing the base becomes relatively more rewarding than persuading the center, and platforms move further apart-driven entirely by voters' incentive to vote, not by candidates' ideology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个空间竞争模型，通过引入投票成本来解释美国政治极化现象。关键机制是：候选人向中间靠拢以争取摇摆选民的同时，会削弱自己核心支持者的投票动力（因为支持者与候选人平台的距离越远，其投票动机越低）。这一权衡导致候选人不收敛到中间选民位置，且极化程度由"投票的平均净值"这一可解释变量决定。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国政治极化持续上升，与古典空间竞争模型预测的候选人向中间收敛相矛盾？如何在不改变候选人目标（只关心获胜）的前提下解释极化？
AI.motivation: 古典空间竞争模型（median voter theorem）预测两党候选人会向中间选民收敛，但现实中美政治极化日益加剧，这一理论预测与经验事实严重不符。现有解释往往需要引入候选人意识形态偏好等假设，本文试图仅从选民的投票激励出发解释极化现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间竞争模型（spatial competition model），结合投票成本理论（costly voting theory）和选民参与率（turnout）内生化的框架。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与分析：在标准空间竞争模型中引入投票成本，使选民投票参与率内生决定——选民支持者与候选人之间的距离越远，投票动机越低。在此基础上分析候选人在"争取中间选民"与"动员核心支持者"之间的策略性权衡。
AI.findings: 1) 在投票有成本的情况下，候选人不会收敛到中间选民位置；2) 极化程度由"投票的平均净值"（平均选民从投票中获得的净收益）决定；3) 当投票净价值下降时，动员核心支持者比说服中间选民更具相对回报，政治平台将进一步分化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 在不改变候选人目标（仅追求获胜）的假设下，仅通过投票成本内生化的机制解释了政治极化；2) 提出了"投票平均净值"这一可解释且可量化的极化驱动变量；3) 弥合了古典空间竞争理论预测与现实经验观察之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为理解美国政治极化提供了新的理论视角，指出降低投票成本或提升投票价值可能缓解极化；2) 为政策制定者提供了可操作的干预方向——通过改善投票体验、降低参与成本来抑制政治分化。

title: Insurers and Real Estate Credit
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Business School, Bank for International Settlements,  and Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

detail.title: Insurers and Real Estate Credit

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded in part by the Fama-Miller Center for Research in Finance at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

detail.abstract: Life insurance companies hold about $650 billion in commercial mortgages in the United States, yet little is known about their role as suppliers of real estate credit. Using regulatory data covering the universe of mortgage loans held by U.S. life insurers, we show that insurers complete this market, dominating long-maturity, low-leverage lending. We then show that aggregate macroeconomic shocks, specifically changes in interest rates, transmit differently through insurers than through banks. When rates rise, banks cut lending and raise loan rates, while insurers expand lending and reduce loan spreads, without loosening loan-to-value ratios. Insurers' expansion is concentrated in shorter-maturity loans, a segment otherwise dominated by banks. We find that two reinforcing mechanisms explain insurers' response. Rising rates generate inflows into guaranteed-return products and narrow the duration gap embedded in insurers' long-dated liabilities, lowering the shadow cost of holding shorter-duration mortgage assets. At the same time, bank retrenchment shifts part of the residual borrower demand toward insurers. We isolate credit supply by exploiting cross-sectional variation in insurers' liability and asset durations, local exposure to bank retrenchment, and granular time-varying fixed effects. Our findings imply that bank-centered analyses may misstate the contraction in real estate credit when rates rise, and that monetary tightening reallocates credit not only across intermediaries, but also across maturities and borrowers.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国寿险公司全部抵押贷款监管数据，发现寿险公司是商业抵押贷款市场的重要供给者，主导长期限、低杠杆贷款。当利率上升时，银行收缩贷款而寿险公司扩张贷款并降低利差，但未放松贷款价值比。寿险公司的扩张集中在银行主导的短期限贷款领域，这一现象由利率上升带来的保证回报产品资金流入和久期缺口收窄两个机制驱动。
AI.research_question: 美国寿险公司作为房地产信贷供给者的角色是什么？利率变动如何通过寿险公司与银行产生不同的信贷传导效应？
AI.motivation: 寿险公司持有约6500亿美元的商业抵押贷款，但作为房地产信贷供给者的角色鲜为人知；现有研究多集中于银行信贷渠道，忽视了寿险公司在货币政策传导中的独特作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷供给与需求理论、久期匹配理论、金融中介资产负债表传导机制
AI.method: 利用覆盖美国寿险公司全部抵押贷款组合的监管数据，采用交叉截面差异（保险公司资产与负债久期、银行收缩的本地暴露）和颗粒化时变固定效应来识别信贷供给。
AI.findings: 利率上升时，银行削减贷款并提高贷款利率，而寿险公司扩张贷款并降低贷款利差，且未放松LTV比率；寿险公司的扩张集中在短期限贷款领域；两个机制解释了这一反应：利率上升带来保证回报产品的资金流入，收窄了长期负债中的久期缺口，降低了持有短久期抵押资产的影子成本；同时银行收缩将部分剩余借款需求转移给寿险公司。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了金融中介异质性视角下的货币政策传导理论，揭示了非银行金融机构（寿险公司）在信贷周期中发挥的逆周期和互补作用；丰富了关于信贷供给识别的研究方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和研究者仅基于银行的分析可能误判利率上升时房地产信贷的实际收缩程度；货币政策紧缩不仅会在不同类型中介机构之间重新配置信贷，还会在不同期限和借款人之间进行重新分配。
