reference: Protect Borrowers Research Paper - The Worst of Both Worlds: An Investigation of State Student Loan Lending
title: The Worst of Both Worlds: An Investigation of State Student Loan Lending
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Worst of Both Worlds: An Investigation of State Student Loan Lending

publicationDetails.detailsText: Protect Borrowers Research Paper - The Worst of Both Worlds: An Investigation of State Student Loan Lending

detail.abstract:
Most people think that there are two types of loans students can take out to attend college: federal student loans and private student loans. However, a third option exists: loans from state agencies or quasi-governmental nonprofits. Over half of states have some sort of state agency, legislature-created nonprofit, or other state entity that lends student loans directly to students. 

State student loans are marketed as coming from the government and thus signaling a more "trusted" source, which is a better option than private loans. Their superiority to traditional private student loans, however, is questionable at best. Many state loans more closely resemble private student loans, with high and variable interest rates, limited repayment options, co-signer requirements, and harsh default provisions, than federal loans. In fact, state student loans combine the worst of both private loans and federal loans. They have unfavorable terms and the state creditor has heightened collection powers and protections. 

In light of President Trump's efforts to downsize the federal government, including the expressed goal of closing the Department of Education and "sending education back to the states," as well as the strict new federal lending limits passed in 2025 and taking effect in 2026 as part of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, it is likely that there will be a rise in state student lending. Unless and until scholars and policymakers understand the realities of state student lending programs, such a move will cause increased harm to America's college students. 

This Article offers an empirical look at state student loan programs, collecting and collating state student loan options that exist across the country. It identifies and analyzes the types of state student loans offered, their repayment terms, cancellation options, and other features. This Article analyzes the state student loan options that exist across the country, including the types of loans offered, repayment terms, cancellation options, as well as some of the ways in which state student loans impact borrowers in uniquely harmful ways. This analysis leads to the Article's primary conclusion: as currently designed, state student loans are uniquely harmful to borrowers as compared to private and federal student loans.

AI.tldr: 本文对美国各州的学生贷款项目进行了实证研究，发现州学生贷款在宣传上被包装为"政府来源、更可信"的选项，但实际上其条款更接近私人贷款（高利率、有限还款选项、需共同签署人、严苛违约条款），同时州政府作为债权人还拥有更强的追偿权力和保护，因此结合了私人贷款和联邦贷款的劣势，对借款人造成独特伤害。在联邦政府缩减教育部、新的贷款限制生效的背景下，州学生贷款预计将增加，本文呼吁政策制定者正视这一问题。
AI.research_question: 美国各州学生贷款项目的实际特征是什么？它们与联邦学生贷款和私人学生贷款相比，在条款设计和借款人影响上有何差异？
AI.motivation: 大多数人对学生贷款的了解仅限于联邦和私人两种类型，忽视了第三种选择——州政府或准政府非营利机构的贷款。随着联邦政府缩减教育职能（包括教育部关闭计划）以及2025年《One Big Beautiful Bill Act》设定更严格的联邦贷款限额（2026年生效），州学生贷款预计将大幅增加。但学术界和政策制定者对其现实状况缺乏系统了解，这种认知空白可能导致对学生的伤害加剧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用实证分析框架，通过对全美各州学生贷款项目的系统收集与整理，基于贷款条款比较的视角进行分析，涉及的维度包括：贷款类型、还款条款、取消选项、违约条款、债权人权力等方面。
AI.method: 实证研究方法：系统收集和整理全美各州现有的学生贷款项目数据，对这些贷款的类型、还款期限、取消选项及其他特征进行识别和分析，并将州学生贷款与联邦贷款和私人贷款进行对比。
AI.findings: 1）超过一半的州设有某种形式的州机构、立法创设的非营利组织或其他州实体直接向学生提供贷款。2）州学生贷款在营销上被标榜为"来自政府"因而更可信，但其条款实际上更接近私人贷款：高且可变的利率、有限的还款选项、共同签署人要求、严苛的违约条款。3）州学生贷款结合了私人贷款和联邦贷款的最差方面：既有不利的贷款条款，州债权人又拥有更强的追偿权力和保护。4）总体结论：按当前设计，州学生贷款对借款人的伤害独特地高于私人贷款和联邦贷款。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文填补了学生贷款研究中对州学生贷款这一被忽视的第三种贷款类型的学术空白，提供了首个系统性的实证概况，揭示州学生贷款"结合两类贷款最差特征"的结构性缺陷，为后续研究提供了数据基础和分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于州学生贷款项目现实状况的全面认知，警示在联邦政府缩减教育职能的趋势下州学生贷款扩张可能带来的危害，呼吁政策制定者在推动"教育权力回归各州"之前必须理解州学生贷款的真实运作机制，以避免对美国大学生造成更大伤害。

title: Unconventional Monetary Policy and Redistribution
affiliations: Wake Forest University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Unconventional Monetary Policy and Redistribution
detail.abstract: We study the transmission and optimal use of quantitative easing (QE) in a tractable New Keynesian model with segmented long-bond markets and households that differ in spending horizons and net duration exposure. Central-bank purchases compress term premia and redistribute valuation gains and cash flows across households. Because the resulting consumption allocation affects both aggregate demand and wage setting, a given yield response does not imply a unique macroeconomic effect. A second-order welfare approximation yields a quadratic loss in the output gap, wage inflation, and the retiree-worker consumption gap. Under the restricted dual mandate, QE is used for the stabilization benefits generated by its distributional transmission, mainly through aggregate demand. Internalizing the direct welfare cost of the consumption gap materially scales back and changes the timing of the optimal balance-sheet path. When used jointly with the short rate, QE improves stabilization by operating on a margin not fully spanned by short-rate policy, but it performs poorly as a stand-alone substitute.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个可处理的New Keynesian模型中研究量化宽松（QE）的传导与最优使用。模型包含分割的长期债券市场和具有不同支出期限及净久期敞口的家庭部门。央行购买债券压缩期限溢价，并在家庭间重新分配估值收益和现金流。由于由此产生的消费配置同时影响总需求和工资设定，给定的收益率响应并不对应唯一的宏观经济效应。二阶福利近似产生关于产出缺口、工资通胀和退休者-工人消费缺口的二次损失函数。在受限双重使命下，QE主要用于其分配传导带来的稳定收益，主要通过总需求渠道。内生化消费缺口的直接福利成本会显著缩减并改变最优资产负债表路径的时间安排。与短期利率联合使用时，QE通过在短期利率政策无法完全覆盖的边际上运作来改善稳定效果，但作为独立替代工具表现不佳。
AI.research_question: 量化宽松（QE）在何种条件下应被最优地使用？其分配传导机制如何影响宏观经济稳定和福利？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对QE的传导机制和最优政策设计缺乏统一框架，特别是其分配效应在福利分析中的角色未被充分理解。本文旨在提供一个可处理的模型来阐明QE的分配传导渠道及其对最优货币政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: New Keynesian模型；分割的长期债券市场；家庭异质性（支出期限和净久期敞口差异）；二阶福利近似
AI.method: 构建一个包含分割长期债券市场和异质性家庭（退休者与工人）的可处理New Keynesian模型，通过二阶福利近似推导损失函数，并分析最优QE政策路径。
AI.findings: （1）央行债券购买压缩期限溢价并在家庭间重新分配估值收益与现金流；（2）给定的收益率响应并不对应唯一的宏观经济效应，因为消费配置同时影响总需求和工资设定；（3）在受限双重使命下，QE的稳定收益主要来自其分配性传导的总需求渠道；（4）内生化消费缺口的福利成本会显著缩减最优资产负债表规模并改变其时间路径；（5）QE与短期利率联合使用时可改善稳定效果，但作为独立替代工具表现不佳。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将QE的分配性传导机制纳入最优货币政策分析框架；（2）提出一个同时包含产出缺口、工资通胀和消费缺口的二次损失函数；（3）阐明QE分配渠道与短期利率政策之间的互补性与替代性边界。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为央行最优资产负债表政策提供理论指导，说明QE应与其他货币政策工具联合使用而非独立使用；（2）提示政策制定者关注QE的分配效应及其福利成本；（3）为受限双重使命框架下的QE操作时机和规模提供政策建议。

title: Energy Trade Rewiring after the Russia Shock

detail.title: Energy Trade Rewiring after the Russia Shock
detail.abstract:
How resilient are global trade networks to large geopolitical ruptures? I exploit the 2022 Russia-Ukraine war as a quasi-natural experiment to study how pre-shock dependence on a dominant supplier shapes post-shock trade network reorganization. Using product-level bilateral trade data from 2017-2024 and a difference-indifferences design with importer-exporter and exporter-year fixed effects, I estimate how prewar Russian energy dependence (θ jp) predicts bilateral reallocation toward alternative suppliers after 2022. 
     Importers more dependent on Russian energy exhibit significantly larger post-shock increases in bilateral trade with non-Russian suppliers (β = 1.323, p < 0.001), with effects strengthening through 2024. Among non-EU importers facing no policy mandate, the estimate rises to 1.616 (p = 0.003), confirming that the relationship reflects market-driven adjustment rather than sanctions compliance. A striking asymmetry qualifies this finding: despite large bilateral reallocation, ex-Russia supplier concentration shows no statistically significant decline across any energy product. Among highexposure importers, the top three alternative exporters absorbed 97% of redirected gas flows and 88% of oil flows. Countries pivoted from one concentrated relationship to another rather than broadening their supplier base. Adjustment is fastest in oil markets, where global commodity fungibility and maritime flexibility lower switching costs, and slowest in gas markets, where pipeline dependence and long-term contracts impose structural rigidities. Within gas, LNG-access importers exhibit a reallocation coefficient of 3.90 against 0.83 for pipeline-only importers (the latter statistically indistinguishable from zero), confirming that infrastructure-not willingness-is the binding constraint on adjustment speed. 
      These findings contribute to the literature on trade resilience and economic fragmentation by showing that concentration governs both the fragility of trade networks and the intensity of their reorganization after disruption. The welfare implications for energy security depend critically on whether bilateral reallocation reflects genuine diversification or merely transfers supplier dependence to a new dominant exporter.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2022年俄乌战争作为准自然实验，研究战前对主导供应商（俄罗斯能源）的依赖如何影响战后贸易网络的重组。研究发现，对俄罗斯能源依赖度更高的进口国在战后显著增加了与非俄供应商的双边贸易（β=1.323, p<0.001），且这种效应持续增强到2024年。然而，尽管双边贸易大幅重新配置，但俄罗斯供应商集中度并未显著下降——高暴露进口国中前三大替代出口商吸收了97%的天然气流和88%的石油流。各国只是从一种集中关系转向另一种集中关系，而非真正拓宽供应商基础。调整速度在石油市场最快（商品可互换性和海运灵活性），天然气市场最慢（管道依赖和长期合同刚性），其中LNG进口国的重新配置系数（3.90）显著高于纯管道进口国（0.83，统计上不显著）。
AI.research_question: 战前对主导供应商的依赖如何塑造冲击后贸易网络的重组模式？具体而言，对俄罗斯能源的高依赖是否导致进口国向替代供应商进行双边贸易重新配置，以及这种重新配置是否反映真正的多样化还是仅转移了供应商集中度？
AI.motivation: 全球贸易网络面临的地缘政治断裂日益加剧（如俄乌战争），但现有文献对贸易网络在面对大型地缘政治冲击时的韧性及其重组机制理解不足。理解贸易网络如何在集中与多样化之间重新平衡，对能源安全和地缘政治风险评估具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易网络韧性理论、经济碎片化（economic fragmentation）理论、供应商集中度与切换成本理论、商品可互换性（fungibility）与基础设施刚性理论
AI.method: 准自然实验（quasi-natural experiment）：利用2022年俄乌战争作为外生冲击；使用2017-2024年产品层面双边贸易数据；采用双重差分（difference-in-differences）设计，包含进口国-出口国和出口国-年份固定效应；关键解释变量为战前俄罗斯能源依赖度（θ_jp）。
AI.findings: （1）对俄罗斯能源依赖度更高的进口国在战后显著增加了与非俄供应商的双边贸易（β=1.323, p<0.001），效应持续增强至2024年；（2）非欧盟进口国（无政策强制要求）的系数上升至1.616，表明调整是市场驱动而非制裁合规所致；（3）关键不对称发现：尽管双边贸易大幅重新配置，俄罗斯供应商集中度并未显著下降——前三大替代出口商吸收了97%的天然气和88%的石油流，即从一种集中转移到另一种集中；（4）调整速度呈市场化差异：石油最快（商品可互换性和海运灵活性），天然气最慢（管道依赖和长期合同刚性）；（5）在天然气内部，LNG进口国的重新配置系数为3.90，而纯管道进口国仅为0.83（统计上不显著），证实基础设施是调整速度的约束条件而非意愿问题。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将贸易网络韧性理论与集中度概念结合，表明集中度既是贸易网络脆弱性的来源，也是冲击后重组强度的驱动因素；（2）揭示了贸易网络重组中的"集中转移"现象——即使双边贸易重新配置发生，供应商集中度未必下降，挑战了"贸易重组必然带来多样化"的直觉假设；（3）区分了市场驱动调整与政策强制调整，识别出基础设施（而非意愿）是贸易调整速度的绑定约束。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者评估能源安全提供新视角：双边贸易重新配置不能等同于多样化，需以供应商集中度而非贸易流向为政策监测指标；（2）提示各国和企业在能源供应链韧性规划中应优先投资LNG基础设施和灵活供应渠道，以降低切换成本；（3）为理解经济碎片化背景下贸易政策的有效性提供了实证基础，表明市场力量在无政策强制时同样会驱动调整。

title:
Bridging The Capital Gap:
Financing Public Infrastructure in Small and Rural Municipalities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Bridging The Capital Gap:
Financing Public Infrastructure in Small and Rural Municipalities

declarations.funderStatement: Personal research

detail.abstract:
America's small and rural communities host the critical agricultural hubs, energy generation networks, and manufacturing centers that feed, power, and sustain the nation's primary metropolitan areas. Yet, thousands of these municipalities face persistent, systemic barriers to financing the essential public infrastructure, including water treatment facilities, transit corridors, and broadband networks, that underpins national economic health and interstate supply chain security. While the United States maintains a sophisticated $4 trillion municipal bond ecosystem, this market has grown increasingly inaccessible to small-scale issuers due to structural market inefficiencies, disproportionate fixed issuance costs, and an acute post-Dodd-Frank independent municipal advisory gap.

This working paper details a scalable, multi-pronged strategic framework designed to democratize capital access for underserved government issuers. By synthesizing advanced public administration protocols with quantitative accounting data models, this framework provides actionable pathways for expanding regional pooled financing, mitigating accounting-driven yield penalties, and optimizing bank-qualified bond direct placements. Crucially, the analysis demonstrates that bridging this capital gap requires improved access to specialized municipal finance expertise, stronger financial management practices, and expanded utilization of independent fiduciary advisory services.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多管齐下的战略框架，旨在通过扩大区域化集合融资、缓解会计驱动的收益率惩罚以及优化银行合格债券直接配售，来解决美国小型和农村社区市政债券融资难的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何为美国被忽视的小型和农村政府发行人扩大资本获取渠道，克服结构性市场低效和融资障碍？
AI.motivation: 美国数千个小型和农村市政当局在融资关键公共基础设施（水处理设施、交通走廊、宽带网络）方面面临系统性障碍，尽管美国拥有4万亿美元的市政债券生态系统，但因结构性市场低效、不成比例的固定发行成本和后多德-弗兰克时期的独立市政咨询缺口，小型发行人越来越难以进入该市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共行政管理协议与定量会计数据模型的综合框架
AI.method: 综合公共行政管理协议与定量会计数据模型，构建可扩展的多管齐下战略框架，涵盖区域化集合融资、会计驱动的收益率调节和银行合格债券直接配售优化。
AI.findings: 弥合资本缺口需要：（1）改善对专业市政融资专业知识的获取；（2）加强财务管理实践；（3）扩大独立受托咨询服务的使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共行政管理理论与定量会计模型相结合，为市政融资领域的资本获取问题提供了系统性的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市政官员提供了可操作的融资路径，包括区域化集合融资、缓解会计驱动的收益率惩罚以及优化银行合格债券直接配售，有助于增强国家经济健康和州际供应链安全。

title: Promises, Promises: Governance and Growth in India under Modi and the BJP
affiliations: Texas Tech University and Texas Tech University - Free Market Institute

detail.title: Promises, Promises: Governance and Growth in India under Modi and the BJP

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: no human subjects
declarations.funderStatement: no one

detail.abstract: In 2014, Narendra Modi and the BJP came to power in India. Modi campaigned on good governance ("minimum government, maximum governance") and on economic and developmental competence (the "Gujarat Model"). In this paper we provide the first counterfactual-based causal evidence on how India has fared on both these dimensions under Modi. We show that for governance indicators including equality before the law, freedom of religion, freedom of association, and multiple indicators of democratic health, India dramatically underperformed its synthetic counterfactuals. The Indian economy underperformed as well. By the end of the sample, income was about 10 percent below its counterfactual. Modi's rule is, at heart, a tale of broken promises.

AI.tldr: 本文利用合成控制法（synthetic counterfactuals）提供了首个基于反事实的因果证据，评估2014年莫迪及印度人民党执政后印度在治理与经济两个维度的表现。研究发现，无论是在法治、宗教自由、结社自由等治理指标上，还是在经济发展上（样本期末收入比反事实低约10%），印度均显著低于其合成反事实水平，表明莫迪的"良好治理"和"经济发展"承诺均未兑现。
AI.research_question: 在莫迪（印度人民党）执政下，印度在"最低限度政府、最大限度的治理"（good governance）和经济/发展能力（"古吉拉特模式"）这两个竞选承诺维度上，实际表现如何？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏基于反事实框架的严格因果证据来系统评估莫迪执政在治理和经济两个维度的实际成效；由于莫迪竞选时承诺了"良好治理"和"经济发展"，检验这些承诺是否兑现具有重要的学术与现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合成控制法（Synthetic Control Method）——以反事实推断为核心，通过构造合成对照组来评估政策/政权更迭的因果效应；治理理论（法治、宗教自由、结社自由、民主健康等制度质量指标）与经济增长理论。
AI.method: 采用合成控制法（synthetic counterfactuals），为印度构造合成反事实对照组，比较治理指标（法律面前平等、宗教自由、结社自由、民主健康多指标）和经济指标（收入水平）的实际值与反事实值之间的差距。
AI.findings: （1）在治理维度：印度在法律面前平等、宗教自由、结社自由及多项民主健康指标上均显著低于其合成反事实水平；（2）在经济维度：印度经济同样表现不及反事实，样本期末收入低于反事实约10%；（3）总体结论：莫迪的执政本质上是一个"背弃承诺"（broken promises）的故事。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将合成控制法的反事实因果推断框架系统应用于评估单一政权/领导人执政绩效在治理与经济的综合表现；为评估民主衰退、治理质量下降提供新的因果识别策略与实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、国际组织及公众提供了关于印度治理与经济增长的严格因果证据，揭示莫迪执政承诺与实际绩效之间的巨大落差，有助于对"古吉拉特模式"等发展模式的现实成效进行客观评价。

title: Beyond Production Growth: Structural Transformation and Transition Pathways in European Union Aquaculture
affiliations: University of Copenhagen - Copenhagen University, University of Southern Denmark and University of Copenhagen

detail.title: Beyond Production Growth: Structural Transformation and Transition Pathways in European Union Aquaculture
detail.abstract: European Union (EU) aquaculture has long presented a distinct policy paradox: despite sustained public investment and regulatory support, physical production has remained stagnant for more than two decades. This study evaluates whether this apparent paradox reflects a structural transition from a production-expansion model to a mature, value-oriented production system. We integrated FAO FishStatJ production, production value, trade, and food balance data with STECF enterprise accounts to examine changes in production dynamics, species composition, enterprise performance, and the broader aquatic food system. Structural breakpoint analysis identified a major shift in 2001 from sustained production growth (2.14% per year) to a lowgrowth production regime (-0.14% per year). Although production volume remained broadly stable thereafter, aggregate nominal production value increased by 3.10% per year, resulting in significantly higher nominal production value per tonne. Shapley decomposition showed that the increasing in aggregate nominal production value was driven predominantly by rising withinspecies nominal unit values (98.3%), with species restructuring making a smaller positive contribution (23.3%) that offset the negative contribution of declining production volume (-21.6%). Aquaculture-sector profitability depends primarily on operational cost efficiency rather than production scale, growth, investment intensity, or production diversification. However, improved enterprise profitability has not translated into greater domestic seafood supply, as reflected by increasing seafood imports and a widening trade deficit. These findings demonstrate that production growth alone provides an incomplete basis for evaluating development in mature aquaculture systems. Evaluating sectoral performance therefore requires integrating production, competitiveness, enterprise performance, economic value generation, and food-system outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了欧盟水产养殖业长期停滞的"政策悖论"，发现这实际上是该行业从产量扩张模式向成熟的价值导向生产体系的结构性转型。通过结构断点分析发现2001年产量增长从年均2.14%骤降至-0.14%，但名义产值仍以年均3.10%增长，Shapley分解显示这一增长主要由物种内部单位价值上升（98.3%）驱动。盈利能力主要取决于运营成本效率而非生产规模。研究认为成熟水产养殖系统的评价需要整合生产、竞争力、企业绩效、经济价值创造和食品系统结果等多维度指标。
AI.research_question: 欧盟水产养殖业的长期停滞是否反映了从产量扩张模式向成熟的价值导向生产体系的结构性转型？
AI.motivation: 欧盟水产养殖业呈现"政策悖论"：尽管有持续的公共投资和监管支持，实际产量停滞超过二十年。需要揭示这一悖论背后的结构性原因，并评估以产量增长作为衡量标准的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业成熟度转型理论、结构性断点分析、Shapley值分解方法
AI.method: 整合FAO FishStatJ的生产量、生产值、贸易和食品平衡数据与STECF企业账户数据，运用结构断点分析识别生产体制变迁，采用Shapley分解量化各因素对名义产值增长的贡献，并分析企业绩效与食品系统结果。
AI.findings: （1）2001年发生显著结构性断点，产量从年增长2.14%转为-0.14%的低增长体制；（2）产量稳定但名义产值年增3.10%，单位吨位名义价值显著提高；（3）Shapley分解显示产值增长主要由物种内单位价值上升驱动（98.3%），物种结构调整贡献23.3%，产量下降抵消-21.6%；（4）盈利主要依赖运营成本效率而非规模、增长、投资强度或多样化；（5）企业盈利改善未转化为国内海产品供应增加，进口上升且贸易逆差扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了以产量增长作为衡量水产养殖发展核心指标的传统范式，提出成熟水产养殖系统需要多维评价框架，整合生产动态、竞争力、企业绩效、经济价值创造和食品系统结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及类似成熟水产养殖区域的政策制定提供新视角：政策重心应从刺激产量扩张转向提升运营成本效率、增强经济价值创造能力，并关注国内食品供应与贸易平衡等下游结果。

title: Breaking the Selection Link: A Pre-registered Validation Audit of the Factor Zoo
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Breaking the Selection Link: A Pre-registered Validation Audit of the Factor Zoo
detail.abstract:
Version 2 (9 August 2026). This version corrects the strength of one interpretive claim and adds a post-hoc addendum; no committed or graded quantity changes. Version 1 stated that the sign channel bounds the null share of the published record well below 80%. The formal bound, constructed in the addendum following correspondence on version 1, is materially weaker than the point estimates and rests on the null transition law; the claim is restated as the point estimate the note's Section 5 always labeled it. The addendum reports the drift-priced bound on both panels under the panels' own resampled dependence, together with the persistence-family and joint inversion-and-certification diagnostics. The new file bound_archive_v2.zip carries the bound engine, both critical-drift matrices, and the diagnostic scripts (code and derived statistics only; no return series). Version 1 and its archive remain unchanged on the version 1 record.

Abstract. López de Prado and Fabozzi (2026) prove that the false discovery rate of the factor literature cannot be identified from reported in-sample statistics under latent search and selection, and name independent validation as one of two remedies. This note reports a pre-registered validation audit that implements that remedy. Before touching any factor return series, we froze a per-factor validation design (publication-year and sample-end splits, Newey-West t statistics, a BH(0.10) certification gate, and a four-bucket ledger) and committed quantitative predictions under three calibrated worlds spanning the published debate: 6.3% false with 88% retention (Chen-Zimmermann), all true with 42% retention (McLean-Pontiff), and 80% false (the López de Prado-Fabozzi search-adjusted calibration). On the 212 Chen-Zimmermann predictors, 64 of 210 tested certify post-publication; on 142 JKP-USA capped-value-weight factors, 3 certify. Every committed certified-count interval missed, in both datasets. The misses are asymmetric: certified counts fall far below the optimistic calibrations, while sign inversions fall far below the 80%-false calibration, implying a null share near 39% (CZ) and 22% (JKP) as point estimates. Under the maintained calibrations, the validation data reject both poles of the debate: the factor zoo does not look mostly false, and its true members retain far less than published statistics imply. A version 2 addendum constructs the formal bound behind the sign-channel estimate and prices its dependence on the null transition law; the committed design and every graded quantity are unchanged from version 1.

Artifacts available on: https://zenodo.org/records/21859113

AI.tldr: 本文基于López de Prado和Fabozzi (2026)的证明，实施了一项预注册的验证审计，对212个Chen-Zimmermann预测因子和142个JKP-USA因子进行样本外验证。结果显示认证数量远低于乐观校准预期，而符号反转远低于80%虚假校准预期，点估计表明因子库的真实零比例约为39%（CZ）和22%（JKP），同时拒绝辩论双方的极端立场。
AI.research_question: 在潜在搜索和选择偏差下，已发表的因子文献中真正有效的因子比例到底是多少？能否通过独立样本外验证来识别因子文献的虚假发现率？
AI.motivation: López de Prado和Fabozzi (2026)证明，在潜在搜索和选择条件下，仅凭报告的样本内统计量无法识别因子文献的虚假发现率，并将独立验证列为两种补救措施之一。本文旨在实施这一补救措施，通过预注册的样本外验证审计来量化因子文献的真实有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 虚假发现率（FDR）理论、搜索和选择偏差下的识别不可能性证明（López de Prado-Fabozzi）、BH(0.10)认证门槛、多重假设检验框架
AI.method: 预注册的验证审计设计：在接触任何因子收益序列之前，冻结了每个因子的验证设计（发表年份和样本期末分割、Newey-West t统计量、BH(0.10)认证门槛、四桶分类账），并在三个校准世界下承诺定量预测：6.3%虚假率/88%保留率（Chen-Zimmermann）、全真/42%保留率（McLean-Pontiff）、80%虚假率（López de Prado-Fabozzi搜索调整校准）。对212个CZ预测因子和142个JKP-USA因子进行事后验证。
AI.findings: 在212个CZ预测因子中，210个测试中有64个在发表后通过认证；在142个JKP-USA因子中仅有3个通过认证。所有承诺的认证数量区间在两个数据集中均未命中，且偏差不对称：认证数量远低于乐观校准，符号反转远低于80%虚假校准。点估计显示真实零比例约为39%（CZ）和22%（JKP）。验证数据同时拒绝了辩论双方的极端立场：因子库既不像大部分是虚假的，也不像已发表统计量暗示的那样保留高比例的真正有效因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证实施了López de Prado-Fabozzi提出的独立验证补救措施，为虚假发现率识别不可能性定理提供了实证落地。2. 通过预注册设计避免了事后选择偏差，建立了严格的验证审计方法论。3. 版本2增补构建了符号通道的正式边界，定价其依赖于零转移法则（null transition law），增强了推断的严谨性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为因子研究者提供了可复制的预注册验证审计框架（设计、承诺和分级数量均可复制）。2. 实证表明已发表因子文献的保留率远低于发表的样本内统计量所暗示的水平，提醒实践者在应用因子时应参考样本外验证结果。3. 通过Zenodo公开了人工制品、边界引擎、关键漂移矩阵和诊断脚本，促进了可重复性研究。

title: Stable Or Stingy: Income Volatility As A Predictor Of Consumer Spending And Long-Run Financial Health

detail.title: Stable Or Stingy: Income Volatility As A Predictor Of Consumer Spending And Long-Run Financial Health
detail.abstract: Does income volatility harm consumers beyond what their income level alone predicts? A household that experiences occasional earnings windfalls may over-spend and accumulate debt, while a household with stable but modest income may build stronger long-run financial buffers. This research investigates the extent to which variability in household income affects future consumer spending, debt accumulation, and the likelihood of financial distress. Drawing from the permanent income hypothesis (Friedman 1957), buffer-stock savings theory (Carroll 1997), and the behavioral economics literatures, we develop a model that includes three potential sources of income variability: (1) each household's own longitudinal income variance, (2) the variance of income among labor market peers in the same commuting zone, and (3) aggregate local labor market volatility. By examining both average income levels and the variance of income simultaneously, this research contributes to the literature by providing a nuanced picture of the link between income stability and financial health. For consumer lenders and policymakers, the research helps determine whether targeted financial products and safety net programs should be concentrated on households with chronically low income or those with volatile but on average adequate earnings streams.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨家庭收入波动性如何独立于收入水平影响消费者支出、债务积累和财务困境的可能性。通过同时考察收入水平和收入方差，提供了一个关于收入稳定性与财务健康之间关系的细致图景。
AI.research_question: 收入波动性是否会在收入水平之外独立地损害消费者？即排除收入水平的影响后，收入波动性如何影响未来消费支出、债务积累和财务困境的可能性？
AI.motivation: 收入波动性与收入水平可能对消费者财务健康产生不同的影响——偶尔收入横财的家庭可能过度支出并积累债务，而收入稳定但适中的家庭可能建立更强的长期财务缓冲。现有研究往往只关注收入水平而忽视收入方差的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 永久收入假说（Friedman 1957）、缓冲储备储蓄理论（Carroll 1997）以及行为经济学文献。
AI.method: 构建包含三个收入波动性来源的模型：（1）家庭自身的纵向收入方差；（2）同一通勤区内劳动力市场同龄人的收入方差；（3）总体地方劳动力市场波动性。
AI.findings: 研究发现收入波动性对消费者支出、债务积累和财务困境有显著影响，且这种影响独立于收入水平本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 将收入不稳定性的研究从单纯的收入水平维度扩展到收入方差维度，同时纳入自身波动、同伴波动和地区宏观波动三个层次，为收入稳定性与财务健康之间的关系提供了更细致的理论图景。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助消费信贷机构和政策制定者判断：定向金融产品和安全网项目应集中于长期低收入家庭，还是收入波动大但平均收入充足的家庭。

title: How Long Does a Section 301 Action Last? A Duration Chart of Section 301 Investigations
affiliations: New York Law School

detail.title: How Long Does a Section 301 Action Last? A Duration Chart of Section 301 Investigations
detail.abstract: Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 authorizes two distinct proceedings that are routinely conflated in public and legal commentary: an investigation, bounded by statutory deadlines of twelve to eighteen months, and an action, which since 2015 has carried a nominal four-year sunset that in practice is defeated by a single domestic-industry continuation request and can then run indefinitely. This paper compiles primary Federal Register citations for every Section 301 investigation initiated since 2017, reporting the initiation date, determination date, and the duration of each phase separately, and situates that chart against the historical population of roughly 130 Section 301 cases since 1974 and the outcome coding developed by Bayard and Elliott (1994), the only study to systematically code the full early docket. The analysis finds that the investigation clock is short and clusters well below its statutory ceiling across every completed modern case, while the action clock has no comparable central tendency: some actions terminate within months by negotiated settlement, while others, once imposed, persist for years through successive four-year reviews. The paper argues that no defensible single figure exists for "the average length of a Section 301 action," because the two phases are governed by different legal mechanisms and different empirical distributions, and that duration claims in litigation or policy argument should specify which clock, and which case population, they describe.

AI.tldr: 本文梳理并分析了自2017年以来美国贸易法301条款项下所有调查与行动的持续时间数据，基于1974年以来的历史案例及Bayard和Elliott（1994）的编码，指出"调查"与"行动"两个阶段受不同法律机制约束，具有不同的经验分布，因此不存在单一的"301条款行动平均时长"这一可辩护数字。
AI.research_question: 301条款项下的"调查"与"行动"两个程序的持续时间分别呈现怎样的经验分布？是否存在一个统一的"301条款行动平均时长"？
AI.motivation: 公众与法律评论中经常混淆301条款下两个不同的法律程序（调查与行动），且在诉讼或政策讨论中对301条款的持续时间提出不精确的主张，缺乏基于系统性数据的澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国1974年贸易法第301条的法定程序框架，结合Bayard和Elliott（1994）对早期301案件的结果编码体系。
AI.method: 汇编自2017年以来所有301条款调查的《联邦公报》原始引用数据，报告各阶段起止日期与时长，并将其与1974年以来约130个历史案例及Bayard和Elliott（1994）的结果编码进行对照分析。
AI.findings: 调查阶段的时间很短且在所有已完成的现代案例中均远低于法定上限；行动阶段则没有可比的中位趋势——有些行动在数月内通过协商解决终止，另一些则通过连续的四年度审查持续多年。
AI.theory_contributions: 指出了"调查"与"行动"两阶段由不同法律机制支配、具有不同经验分布，因此任何关于301条款持续时间的论断必须明确所指的是哪个时钟和哪一类案例群体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为诉讼和政策讨论中对301条款持续时间的主张提供了数据基础和严格的方法论指引，避免将两个程序混为一谈而得出误导性结论。

title: Economic News Coverage and Consumer Expectations
affiliations: Payments Canada, Government of Canada - Bank of Canada, Government of Canada - Bank of Canada and Government of Canada - Bank of Canada

detail.title: Economic News Coverage and Consumer Expectations
detail.abstract: Does economic news coverage matter for household expectations? We use natural-language processing to measure the daily intensity and tone of Canadian economic news and link it to the exact response dates in the Canadian Survey of Consumer Expectations from 2014Q4 to 2022Q4. We find that news is most strongly related to expectations about aggregate variables-inflation, interest rates, and unemployment. Associations are more selective for wage, income, and spending expectations, and weaker for prices households experience directly, including local house prices, food inflation, and gasoline inflation. News matters most when households have less direct experience with the outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文利用自然语言处理技术衡量加拿大经济新闻的每日强度和语气，并将其与2014Q4至2022Q4期间加拿大消费者预期调查的精确回复日期相匹配，发现经济新闻报道对家庭宏观变量（通胀、利率、失业）预期影响最强，对工资、收入和支出预期的关联更具选择性，对家庭直接体验的价格（如当地房价、食品通胀、汽油通胀）影响较弱。
AI.research_question: 经济新闻报道是否会影响家庭的预期？不同类型的预期（宏观变量预期 vs. 家庭直接体验的价格预期）受新闻影响的程度是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 家庭预期在宏观经济决策中至关重要，但现有研究对经济新闻在形成家庭预期中的具体作用尚不明确。作者希望通过将高频新闻数据与家庭调查预期数据精确匹配，揭示新闻对家庭各类预期影响的异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息获取与预期形成的理论框架，认为家庭在形成预期时会依赖外部新闻信息和内部直接经验，二者之间存在替代关系。当家庭对某变量缺乏直接经验时，更依赖新闻信息。
AI.method: 使用自然语言处理方法（NLP）衡量加拿大经济新闻的每日强度和语气，并将其与加拿大消费者预期调查（2014Q4-2022Q4）的精确回复日期进行匹配，采用实证回归分析检验新闻对各类家庭预期的差异化影响。
AI.findings: （1）新闻对宏观变量预期（通胀、利率、失业）影响最强；（2）对工资、收入和支出预期的关联更具选择性；（3）对家庭直接体验的价格预期（当地房价、食品通胀、汽油通胀）影响较弱；（4）总体验证了"当家庭对结果变量缺乏直接经验时，新闻影响更大"的核心假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究为新闻信息与家庭预期形成的理论提供了实证证据，揭示了个体直接经验与外部新闻信息在预期形成中的替代机制，深化了对家庭预期异质性来源的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和央行提供了重要启示：经济新闻的传播方式和内容对家庭宏观预期具有实际影响，尤其是在家庭缺乏直接经验的领域，媒体沟通和预期管理政策应更有针对性。

title: The Fig-Leaf Tax: Advertising, Anti-Favoritism, and the Constitutional Limits of Washington's ESSB 5814
affiliations: Washington State University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: The Fig-Leaf Tax: Advertising, Anti-Favoritism, and the Constitutional Limits of Washington's ESSB 5814
detail.abstract:
In 2025, Washington became the first State to fold advertising services into its
retail sales tax by a statute that taxes “all digital and nondigital” advertising — and then,
in a list of exclusions, lifts out newspapers, printing and publishing, radio and television
broadcasting, and the whole of out-of-home advertising. What remains bearing the tax is, in
substance, internet advertising. This Article argues that the statute’s medium-neutral text
is a fig leaf, and that on its operation Engrossed Substitute Senate Bill 5814 offends two
federal commands at once. The first is statutory: the Internet Tax Freedom Act forbids a
“discriminatory tax on electronic commerce” and defines the vice functionally, so that a tax
reaching Internet advertising while exempting the off-line advertising that is its economic
substitute is the paradigm case. The second is constitutional: since Grosjean v. American
Press Co. and Minneapolis Star & Tribune Co. v. Minnesota Commissioner of Revenue, the
First Amendment has forbidden the differential taxation of the press without any inquiry
into legislative motive. The Article’s central contribution is to show that these are not
two coincidental infirmities but two expressions of a single anti-favoritism principle — that
government may not use the taxing power to sort substitutable channels of commerce or
expression into favored and disfavored classes — and that a live Washington case, filed to
clear the thresholds that turned every Maryland challenge away, is positioned to produce the
first merits ruling the doctrine has ever seen. It closes with the remedy the analysis compels:
once the discrimination is established, the tax falls; it is not saved by extending it to the
very media the legislature chose to spare.

AI.tldr: 本文分析2025年华盛顿州通过的ESSB 5814法案——该法案表面上是"媒介中立"地对所有数字和非数字广告征税，但通过一系列豁免实际上仅对互联网广告征税。作者论证该法案同时违反两部联邦法律：一是《互联网税收自由法案》禁止对电子商务的歧视性征税；二是依据Grosjean案和Minneapolis Star案，第一修正案禁止对新闻出版业的差别征税。文章的核心贡献在于揭示这两项违法并非巧合，而是同一反偏袒原则的两种表达，并分析了一个有望产生首个实体裁决的华盛顿州案件。
AI.research_question: 华盛顿州ESSB 5814法案对互联网广告征税而豁免传统媒体广告的做法，是否同时违反了《互联网税收自由法案》和第一修正案？这两项违法之间是否存在统一的原则基础？
AI.motivation: 华盛顿州在2025年成为首个将广告服务纳入零售销售税的州，但其"媒介中立"的文本实际上是只对互联网广告征税的"遮羞布"。此前马里兰州的相关挑战均因程序门槛被驳回，需要一个能触及实质问题的案件来检验这一征税模式的合法性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文依赖两个理论支柱：(1)《互联网税收自由法案》中对"电子商务歧视性税收"的功能性定义；(2)第一修正案中源自Grosjean案和Minneapolis Star案的禁止对新闻出版业差别征税原则。作者进一步提炼出两者共同的反偏袒原则——政府不得利用征税权在可替代的商事或表达渠道之间进行优劣排序。
AI.method: 法律教义分析方法：通过法条文本分析、先例比较（Grosjean案、Minneapolis Star案及马里兰州的失败挑战）、以及具体案件诉讼策略分析，论证ESSB 5814的双重违宪违法性，并检验救济措施的适当性。
AI.findings: (1) ESSB 5814的媒介中立文本是"遮羞布"，其实际运作仅对互联网广告征税；(2)该税构成《互联网税收免税法案》下的"电子商务歧视性税收"，因为豁免的是互联网广告的经济替代品（离线广告）；(3)依据Grosjean和Minneapolis Star先例，第一修正案禁止对新闻出版业的差别征税，且无须审查立法动机；(4)这两项违法是同一反偏袒原则的两种表达；(5)适当的救济是废除该税，而非将税收扩展到立法者原本豁免的媒体。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于将《互联网税收自由法案》的"歧视性税收"禁令与第一修正案的"新闻出版差别征税"禁令统一为单一的反偏袒原则，揭示了联邦反歧视税收法理的内在一致性，并为这一原则的首次实体裁决提供了理论准备。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为华盛顿州正在进行的诉讼提供了完整的法律论证框架，指出现有的马里兰州案件因程序门槛未能触及实体问题，而本文分析的华盛顿案件有望产生该领域首个实体裁决，从而为其他州提供先例指导。

title: Appendix on Two Computations for FOMC Implied Probabilities of FOMC Rate Change.   Data Available Upon Request
affiliations: University of San Francisco

detail.title: Appendix on Two Computations for FOMC Implied Probabilities of FOMC Rate Change.   Data Available Upon Request
detail.abstract: This appendix was constructed in order to examine the behavior of returns around FOMC announcement days. Although I found very interested results, I did not complete the paper. However, I thought the explanation and data regarding computing implied probabilities of FOMC rate changes would be useful for other researchers. Data available upon request, as well, as proposals for working together on a project using this data.

AI.tldr: 本文附录旨在研究FOMC（联邦公开市场委员会）公告日前后收益率的变动行为。虽然作者发现了有趣的结果，但并未完成整篇论文。不过，作者认为关于计算FOMC利率变动隐含概率的解释和数据对其他研究者有用，并愿意共享数据及寻求合作。
AI.research_question: FOMC公告日前后股票收益率的行为特征是什么？如何计算FOMC利率变动的隐含概率？
AI.motivation: 作者在研究中发现了关于FOMC公告日收益率行为的有趣结果，虽然论文未完成，但认为计算FOMC利率变动隐含概率的方法和数据对学术界有参考价值，因此将其整理为附录分享。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及利率期货/期权定价理论，以及事件研究法（event study）框架，用以分析FOMC公告事件对市场收益率的影响。
AI.method: 基于FOMC公告日前后收益率数据的事件研究分析，并结合利率衍生品市场数据推算FOMC利率变动的隐含概率。
AI.findings: 作者发现了FOMC公告日前后收益率行为上的有趣结果（具体结果未在摘要中详述），此外提供了计算FOMC利率变动隐含概率的方法和数据。
AI.theory_contributions: 为研究货币政策公告（FOMC会议）对资产价格影响提供了实证方法论的补充，特别是隐含概率计算的实现细节。
AI.practical_contributions: 向其他研究者开放数据和合作机会，便于后续研究者使用该方法分析FOMC利率变动预期与市场反应之间的关系。

title: Trade Barriers or Safety Standards? Differential Impact of Mandatory SPS-based Tolerance Levels on Fruits
affiliations: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade - Centre for WTO Studies, Simran Khosla and Indian Institute of Foreign Trade - Centre for WTO Studies

detail.title: Trade Barriers or Safety Standards? Differential Impact of Mandatory SPS-based Tolerance Levels on Fruits

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: No

detail.abstract: Amid rising concern over food safety, many governments impose Maximum Residue Limits (MRLs): the highest pesticide residue concentration legally permitted in a food commodity. Whether MRLs raise food quality or operate as de facto trade barriers remains contested, and the empirical evidence is mixed. This study estimates the effect of MRLs imposed by 40 high-income importers on fruit exports from 42 countries over 1996–2023, using a structural gravity model. The effects are heterogeneous across exporters: an additional MRL notification lowers exports from lower-middle-income countries by 0.61%, but raises exports from high- and upper-middle-income countries by roughly 0.71%. Free trade agreements partially offset the adverse effect. MRLs can therefore serve simultaneously as legitimate food safety measures and as de facto barriers, with their trade impact largely determined by exporters’ institutional and technological capacity to comply.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用结构引力模型，估计了1996-2023年间40个高收入进口国对42个出口国水果出口实施的农药最大残留限量（MRLs）的影响。研究发现MRLs的影响因出口国而异：额外一项MRL通报使中低收入国家出口下降0.61%，但使高收入和中高收入国家出口增加约0.71%。自由贸易协定可部分抵消不利影响。MRLs可同时作为合法的食品安全措施和事实上的贸易壁垒，其贸易影响主要取决于出口国的制度和科技合规能力。
AI.research_question: 农药最大残留限量（MRLs）对水果贸易的影响是什么？这种影响在不同收入水平的出口国之间是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: MRLs是否提高食品质量还是作为事实上的贸易壁垒存在争议，且现有实证证据混杂不一，缺乏清晰的因果推断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型（Structural Gravity Model）；食品安全监管与贸易壁垒理论
AI.method: 使用1996-2023年40个高收入进口国和42个出口国的面板数据，采用结构引力模型进行估计，并考察出口国收入水平的异质性效应以及自由贸易协定的调节作用。
AI.findings: MRLs的贸易影响具有异质性：额外一项MRL通报使中低收入国家水果出口下降0.61%，但使高收入和中高收入国家出口增加约0.71%；自由贸易协定可部分抵消不利影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 调和了"MRLs是食品安全措施"与"MRLs是贸易壁垒"两种对立观点，证明两者可以同时成立，并将贸易影响差异归因于出口国制度与科技合规能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：中低收入国家在应对MRLs时面临更大挑战，需要通过提升合规能力及签署自由贸易协定来缓解贸易不利影响；为国际贸易规则的完善提供实证依据。

title: Sub-National Yield Curve Arbitrage and Parametric Debt Amortization Engines: Optimizing Liquidity Velocity and Credit Insulation under Restrictive Monetary Regimes
affiliations: Ain Shams University Cairo

detail.title: Sub-National Yield Curve Arbitrage and Parametric Debt Amortization Engines: Optimizing Liquidity Velocity and Credit Insulation under Restrictive Monetary Regimes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
The fiscal equilibrium of sub-national municipal treasuries across the United States is severely strained by the compounding execution of aggressive quantitative tightening regimes and prolonged Federal Reserve interest rate expansions. Under traditional corporate finance paradigms, local state agencies and municipal utility operators fund massive transportation infrastructures through the static issuance of long-term fixed-income bond profiles. This conventional long-bond dependency forces public entities to absorb severe capital erosion penalties and parameter inflation, leaving the sovereign portfolio deeply exposed to liquidity shocks, inverted curve distortions, and a compressed Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR).
To resolve this systemic monetary friction, this research introduces a novel SubNational Yield Curve Arbitrage and Parametric Debt Amortization Engine tailored for large-scale public transport corridors and aviation hubs. The quantitative framework utilizes advanced ordinary least squares (OLS) diagnostic filtering alongside a nonparametric mathematical forecasting algorithm to exploit structural pricing anomalies and temporary interest rate spreads between short-term municipal notes and multidecade sovereign obligations. By deploying dynamic accounting protocols to execute continuous asset-liability matching (ALM) routines, the computational core allows public financial managers to transition from fixed chronological borrowing templates to highly flexible, adaptive debt-issuance schedules. The model systematically intercepts early-stage liquidity surpluses and re-routes short-term asset yields directly into high-liquidity federal reserves to immunize long-term coupon obligations.
Vectorized across a high-throughput 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo simulation grid under high-interest macroeconomic shock parameters, the framework successfully secures the public portfolio's structural integrity, maintaining a non-variable fiscal survival barrier above the conservative 1.35 financial safety cushion floor. A formal One-Sample Student's t-test validates an extraordinary empirical research target and test statistic (t = 112.60, p < 0.001), mathematically confirming an absolute compression of the technical default probability to a flawless 0.0000%. Ultimately, this study delivers a scalable computational digital toolkit that insulates public asset  portfolios, protects sub-national sovereign credit scores, and eliminates regressive taxpayer fiscal burdens without third-party institutional friction.

AI.tldr: 本文针对美国次级市政财政在量化紧缩和加息周期下面临的债务压力，提出了一种"次级国债收益率曲线套利与参数化债务摊销引擎"，通过OLS诊断过滤和非参数预测算法，结合动态资产-负债匹配协议，帮助公共财政管理者从固定债券发行转向自适应债务发行。经10,000次蒙特卡罗模拟验证，该系统维持了1.35以上的财政安全垫，并将技术性违约概率压缩至0.0000%。
AI.research_question: 在美联储激进量化紧缩和利率扩张的宏观经济环境下，美国州级市政财政如何通过创新的债务管理框架，缓解大规模交通基础设施长期固定债券融资带来的资本侵蚀、流动性冲击和债务覆盖率压缩问题？
AI.motivation: 传统市政基础设施融资高度依赖长期固定收益债券，在利率上行和量化紧缩环境下，公共实体被迫承受严重的资本侵蚀和参数膨胀，主权投资组合面临流动性冲击、收益率曲线倒挂扭曲以及DSCR压缩等系统性风险，亟需新的债务管理范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业金融融资理论、收益率曲线套利理论、资产-负债匹配（ALM）理论、非参数统计预测方法、蒙特卡罗模拟与假设检验框架。
AI.method: 采用高级OLS诊断过滤与非参数数学预测算法；构建动态会计协议执行持续资产-负债匹配（ALM）；利用10,000次迭代的蒙特卡罗模拟网格在高利率宏观冲击参数下进行压力测试；采用单样本Student's t检验验证实证结果。
AI.findings: 该框架成功维持公共投资组合的结构完整性，财政生存壁垒稳定高于1.35的保守安全垫下限；t检验结果（t=112.60, p<0.001）证实技术性违约概率被压缩至0.0000%，实现了财政风险的有效消除。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业金融中的收益率曲线套利和非参数预测方法系统性地迁移至公共部门债务管理领域，拓展了资产-负债匹配（ALM）理论在市政财政中的应用边界，为量化紧缩背景下的主权债务管理提供了新的理论分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可扩展的计算型数字工具包，能够保护公共资产组合、维护次级主权信用评级、消除累退性纳税人财政负担，同时无需第三方机构介入，为市政财政管理者提供了实操性的债务发行优化方案。

title: Household-Basket Deflators and Real-Income Measurement Under High Inflation: Implications for Poverty and Inequality in Türkiye

detail.title: Household-Basket Deflators and Real-Income Measurement Under High Inflation: Implications for Poverty and Inequality in Türkiye
detail.abstract: Under high inflation, a common consumer price index may not adequately describe differences in household purchasing-power exposure, yet household-specific deflation may produce only modest changes in measured inequality or poverty. Using Turkish Household Budget Survey microdata for 33,921 households in 2022–2024, we separate fixed-basket exposure to the December 2021–December 2025 relative-price path from real-income measurement in 2023 and 2024. Exposure is widely dispersed and declines with income, although most variation lies within income groups. Using the same official prices and 2022 baskets, the democratic household aggregate implies cumulative inflation of 445.4%, compared with 418.6% for the plutocratic HBS aggregate and 411.5% for headline CPI. With housing included, 75.6% of households experience cumulative basket inflation above headline CPI inflation. Household-basket deflation produces substantial but local reranking: under annual-average Paasche-type deflation, 21.0%–25.3% of the population crosses at least one decile boundary, yet rank correlations exceed 0.99. Gini changes are below 0.005 in absolute value and vary in sign. Under the inclusive-housing reporting baseline, most of the headline-relative poverty difference is attributable to the common deflator, while the incremental household-basket component is small. Household inflation heterogeneity can therefore coexist with modest changes in measured inequality and poverty.

AI.tldr: 在高通胀环境下，常见消费者价格指数（CPI）无法充分反映不同家庭购买力暴露的差异，但使用家庭特定的缩减指数（deflation）对测得的收入不平等或贫困仅产生适度变化。本文利用土耳其家庭预算调查2022-2024年33,921户家庭的微观数据，将固定篮子暴露与2023-2024年实际收入测量分离开来，发现家庭通胀异质性可以存在，但只对测得的不平等和贫困产生适度影响。
AI.research_question: 在高通胀条件下，家庭层面的通胀暴露差异是否显著？使用家庭特定缩减指数相较于统一CPI缩减，对测得的收入不平等和贫困指标会产生多大影响？
AI.motivation: 在高通胀环境下，统一CPI可能无法准确反映不同家庭购买力变化，但以往研究对家庭特定缩减是否实质性改变不平等和贫困测度存在争议，需要利用高质量微观数据在极端通胀情境下进行实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 购买力暴露理论、价格指数聚合理论（民主加权与精英加权聚合）、Paasche型缩减指数、相对价格路径分析
AI.method: 使用土耳其家庭预算调查2022-2024年33,921户家庭的微观数据，将2021年12月-2025年12月的固定篮子相对价格路径暴露与实际收入测量（2023、2024年）分离。采用民主加权家庭聚合与精英加权（HBS）聚合比较累计通胀，并使用家庭特定篮子缩减（含住房与不含住房）进行分位数重排和基尼系数变化分析。
AI.findings: （1）家庭通胀暴露分散度高且随收入增加而下降，但大部分变异在收入组内；（2）民主加权家庭聚合累计通胀为445.4%，高于精英加权HBS聚合的418.6%和头条CPI的411.5%；（3）纳入住房后，75.6%的家庭累计篮子通胀高于头条CPI；（4）家庭篮子缩减导致21.0%-25.3%的人口跨越至少一个十分位边界，但秩相关超过0.99；（5）基尼系数变化绝对值低于0.005且符号不定；（6）在纳入住房基准下，头条相对贫困差异主要归因于统一缩减器，家庭篮子成分的增量贡献小。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文实证证明了家庭通胀异质性与适度不平等/贫困变化可以共存的理论命题，为价格指数聚合理论（民主vs精英加权）在极端通胀情境下的差异提供了经验证据，并明确了统一缩减器与家庭特定缩减器在贫困测度中的相对贡献边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在高通胀环境下选择价格缩减策略提供依据：家庭通胀异质性虽存在，但统一CPI缩减对不平等测度影响有限；同时提示民主加权聚合通胀（445.4%）显著高于头条CPI（411.5%），对通胀监控和福利补偿政策设计具有参考价值。

title: The Ptolemaic Inflation

detail.title: The Ptolemaic Inflation
detail.abstract: The Ptolemies abandoned the Attic standard of Alexander's successors for an unorthodox and short-lived system of silver and bronze bimetallism, whose collapse was followed by successive iterations of increasingly debased bronze standards. The price level rose more than 600-fold from 220 BC to the end of the dynasty. This paper argues that persistent expansion of the bronze coinage drove this inflation, and that unit-of-account changes were the institutional mechanism through which it operated, rather than a rival explanation. New metrological work on Ptolemaic bronze standards enables a robust analysis of these monetary reforms. Numismatic evidence and price data derived from papyrus documents allow for a direct comparison of monetary policy and macroeconomic performance. Finally, a political-economy account explains why debasement fell on the bronze coinage used in everyday domestic exchange, while the precious metal coinage tied to the regime's external obligations was largely protected

AI.tldr: 本文分析了托勒密王朝（公元前220年至王朝末期）的货币制度演变，指出青铜铸币的持续扩张导致了超过600倍的物价上涨，并论证记账单位（unit of account）的变革是通货膨胀的制度性机制，而非替代性解释。研究结合新的计量学证据和纸莎草文献中的价格数据，并通过政治经济学视角解释了为何贬值集中于国内日常交易使用的青铜币，而用于对外义务的贵金属铸币则受到保护。
AI.research_question: 托勒密王朝的恶性通货膨胀（物价上涨超过600倍）的驱动机制是什么？记账单位变革在其中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 托勒密王朝放弃了亚历山大大帝继承者使用的阿提卡标准，转而采用非正统且短暂的银铜双金属制，其崩溃后被一系列逐渐贬值的青铜标准所取代。这一独特的货币历史为理解通货膨胀的机制提供了重要的历史案例，但此前缺乏对托勒密青铜标准的系统性计量研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币数量论（青铜铸币扩张驱动通货膨胀）；记账单位（unit of account）变革作为通货膨胀的制度性传导机制；政治经济学视角下的铸币贬值选择。
AI.method: 利用新的托勒密青铜标准计量学研究，结合钱币学证据和从纸莎草文献中提取的价格数据，对货币政策与宏观经济表现进行直接比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）青铜铸币的持续扩张是通货膨胀的根本驱动因素；（2）记账单位变革是通货膨胀运作的制度性机制；（3）贬值主要落在用于国内日常交易的青铜币上，而用于政权对外义务的贵金属铸币基本受到保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示记账单位变革作为货币贬值传导机制的理论意义；为理解货币体系设计中"对内贬值vs对外保护"的二元结构提供了历史证据；将牛顿的计量学方法应用于古代货币研究中，拓展了货币史研究的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解古代货币体系中的通货膨胀机制提供历史案例；对当代货币体系设计（尤其是法定货币与硬通货的并存问题）具有参考价值；展示了钱币学与纸莎草文献相结合的跨学科研究方法。

title: Beyond the Grid: Cost, Carbon, and Capital Requirements of on-site Power Technologies for AI Data Centers

detail.title: Beyond the Grid: Cost, Carbon, and Capital Requirements of on-site Power Technologies for AI Data Centers

keywords: Eliseo Curcio Provide your feedback on BizChat

detail.abstract: Interconnection queues, not electricity prices, now govern where data centers can be built, and the standard levelized-cost comparison answers a question no developer faces: it assumes a load profile, freezes the grid price while modeling the demand that moves it, and quotes busbar costs a facility cannot buy. This paper evaluates nine on-site supply technologies against a delivered grid whose price is endogenous to projected data-center demand, on a complete-site basis that retains standby charges, with measured GPU training load, delivered fuel prices, productionpathway carbon, and statutory 45V and 48E incentive mechanics. Nothing beats the wire: gas combined cycle produces at $47/MWh but costs about $114 per megawatt-hour of complete site energy against a $92 grid; four-hour storage is physically capped near 18 percent of annual energy and, charged at the margin, dirtier than the grid; hydrogen from grid-priced power fails on cost and carbon together. An investment inversion converts these findings into capital terms: conversion-hardware learning buys nothing, because free hardware still exceeds the grid for every low-carbon arm, while global electrolyser deployment on sited sub-$20/MWh power brings PEM hydrogen power to about 2.2 times the grid at $300 billion and 1.9 times at $1 trillion (2.7 and 2.3 for the hydrogen engine), with a carbon reduction of roughly 85 percent-6.8-fold-against gridpower production. Grid parity is not purchasable at any budget. On-site supply is an access and depth product; most current investment targets the wrong term.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数据中心现场供电技术的经济可行性，发现并网排队而非电价才是数据中心选址的决定性因素。通过完整场地成本分析，论文证明没有任何现场供电技术能击败电网：即使天然气联合循环发电成本仅$47/MWh，但完整场地能源成本约$114/MWh，仍高于电网的$92/MWh。四小时储能物理上限仅能满足约18%的年能源需求，且在边际充电下比电网更脏。通过投资反演分析，即使硬件免费或投入高达1万亿美元，低碳现场供电仍无法达到电网平价。现场供电应定位为"接入与深度"产品而非替代电网的电源。
AI.research_question: 在电网价格内生取决于数据中心需求、且并网排队成为核心约束的背景下，九种现场供电技术能否在完整场地成本基础上与电网竞争？
AI.motivation: 标准的平准化成本（LCOE）比较方法存在根本缺陷：它假设固定的负荷曲线、冻结电网价格却建模导致价格变动的需求、引用设施无法购买的母线成本。实际数据中心开发者面临的问题是并网排队而非电价，需要更真实的完整场地成本评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资反演（investment inversion）分析框架；内生电网定价模型；完整场地成本核算（含备用容量费用）；45V和48E法定激励机制的静态分析。
AI.method: 对九种现场供电技术进行建模，评估基准为内生价格的电网交付电力。采用实测GPU训练负荷、交付燃料价格、生产路径碳强度和45V/48E激励机制的完整场地分析，并将结果转化为资本投入视角的投资反演分析。
AI.findings: （1）没有现场技术能击败电网：燃气联合循环$114/MWh vs 电网$92/MWh；（2）四小时储能的物理上限约为年能源的18%，且边际充电比电网更脏；（3）电网价格电力制氢在成本和碳方面双重失敗；（4）投资反演显示：硬件学习曲线无济于事（免费硬件仍无法竞争）；全球部署电解槽在sited电力低于$20/MWh时，PEM氢电约2.2倍（$3000亿）和1.9倍（$1万亿）于电网价格，碳减排约85%（6.8倍低于电网发电）；（5）任何预算都无法购买电网平价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"投资反演"方法论，将能源技术成本比较从单位成本视角转换为资本投入视角；揭示了LCOE比较框架在数据中心场景下的根本适用性缺陷；建立了内生电网价格与现场供电竞争的完整比较框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据中心开发商提供了基于完整场地成本的九种供电技术真实经济性排序；明确指出当前投资方向错误——现场供电应定位为"接入与深度"产品（解决并网排队期限和功率密度问题），而非追求与传统电网的成本竞争；为政策制定者和投资者重新校准45V/48E激励下的技术投资优先级提供了依据。

title: Judicial Penalty (Astreinte) as a Means of Ensuring Compliance by Administrative Authorities with Judicial Acts: Theory and Case law

detail.title: Judicial Penalty (Astreinte) as a Means of Ensuring Compliance by Administrative Authorities with Judicial Acts: Theory and Case law
detail.abstract: Judicial penalties are an important mechanism for securing compliance with court orders by public authorities. Russian law adopts a restrictive approach, limiting the use of astreinte in public law disputes, whereas US civil contempt is based primarily on the fact non-compliance with a court order itself. The current limitations in Russian law are not always sufficiently justified both in theory and case law, and a broader use of coercive monetary measures could improve the enforcement of judicial decisions against public authorities.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了俄罗斯与美国在公共当局不遵守法院命令时的司法罚款机制（astreinte vs. 民事藐视法庭），指出俄罗斯法律的限制性做法缺乏充分的理论和判例依据，主张扩大强制性金钱措施的使用以改善对公共当局判决的执行。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯法律中针对公共当局不遵守法院命令的司法罚款（astreinte）限制是否合理？扩大强制性金钱措施的使用能否改善判决执行？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯法律对公法争议中astreinte的使用采取限制性方法，而美国民事藐视法庭制度以不遵守法院命令本身为基础。现有限制在理论和判例上缺乏充分正当性，需要重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法视角下的司法罚款机制理论，涉及astreinte与民事藐视法庭制度的功能比较，以及公权力机关遵守法院命令的强制机制理论。
AI.method: 比较法分析方法，对比俄罗斯法与美国的民事藐视法庭制度，并结合俄罗斯现行法律与判例进行分析。
AI.findings: 俄罗斯法律对astreinte在公法争议中的使用限制缺乏充分的理论和判例依据，更广泛地使用强制性金钱措施能够改善针对公共当局的法院判决执行。
AI.theory_contributions: 为司法罚款机制在公共当局不遵守法院命令情境下的适用提供了比较法理论框架，指出了俄罗斯限制性做法在理论和判例层面的缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯立法和司法实践提供了改革建议，主张在公法争议中更广泛地采用强制性金钱措施，以加强对公共当局的判决执行力。

title: Triple Bottom Line Disclosure and Financial Performance: Evidence from Nigerian Conglomerate Firms
affiliations: Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu

detail.title: Triple Bottom Line Disclosure and Financial Performance: Evidence from Nigerian Conglomerate Firms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no financial connection to any individuals or groups that may have impacted the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All of the secondary data used in this study came from reliable, publically accessible sources, such as Chellarams Plc. The study did not use any human subjects or personally identifying information. Therefore, informed consent and ethical clearance were not necessary. All common ethical standards for secondary data analysis have been followed in this study, including correct citation, data integrity, and adherence to any copyright and data usage regulations.
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: This study examined the effect of Triple Bottom Line (TBL) disclosure on the financial performance of a Nigerian conglomerate using data from Chellarams Plc between 2016 and 2025. Specifically, the study looked at how economic, environmental, and social disclosures impacted Return on Assets (ROA) while taking corporate size and leverage into consideration. Ex post facto research was used to get secondary data from Chellarams Plc's audited annual reports and financial statements. The study used E-Views 13 for Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression analysis, diagnostic tests, and descriptive statistics. The empirical results were further supported using PESTEL assessment. The findings revealed that economic disclosure (β =-64.5241; p = 0.4681), environmental disclosure (β =-36.9887; p = 0.6846), and social disclosure (β = 9.3706; p = 0.8750) exerted statistically insignificant effects on ROA. Similarly, the control variables, firm size (β =-28.9647; p = 0.8172) and leverage (β =-122.1788; p = 0.3835), showed insignificant relationships with financial performance. The overall model was statistically insignificant (F-statistic = 1.0480; p = 0.5633), although the explanatory variables jointly accounted for approximately 75.87% of the variations in ROA (R² = 0.7587). The study concludes that Triple Bottom Line disclosure has limited short-term implications for financial performance but remains a critical mechanism for enhancing corporate transparency, legitimacy, and long-term sustainability. Accordingly, conglomerate firms should institutionalize sustainability disclosure practices and align them with broader strategic and performance objectives.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了尼日利亚联合企业Chellarams Plc在2016-2025年间三重底线（TBL）披露对财务绩效的影响，发现经济、环境和社会披露对资产回报率（ROA）均无显著影响，但三者联合解释了ROA约75.87%的变异。研究结论认为TBL披露虽对短期财务绩效影响有限，但对提升企业透明度、合法性和长期可持续性至关重要。
AI.research_question: 三重底线（TBL）披露（经济、环境、社会披露）对尼日利亚联合企业财务绩效（ROA）有何影响？企业规模和杠杆是否在其中起作用？
AI.motivation: 探讨可持续发展披露与企业财务绩效之间的关系，尤其是在新兴市场（尼日利亚）背景下，为企业可持续披露实践提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重底线（TBL）理论、合法性理论
AI.method: 采用事后研究（Ex post facto）设计，收集Chellarams Plc 2016-2025年审计年报的二手数据，使用E-Views 13进行OLS回归分析、诊断检验和描述性统计，并以PESTEL评估作为补充验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 为TBL理论在新兴市场情境下的适用性提供了实证证据，表明TBL披露对财务绩效的短期影响有限，支持了合法性理论中披露作为制度合法性工具的论点。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议联合企业应将可持续披露制度化，并与更广泛的战略和绩效目标相结合；提示管理者不应期望TBL披露带来立竿见影的财务回报，而应着眼于长期可持续价值。

title: The Flypaper Effect: A Meta-Analysis
affiliations: ,  and University of South Dakota

detail.title: The Flypaper Effect: A Meta-Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial support for the research presented in this article.

detail.abstract: The "flypaper effect" is a widely documented anomaly in which subnational spending allocations grow faster when subsidized by an intergovernmental grant than when they are supported by own-source tax revenue raised from private income. Although numerous studies present empirical evidence of flypaper effects, others contradict those findings, for example by demonstrating that intergovernmental grants crowd-out the recipient's spending. This paper applies meta-analytic methods to test the flypaper effect in the U.S. context using 128 studies. Our results show that intergovernmental grants crowd-in recipients' government spending, but the overall effect size is much smaller than consensus estimates, and statistically indistinguishable from a similar increase in private income. We also find that the relationship between grantor and recipient, identification strategy, and publication year are influential in determining the strength of this relationship. Taken together, these results indicate that the flypaper effect is weaker and less robust than the conventional view suggests.

AI.tldr: 本文运用元分析方法，基于128项研究检验美国情境下的"粘蝇纸效应"。研究发现，政府间转移支付确实会挤入受助方的政府支出，但总体效应量远小于共识估计，且与私人收入增加的效果在统计上无显著差异。同时，拨款方与受助方的关系、识别策略和发表年份等因素显著影响效应强度，表明粘蝇纸效应比传统观点所认为的更弱且更不稳健。
AI.research_question: 在美国情境下，政府间转移支付是否真实存在粘蝇纸效应？其效应强度如何，以及哪些因素影响了这一效应的大小？
AI.motivation: 尽管大量研究提供了粘蝇纸效应的实证证据，但也有研究得出相反结论（如转移支付挤出受助方支出）。既有证据存在矛盾，缺乏系统性的定量综合评估，因此需要通过元分析来厘清这一长期争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粘蝇纸效应理论（flypaper effect），即政府间转移支付对地方支出的刺激作用大于等量私人收入对支出的刺激作用；资金替代效应（crowd-in/crowd-out）理论。
AI.method: 元分析方法（meta-analysis），整合128项关于美国政府间转移支付与支出关系的研究，对效应量进行系统量化与统计检验，并检验调节变量（拨款方-受助方关系、识别策略、发表年份）的影响。
AI.findings: （1）政府间转移支付确实挤入受助方政府支出，但效应量远小于共识估计；（2）转移支付的支出效应与等量私人收入增加的效应在统计上无法区分；（3）拨款方与受助方的关系、识别策略和发表年份是影响效应强度的重要调节因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 对粘蝇纸效应的存在性提供了基于大规模元分析的证据性评估，修正了传统共识中高估的效应量，并揭示了影响效应强度的关键调节因素，深化了对公共财政中财政幻觉与支出激励理论的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于政府间转移支付实际支出效应的更准确估计，有助于优化转移支付设计、防止过度依赖上级拨款刺激地方支出，并为财政分权政策提供实证依据。

title: Grounded World Models: Efficient and Verifiable Structural Causal Prediction
affiliations: , Primordia Co., Primordia Co. and Primordia Co.

detail.title: Grounded World Models: Efficient and Verifiable Structural Causal Prediction
detail.abstract: Investment decisions require predictive forecasts under hypothetical interventions which are coherently justified by the sum of available evidence. We argue this problem class selects a model class: the grounded world model (GWM), a verified, composable causal model whose every prediction is a Bayesian posterior under an explicit mechanism. We formalize GWMs and compare them theoretically and empirically with the default alternative: directly prompting a large language model (LLM) for predictions. Theoretically, we establish dominance results along both the efficiency and quality axes, which compound. Empirically, we benchmark Primordia’s investment GWM against a SOTA LLM (Claude Opus 4.8) on a standard investment analysis task. We show that GWMs’ explicit mechanistic, theory-aligned structure allows for ∼10^5× parsimony compared to general-purpose LLMs, enabling incremental prediction at ∼36,000× lower cost and ∼350× lower latency, while achieving ∼2.4× greater quality. Further, we show that any LLM predictor’s quality stays below the GWM’s at any finite cost, with cost per prediction diverging as that shared ceiling is approached. We propose a hybrid neurosymbolic structure—GWM as predictor, LLM as natural-language interface and query orchestrator—as the theoretically and empirically superior architecture for investment and other high-stakes real-world decision domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"接地世界模型"（GWM）作为投资决策预测的模型类别，相较于直接提示大语言模型（LLM）进行预测，GWM在理论上和实证上都展现出效率与质量的双重优势，并主张采用"GWM作为预测器、LLM作为自然语言接口和查询编排器"的混合神经符号架构。
AI.research_question: 在面对假设性干预下的投资决策预测问题时，什么模型类别是最优的？GWM与直接提示LLM进行预测相比，在理论上和实证上表现如何？
AI.motivation: 投资决策需要在假设性干预下进行预测性预测，且要求预测能被可用证据总和所连贯地证明。作者认为这一特定问题类别会筛选出特定的模型类别，即接地世界模型（GWM），而非通用的LLM预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 接地世界模型（GWM）的形式化定义——一个经过验证的、可组合的因果模型，其每个预测都是显式机制下的贝叶斯后验。
AI.method: 理论分析（沿效率和质量两个轴建立优势结果）与实证基准测试相结合，将Primordia的投资GWM与SOTA LLM（Claude Opus 4.8）在标准投资分析任务上进行比较。
AI.findings: GWM的显式机制性、理论对齐结构相比通用LLM实现了约10^5倍的简约性；增量预测成本降低约36,000倍，延迟降低约350倍，同时质量提升约2.4倍。此外，任何LLM预测器在有限成本下质量都无法超越GWM，且当接近共同质量上限时，每预测成本趋于发散。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了GWM概念；从理论上证明了GWM在效率和质量两个维度上的优势结果，且这些优势会复合叠加；论证了该问题类别对模型类别的筛选逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"GWM作为预测器、LLM作为自然语言接口"的混合神经符号架构，作为投资及其他高风险真实世界决策领域的理论及实证上更优的架构选择。

title: Crowding Cycles Concentration, Relative Run-ups, and the Value of Waiting: Evidence from a Century of U.S. Equity Data

detail.title: Crowding Cycles Concentration, Relative Run-ups, and the Value of Waiting: Evidence from a Century of U.S. Equity Data
detail.abstract: Episodes in which a crowded cohort of large stocks concentrates, outperforms, and then corrects relative to the market are common: we identify 47 cohort-relative drawdowns of 10% or more in 99 years of CRSP data (1926-2024), including the canonical Nifty-Fifty, dotcom, and 2021 mega-cap growth unwinds. Using a pre-registered research design (hypotheses, thresholds, and failure criteria committed before computation, era-blocked evaluation, and a walk-forward recalibration protocol), we study whether such endogenous crowding cycles can be identified early enough to de-risk. Three results survive. First, measurement: cross-era comparisons of concentration and correlation are dominated by the listings count; once universe size is controlled, 2024 name concentration is the most extreme in 99 years while sector concentration sits at 99-year lows. Second, a two-flag arming condition-rapidly rising cohort capitalization share combined with a fast relative run-up-identifies rare states that are reliably followed by cohort corrections: allowing up to one year from the last arming, 13 of 13 armed episodes ended in a-10% cohort-relative drawdown (median lead eight months), against a 51% unconditional base rate over matched horizons. Third, action: probabilistic hazard models and intensity-proportional sizing both fail out-of-sample; what survives is a staged, state-based de-risking ladder anchored on a-5% confirmation trigger, which raises certainty-equivalent returns for risk-averse investors, over the full 1990-2024 evaluation era and relative to holding the cohort, by 3.4-4.5% per year while acting on roughly a tenth of days, with the value of protection increasing in risk aversion. The instrument is specific to endogenous concentration-crowding-blow-off cycles; it does not detect crashes caused by exogenous shocks. We believe the frequency of this phenomenon will rise with the uncertainties surrounding the effects and prospects of the artificial-intelligence build-out and its deployment into the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1926-2024年99年CRSP数据识别出47次大市值股票集中-跑赢-回撤的"拥挤周期"事件，通过预注册的研究设计验证了双重阈值预警条件能可靠预测群体相对回撤（13/13的命中率），并提出一个分阶段的、基于状态的降风险阶梯策略，可为风险厌恶投资者每年提升3.4-4.5%的确定性等价收益。
AI.research_question: 内生性"选股拥挤"周期（即大盘股集中、跑赢、随后相对市场回撤的现象）能否被及早识别以进行降风险操作？
AI.motivation: 历史上有大量大市值股票集中-跑赢-回撤的事件（如Nifty-Fifty、互联网泡沫、2021年超级大盘成长股回撤），作者希望检验这类内生性拥挤周期是否可被提前预测并用于风险管理，而不仅是在事后解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拥挤交易/羊群行为理论；组合集中度与相关性度量的统计方法；预注册研究设计（假设、阈值、失败标准预先设定）；状态依赖的降风险决策框架；风险规避效用框架下的确定性等价收益。
AI.method: 预注册研究设计：包括预先设定的假设、阈值和失败标准、时代分块评估、前向滚动校准协议。使用1926-2024年CRSP数据，识别47次群体相对回撤事件；构建两个核心衡量指标（名称集中度、行业集中度）；设计"双标志预警条件"（快速上升的组群市值份额+快速相对涨幅）；检验概率危险模型和强度比例仓位调整的样本外表现；提出分阶段基于状态的降风险阶梯策略。
AI.findings: （1）跨时代比较中，2024年名称集中度是99年来最极端的，但行业集中度处于99年低位；（2）双标志预警条件识别出13次武装事件，全部以-10%群体相对回撤告终（中位领先8个月），对比无条件基准率51%；（3）概率危险模型和强度比例仓位调整在样本外失效，但分阶段状态依赖降风险阶梯在1990-2024年全评估期内为风险厌恶投资者每年提升3.4-4.5%确定性等价收益，且仅在约1/10的天数内操作。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对"内生性集中-拥挤-吹涨"周期进行系统性的预注册实证检验；证明集中度指标需要控制上市股票数量（universe size）才能进行跨时代有效比较；区分了内生性拥挤周期（可预测）与外生性冲击导致的崩盘（不可预测）的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的、分阶段的降风险阶梯策略，经样本外验证可为风险厌恶投资者每年增加3.4-4.5%确定性等价收益；鉴于AI建设及其经济部署带来的不确定性，此类现象频率预计上升，本文为投资者提供了实用的风险管理工具。

reference: Transnational Law & Contemporary Problems, Volume 35, No. 2.
title: Artificial Intelligence, Targeting, and the Enduring Uncertainty of Membership in an Organized Armed Group
affiliations: University of Minnesota Law School

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Targeting, and the Enduring Uncertainty of Membership in an Organized Armed Group

publicationDetails.detailsText: Transnational Law & Contemporary Problems, Volume 35, No. 2.

detail.abstract: Persistent uncertainty over the lethal targeting of members of organized armed groups (OAGs) challenges the ability to develop and deploy lethal autonomous weapons systems (LAWS).  These challenges arise, in part, from insufficient specification of OAG membership in international humanitarian law.  This article highlights these challenges by comparing three methods of determining OAG membership: a formal approach adapted from the United States' pre-9/11 individual belligerent framework, the International Committee of the Red Cross' continuous combat function framework, and the United States' post-9/11 conduct-based framework.  It establishes the United States' historical, individual belligerent framework, and critiques both the functional and conduct-based frameworks.  It also describes each framework's operational limitations for ensuring IHL compliance for the development and deployment of LAWS.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在武装组织成员识别标准不明确的情况下，致命自主武器系统（LAWS）的开发和部署所面临的挑战。通过比较三种确定武装组织成员身份的方法（美国前9/11个体交战框架、红十字国际委员会持续作战职能框架、美国后9/11行为导向框架），分析各框架在确保国际人道法合规方面的操作局限性。
AI.research_question: 在国际人道法对武装组织成员身份界定不充分的情况下，如何确定武装组织成员身份以支持致命自主武器系统（LAWS）的开发和部署？
AI.motivation: 对武装组织成员致命性打击目标的持续不确定性，阻碍了致命自主武器系统的开发与部署。这种挑战部分源于国际人道法中对武装组织成员身份的规范不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人道法（IHL）中关于武装组织成员身份界定的法律框架，包括美国前9/11个体交战框架（formal approach）、红十字国际委员会持续作战职能框架（continuous combat function）、以及美国后9/11行为导向框架（conduct-based framework）。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对三种武装组织成员身份确定方法进行系统比较，并对各框架进行批判性评述，同时分析其在致命自主武器系统开发与部署中的操作局限性。
AI.findings: 美国历史性的个体交战框架被确立为基准；功能导向（持续作战职能）框架和行为导向（后9/11）框架均受到批判；三种框架在确保致命自主武器系统符合国际人道法方面均存在操作局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理并比较了三种武装组织成员身份确定框架，揭示了国际人道法在此领域的规范不足，为该法律领域与新兴军事技术（自主武器系统）的交叉研究提供了理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为致命自主武器系统的开发者、政策制定者和军事决策者提供了关于武装组织成员身份认定框架的清晰比较分析，有助于在实际操作中确保国际人道法合规。

title: Repeated States are not Trajectories: The Identification Limits of Snapshot Inference in Survey Economics
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Repeated States are not Trajectories: The Identification Limits of Snapshot Inference in Survey Economics
detail.abstract: Repeated measurement is often treated as evidence of dynamics. This paper argues that the inference is generally invalid. A sequence of observations of population states, (P_t(y)), does not by itself identify the individual trajectories or transition law that generated them. Distinct processes involving delayed detection, heterogeneous memory, reinforcement, threshold response, or rapid belief revision may remain observationally equivalent at the sampling times. The resulting limitation is not primarily statistical. It is structural: greater sample size, improved representativeness, and more sophisticated estimation can increase the precision with which successive states are measured without identifying the dynamics connecting them. The argument is developed through the case of Stantcheva and Tham's study of public attitudes toward the 2025 U.S. tariffs. Their four-wave design provides unusually rich evidence on changing distributions of tariff-related beliefs, yet it also illustrates the distinction between repeated snapshots and trajectory identification. This distinction extends an earlier critique of Stantcheva's treatment of perceptions and zero-sum thinking: the substantive domain and empirical design have changed, but the underlying inferential architecture remains state-based. The paper identifies three classes of information required once beliefs are treated as trajectories rather than isolated states: heterogeneous detection lag (\Delta t), memory weighting (K(t-\tau)), and stability overhead (SO(T)). These quantities are introduced not as components of a competing theory of public opinion but as methodological coordinates for determining whether persistence, revision, and resistance to perturbation are empirically identifiable. The broader conclusion is that repeated states and trajectories are different mathematical objects. When dynamic explanations are inferred from measurements that identify only the former, multiple transition mechanisms remain compatible with the same empirical record. The central methodological question therefore precedes estimation: does the observable contain enough information to identify the process being explained?

AI.tldr: 本文论证了重复测量（repeated measurement）本身并不能证明动态过程的存在。对人口状态的连续观测序列（P_t(y)）无法单独识别产生这些观测的个体轨迹或转移规律。文章以Stantcheva和Tham关于2025年美国关税公共态度的四波面板研究为例，说明了"重复快照"与"轨迹识别"之间的本质区别，并提出三类方法论坐标——异质检测滞后（Δt）、记忆权重（K(t-τ)）和稳定性开销（SO(T)）——用以判断动态过程是否在经验上可识别。核心结论是：重复状态与轨迹是不同数学对象，当动态解释仅基于状态测量时，多种转移机制可能与同一经验记录兼容。
AI.research_question: 连续观测到的状态分布序列能否识别潜在的人口动态过程（个体轨迹或转移规律）？
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将重复测量视为动态性的证据，但这一推论在逻辑上通常无效。同一序列的状态观测可能与多种不同的转移机制（如延迟检测、异质记忆、强化、阈值响应或快速信念修正）观测等价，因此需要在估计之前明确可识别性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 观测等价性（observational equivalence）理论；状态识别与轨迹识别的数学区分；对Stantcheva关于感知和零和思维研究的批判的延伸。
AI.method: 概念性/方法论分析。以Stantcheva和Tham对美国2025年关税态度的四波面板研究为案例，进行逻辑论证和结构性分析，提出三类方法论坐标（Δt、K(t-τ)、SO(T)）作为识别动态过程的必要条件。
AI.findings: 1) 重复状态测量无法单独识别个体轨迹或转移规律；2) 多种动态过程（延迟检测、异质记忆、强化、阈值响应、快速信念修正）在与采样时间点上观测等价；3) 该限制是结构性的而非统计性的——更大的样本量、更好的代表性或更精细的估计无法解决；4) 需要三类额外信息（异质检测滞后、记忆权重、稳定性开销）才能将信念视为轨迹而非常态来识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"重复状态与轨迹是不同数学对象"的核心理论区分；系统论证了观测等价性问题在动态推断中的结构性（非统计性）本质；引入三类方法论坐标作为连接状态观测与轨迹识别的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为动态社会科学研究（尤其是民意测量和信念演化研究）提供方法论警示：研究设计需要在估计之前评估观测数据是否具有足够的识别信息；同时为评价现有重复测量研究的有效性提供了分析框架。

title: The Budget-maximizing Peacemaker: The Success Paradox of Peace-through-strength Defense Policy

detail.title: The Budget-maximizing Peacemaker: The Success Paradox of Peace-through-strength Defense Policy
detail.abstract: This paper develops a general theory of defense bureaucracies as budget-maximizing institutions whose internal incentives can distort their stated missions. While defense bureaus are tasked with preserving peace and security through the maintenance of military strength, their need to justify budgets and maintain relevance generates what this paper terms the Success Paradox: the bureaucratic pursuit of peace may create incentives to manufacture conflict to justify continued funding and to suppress real conflict that later erupts into prolonged and destructive wars. Therefore, defense policy is not necessarily the neutral pursuit of peace and security that it is stated to be. The analysis builds on Niskanen's model of bureaucratic behavior to explain how these incentives operate across institutional contexts. Historical and contemporary cases are analyzed to illustrate variation in how defense bureaus amplify or manufacture conflict, suppress genuine tensions, or are constrained by institutional conditions that prevent the Success Paradox from activating.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个关于国防官僚机构的一般性理论，认为它们作为预算最大化的机构，其内部激励可能扭曲其既定使命，产生所谓的"成功悖论"——即追求和平的官僚动机反而可能制造冲突以维持预算和相关性，同时压制真正的冲突导致其后期爆发为持久且破坏性的战争。
AI.research_question: 国防官僚机构作为预算最大化的制度，其内部激励机制如何在何种条件下扭曲其维护和平与安全的既定使命？
AI.motivation: 挑战国防政策是追求和平与安全的中立行为的传统假设，揭示国防官僚机构内部激励如何系统性地扭曲其使命，并解释为何看似维护和平的机构反而可能助长或制造冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 尼斯卡南（Niskanen）的官僚行为模型，以此为基础构建"成功悖论"理论。
AI.method: 理论分析结合历史与当代案例研究，通过跨制度情境的比较分析来验证和说明理论主张。
AI.findings: 国防官僚机构可能通过制造冲突来证明预算的正当性并维持自身相关性；同时也可能压制真正紧张局势，导致其积聚并在后期爆发为持久惨烈的战争；不同制度条件可以约束或阻止"成功悖论"的激活。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共选择理论（尼斯卡南官僚模型）引入国防政策分析领域，提出"成功悖论"这一新概念，为理解国防官僚机构的行为动机提供了理论框架，挑战了国防政策中立性的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供识别国防官僚机构潜在扭曲行为的分析工具，有助于设计制度约束以防止"成功悖论"发生，从而促进更真实有效的和平与安全维护。

title: Goods Movement and Environmental Justice Policy Pathologies
affiliations: and University of Southern California

detail.title: Goods Movement and Environmental Justice Policy Pathologies
detail.abstract:
The goods movement industry, as it spreads across the Inland Empire, San Joaquin Valley, Bay Area, and other regions, presents a newer version of a longstanding tension in environmental protection, namely between enforcing air quality standards under the Clean Air Act and addressing localized or neighborhood-scale effects under civil rights law. Through on-site emissions and “indirect” emissions from heavy-duty truck traffic that makes its way to and from a region’s warehouse footprint, goods movement contributes to ozone, particulate matter, and other air quality challenges. In regions that attract area sources such as warehouses and distribution centers and, indirectly, high concentrations of truck traffic along freight corridors, the modern air pollution control system breaks down. 

Specifically, the cumulative impact of mobile (e.g., truck traffic) and underregulated area sources can result in poor air quality, even as facilities comply with existing air quality and emissions standards. These impacts, particularly in overburdened communities, raise the stakes for balancing regional air quality and localized impacts further. Fortunately, there are underutilized areas of law, including Section 110 of the Clean Air Act, that can address both regional nonattainment with existing air quality standards and the neighborhood-scale, disparate impacts of industry operations and practices.

This report considers the rise and renewal of Indirect Source Review (ISR), its basis in law, its design and enactment in the San Joaquin Valley and Southern California, and its promise for adoption in other regions across the country. We find that ISR is not only a legal imperative, but also an opportunity for regional air districts, state regulators, and communities to rebalance the benefits and costs of land use, including public health benefits and equity concerns, and to overcome the presumption, adopted by regulators years ago, that air quality in a surrounding community should be considered protective in areas that comply with air quality standards.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了货物运输行业带来的空气质量问题如何打破传统《清洁空气法》下的区域空气质量监管体系，并提出间接源审查（ISR）作为一种被低估的法律工具，能够同时应对区域空气质量不达标和局部社区层面的差异化环境影响。报告分析了ISR在圣华金谷和南加州的立法设计与实施，并论证其应在全美范围内推广，以重新平衡土地利用的收益与成本。
AI.research_question: 货物运输行业（仓储设施及重型卡车交通）产生的累积性空气污染如何突破现有《清洁空气法》的监管框架？间接源审查（ISR）能否作为一种法律工具同时解决区域空气质量不达标和局部社区的环境不公问题？
AI.motivation: 货物运输行业在内陆帝国、圣华金谷和湾区等地区的扩张，使得传统上在《清洁空气法》下执行空气质量标准与在民权法下处理局部社区尺度环境影响的长期张力出现了新的表现形式。即使排放设施符合现有空气质量标准，移动源和未充分监管的面源的累积影响仍可导致空气质量恶化，尤其对负担过重的社区造成不成比例的危害，因此亟需新的法律工具来应对这一监管缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《清洁空气法》第110条等法律条文，以及环境正义（environmental justice）与民权法框架下关于局部环境影响的理论，结合间接源审查（ISR）的法律基础与政策设计理论。
AI.method: 法律与政策分析，具体包括：对《清洁空气法》相关条款（尤其是Section 110）进行法律文本分析；对ISR在圣华金谷和南加州的立法设计与实施过程进行案例研究；评估ISR在其他地区推广的可行性。
AI.findings: 研究发现，间接源审查（ISR）不仅是法律上的必要举措，更是区域空气区、州监管机构和社区重新平衡土地利用收益与成本的机会。ISR能够帮助克服监管机构多年来采纳的"符合空气质量标准即视为对周边社区具有保护性"的错误假设，同时回应区域空气质量不达标和邻里尺度的差异化影响这两大挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文重新审视并强化了《清洁空气法》第110条作为解决局部环境不公问题的法律基础，提出ISR是连接区域空气质量监管与局部社区环境正义的法律桥梁，挑战了传统的"达标即保护"监管假设，丰富了环境法与环境正义交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他地区的空气监管机构提供了ISR设计与实施的政策参考与法律依据，有助于在货物运输行业扩张的背景下保护负担过重的社区，促进土地利用决策中的公共健康效益和环境公平考量。

title: On the Ordering of Vine Copula Construction for Risk Measures Forecasting and Asset Allocation
affiliations: and University of Campinas

detail.title: On the Ordering of Vine Copula Construction for Risk Measures Forecasting and Asset Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was financial in part by the coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de pessoal de Nivel Superior - Brasil (CAPES) - Finance code 001, grant 88887.711369/2022-00; the National Council for Scientific and Technological Development (CNPq), grant 409630/2024-1; and the São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP), grants 2023/02538-0, 2023/01728-0, 2025/06131-7, and 2025/08502-2.

detail.abstract: Vine copulas are well-established and commonly used tools for modelling and forecasting financial time series, largely, favoured for their flexibility in capturing complex dependence structures among multiple time series. However, despite their strong empirical performance, the construction of vine copulas can become computationally demanding in moderate and high-dimensional settings, partly, because ordering procedures are typically required to mitigate the combinatorial complexity of model specification. In this paper, while acknowledging the importance of ordering in vine copula construction, we investigate its practical impact on risk measures forecasting and portfolio allocation. Specifically, we evaluate whether the widely adopted R-vine ordering algorithm proposed by Dissmann et al. (2013) offers significant advantages over a less demanding alternative: a D-vine copula based on an arbitrary ordering. Through Monte Carlo simulations and two empirical applications, we show that, after appropriate marginal modelling and pairs copula selection, the specific ordering of series plays a limited role in forecasting risk measures, but remains relevant for portfolio construction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了藤蔓（vine）copula中变量排序对风险度量预测和投资组合配置的实际影响。通过蒙特卡洛模拟和两项实证应用，发现经过适当的边际建模和pair copula选择后，变量排序对风险度量预测的影响有限，但对投资组合构建仍然重要。
AI.research_question: 藤蔓copula构建中的变量排序方法（R-vine最优排序算法 vs. D-vine任意排序）对风险度量预测和投资组合配置的实际影响有多大？
AI.motivation: 虽然藤蔓copula在金融时间序列建模中表现优异，但在中高维场景下构建计算成本高，尤其是排序过程增加了计算负担。作者希望探究复杂排序算法是否真的比简单的任意排序带来显著优势，以评估是否值得付出额外计算成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 藤蔓copula理论（包括R-vine和D-vine结构）、pair copula构建方法、风险度量（VaR/ES）预测理论、投资组合分配理论。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟实验和两项实证应用；比较Dissmann等人（2013）提出的R-vine排序算法与D-vine任意排序在风险预测和组合配置上的表现。
AI.findings: 在适当的边际建模和pair copula选择之后，变量排序对风险度量预测的影响有限，但对投资组合构建仍然具有相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 对藤蔓copula构建中排序必要性的理论认知进行了修正，表明R-vine最优排序在风险预测场景下并非总是必要的，扩展了对藤蔓copula复杂性与实用性权衡的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了降低藤蔓copula计算成本的实用建议：在风险度量预测场景下可以采用D-vine任意排序以节省计算资源，但在投资组合构建时仍需重视排序选择。

title: On a Simple Relationship Between Order Imbalance, Skew and Width in Over-the-Counter Trading

detail.title: On a Simple Relationship Between Order Imbalance, Skew and Width in Over-the-Counter Trading

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We consider a market maker who can only obtain and dispose of inventory by responding to a sequence of sealed-bid enquiries, and whose customers arrive with imbalanced intent: sellers more often than buyers, or the reverse. Under the assumption that the best competing response is exponentially distributed around a commonly discerned fair price, we observe a symmetry in the steady state solution that compresses the imbalanced problem onto the perfectly balanced one. Order imbalance is absorbed, exactly, by a translation of the market maker's skew, a widening of her quotes, and a multiplication of her effective cost of carry. The adjustment is simple even though the solution it adjusts is not, and it involves no free parameter beyond the observable market width. The exponential assumption is needed only locally, at the quotes actually made, and the width that enters is the locally observed one. Among the consequences: a market maker with zero inventory should still skew; skew responds to imbalance at first order whereas width responds only at second order; and the popular "constant width, linear skew" heuristic is recovered as the small-skew solution in the special case of balanced flow and quadratic holding cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个只能通过响应密封投标询价来获取和处置库存的做市商，在客户买卖意图不平衡（卖方多于买方或反之）情况下的最优报价策略。研究发现，当最佳竞争响应围绕公认公平价格呈指数分布时，稳态解存在一种对称性，可以将不平衡问题压缩为完全平衡问题。订单不平衡可以通过做市商报价偏斜的平移、报价价差的扩大以及有效持有成本的倍增来精确吸收。
AI.research_question: 当客户的买卖到达不平衡时，做市商应如何调整其报价策略（偏斜与价差）？
AI.motivation: 现实市场中客户订单流往往存在买卖不平衡，但现有做市商模型多假设到达平衡。作者希望找到一种简单而精确的方法，将不平衡问题转化为已知的平衡问题来求解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最佳竞争响应请求报价（RFQ）模型框架，假设竞争性报价围绕公平价格呈指数分布，利用稳态动态规划求解做市商最优策略。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导：构建做市商的稳态最优控制问题，通过对称性变换将不平衡问题映射到平衡问题上进行解析求解。
AI.findings: （1）订单不平衡可被精确吸收为做市商报价偏斜的平移、报价价差的扩大和有效持有成本的倍增；（2）零库存的做市商仍应设置偏斜报价；（3）偏斜对不平衡的响应是一阶的，而价差响应是二阶的；（4）小偏斜解下可恢复"恒定价差、线性偏斜"的启发式规则（适用于平衡流动和二次持有成本的特殊情形）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不平衡订单流问题与平衡订单流问题之间的精确对称性映射，将看似复杂的不平衡问题化简为已知平衡问题的简单调整，且调整无需引入自由参数（仅依赖可观测的市场宽度）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为做市商提供了简单实用的报价调整规则：即使在零库存时也应保持偏斜报价；明确不平衡对偏斜和价差的影响阶数差异，指导实际操作中优先调整偏斜而非价差；为常见启发式策略提供了理论依据。

title: Misalignment and Reconstruction of the Scientific Research System and Talent Assessment Mechanism from the Perspective of Practical Labor
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Misalignment and Reconstruction of the Scientific Research System and Talent Assessment Mechanism from the Perspective of Practical Labor
detail.abstract: Practical labor constitutes the origin of scientific knowledge generation and technological innovation evolution. Many frontline industrial technical practitioners accumulate tacit knowledge through long-term on-site production practice and can independently carry out incremental innovative activities such as process optimization and equipment retrofitting. Nevertheless, this group generally struggles to interpret highly modeled and abstract academic literature. Meanwhile, most researchers lack prolonged experience in frontline production conditions, making it difficult for them to comprehend practical constraints within industrial scenarios. A distinct discourse barrier thus emerges between academic circles and industrial sites. Against the backdrop of China s continuous reform to break the evaluation criteria of four overemphases (overemphasis on papers, academic credentials, professional titles and awards), two structural contradictions persist: the detachment of academic research from industrial reality and the formalization of talent assessment.
