title: The Dynamic Consequences of Inflow-driven Sudden Stops
affiliations: University of Namur and

detail.title: The Dynamic Consequences of Inflow-driven Sudden Stops
detail.abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic effects of sudden stops using a newly constructed database that expands country coverage to 137 economies and extends the sample to 1985Q1–2025Q4. We document a new wave of sudden-stop episodes in the 2020s, partly reversing the apparent decline observed after the post-global-financialcrisis. Local-projection estimates show that sudden stops are typically preceded by economic expansions and followed by persistent output losses lasting up to two years. The contraction is driven mainly by sharp declines in investment and consumption, while net exports rise because imports contract more strongly than exports. The results reveal two distinct transmission mechanisms. Sudden stops in net external financing operate through forced external adjustment and import compression, with larger and more persistent effects under pegged exchange-rate regimes. By contrast, gross-inflow sudden stops operate through financial conditions: leverage rises, credit conditions tighten, asset prices fall, and investment declines. This financial transmission of gross-inflow sudden stops also differs across country groups, reflecting differences in financial structure. Developing countries are more exposed to increases in financing costs, whereas advanced economies display stronger debt deflation and asset-price effects.

AI.tldr: 本文利用新构建的覆盖137个经济体、样本期1985Q1-2025Q4的突然停止数据库，研究了突然停止的宏观经济效应，发现2020年代出现了新一轮突然停止浪潮，其通过净外部融资和总流入两种不同机制传导，产生持续两年的产出损失。
AI.research_question: 突然停止（sudden stops）的宏观经济效应是什么？其传导机制在不同汇率制度和国家类型间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对突然停止的分析多局限于少数经济体或较早样本期，缺乏覆盖全球范围和大时间跨度的系统证据。且2020年代出现的新一轮突然停止浪潮，以及不同国家金融结构差异对传导机制的异质性影响，尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 突然停止理论、国际金融传导机制理论、金融加速器/债务通缩理论、汇率制度与外部调整理论
AI.method: 构建覆盖137个经济体、1985Q1-2025Q4的突然停止新数据库；采用局部投影法（local projections）估计突然停止的宏观经济动态效应，并按汇率制度和国别组进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）2020年代出现新一轮突然停止浪潮；（2）突然停止前通常伴随经济扩张，随后产出损失持续长达两年；（3）收缩主要由投资和消费急剧下降驱动，净出口因进口降幅大于出口而上升；（4）净外部融资突然停止通过强制外部调整和进口压缩发挥作用，在固定汇率制下效应更大更持久；（5）总流入突然停止通过金融渠道传导：杠杆上升、信贷收紧、资产价格下降、投资减少；（6）发展中国家对融资成本上升更敏感，发达经济体则表现出更强的债务通缩和资产价格效应。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）区分了净外部融资突然停止与总流入突然停止两种不同的传导机制，丰富了突然停止的理论分类；（2）揭示了汇率制度与金融结构对突然停止传导的调节作用；（3）为理解发展中国家与发达经济体突然停止的差异化影响提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）构建了覆盖面更广、样本期更长的突然停止数据库，为政策制定者和研究者提供基准数据；（2）为各国尤其是新兴市场国家的资本账户管理和宏观审慎政策提供实证依据；（3）对不同汇率制度下突然停止的差异化效应为汇率政策选择提供参考。

title: When Does Party Convergence Persist under Alienation-Based Abstention?
affiliations: and

detail.title: When Does Party Convergence Persist under Alienation-Based Abstention?
detail.abstract: In the standard Downsian model, two office-seeking parties converge to the median voter. However alienated voters may abstain and turn out only for a party within their tolerance radius. For single-peaked voter distributions, convergence survives but relocates to a central voter, the median of the electorate that participates at the convergent platform. However single-peakedness of the voter distribution is an empirically contested assumption. So we first characterize purestrategy equilibrium for any continuous voter distribution. For general distributions, purestrategy equilibrium can fail to exist or be non-unique, and existence of equilibrium need not persist as the tolerance radius of the voters increases. In order to resolve these issues, we propose a fundamental object: centripetal structure for which there is a single anchor platform toward which competition always pulls. We show this structure produces convergence at equilibrium under alienation based abstention. Our main result concerns the emergence and persistence of this new structure as the tolerance radius increases. Even though equilibria for office-seeking parties themselves can vanish and reappear as the radius grows, once centripetal structure emerges, it persists as long as the midpoint voter is not alienated. Moreover, the centripetal structure always emerges, and this structure classifies equilibrium completely when parties are policy motivated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在选民疏离（alienation）导致弃权的情况下，两党竞争模型的均衡问题。研究发现，对于任意连续选民分布，纯策略均衡可能不存在或不唯一，且随着容忍半径增大，均衡存在性不具持续性。作者提出了"向心结构"（centripetal structure）这一新概念，证明在该结构下竞争总是向单一锚定平台收敛，并分析了该结构随容忍半径增加的涌现与持续性。
AI.research_question: 在选民疏离弃权（alienation-based abstention）条件下，两党竞争模型中纯策略均衡的存在性与收敛性如何？是否存在一个能够统一刻画均衡的稳定性结构？
AI.motivation: 标准Downsian模型预测两党收敛于中位选民，但这一结论依赖于选民分布的单峰假设，而该假设在实证上受到质疑。当考虑选民疏离弃权时，需要重新审视均衡的存在性与收敛性，并寻找更一般的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Downsian空间竞争模型、选民疏离弃权理论（alienation-based abstention）、纯策略纳什均衡分析
AI.method: 理论建模与形式化分析：针对任意连续选民分布刻画纯策略均衡；提出"向心结构"概念并证明其性质；分析均衡随容忍半径变化的动态特征。
AI.findings: （1）对于一般连续分布，纯策略均衡可能不存在或非唯一，且均衡存在性不随容忍半径增加而持续；（2）提出向心结构，该结构下存在单一锚定平台使竞争总是收敛于此；（3）向心结构一旦涌现，只要中点选民未被疏离就会持续存在；（4）当政党具有政策动机时，向心结构总是涌现且能完全分类均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）突破了单峰分布假设的限制，将均衡分析推广到任意连续选民分布；（2）提出了"向心结构"这一新概念，为理解政党竞争收敛提供了一个新的理论工具；（3）揭示了均衡存在性与容忍半径之间的非单调关系，深化了对疏离弃权机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为理解现实中政党平台为何不一定收敛于中位选民提供了理论解释；（2）为政党和政策制定者预测选民参与和政治竞争动态提供了分析框架；（3）有助于理解当选民容忍度变化时政治格局的演变。

title: Gender Disparities in Access to Nephrology Care in North India: A 10-Year Analysis of Tertiary Care Utilization
affiliations: Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Miimansa AI Systems, Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Miimansa AI Systems, Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Miimansa AI Systems and Miimansa AI Systems

detail.title: Gender Disparities in Access to Nephrology Care in North India: A 10-Year Analysis of Tertiary Care Utilization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: V.A., N.G., L.S., and V.Y. are affiliated with Miimansa AI Systems, which developed the Bridgecloud platform used for data standardisation during preprocessing. The remaining authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the Institutional Ethics Committee of Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS), Lucknow, India As this was a retrospective observational study using routinely collected electronic health record data, the requirement for informed patient consent was waived by the ethics committee. All data were anonymised prior to analysis, and no personally identifiable information was available to the investigators. The study was conducted in accordance with the ethical principles of the Declaration of Helsinki and applicable national ethical guidelines for biomedical research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background: Sex- and gender-related inequities in access to specialist kidney care remain insufficiently characterised in low- and middle-income countries despite the substantial burden of chronic kidney disease (CKD). We evaluated differences in utilisation of tertiary nephrology services by sex over a 10-year period in North India.

Methods: We conducted a retrospective observational study using electronic health records from a high-volume tertiary nephrology referral centre in North India. All nephrology visits between Jan 1, 2010, and Dec 31, 2020, were included. Patient-level data were linked with district-level demographic and socioeconomic indicators from the 2011 Census of India. The primary outcome was utilisation of nephrology services by sex. Secondary outcomes included utilisation of kidney replacement therapies (haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, and kidney transplantation), post-transplant survival, temporal trends, and geographical patterns of access.

Findings: A total of 492,857 nephrology visits from 104,512 unique individuals were analysed. Women accounted for 152,136 (30.9%) visits and 35,254 (33.7%) unique patients. The lower representation of women was consistent across administrative divisions and throughout the study period, including after a marked expansion in service utilisation in 2014 (30.9% after vs 31.1% before; p=0.24). Women were also less likely than men to receive kidney transplantation. Among 1,205 transplant recipients, 151 (12.5%) were women; transplantation rates among patients receiving nephrology care were 2.45% for women and 6.86% for men (p<0.0001). Post-transplant survival was similar between women and men (log-rank p=0.38). Districts located farther from the study centre contributed fewer patients, whereas greater female socioeconomic advantage at the district level was associated with higher utilisation by women.

Interpretation: Women had consistently lower utilisation of tertiary nephrology services over a decade despite comparable post-transplant survival, suggesting that inequities occur primarily before access to specialist kidney care is achieved. Strategies that improve timely referral, equitable access to diagnostic and therapeutic services, and financial protection may help reduce sex- and gender-related inequities in kidney care in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于印度北部一家大型三级肾脏病转诊中心10年间的电子健康记录（492,857次肾内科就诊，104,512名患者），发现女性在肾内科服务利用方面持续低于男性（仅占就诊量的30.9%和患者数的33.7%），且在肾移植获取上差异更为显著（女性移植率2.45% vs 男性6.86%），但移植后生存率无性别差异。研究提示性别不平等主要发生在获得专科肾脏护理之前，而非诊疗过程本身。
AI.research_question: 在低收入和中等收入国家中，性别相关的肾脏专科护理获取不平等现象是否显著存在，其模式与决定因素是什么？具体而言，本研究考察印度北部地区10年间三级肾脏病服务的性别利用差异及其地理和社会经济关联因素。
AI.motivation: 慢性肾脏病在中低收入国家负担沉重，但性别相关的肾脏专科护理获取不平等尚未得到充分研究。既有证据多来自高收入国家，中低收入国家尤其在印度背景下的性别不平等特征缺乏系统性量化数据，亟需填补这一知识空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于性别与健康获取不平等的理论框架，结合地理可达性（距离对医疗利用的影响）和社会经济地位（女性社会经济优势对服务利用的调节作用）来分析肾脏专科护理利用的性别差异。
AI.method: 回顾性观察性研究。利用印度北部大型三级肾脏病转诊中心2010-2020年的电子健康记录，纳入所有肾内科就诊数据，与2011年印度人口普查的区级人口和社会经济指标进行关联分析。主要结局为按性别划分的肾脏病服务利用情况；次要结局包括肾脏替代治疗（血液透析、腹膜透析、肾移植）利用、移植后生存率、时间趋势和地理可及模式。
AI.findings: （1）女性占肾内科就诊量的30.9%和患者数的33.7%，低于男性；（2）性别不均衡在行政分区和研究期间保持一致，即使2014年服务利用显著扩张后仍未改变（30.9% vs 31.1%，p=0.24）；（3）女性接受肾移植的比例显著低于男性（12.5% vs 87.5%；移植率2.45% vs 6.86%，p<0.0001）；（4）移植后生存率无性别差异（log-rank p=0.38）；（5）距研究中心越远的地区贡献患者越少，区级女性社会经济优势越高则女性利用率越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了印度北部（中低收入国家背景）10年间三级肾脏病服务的性别利用差异，证明性别不平等在专科护理获取前阶段即已形成，丰富了对中低收入国家慢性肾脏病护理中性别不平等机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果提示需要制定改善及时转诊、公平获取诊断和治疗服务以及财务保护的政策策略，以在资源受限环境中减少肾脏护理的性别相关不平等，为卫生政策制定者和临床服务规划提供实证依据。

title: Weak Supervision at Rare-Event Priors: A Lift Threshold for Sign Degeneracy

detail.title: Weak Supervision at Rare-Event Priors: A Lift Threshold for Sign Degeneracy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only public regulatory filings of publicly listed companies, obtained from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's EDGAR system. No human participants, personal data, or animal subjects are involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding from any agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Label models of the Snorkel lineage take the polarity of each labeling function as given and estimate only a magnitude around it. At a rare-event prior that estimate cannot carry the polarity. For coverage c, lift ℓ and declared polarity p, the moment E[λy] equals p·c·(πℓ−(1−π))/(πℓ+(1−π)), so its sign turns over at ℓ* = (1−π)/π whatever the coverage. At a prior of 0.8185 % the threshold is a lift of 121.2; the strongest function in our register reaches 7.99. The sign such a model reports is a fact about the class balance, not about the function. In post-hoc synthetic sweeps, the conditionally correct sign instead of the declared one is worth 1.0 points of precision on a 5-function register and 48.4 on a 50-function one: writing more functions enlarges the surface of the one assumption nobody checks. In the same sweeps reversal needs no confounder; it all but disappears when functions are independent (0.5 % reverse), so correlation is its precondition, not an aggravating factor. The register came out of a pre-registered comparison on SEC filings, read exactly once, where four weak-supervision stages do not separate from one frozen rule at a budget whose registered detectable difference is 27.4 percentage points: the design cannot decide it, and said so in advance. A pre-registered placebo failed and is reported as such. We release it with the scored panel as a labeling-function benchmark in a regime existing suites do not pose as rare-event detection at an alert budget.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Snorkel系列标签模型在罕见事件（低先验概率）场景下的根本性缺陷：模型将标注函数的极性（polarity）视为给定事实，仅估计幅度，但在极低先验下符号（sign）会翻转，导致模型报告的符号反映的是类别平衡而非函数本身的真实性质。作者通过合成扫描实验和SEC备案文件的预注册比较证明了该问题，并发布了标注函数基准数据集。
AI.research_question: 在罕见事件（极低先验概率）条件下，Snorkel系列标签模型的标注函数极性估计为何失效？标注函数之间相关性如何影响符号反转？
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督标签模型在罕见事件检测场景下未被充分检验，已有的基准套件不涵盖此类低先验高警报预算条件的设置。
AI.theoretical_framework: Snorkel标签模型的矩估计理论（E[λy]的符号判定）；覆盖率-提升度-极性三者之间的数学关系；标注函数相关性对估计的影响。
AI.method: 数学推导（矩E[λy]的符号临界点）；后验合成扫描（synthetic sweeps），在5函数和50函数注册表上对比条件正确符号与声明符号；SEC备案文件上的预注册比较实验（四阶段弱监督与单一冻结规则对比）；预注册安慰剂检验。
AI.findings: （1）E[λy]的符号在ℓ*=(1−π)/π处翻转，与覆盖率无关；在先验0.8185%下阈值为提升度121.2，而最强函数的提升度仅7.99；（2）条件正确符号在5函数注册表上值1.0点精确度，在50函数上值48.4点——写更多函数扩大了未被检验假设的表面积；（3）符号反转不需要混杂因素，函数独立时反转率仅0.5%，相关性是反转的前提条件而非加剧因素；（4）预注册比较中四阶段弱监督不能与单一冻结规则区分，注册的可检测差异为27.4个百分点，设计在事先就确认无法决断；（5）预注册安慰剂失败并如实报告。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Snorkel标签模型在低先验下极性估计的根本性缺陷：符号是类别平衡的产物而非函数性质的反映；阐明了函数相关性是符号反转的充分必要条件（而非简单加剧因素）；将极性可信度与覆盖率、提升度、先验结合起来刻画了可验证的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布了罕见事件检测情境下的标注函数基准（含评分面板），填补了现有基准套件在低先验高警报预算场景的空白；提供了评估标签模型符号有效性的临界阈值公式；通过预注册实验和如实报告的安慰剂失败树立了实践标杆。

title: Does Federal Preclearance of State Election Laws Make a Difference? Examining the Effects of Shelby on the Minority Voting Gap and Countermobilization
affiliations: University of Colorado Boulder and University of Missouri - Economics

detail.title: Does Federal Preclearance of State Election Laws Make a Difference? Examining the Effects of Shelby on the Minority Voting Gap and Countermobilization
detail.abstract: In Shelby County v. Holder (2013), the Supreme Court suspended federal preclearance restrictions on changes to election laws in several states with a history of racial or ethnic discrimination and disparities in voting. We analyze the impact of this decision by estimating the triple difference in minority versus non-minority turnout in affected and unaffected states before and after Shelby. The end of federal preclearance does not appear to have detrimental effects on minority voter turnout or registration. We also show that revised federal preclearance procedures in the proposed John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act are not better targeted at states where minority voting may have retrogressed after Shelby. Finally, we do not find support for the hypothesis that countermobilization among minority voters mitigates or confounds what would otherwise have been an increase in the minority voting gap post-Shelby.

AI.tldr: 本文利用三重差分方法，分析美国最高法院在Shelby County v. Holder（2013）案中暂停联邦预先审查制度对少数族裔投票率的影响。研究发现，该决定并未对少数族裔选民投票率或登记率产生不利影响，并进一步评估了拟议的《约翰·刘易斯投票权促进法案》中的新条款的针对性和少数族裔反动员假说。
AI.research_question: Shelby County v. Holder案中联邦预先审查制度的暂停是否对少数族裔选民投票率和登记率产生了不利影响？
AI.motivation: 联邦预先审查制度（preclearance）是《投票权法》的核心保护机制，旨在防止有歧视历史的州在选举法变更中损害少数族裔投票权。Shelby案暂停该制度引发了关于少数族裔投票权是否受到损害的广泛学术和政策争论，因此需要实证评估其实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投票权法与联邦预先审查制度；少数族裔投票参与的歧视与抑制理论；反动员（countermobilization）理论
AI.method: 三重差分估计（triple difference）：比较受影响州与未受影响州中少数族裔与非少数族裔选民在Shelby案前后的投票率差异
AI.findings: （1）联邦预先审查制度的结束并未对少数族裔选民投票率或登记率产生不利影响；（2）拟议的《约翰·刘易斯投票权促进法案》中的新预先审查程序并未更好地针对Shelby后少数族裔投票可能退步的州；（3）没有证据支持少数族裔反动员假说——即反动员并未掩盖或缓解Shelby后少数族裔投票差距的扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 对联邦预先审查制度的效应提供了新的因果证据，挑战了"取消预先审查必然损害少数族裔投票权"的假设；同时通过检验少数族裔反动员假说，丰富了关于投票权保护制度效果的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国最高法院关于《投票权法》相关裁决的政策评估提供了实证依据；对拟议的《约翰·刘易斯投票权促进法案》中预先审查程序的针对性提出了经验质疑，为立法决策提供参考。

title: Re-Engineering Infrastructure Procurement: A Dynamic Life-Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA) Framework Integrating Accelerated Depreciation and Stochastic Climate Risks into Public Asset Valuation
affiliations: Ain Shams University Cairo

detail.title: Re-Engineering Infrastructure Procurement: A Dynamic Life-Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA) Framework Integrating Accelerated Depreciation and Stochastic Climate Risks into Public Asset Valuation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: The critical fiscal deficit in United States infrastructure asset management is largely driven by a systemic failure in long-term capital allocation strategies. Traditional public procurement pathways under the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA) prioritize minimized short-term capital expenditures (Capex), frequently resulting in the selection of low-cost vendors whose upfront savings are heavily wiped out by catastrophic operational expenditures (OpEx) over multi-decade horizons. This research establishes a novel, comprehensive financial engineering framework that re-engineers' legacy Life-Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA) into a standardized, dynamic economic model. The proposed framework mathematically endogenizes both accelerated physical asset depreciation and stochastic climate-induced risk distributions directly into the dynamic Net Present Value (NPV) and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) equations of smart public infrastructure. By utilizing advanced econometric modeling alongside a high-throughput 10,000iteration Monte Carlo simulation engine, this study provides a turnkey digital toolkit for state Treasurers and municipal chief financial officers. The model demonstrates a scalable capacity to achieve deep, sustainable long-term fiscal conservation, optimizing asset-liability management, stabilizing long-term municipal debt service requirements, and safeguarding American taxpayer wealth against compounding macroeconomic and environmental shocks over a fixed 30-year operational lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文针对美国基础设施资产管理中长期资本配置的系统性失灵问题，提出将传统全生命周期成本分析（LCCA）重构为标准化动态经济模型的金融工程框架，通过将加速物理折旧和气候风险分布内生化于动态NPV和TCO方程中，并运用计量经济建模与10,000次蒙特卡洛模拟，为州财政官员提供数字工具包，以实现30年运营周期内的深度财政节约和风险规避。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重新设计全生命周期成本分析框架，将气候风险和加速资产折旧纳入动态财务模型，以解决美国基础设施公共采购中因过度关注短期资本支出而导致长期运营成本失控的系统性问题？
AI.motivation: 美国基础设施资产管理面临严重的财政赤字，根本原因在于长期资本配置策略的系统性失效。现行《基础设施投资与就业法案》（IIJA）下的传统公共采购路径过度优先最小化短期资本支出，导致低价供应商的初始节省在数十年运营周期中被灾难性的运营支出（OpEx）完全抵消。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期成本分析（LCCA）、动态净现值（NPV）模型、总拥有成本（TCO）理论、金融工程框架、资产-负债管理理论
AI.method: 采用高级计量经济学建模结合10,000次迭代的蒙特卡洛模拟引擎，构建标准化的动态经济模型，将加速物理资产折旧和随机气候风险分布直接内生化于动态NPV和TCO方程中。
AI.findings: 该模型具备规模化实现深度、可持续的长期财政节约的能力，能够优化资产-负债管理，稳定长期市政债务服务需求，并在固定的30年运营生命周期内保护美国纳税人财富免受复合宏观经济和环境冲击的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统的静态生命周期成本分析重构为标准化、动态化的经济模型，创新性地将加速物理折旧和气候风险分布内生到财务方程中，推动LCCA从静态工具向动态风险管理框架的理论演进。
AI.practical_contributions: 为州财政官员和市政首席财务官提供了一站式数字工具包（turnkey digital toolkit），可规模化应用于公共基础设施的采购决策和长期财政规划，有助于优化政府的资产-负债管理和债务服务能力。

title: Financing the Scalable Stage: Technology, Donations, and Earned Revenue in the Performing Arts

detail.title: Financing the Scalable Stage: Technology, Donations, and Earned Revenue in the Performing Arts
detail.abstract: This paper studies how digital distribution changes the financing mix of a nonprofit performing-arts organization when audience access becomes scalable but live production remains labor intensive. The organization chooses quality, live ticket prices, and digital access to maximize quality-adjusted service subject to break-even; a donor then contributes after observing earned revenue and the mission supported by each donated dollar. The model yields three results. First, higher live-production wages raise the contribution share but reduce donations, production, and mission output. Second, for a fixed digital strategy, better distribution technology lowers the contribution share while raising donations because earned revenue and audience reach increase the mission supported by each donated dollar. Third, the organization commercializes digital access when the monetization gain exceeds the donor-valued loss from narrower access. The commercialization threshold rises with Baumol pressure and falls as digital access becomes easier to monetize. Numerical experiments with endogenous quality, ticket prices, and commercialization generate open, mixed, and commercial regimes. Donations can therefore rise even as their share of operating resources falls, while digital distribution helps finance the labor-intensive live core.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字发行如何改变非营利表演艺术组织的融资结构，在观众可及性变得可规模化但现场制作仍属劳动密集型的情况下，组织选择质量、现场票价和数字访问以在盈亏平衡约束下最大化质量调整服务，捐赠者观察到赚取收入和每美元捐赠所支持的使命后进行捐赠。模型得出三个结果：更高的现场制作工资提高捐赠份额但减少捐赠、生产和使命产出；对于固定数字策略，更好的发行技术降低捐赠份额但提高捐赠；组织在货币化收益超过捐赠者价值损失时商业化数字访问。
AI.research_question: 数字发行如何改变非营利表演艺术组织的融资组合（捐赠与盈利收入的结构）？
AI.motivation: 数字技术使观众访问可规模化，但现场演出仍高度依赖劳动密集型生产，这改变了非营利表演艺术组织的传统融资逻辑和捐赠者行为，需要理论模型加以分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非营利组织融资理论、Baumol成本病理论、捐赠者行为理论（捐赠者关注每美元捐赠所支持的使命）
AI.method: 理论模型构建：组织在盈亏平衡约束下选择质量、票价和数字访问策略以最大化质量调整服务，捐赠者随后根据盈利收入和使命支持度进行捐赠；辅以数值实验（内生质量、票价和商业化决策）。
AI.findings: （1）更高的现场生产工资提高捐赠份额但减少捐赠、生产和使命产出；（2）更好的数字发行技术降低捐赠份额但提高捐赠总量，因为盈利收入和观众覆盖面增强了每美元捐赠支持的使命；（3）组织在货币化收益超过捐赠者价值损失时商业化数字访问，商业化阈值随Baumol压力上升而上升、随数字访问货币化难度下降而下降；数值实验识别出开放、混合和商业三种制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字发行引入非营利表演艺术融资理论，揭示捐赠份额下降与捐赠总量上升可以并存，阐明商业化决策的权衡条件，拓展Baumol成本病在数字时代对非营利组织融资结构的影响分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非营利表演艺术组织在数字时代制定融资和商业化策略提供指导，说明数字发行可帮助资助劳动密集型现场核心业务，为管理者理解捐赠结构变化提供决策参考。

title: Optimizing Public Infrastructure Financing in the U.S.: A Financial Engineering Framework Utilizing Green Bonds and Carbon Credit Arbitrage to Reduce the Cost of Capital
affiliations: Ain Shams University Cairo

detail.title: Optimizing Public Infrastructure Financing in the U.S.: A Financial Engineering Framework Utilizing Green Bonds and Carbon Credit Arbitrage to Reduce the Cost of Capital

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: The massive structural funding deficit plaguing United States public infrastructure, exacerbated by the compounding macroeconomic pressures of persistent core inflation and elevated interest rates in 2026, demands an immediate paradigm shift in public capital efficiency. Traditional municipal financing models, which rely almost exclusively on regressive tax mechanisms and direct federal grants under the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA), are increasingly inadequate to cover substantial cost overruns and higher debt servicing burdens. This research introduces a novel, structurally integrated financial engineering framework designed to systematically minimize the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) for large-scale U.S. public infrastructure assets. The core mechanism of the proposed framework achieves this by synergizing high-efficiency Green Bond issuances with a dynamic Carbon Credit Arbitrage model. By doing so, it effectively establishes a multilayered quantitative pricing engine that allows state Departments of Transportation (DOTs) and local municipalities to monetize verified environmental externalities into highly liquid, upfront fiscal assets. Unlike existing qualitative sustainable finance literature, this study develops a predictive optimization model that calculates the precise empirical thresholds of the "Greenium" (the yield discount on green debt) while simultaneously factoring in the volatility of both voluntary and compliance carbon credit markets. Applied across a simulated portfolio of U.S. mass transit and clean energy grid expansions, the framework demonstrates a highly scalable capability to compress municipal borrowing yields by 150 to 300 basis points. Ultimately, this research provides an actionable, market-driven blueprint that safeguards American taxpayer funds, preserves long-term Debt Service Coverage Ratios (DSCR), and accelerates the deployment of strategically vital, climate-resilient national infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结构化的金融工程框架，通过整合绿色债券发行与碳信用套利模型，系统性地最小化美国大型公共基础设施资产的加权平均资本成本（WACC），可将市政借贷收益率压缩150至300个基点。
AI.research_question: 如何通过金融工程手段系统性地最小化美国大型公共基础设施资产的加权平均资本成本（WACC）？
AI.motivation: 美国公共基础设施面临巨大的结构性资金赤字，传统市政融资模式（依赖累退税机制和联邦拨款）不足以覆盖成本超支和更高的债务偿还负担，尤其在2026年持续通胀和高利率的宏观压力下，亟需新的资本效率范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以加权平均资本成本（WACC）最优化为核心理论，结合绿色债券发行机制中的"绿色溢价"（Greenium）定价理论，以及自愿性和合规性碳信用市场的套利定价理论。
AI.method: 提出一个结构化的金融工程框架，核心机制是高效绿色债券发行与动态碳信用套利模型的协同，构建多层次的量化定价引擎，并开发预测性优化模型以计算"绿色溢价"的经验阈值，同时纳入碳信用市场波动性因素。通过模拟美国公共交通和清洁能源电网扩张投资组合进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 该框架在模拟投资组合中展现出高度可扩展性，能够将市政借贷收益率压缩150至300个基点，有效降低融资成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 区别于现有定性可持续金融文献，本研究开发了预测性优化模型，精确计算绿色债务收益率折价的"绿色溢价"经验阈值，并综合考量自愿性和合规性碳信用市场的波动性，推动了可持续金融的量化理论发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为州交通部门和地方政府提供了可操作的市场驱动型蓝图，将验证的环境外部性货币化为高流动性的前期财政资产，保护美国纳税人资金，维护长期债务偿付覆盖率（DSCR），并加速气候韧性国家基础设施的部署。

title: Feedback And Learning in Higher Education: A Field Experiment with Exam Retrievals
affiliations: University of Bath - Department of Economics

detail.title: Feedback And Learning in Higher Education: A Field Experiment with Exam Retrievals

declarations.ethicsApproval: Approval code from the University of Bath Social Sciences Research Ethics Committee: SSREC S17-204

detail.abstract: Graded examination scripts often contain much information that could inform student learning, yet this information may never reach students. This is either because institutional regulations do not allow access to exam scripts (as in the case of final exams in the UK) or because students tend to not retrieve scripts when they already know their grades. What would students learn if they retrieved exam scripts that would otherwise remain uncollected? This question is investigated with a four-year field experiment with first year university students. In this experiment students receive their midterm exam grades but only receive detailed feedback by retrieving their script. A randomly selected group of students receives reminders to retrieve their script and suggestions on how to use it for revision for the final exam. We find that the effects of retrieving exam scripts are on average small and insignificant but vary with ability. Students with the highest university entry scores benefit substantially from retrieving their scripts while the benefits to students with lower entry scores are at best small and not statistically significant. These results can be explained by two key features of detailed feedback: that at least some prior study is necessary for it to be minimally effective and that it becomes more effective with better academic preparation. Because higher ability students tend to have better academic preparation, they benefit more from it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个为期四年的田野实验，探讨大学生取回考试答卷（获得详细反馈）对其期末考试成绩的影响。研究发现，取回答卷的平均效应较小且不显著，但对大学入学成绩最高的学生有显著正收益，能力较低的学生获益甚微。这源于详细反馈需要一定的前期学习和更好的学术准备才能发挥效果。
AI.research_question: 如果学生取回那些原本不会被取回的考试答卷，他们能学到什么？即取回答卷（获得详细反馈）对学业成绩有何影响？
AI.motivation: 评分后的考试答卷包含大量有助于学生学习的信息，但这些信息可能永远不会到达学生手中。原因包括制度限制（如英国期末考试不允许查看答卷）或学生已经知道成绩后不愿取回答卷。因此需要探究取回答卷是否能带来学习收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于详细反馈有效性的两个关键特征：（1）至少需要一定的先前学习才能使反馈发挥最低限度的效果；（2）反馈效果随学术准备程度提高而增强。这解释了为什么能力越高的学生从详细反馈中获益越多。
AI.method: 四年田野实验，研究对象为大学一年级学生。学生得知期中考试成绩，但只有取回答卷才能获得详细反馈。随机选取一组学生接收取回答卷的提醒以及如何使用答卷进行期末复习的建议。
AI.findings: 取回答卷的效应平均而言较小且不显著，但随能力不同而变化。大学入学成绩最高的学生从取回答卷中获益显著，而入学成绩较低的学生获益至多很小且统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了详细反馈效果的异质性机制：反馈需要一定基础知识和良好学术准备才能有效，从而解释了为何高能力学生从反馈中获益更多，为反馈理论提供了更为细致的条件性理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构和教师提供了关于如何设计反馈机制的实证依据。提示仅提供反馈渠道（如取回答卷）可能不够，应结合学生能力水平差异化设计反馈策略，并对低能力学生提供额外支持以弥补其基础不足。

title: Shadow Banking Regulation, Credit Supply Volatility, And the Effectiveness of Monetary and Macroprudential Policies in China
affiliations: School of Finance, Nankai University, Sun Yat-sen University and Guangdong University of Technology

detail.title: Shadow Banking Regulation, Credit Supply Volatility, And the Effectiveness of Monetary and Macroprudential Policies in China
detail.abstract: Building on an empirical analysis of stylized facts about the macroeconomic effects of China's shadow banking regulation, this study develops a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model including an explicit financial intermediary sector, and estimates this model on China data using macroeconomic time series to reveal how comprehensive shadow banking regulation can smooth credit supply fluctuations and strengthen the effectiveness of China's monetary and macroprudential policies. The results demonstrate that microprudential regulation curbs shadow banking's countercyclical expansion, enabling macroprudential policy to alleviate credit shortages via partial reintermediation. Coordinated policies foster countercyclical commercial bank lending, mitigating tensions between monetary countercyclicality and inherent credit procyclicality. Macroprudential subsidies endogenously curb self-fulfilling shadow bank runs, enabling better balance between economic stabilization and financial stability. Welfare analysis confirms that the coordination framework yields lower aggregate welfare losses, particularly when macroprudential policy appropriately weights the output gap. This study deepens the understanding of shadow banking regulation by quantifying how it limits the sector's impact on economic fluctuations and financial stability across different economic regimes, thereby contributing to a more coherent policy coordination framework.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含金融中介部门的动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，并利用中国宏观时间序列数据进行估计，系统揭示了综合影子银行监管如何平滑信贷供给波动并增强货币政策和宏观审慎政策的有效性。研究发现微观审慎监管抑制了影子银行的逆周期扩张，协调政策能够促进商业银行贷款的逆周期放贷，宏观审慎补贴能够内生地抑制自我实现的影子银行挤兑，整体福利分析表明协调框架能降低社会福利损失。
AI.research_question: 综合影子银行监管如何平滑信贷供给波动，并增强中国货币政策和宏观审慎政策的有效性？
AI.motivation: 基于对中国影子银行监管宏观经济效应的典型事实的经验分析，现有文献对影子银行监管如何影响货币政策传导和金融稳定缺乏系统性的定量理解，需要构建一般均衡框架来揭示监管协调的宏观效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，包含显性金融中介部门，整合微观审慎监管与宏观审慎政策框架。
AI.method: 构建包含金融中介部门的DSGE模型，利用中国宏观时间序列数据进行贝叶斯估计，并结合福利分析定量评估不同监管政策组合的效应。
AI.findings: （1）微观审慎监管可抑制影子银行的逆周期扩张，使宏观审慎政策能通过部分再中介化缓解信贷短缺；（2）协调政策促进商业银行贷款逆周期放贷，缓解货币政策逆周期性与信贷固有顺周期性之间的张力；（3）宏观审慎补贴内生地抑制自我实现的影子银行挤兑；（4）政策协调框架能降低总福利损失，尤其在宏观审慎政策合理权衡产出缺口时效果更佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对影子银行监管的理解，通过定量刻画监管如何在不同经济体制下限制影子银行对经济波动和金融稳定的影响，为政策协调框架提供了更连贯的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国的货币政策与宏观审慎政策协调提供定量政策依据，指导影子银行监管框架设计以更好地平衡经济稳定与金融稳定目标。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12891
title: Neighborhood Change and Local Economic Activity
affiliations: Rutgers University and University of Rome Tor Vergata - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Neighborhood Change and Local Economic Activity
detail.abstract: We study how neighborhood change shapes local business demographics and employment. We use the regeneration of London public housing into mixed-income housing as a natural experiment that led to a large influx of more affluent households. In a difference-in-differences design comparing nearby businesses to those located farther away, we find that regenerations shift business composition – in both counts and employment – away from small local shops and toward larger general retail establishments and dining services that cater to the new residents. While we find no effect on total local employment on average, employment does increase in the areas most disadvantaged at baseline, suggesting that neighborhood change can expand local employment opportunities in these areas.

AI.tldr: 本文利用伦敦公共住房改造为混合收入住房这一自然实验，采用双重差分方法研究邻里变迁如何影响当地商业人口结构和就业，发现改造导致商业结构从小型本地商店转向服务新居民的大型综合零售和餐饮业，且在最贫困地区就业有所增加。
AI.research_question: 邻里变迁（收入结构变化）如何影响当地商业构成和就业？
AI.motivation: 理解社区收入结构变化（富裕人群涌入）对本地商业生态和就业的影响，为城市更新政策提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 邻里变迁理论、消费需求拉动效应、商业集聚理论、双重差分自然实验方法
AI.method: 利用伦敦公共住房改造为混合收入住房作为自然实验，采用双重差分设计，比较靠近改造区域的商业与远离区域商业的差异。
AI.findings: 1）改造使商业构成从小型本地商店转向大型综合零售和餐饮服务；2）总体上对当地总就业没有显著影响；3）在基线最贫困地区，就业有所增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为邻里变迁如何影响商业人口结构提供了因果证据，揭示了消费需求变化对商业结构重塑的作用机制，并区分了不同初始条件区域的不同效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市公共住房改造政策提供评估依据，提示政策制定者关注改造对本地小商业的替代效应，同时认识到在贫困地区改造可能创造就业机会。

title: Unexpected Gross Profit and Cross-Sectional Stock Returns
affiliations: Sichuan Normal University, City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Economics & Finance, University of Hawaii at Manoa - Shidler College of Business and Shanghai Jiao Tong University - Antai College of Economics & Management

detail.title: Unexpected Gross Profit and Cross-Sectional Stock Returns
detail.abstract: In this study, we define unexpected gross profit (GAP) as the difference between the current level of gross profit and its expected value, estimated using a moving average over the preceding eight quarters. With Fama-MacBeth t-statistics of 8.32 under ordinary least squares and 2.72 under weighted least squares, GAP emerges as one of the strongest predictors of individual stock returns, comparable to standardized unexpected earnings (SUE) measures. Moreover, GAP exhibits low correlations with both SUE and the revenue surprise measure, while providing incremental predictive power. Using the newly developed instrumented principal component analysis (IPCA) framework, we find that the predictive ability of GAP is primarily attributable to its role as a proxy for systematic risk (beta) rather than mispricing (alpha).

AI.tldr: 本研究定义了非预期毛利（GAP），将其作为股票收益的强预测因子。通过Fama-MacBeth检验和IPCA框架分析，发现GAP的预测能力主要源于其作为系统性风险（beta）的代理变量，而非错误定价（alpha）。
AI.research_question: 非预期毛利（GAP）是否能预测个股收益？其预测能力是源于系统性风险（beta）还是错误定价（alpha）？
AI.motivation: 已有的盈余惊喜（SUE）和收入惊喜等指标虽能预测股票收益，但毛利作为企业核心盈利指标尚未被系统研究。作者希望探索GAP这一新的收益预测因子，并厘清其预测能力的来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效市场假说与资产定价理论，利用Fama-MacBeth回归框架和新兴的仪器化主成分分析（IPCA）框架来区分系统性风险（beta）与错误定价（alpha）的解释力。
AI.method: 基于前八个季度的移动平均估计预期毛利，构建GAP指标；采用Fama-MacBeth回归（OLS和WLS）检验预测能力；使用IPCA框架区分beta与alpha的贡献。
AI.findings: GAP是股票收益的最强预测因子之一（Fama-MacBeth t值OLS为8.32，WLS为2.72），与SUE相当；GAP与SUE及收入惊喜指标相关性低，具有增量预测能力；IPCA分析表明GAP的预测能力主要来自系统性风险（beta）代理，而非错误定价（alpha）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资产定价文献提供了新的收益预测因子GAP，并通过IPCA框架明确了该因子的预测能力源自系统性风险而非市场异象，深化了对会计信息与资产定价关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于毛利信息的新预测指标，可作为现有盈余惊喜指标的补充工具；同时为实务中区分风险溢价与错误定价提供了方法论参考。

title: Reference Health, Medical Spending, and Investment Decisions
affiliations: Deakin University, Deakin University - Deakin Business School, University of Hamburg - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration and University of Zurich

detail.title: Reference Health, Medical Spending, and Investment Decisions
detail.abstract: We propose a dynamic economic model of medical spending, consumption, and risky investment including reference values in health and their adaptation to decaying health, which are found empirically relevant to the demand for medical care. Calibrating the model using Health and Retirement Study data yields gradually adapting health reference values for both genders which closely replicate observed medical spending and shares of risky investment. Including projection bias, meaning inability to fully anticipate the health reference value adaptation, significantly improves our model’s replication of observed choices for less wealthy individuals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含健康参照值及其适应性调整的动态经济学模型，用于解释医疗支出、消费和风险投资决策。利用健康与退休研究（HRS）数据进行校准，模型较好地复现了观察到的医疗支出和风险投资占比。引入预期偏差（projection bias）后，模型对不太富裕个体的行为复制能力显著提升。
AI.research_question: 健康和参照值的适应性如何影响个体的医疗支出、消费及风险投资决策？预期偏差在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有文献发现健康参照值及其对衰退健康的适应性对医疗需求具有实证相关性，但缺乏将其纳入动态经济模型以解释医疗支出与投资行为的系统性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态经济学模型；参照依赖偏好（reference-dependent preferences）；预期偏差（projection bias）
AI.method: 构建动态经济模型，使用健康与退休研究（HRS）数据进行校准，对性别分组进行参数估计，并比较有/无预期偏差设定下的模型拟合效果。
AI.findings: 1. 男女两性均存在逐渐适应的健康参照值，模型可密切复现观察到的医疗支出与风险投资占比；2. 引入预期偏差（无法充分预见健康参照值适应）显著改善了对不太富裕个体行为的复制能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将健康参照值的适应性纳入动态经济模型，拓展了参照依赖偏好理论在健康和医疗需求领域的应用，并首次将预期偏差与健康参照适应相结合来解释个体行为异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同财富水平个体的医疗支出与投资决策提供模型基础，有助于政策制定者设计针对低收入群体的健康储蓄与投资激励政策。

title: Market Risk Premium Expectation: Combining Option Theory with Traditional Predictors
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - Olin Business School, University of North Carolina  (UNC) at Wilmington,  and Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: Market Risk Premium Expectation: Combining Option Theory with Traditional Predictors
detail.abstract: We propose a state-dependent framework that integrates option-implied information with macro-financial variables to explore the out-of-sample predictive ability for the market excess return. By allowing economic conditions to influence the tightness of option-implied bounds, the approach transforms static measures into flexible bounds that adapt to changing market environments. Empirically, the resulting state-dependent bound (SDB) improves out-of-sample performance both statistically and economically. Relative to the Martin bound, the SDB increases the Sharpe ratio by over 150% and delivers utility gains exceeding 200 basis points per year. The framework also extends naturally to the cross section of stock returns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个状态依赖框架，将期权隐含信息与宏观金融变量相结合，用于探索市场超额收益的样本外预测能力。通过允许经济条件影响期权隐含边界的松紧度，该方法将静态度量转化为适应不断变化的市场环境的灵活边界。实证结果表明，由此产生的状态依赖边界（SDB）在统计上和经济上都提高了样本外表现。
AI.research_question: 如何利用期权隐含信息与宏观金融变量的结合，提高市场超额收益的样本外预测能力？
AI.motivation: 传统的期权隐含度量（如Martin bound）是静态的，未能反映经济条件变化对风险溢价的影响，因此样本外预测能力有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态依赖框架，期权隐含边界理论（Martin bound），宏观金融变量联动框架
AI.method: 构建状态依赖框架，将期权隐含信息与宏观金融变量整合，允许经济状态调节期权隐含边界的松紧度，形成动态调整的样本外预测边界。
AI.findings: 状态依赖边界（SDB）在统计上和经济上都显著改善了样本外预测表现。相较于Martin bound，夏普比率提高了超过150%，每年产生的效用收益超过200个基点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将静态的期权隐含度量推广为状态依赖的动态边界，为资产定价与预测领域提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供更优的市场超额收益预测工具，改善投资组合的夏普比率和效用收益；框架还可自然扩展至个股收益的横截面分析。

title: Oil Price Uncertainty and Sovereign Spreads of OilImporters

detail.title: Oil Price Uncertainty and Sovereign Spreads of OilImporters
detail.abstract: This paper examines how global oil price volatility affects sovereign spreads in oil-importing countries. Using data from 35 emerging economies, I first establish a positive empirical relationship between oil price volatility and spreads. I then develop a sovereign default model where oil prices follow a stochastic volatility process estimated via Bayesian MCMC methods. The model reveals that spread responses to oil price changes are highly state-dependent. During high volatility periods, spreads respondthree times more sharply to price fluctuations than during normal times. Debt levels amplify this sensitivity—more indebted economies experience larger spread increases. Importantly, governments strategically borrow more during high volatility periods when oil prices are expected to rise, effectively using debt as insurance against future import costs and higher borrowing rates. These findings highlight oil price uncertainty as aquantitatively important macroeconomic risk for oil-importing nations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球油价波动如何影响石油进口国的主权利差。基于35个新兴经济体的数据，首先确立了油价波动与利差之间的正向经验关系，然后构建了一个油价遵循随机波动率过程（通过贝叶斯MCMC方法估计）的主权违约模型。模型揭示利差对油价变化的响应高度依赖状态：高波动时期利差对价格波动的响应是正常时期的三倍；债务水平会放大这种敏感性。重要的是，政府在高波动期且油价预期上涨时会战略性增加借贷，将债务作为对冲未来进口成本和更高借款利率的保险工具。这些发现凸显了油价不确定性是石油进口国重要的宏观经济风险。
AI.research_question: 全球油价波动如何影响石油进口国的主权利差？其传导机制和状态依赖性是什么？
AI.motivation: 油价波动对石油进口国是重要的宏观经济风险来源，但已有文献主要关注油价水平（而非波动性）对利差的影响，缺乏对油价不确定性影响主权借贷成本的系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权违约模型（Sovereign Default Model），油价随机波动率过程（Stochastic Volatility），贝叶斯MCMC估计
AI.method: 首先利用35个新兴经济体的面板数据进行经验分析，确立油价波动与主权利差的正向关系；然后构建理论主权违约模型，其中油价遵循随机波动率过程，并使用贝叶斯MCMC方法估计模型参数。
AI.findings: （1）油价波动与主权利差之间存在正向经验关系；（2）利差对油价变化的响应高度状态依赖，高波动时期利差对价格波动的响应是正常时期的三倍；（3）债务水平放大这种敏感性，高负债经济体利差增幅更大；（4）政府在高波动期且油价预期上涨时会战略性增加借贷，将债务作为对未来进口成本和借款利率上升的保险。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将油价随机波动率引入主权违约模型，揭示了油价波动通过状态依赖渠道影响主权借贷成本的机制，并提出了政府策略性借贷行为（将债务作为保险）的理论解释，丰富了主权债务和油价风险交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油进口国（尤其是高负债新兴经济体）的风险管理和借款策略提供了政策启示：在高油价波动时期需警惕利差放大效应，并合理规划债务融资以对冲油价不确定性风险。

title: Stablecoin Flows, Dollar Convenience Yields and Exchange Rates
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology,  and Tsinghua University, School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Stablecoin Flows, Dollar Convenience Yields and Exchange Rates
detail.abstract: We study how U.S. dollar–denominated stablecoins affect U.S. Treasury convenience yields, exchange rates, and financial market stability. We first find that a one-standard-deviation inflow into dollar stablecoins raises the U.S. Treasury convenience yield by 4 bps. The effects are more pronounced when transaction fees are lower, transaction activity is higher, and stablecoins command a larger convenience premium. To address endogeneity, we instrument stablecoin flows using shocks to crypto-market demand. Consistent with the effect of the convenience yield on the FX market, we find that stablecoin inflows are associated with a dollar appreciation in the short run, and that the stablecoin market size is negatively associated with the dollar's excess returns in the long run. These results support a convenience-yield-based view in which stablecoins generate a novel crypto-related demand channel for the U.S. dollar. We further show that dollar stablecoins transmit volatility from crypto markets to the FX and Treasury markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美元稳定币对美国国债便利收益率、汇率和金融市场稳定的影响。研究发现，一个标准差的标准币流入会使美国国债便利收益率上升4个基点，且该效应在交易费用更低、交易活动更活跃、稳定币便利溢价更高时更为显著。稳定币流入还与短期内美元升值相关，稳定币市场规模与长期美元超额收益负相关。研究还表明美元稳定币将加密货币市场的波动传导至外汇市场和国债市场。
AI.research_question: 美元稳定币如何影响美国国债便利收益率、汇率以及金融市场稳定性？
AI.motivation: 稳定币作为加密市场与美元系统之间的关键连接，其规模快速增长，但对传统金融市场的传导机制缺乏系统研究。作者希望揭示稳定币是否通过便利收益率渠道创造了对美元的新型加密相关需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 便利收益率框架（Convenience Yield View），认为稳定币通过创造对美元的加密相关需求渠道，影响国债便利收益率和汇率。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用稳定币流入数据回归美国国债便利收益率；使用加密市场需求冲击作为工具变量（IV）处理内生性问题；同时分析短期汇率反应和长期美元超额收益率关系。
AI.findings: 1) 一个标准差稳定币流入使国债便利收益率上升4个基点；2) 该效应在低交易费用、高交易活跃度和高便利溢价时更显著；3) 稳定币流入与短期美元升值相关；4) 稳定币市场规模与长期美元超额收益负相关；5) 稳定币将加密市场波动传导至外汇和国债市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了稳定币通过便利收益率渠道创造美元需求的新的理论视角，将加密市场纳入国际金融的传统分析框架，扩展了便利收益率理论在新型金融工具中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者理解稳定币对美元体系的影响提供了依据；揭示了稳定币作为加密市场与传统金融市场之间风险传导渠道的机制，有助于防范金融稳定风险。

title: Narrative Contagion on a Network of Themes: Exact Tipping Thresholds, Spectral Stability, and Hysteresis

detail.title: Narrative Contagion on a Network of Themes: Exact Tipping Thresholds, Spectral Stability, and Hysteresis
detail.abstract: This paper models socially transmitted narratives as a bounded prevalence field over a measurable space of themes: the state is the fraction of the population carrying each theme, an element of the order interval . A discrete-choice microfoundation with retention and imperfect attention yields a monotone nonlinear operator that preserves prevalence in  theme by theme. It proves the existence of least and greatest stationary narratives, and we show that the stationary state is unique for every communication profile and every admissible semantic network if and only if , where  is conformity,  the attention probability, and  retention. Above this exact virality threshold, aligned communication generates two stable homogeneous states separated by an unstable tipping state. The stationary set admits a closed-form fold representation, which yields explicit communication thresholds and an exact hysteresis width, independent of the adoption threshold and — at full attention — of memory: retention and depletion of the susceptible pool offset exactly. Local stability is characterized mode by mode: at a homogeneous state the linearization is , so the Perron mode has the largest amplification factor and is the first to lose stability, while the decay or amplification of heterogeneous thematic shocks is governed by the spectrum of the semantic network. The fold geometry also yields exact one-period intervention thresholds — including a retention limit beyond which no single-period communication pulse can dislodge an entrenched narrative — thereby providing closed-form comparative statics for tipping, persistence, and communication interventions in a networked belief system.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个社会传播叙事的形式化模型，将叙事视为可测主题空间上的有界流行度场。通过离散选择微观基础（包含保留和有限注意），推导出单调非线性算子，证明平稳叙事的极值存在性，并给出了唯一平稳状态的精确病毒式传播阈值条件。模型揭示了对齐沟通下的双稳态结构、折叠表示的闭合形式，以及局部稳定性的模态分解特征。
AI.research_question: 社会叙事如何在群体中传播并形成稳定的"流行度"分布？在何种条件下平稳叙事唯一存在，何时出现多重稳态和临界转变？
AI.motivation: 社会叙事传播是理解公众舆论、信念扩散和信息影响的重要问题，但缺乏统一的数学框架来刻画叙事在多主题空间中的传播动力学及其临界现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续介质信念传播理论、离散选择微观基础、单调算子理论、非线性动力系统的分岔与折叠理论、谱理论。
AI.method: 通过离散选择模型构建单调非线性算子，利用算子不动点理论证明平稳态存在性，通过折叠表示得到闭合形式的解，并对线性化算子进行模态分解分析稳定性。
AI.findings: (1) 平稳叙事唯一性阈值精确为γ(1-α)=1；(2) 阈值以上对齐沟通产生两个稳定同质态和一个不稳定翻转态；(3) 滞回宽度与采纳阈值无关，全注意下与记忆无关；(4) Perron模态最先失去稳定性；(5) 得到精确的单期干预阈值和保留极限。
AI.theory_contributions: 为叙事传播提供了统一的数学框架，证明了精确的病毒式传播阈值，建立了折叠几何与稳定性模态分解之间的联系，将社会传播理论从标量推广到多主题函数空间。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和传播干预提供精确的闭合形式比较静态分析，包括沟通阈值、干预时机和保留极限的计算方法，有助于设计有效的叙事传播和治理策略。

title: Beyond Demolition: An Integrated Spatial, Structural, and Utility-Resilience Framework for Earthquake Risk Reduction in Historic Unplanned Cities -The Case of Old Dhaka

detail.title: Beyond Demolition: An Integrated Spatial, Structural, and Utility-Resilience Framework for Earthquake Risk Reduction in Historic Unplanned Cities -The Case of Old Dhaka

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this paper. No external funding was received for this work. The author has no financial or advisory relationships with any organizations, technology companies, or government agencies that could be perceived as having influenced the study design, interpretation of findings, or policy recommendations presented herein.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve primary data collection, experiments, or interventions with human participants, patients, or animals. The research is based entirely on a structured narrative synthesis of publicly available peer-reviewed literature, international agency reports, and published statistics. Therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not required. All sources cited are properly attributed in the references.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without external funding. The author's institutional affiliation provided access to library resources and academic databases but did not provide financial support for the research or publication.

detail.abstract: Old Dhaka, the four-hundred-year-old core of Bangladesh's capital, sits on moderately active seismic ground while carrying some of the densest and most structurally fragile building stock in South Asia. Decades of unplanned growth have produced a city of narrow lanes, ageing unreinforced masonry, illegally altered ground floors, and utility lines that snake through walls and under footpaths with almost no protective control. Most existing responses to this danger treat the problem in isolated pieces: planners talk about widening roads, engineers talk about strengthening columns, and utility agencies talk about pipeline maintenance, but rarely do these three conversations happen at the same table. This paper argues that earthquake loss in a historic unplanned city cannot be meaningfully reduced unless spatial planning, structural retrofitting, and utility-safety engineering are treated as one connected system rather than three separate departments. Using a mixed-method approach that combines a review of Bangladeshi and international case evidence, secondary structural and demographic data from RAJUK, BNBC 2020, WASA, and DESCO/DPDC-type utility records, and a GIS-informed spatial reading of a representative Old Dhaka ward, the paper builds an Integrated Resilience Framework with four connected components: (i) micro-scale spatial replanning that opens rescue corridors and pocket assembly points without demolishing the historic fabric; (ii) low-disruption structural strengthening using fibre-reinforced polymer (FRP) wrapping, jacketing, and soft-storey correction; (iii) a smart utility-safety layer built on Internet of Things (IoT) seismic sensors that trigger automatic gas and electricity shut-off, paired with flexible high-density polyethylene (HDPE) water piping; and (iv) a comparative loss-estimation exercise that places the "do nothing" scenario against the integrated intervention scenario. The comparative analysis, built from published vulnerability studies of Dhaka together with international retrofitting performance data, suggests that, on this paper's own illustrative loss-index synthesis, a fully integrated programme could plausibly reduce combined structural, fire, and utility-related casualties and economic loss by roughly 80% relative to the current trajectory-compared with an estimated 48% reduction from structural retrofit alone-although these are order-of-magnitude estimates from a literature-based synthesis, not a calibrated simulation, and the precise number depends heavily on how much of the Old Dhaka Seismic Risk Integrated Planning-Construction-Utility Resilience Framework programme is actually implemented and maintained. The paper closes with policy recommendations for RAJUK, the two Dhaka City Corporations, and the Fire Service and Civil Defence, and argues that public-private partnership and genuine participation of Old Dhaka's residents are what will decide whether this framework survives on paper or changes real outcomes on the ground.

AI.tldr: 本文主张旧达卡的地震损失不能通过孤立的分部门应对来降低，而必须将空间规划、结构加固和公用事业安全工程作为一个相互连接的系统来处理。作者提出一个综合韧性框架，包含微观空间再规划、低干扰结构加固（FRP包裹等）、基于IoT传感器的智能公用事业安全层，以及对比损失估算四个组成部分。文献综合估算显示，综合方案可能比单纯结构加固（约48%）实现约80%的伤亡和经济损失削减，尽管这些是数量级估计而非校准模拟。
AI.research_question: 在历史悠久的无规划城市中，如何通过将空间规划、结构加固和公用事业安全工程整合为一个连接系统来显著降低地震损失？
AI.motivation: 旧达卡作为南亚建筑密度最高、结构最脆弱的城市之一，位于中等活跃地震带上，但现有的应对措施（规划、工程、公用事业）各管各的，缺乏整合。三条线之间极少在同一张桌子上对话，导致地震风险无法得到系统性缓解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合韧性框架（Integrated Resilience Framework），将空间规划、结构加固与公用事业安全视为相互连接的子系统而非独立部门。
AI.method: 混合方法：孟加拉国与国际案例证据综述、来自RAJUK、BNBC 2020、WASA、DESCO/DPDC的二手结构与人口数据、基于GIS的旧达卡代表性行政区的空间解读，以及对比损失估算（"不作为"情景 vs 综合干预情景）。
AI.findings: 文献综合损失指数表明，全面综合方案可能相对当前轨迹减少约80%的结构、火灾和公用事业相关的伤亡及经济损失，而单纯结构改造约减少48%。但这些是文献综述的数量级估计而非校准模拟，精确数字高度依赖实际实施和维护程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种整合空间规划、结构加固和公用事业安全的三维一体的城市抗震韧性分析框架，挑战了传统上将这些领域分开处理的思路，为历史无规划城市的综合减灾提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为RAJUK、两个达卡市公司和消防与民防部门提供政策建议；提出FRP加固、软楼层修正、IoT地震传感器自动切断燃气电力、HDPE柔性水管等具体可操作措施；强调公私伙伴关系和居民参与对框架落地的决定性作用。

title: The Energy Base: Why Labor Taxes Should Be Replaced with an Energy Tax

detail.title: The Energy Base: Why Labor Taxes Should Be Replaced with an Energy Tax
detail.abstract:
Modern states fund themselves by taxing labor income. That base is a historical artifact of an economy in which labor performed most production. It now yields substantially less revenue than the obligations it funds require. The United States collected approximately 5.2 trillion dollars against 7.0 trillion of spending in fiscal 2025 — at the end of an expansion. Closing that gap on the existing base means raising receipts by about a third, to roughly 23 percent of GDP — a level never reached in any postwar year across rates ranging from a 91 percent top bracket to a 28 percent one.

This paper argues that the tax base should move from labor to primary energy. It provides a concrete framework to achieve that transition with minimal economic disruption, and to pay off the federal debt in about a generation.

The argument is not only about revenue. A tax applies downward pressure on the use of whatever it is levied on. The choice of base therefore decides what an economy is discouraged from using, and moving that pressure off labor and onto energy should raise the relative value of employing people while rewarding efficiency in the use of energy.

The instrument is a levy on energy entering the economy — at extraction, at non-combustion generation, and at the border — charged at a published rate that rises on a fixed schedule. Border adjustment runs in both directions, removing a penalty American producers carry today. A dividend is paid per capita, at a rate selected to offset the energy a household buys directly.

The base is approximately 99.5 quadrillion BTU: 88 entering domestically, plus about 11.5 embodied in imported goods net of the rebate on exports. On a two-cent-a-year schedule the requirement closes in year 18 at thirty-six cents per delivered kilowatt-hour-equivalent — yielding on the order of 10.5 trillion dollars against a 30.7 trillion dollar economy. That retires roughly 4.3 trillion dollars of individual income and payroll taxes.

The case rests on three properties of energy and no others: it is universal (embodied in all production), meterable (at a small number of fixed physical points), and unavoidable (no production without it). It does not rest on energy being a large share of costs or on any particular timetable for automation.

All figures derive from a published constants module and an interactive model, both cited and public. Every assumption behind them is a control the reader can move. The whole run exports as data.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将美国联邦税基从劳动收入转向一次能源，通过对进入经济体系的能源（开采、非燃烧发电及边境）征收按固定时间表递增的税费，以每个成年人平均分配股息的方式返还部分收入，从而在不造成重大经济扰动的情况下，约在一代人时间内偿还联邦债务（约30.7万亿美元经济规模下产生约10.5万亿美元收入），同时减少约4.3万亿美元的个人所得税和工资税。
AI.research_question: 如何将美国联邦税基从劳动收入转向一次能源，从而在弥补财政赤字、偿还联邦债务的同时，最小化经济扰动并提升就业价值？
AI.motivation: 现行以劳动收入为税基的体系是历史产物，已难以满足财政需求——2025财年美国收入约5.2万亿美元，而支出达7.0万亿美元；即使将税率提高约三分之一至GDP的23%（战后从未达到的水平），仍难以弥合缺口。因此需要从根本上重新思考税基选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税基选择决定经济被"劝阻"使用的对象；能源具有三个关键属性：普遍性（蕴含于一切生产中）、可计量性（在少数固定物理点上可测量）和不可避免性（没有能源就没有生产）。
AI.method: 提出一个具体框架：对进入经济体系的能源（开采、非燃烧发电、边境）征收按固定时间表递增的税费，双向边境调整以消除美国生产者的竞争劣势，并按人均分红方式返还部分收入以抵消家庭直接购买能源的支出。所有数字基于公开的常数模块和交互式模型，每个假设均可由读者调整。
AI.findings: 在每两年每千瓦时等效增加2美分的税率时间表下，税费在18年内达到36美分/千瓦时等效，可产生约10.5万亿美元收入（相对30.7万亿美元的经济规模），足以在约一代人时间内偿还联邦债务，并减少约4.3万亿美元的个人所得税和工资税。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出税基应基于能源的"普遍性、可计量性、不可避免性"三大属性而非能源成本占比或自动化时间表；论证了将税负从劳动转向能源可以提高雇用劳动力的相对价值，并激励能源使用效率。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作、可验证的联邦税制改革框架：具体税率路径、边境调节机制、人均分红设计以及完全公开可交互的模型，为政策制定者提供了切实可行的实施方案。

title: The Three-Way Complementarity Between Automation, Profit Sharing, And Training: Theory and Evidence
affiliations: Università di Parma, University of Turin and University of Parma - Dipartimento di Scienze Economiche e Aziendali

detail.title: The Three-Way Complementarity Between Automation, Profit Sharing, And Training: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the complementarity between automation, profit sharing, and digital training. We develop a team-theoretic model in which a principal manages two technologically interdependent tasks, one of which can be automated. Because only joint output can be observed, incentives must be provided through profit sharing. By improving team performance, automation increases the cost of incentive provision under profit sharing, generating a tension between the two practices. Training counteracts this effect by increasing the marginal productivity of effort, thereby reducing the cost of incentive provision. Three predictions follow: training and automation are always complementary, profit sharing and automation may be either complements or substitutes, and the three practices are jointly complementary. Reduced-form evidence from a sample of Italian firms supports these predictions: blue-collar profit sharing and digital training are individually associated with robot adoption, but part of these associations is captured by their interaction. The interaction disappears for non-IT training, white-collar profit sharing, and a wide range of non-automation technologies, indicating a complementarity specific to human-machine production.

AI.tldr: 本文通过团队理论模型研究自动化、利润分享与数字培训三者之间的互补关系，并利用意大利企业数据验证了理论预测：培训与自动化总是互补，利润分享与自动化可能互补或替代，三者联合互补。
AI.research_question: 自动化、利润分享和数字培训三种管理实践之间是否存在互补性？其内在机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 自动化技术的普及正在改变企业生产组织方式，但现有研究缺乏对自动化与激励制度、培训实践之间如何互动的系统性理论分析。理解这些实践之间的互补关系对企业管理实践和政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 团队生产理论（team-theoretic model）：主理人管理两个技术相依的任务，其中一个可自动化；由于只能观测联合产出，需要通过利润分享提供激励。
AI.method: 理论建模（团队生产模型）加实证检验（使用意大利企业样本的简约式证据，包含机器人采用、蓝领/白领利润分享、数字/非IT培训等变量）。
AI.findings: （1）自动化通过提升团队绩效增加了利润分享下的激励成本，与利润分享存在张力；（2）培训通过提高努力的边际生产率来抵消这一成本，因此培训与自动化互补；（3）利润分享与自动化可能互补或替代，取决于参数条件；（4）三个实践联合互补；（5）意大利企业数据显示蓝领利润分享和数字培训分别与机器人采用正相关，且二者的交互项捕捉了部分关联。（6）该交互效应在非IT培训、白领利润分享及非自动化技术中消失，表明互补性特定于人机生产。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自动化技术引入团队生产理论框架，阐明了自动化如何影响激励成本，并系统刻画了自动化、利润分享与数字培训三者的互补/替代关系边界条件，为管理实践互补性理论提供了新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业采用自动化时如何配套激励制度与培训投资提供指导：自动化应与数字培训搭配实施，而利润分享制度的搭配需视具体条件而定，有助于企业优化技术转型策略。

title:
Privacy Is Not Enough
On Identity, Agentic AI, and What We Are Actually Losing

detail.title:
Privacy Is Not Enough
On Identity, Agentic AI, and What We Are Actually Losing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Grio and the creator of Codexes.ai, a platform that implements the boundary-first architectural principles described in this essay. This represents a potential non-financial competing interest. The author declares no financial interests related to the submission of this manuscript. This paper has been submitted for peer review to AI & Society (Springer Open Forum, August 2026).
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a philosophical position paper with no human participants, patient data, or empirical studies.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract: Privacy law was built to protect data. But the emergence of persistent, context-aggregating agentic AI systems poses a threat that data protection cannot address: the reduction of a person's plural, context-dependent identity to a single statistical composite. This essay introduces the concept of cognitive identity capture-the process by which an agentic AI system, through the accumulation of personal context across all domains of a person's life, constructs and imposes a unified model of who that person is, undermining their capacity to be different people in different contexts. Drawing on Kant's account of autonomy, Clark and Chalmers' extended mind thesis, Nissenbaum's contextual integrity framework, Illich's distinction between convivial and non-convivial tools, and Damasio and McGaugh's neuroscience of selective memory, the essay argues that cognitive identity capture constitutes a distinct harm-one that is structural, architectural, and prior to any question of data ownership or compensation. Against Lanier's Data Dignity proposal, which addresses the terms of extraction, this essay addresses the need for extraction itself. It proposes three rights that current legal frameworks do not provide: the right to be plural, the right to be unlearned, and the right to determine, in each context, which version of oneself is present. It concludes with a set of architectural conditions-local-first context storage, identity-bounded domains, model-agnostic context management, and explicit bridges-that define what a convivial AI system requires. The essay is written in the first person, as a position piece in the Open Forum tradition, grounded in both academic literature and the author's practice as an AI strategist, educator, and researcher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知身份捕获"（cognitive identity capture）概念，指出持续性的、跨情境聚合的智能体AI系统通过累积个人全领域语境，构建并强加单一统一模型，削弱人在不同情境中成为不同自我的能力。这是数据保护法律无法应对的结构性伤害。文章基于康德自治论、扩展心智理论、情境完整性框架等理论，提出三项新权利（多元性权利、被遗忘学习权利、情境自我决定权利），并给出AI系统应具备的建筑性条件。
AI.research_question: 当智能体AI系统跨所有生活领域持续聚合个人语境并构建统一身份模型时，现有隐私法律（以数据保护为核心）为何无法应对，以及需要何种新的权利框架和架构条件来保护人的多元身份？
AI.motivation: 现有隐私法以保护"数据"为核心范式，但持续性的、跨情境聚合的智能体AI系统所带来的威胁不是数据层面的，而是身份层面的——它将人的多元、情境依赖的身份简化为单一统计合成体。这种威胁超越数据所有权或补偿的范畴，需要全新的理论框架来识别和应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) Kant的自治（autonomy）理论；2) Clark和Chalmers的扩展心智论（extended mind thesis）；3) Nissenbaum的情境完整性框架（contextual integrity）；4) Illich关于共存性（convivial）与非共存性工具的区分；5) Damasio和McGaugh的选择性记忆神经科学。
AI.method: 本文为立场论文（position piece），采用第一人称论述，基于学术文献综述与作者作为AI战略家、教育者和研究者的实践经验的结合分析，属于理论性与规范性论证方法。
AI.findings: 1) 认知身份捕获构成一种独特的伤害——它是结构性的、建筑性的，且先于任何数据所有权或补偿问题；2) 现有的兰尼尔（Lanier）的"数据尊严"提案只解决提取条件而非提取本身；3) 需要三项法律框架未提供的新权利：多元性权利、被遗忘学习权利、情境自我决定权利；4) 定义了共存性AI系统所需的建筑条件：本地优先的语境存储、身份有界域、模型无关的语境管理、显式桥梁。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出"认知身份捕获"这一新概念，将AI带来的伤害从数据层面提升到身份与自主性层面；整合哲学、认知科学、信息伦理多学科理论，构建了分析agentic AI对人格多元性威胁的新框架；对现有"数据尊严"方案的理论局限做出批判性补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项具体的权利主张（多元性权利、被遗忘学习权利、情境自我决定权利），为未来立法提供方向性建议；提出共存性AI系统的四项架构条件，为AI技术设计提供实践指南；对AI从业者、政策制定者和教育者提供基于实践的分析框架。

title: Beyond Spiritual Intelligence: Toward a General Theory of Spiritual Cognition
affiliations: African Research Network (ARN)

detail.title: Beyond Spiritual Intelligence: Toward a General Theory of Spiritual Cognition
detail.abstract: Spiritual intelligence has emerged as an important concept at the intersection of psychology, leadership, education, and organizational studies. However, the field remains conceptually fragmented, with competing definitions, inconsistent theoretical assumptions, and limited integration with recent developments in cognitive science and neuroscience. This article argues that the notion of spiritual intelligence should be reconceptualized within a broader framework of spiritual cognition, defined as the set of higher-order cognitive processes through which individuals construct meaning, discern values, anticipate future possibilities, cultivate relational awareness, and orient action toward transcendent purposes. Rather than treating spirituality as an isolated psychological trait, the proposed theory positions spiritual cognition as an adaptive cognitive architecture emerging from the dynamic interaction of embodied experience, predictive cognition, moral reasoning, relational consciousness, and reflective self-transcendence. By integrating advances in predictive processing, embodied cognition, the cognitive science of religion, moral psychology, phenomenology, neosology, complexity science, and contemporary neuroscience, the article proposes a unified conceptual model capable of explaining how spiritual cognition contributes to ethical judgment, resilient leadership, creativity, and human flourishing. The resulting framework provides a new interdisciplinary foundation for empirical research while extending current debates beyond conventional models of spiritual intelligence. It offers a theoretically robust platform for future investigations across theology, psychology, leadership studies, organizational science, and the cognitive sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将"灵性智力"重新概念化为更广泛的"灵性认知"框架，将其定义为个体构建意义、辨别价值、预见未来、培养关系意识并导向超越性目标的更高阶认知过程。文章整合预测加工、具身认知、宗教认知科学、道德心理学、现象学、复杂性科学和当代神经科学等前沿理论，提出一个统一的灵性认知概念模型，为心理学、领导力研究、组织科学和认知科学提供跨学科的理论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何将灵性智力重新概念化为一个统一的灵性认知框架，以解决该领域概念碎片化的问题，并整合认知科学与神经科学的最新发展？
AI.motivation: 灵性智力领域虽然重要，但存在定义相互竞争、理论假设不一致、与认知科学和神经科学最新进展整合不足等问题，迫切需要理论框架的重构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测加工理论、具身认知、宗教认知科学、道德心理学、现象学、神经科学、复杂性科学等跨学科理论。
AI.method: 理论综合与概念重构（Conceptual/Theoretical Synthesis）：通过整合多学科的理论资源，提出统一的灵性认知概念模型。
AI.findings: 提出灵性认知作为一种适应性认知架构，源于具身经验、预测认知、道德推理、关系意识和反思性自我超越的动态交互；该框架能够解释灵性认知在伦理判断、韧性领导力、创造力和人类繁荣中的作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为灵性智力领域提供了统一的概念基础，将灵性从孤立的心理特质重新定位为适应性认知架构，建立了跨学科的整合性理论平台，超越了传统灵性智力模型的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为心理学、神学、领导力研究、组织科学和认知科学领域的实证研究提供了新的理论框架和坚实基础，有助于推动后续跨学科研究。

title: Ready for what? Enlistment versus Readiness

detail.title: Ready for what? Enlistment versus Readiness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a readiness specialist at the Spanish Ministry of Defense. He has carried out eight international missions. During his 2012 mission in Iraq, under NATO auspices, he served as an advisor to the Iraqi Lieutenant General responsible for readiness.
declarations.funderStatement: The article was published by the Journal of the Spanish Institute of Strategic Studies of the Spanish Ministry of Defense due to its interest

detail.abstract: The fundamental purpose of Armed Forces is to fight and win a Nation's conflicts. Therefore, it is critical that Ministers of Defence (MoD) continually assesses warfighting readiness and capabilities. Readiness is the ability of Armed Forces to conduct and successfully accomplish assigned missions as specified in the National Military Strategy (NMS) with sufficient and sustainable capabilities resulting from personnel, equipment, training, and supporting infrastructures. The readiness system provides an overall assessment of the Ministry of Defence's (MoD) ability to execute the NMS and captures the overarching readiness for each level of warfighting. History holds numerous examples of the cost nations have paid when their Armed Forces were not prepared to respond. Next, the concept of International Readiness is shown, its extrapolation to the Spanish environment and some examples of Readiness systems implemented in other countries are analyzed. This article concludes with the future challenges that are presented to these Readiness evaluation systems in the coming years.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了武装部队战备（Readiness）评估系统的重要性，分析了国际战备概念、其在西班牙环境中的推广，以及其他国家已实施战备系统的案例，最后讨论了未来几年战备评估系统面临的挑战。
AI.research_question: 武装部队战备评估系统如何在国际环境中构建和实施？西班牙应如何借鉴国际经验，以及未来战备评估系统面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 历史上有许多国家因武装部队准备不足而付出惨重代价，因此国防部长必须持续评估战争战备能力和作战能力，以确保国家军事战略的成功执行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战备概念框架：将战备定义为武装部队按照国家军事战略（NMS）执行和成功完成指定任务的能力，涵盖人员、装备、训练和保障基础设施等维度。
AI.method: 概念分析与案例研究法：梳理战备概念，将其推广到西班牙环境，并对其他国家已实施战备系统进行案例比较分析。
AI.findings: 战备系统为国防部提供整体评估，覆盖各战争层级战备状态；不同国家实施战备系统的经验可资借鉴；未来战备评估系统面临新的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将国际战备概念引入西班牙国防环境中，并建立了战备评估系统的比较分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西班牙国防部门提供战备评估系统的国际最佳实践参考，有助于改进其战备评估机制以应对未来安全挑战。

title: Beyond Obsolescence: Dependency Analysis as Cornerstone of Global South Political Economy in the Multipolar Era

detail.title: Beyond Obsolescence: Dependency Analysis as Cornerstone of Global South Political Economy in the Multipolar Era
detail.abstract: Dependency theory is frequently dismissed as obsolete, yet the paradox of intensified structural constraints during Western hegemonic decline suggests otherwise. This article argues that classical Marxist dependency theory-developed by Baran, Amin, Marini, Dos Santos, and Bambirra-provides indispensable analytical tools for understanding contemporary global capitalism. Drawing on recent scholarship on subordinate financialization, global value chains, and monetary hierarchy, we demonstrate how dependency mechanisms persist and intensify through increasingly sophisticated forms that appear voluntary and market-driven. The article develops an original analytical framework comprising two complementary indices: the Structural Dependency Index (SDI), which measures multidimensional constraints across commercial, technological, financial, productive, network, and distributive dimensions; and the State Mediating Capacity (SMC), which captures institutional resources for navigating these constraints. This dual framework generates a four-quadrant typology-Non-Hegemonic Autonomy, Hegemonic Centers, Subordinate Periphery, and Contested Semi-Periphery-that enables systematic comparison across economies while identifying transformation pathways. Both indices are presented here as a proposed operationalization: their dimensions, component variables and data sources are fully specified, but the indices have not yet been computed, and the country placements reported below are theoretically derived rather than empirically estimated. Drawing on Poulantzas and Mann, we clarify the qualitatively distinct meanings of state capacity in core and peripheral economies. The multipolar transition creates opportunities for autonomous development, but realizing these opportunities requires state capacity adequate to strategic delinking-a transformation that historically depends on bottom-up political coalitions capable of challenging entrenched class interests.

AI.tldr: 本文论证古典马克思主义依附理论（Baran、Amin、Marini、Dos Santos和Bambirra）对理解当代全球资本主义仍具有不可或缺的分析价值。作者提出一个包含两个互补指标的分析框架：结构依附指数（SDI）衡量商业、技术、金融、生产、网络和分配六个维度的多维约束；国家中介能力（SMC）捕捉经济体应对这些约束的制度资源。双框架生成四种类型学（非霸权自主、霸权中心、附属边缘、竞争半边缘），并提出操作化方案，但指数尚未实际计算。
AI.research_question: 在西方霸权衰退的背景下，经典马克思主义依附理论是否仍然有效，以及如何系统化地衡量和比较当代各经济体的依附结构与应对能力？
AI.motivation: 依附理论常被视为过时，但西方霸权衰退期间结构约束反而强化的悖论表明其仍有解释力。作者旨在复兴古典依附理论，并提供新的分析工具以理解当代全球资本主义中的依附机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古典马克思主义依附理论（Baran、Amin、Marini、Dos Santos、Bambirra）；次级金融化、全球价值链、货币等级等近期学术成果；Poulantzas和Mann的国家能力理论。
AI.method: 理论分析与框架构建：提出结构依附指数（SDI）和国家中介能力（SMC）两个互补指标，涵盖六个维度（商业、技术、金融、生产、网络、分配），构建四象限类型学。指标作为拟议操作化方案呈现，维度、组成变量和数据来源已完全指定，但尚未实际计算。
AI.findings: 依附机制通过日益精巧的、看似自愿和市场驱动的方式持续存在并强化；四象限类型学（非霸权自主、霸权中心、附属边缘、竞争半边缘）可系统比较各经济体并识别转型路径；多极化转型为自主发展创造机会，但实现这些机会需要足以进行战略性脱钩的国家能力，而这在历史上取决于能够挑战既有阶级利益的底层政治联盟。
AI.theory_contributions: 复兴经典马克思主义依附理论并将其应用于当代全球资本主义；提出SDI和SMC双指标框架，为依附研究提供系统化、可操作化的测量工具；借鉴Poulantzas和Mann澄清核心与边缘经济体中国家能力的质的不同含义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供系统比较各经济体依附程度与国家应对能力的分析工具；提出战略性脱钩的转型路径，并强调底层政治联盟在实现自主发展中的关键作用。

title: Digital System Design Transitions: From Boolean Minimization to Programmable Logic Implementations
affiliations: Bulacan State University

detail.title: Digital System Design Transitions: From Boolean Minimization to Programmable Logic Implementations
detail.abstract: This paper examines the transition from Boolean logic minimization to programmable logic implementation in industrial automation, with particular emphasis on Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) ladder programming. It explores how fundamental digital logic concepts, including Boolean algebra, logic gates, and logic simplification, can be translated into practical ladder logic programs used in automated manufacturing systems. The study critically evaluates the role of Boolean minimization in reducing unnecessary logic elements, improving program organization, and potentially enhancing PLC memory utilization and execution efficiency. A theoretical and functional modeling approach is used to compare simplified Boolean expressions with their corresponding ladder logic implementations. The analysis demonstrates that a strong understanding of digital logic provides an important foundation for developing efficient and maintainable PLC programs. However, the reviewed discussion is primarily focused on conventional relay-based ladder logic and provides limited empirical evidence regarding differences in execution performance among PLC platforms. The paper therefore recommends incorporating actual PLC scan-time measurements, memory usage comparisons, and evaluations across different PLC manufacturers in future studies. Overall, the paper highlights the continuing importance of Boolean logic minimization in industrial automation education and PLC-based control system development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了工业自动化中从布尔逻辑最小化到可编程逻辑实现（特别是PLC梯形图编程）的转变。研究采用理论建模方法，对比简化布尔表达式与其对应的梯形图实现，论证数字逻辑知识是开发高效、可维护PLC程序的重要基础，同时指出当前研究缺乏对不同PLC平台执行性能差异的实证数据。
AI.research_question: 如何将数字逻辑概念（布尔代数、逻辑门、逻辑简化）转化为实用的梯形图逻辑程序，以及布尔最小化在PLC程序组织与执行效率中起何种作用？
AI.motivation: 工业自动化中PLC梯形图编程广泛使用，但数字逻辑最小化在其中的实际价值与作用尚未被充分评估，需要系统性地审视布尔逻辑最小化能否真正提升PLC程序的效率与可维护性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 布尔代数理论、数字逻辑门理论、逻辑化简（布尔最小化）方法、继电器梯形图逻辑原理
AI.method: 采用理论建模与功能建模方法，将简化布尔表达式与对应的梯形图逻辑实现进行系统性比较分析。
AI.findings: 对数字逻辑的深入理解是开发高效、可维护PLC程序的重要基础；布尔最小化有助于减少不必要的逻辑元件、改善程序组织，并可能提升PLC内存利用率和执行效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字逻辑理论与PLC编程实践之间建立了系统的映射框架，阐明了布尔最小化在自动化控制教育中的持续重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议未来研究纳入实际PLC扫描时间测量、内存使用对比以及跨PLC品牌的评估；为工业自动化教学和PLC控制系统的开发提供了指导方向。

reference: Accepted for publication by the Journal for Financial Education
title: A Classroom Experience to Introduce Behavioral Finance and Anchoring Bias
affiliations: Seton Hall University - Department of Finance & Legal Studies and Ipsos Behavioral Science Center

detail.title: A Classroom Experience to Introduce Behavioral Finance and Anchoring Bias

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for publication by the Journal for Financial Education

detail.abstract:
This paper presents an interactive classroom experiment designed to introduce students to behavioral finance and anchoring bias. Anchoring, a well-documented behavioral bias, occurs when an initial value subconsciously influences subsequent judgments. The exercise, based on the seminal work of Tversky and Kahneman (1974), demonstrates the pervasive impact of anchoring bias, challenging the assumptions of rational decision-making foundational to traditional economic theory. 

The experiment begins with a brief survey administered to randomly divided student groups, where the initial question contains an arbitrary anchor. By comparing group responses to a subsequent question, students observe the bias in their own judgments. Results consistently reveal significant anchoring effects, stimulating introspection and active class discussions. This hands-on approach facilitates deep engagement and enhances students' comprehension of behavioral concepts. Feedback from students underscores the experiment's effectiveness in making abstract concepts relatable and memorable.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个交互式课堂实验，旨在向学生介绍行为金融学和锚定偏差。该实验基于Tversky和Kahneman（1974）的开创性工作，通过在随机分组的学生中发放包含任意锚点的问卷，让学生在自身判断中观察到锚定效应，从而加深对行为金融概念的理解。
AI.research_question: 如何通过交互式课堂实验有效地向学生介绍行为金融学和锚定偏差，使其深刻理解并记住这一行为概念？
AI.motivation: 锚定偏差是行为金融学中重要的行为偏差，但传统经济学理论基于理性决策假设。作者希望通过动手实验的方式，让学生在自己身上直接观察这一偏差，以增强学习效果，使抽象的行为金融概念变得具体、可感知和易于记忆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论、锚定偏差（Anchoring Bias）、Kahneman和Tversky（1974）的锚定效应理论、传统理性决策经济理论（作为对比基础）
AI.method: 交互式课堂实验方法：将学生随机分组，在问卷初始问题中植入任意锚点，然后比较各组对后续问题的回答，以观察锚定效应的存在。
AI.findings: 实验结果一致地显示出显著的锚定效应；学生反馈表明该实验在使抽象概念变得可理解和可记忆方面非常有效，激发了学生的自我反思和积极的课堂讨论。
AI.theory_contributions: 为行为金融学教学提供了实证的教学方法验证，展示了如何将经典的锚定偏差理论（Tversky & Kahneman, 1974）转化为可操作的课堂实验，丰富了行为金融学的教学实践理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可直接实施于课堂的互动实验教学设计，帮助学生通过亲身体验理解锚定偏差，增强学习参与度和概念记忆效果，可用于行为金融学及相关课程的教学实践。

title: Generic Gains from Money Creation: General Results

detail.title: Generic Gains from Money Creation: General Results
detail.abstract: This paper proves a Wallace theorem for nominally homogeneous purecurrency economies under anticipated permanent money creation. The Implementation Theorem shows that a proportional, welfare-neutral transfer can be added to any locally favorable policy direction to obtain a nonnegative, increasing policy that is truthfully implemented with private balances. The Genericity Theorem shows that, within a finite-dimensional family of nonproportional policy directions, failure of first-order welfare improvement is confined to a lower-dimensional exceptional set under a full-rank condition. A three-type Lagos-Wright economy verifies all assumptions from primitives and identifies an open parameter region with a strictly welfare-improving permanent transfer policy.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了名义同质纯货币经济中（在预期永久货币创造下）的Wallace定理。实现定理表明，任何局部有利的政策方向都可以加上一个比例性、福利中性的转移，从而获得一个非负、递增的、可由私人余额真实实现的政策。一般性定理表明，在非比例政策方向的有限维族中，一阶福利改进的失败被限制在一个低维例外集内（在满秩条件下）。三类型Lagos-Wright经济从原始假设验证了所有条件，并确定了存在严格福利改善的永久转移政策的开放参数区域。
AI.research_question: 在预期永久货币创造下，名义同质纯货币经济中Wallace定理是否成立？具体而言，任何局部有利的政策方向是否都可以通过添加比例性福利中性转移而转化为可真实实现的福利改进政策？
AI.motivation: Wallace定理是货币经济学中关于政策不可改进性的经典结果，但传统证明依赖于特定的货币框架假设。本文旨在为更一般的名义同质纯货币经济（在预期永久货币创造下）提供Wallace定理的证明，并探讨非比例政策方向下福利改进的普遍性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wallace定理、名义同质纯货币经济（nominally homogeneous pure-currency economies）、Lagos-Wright货币搜寻模型、一阶福利分析、机制设计中的真实实现（truthful implementation）理论。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明实现定理（Implementation Theorem）和一般性定理（Genericity Theorem），前者表明比例福利中性转移可加性，后者通过有限维参数族的满秩条件刻画福利改进失败集的低维性；最后用三类型Lagos-Wright经济进行数值/解析验证。
AI.findings: (1) Wallace定理在预期永久货币创造下的名义同质纯货币经济中成立；(2) 任何局部有利政策方向可通过加法比例福利中性转移获得非负递增且可由私人余额真实实现的福利改进政策；(3) 在满秩条件下，非比例政策方向中一阶福利改进的失败仅发生在低维例外集中；(4) 三类型Lagos-Wright经济从原始假设验证了所有条件，并存在开放参数区域内严格福利改进的永久转移政策。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将Wallace定理推广到预期永久货币创造情形下的更一般经济环境；(2) 建立了实现定理，将抽象的福利改进政策方向与可真实实现的政策联系起来；(3) 通过一般性定理刻画了福利改进失败的例外集维度，深化了对货币政策改进可能性的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为永久货币创造政策（如永久性转账/转移支付政策）的福利效应提供了理论基础；(2) 证明在多数政策方向上存在福利改进空间，而非仅局限于比例性政策；(3) 为货币政策设计提供了可操作的条件（满秩条件）以识别福利改进政策的可行性。
