AI.tldr: 本文对现代审计报告中的"关键审计事项"（KAM）制度进行了理论定价，将其视为一个双通道机制：重点强调使所选项目更清晰可读，而记录在案的勤勉则为其提供保护。文章证明该制度在威慑方面几乎完全失效（45种配置中有44种不如无KAM基线），但作为"透镜"却十分有效：检测转移的能力提升3-8倍，自愿选择在分离阶段能完美分类诚实度。研究还发现"盾牌"（勤勉记录保护）的作用是分配而非保护，并最终为发表本身定价——分离结果在利益低于模仿价格时能够经受审查者的检验。
AI.research_question: 关键审计事项（KAM）制度作为审计师自行撰写的审计报告组成部分，其"强调"与"记录勤勉"的双重功能如何定价？该制度能否实现威慑作用，又在何种条件下能够有效识别和检测不当行为？
AI.motivation: 既有研究（同伴论文）已证明"弱点证明"（certificate of weakness）是威慑的万能钥匙，但KAM制度作为审计师自选的"强项证明"（certificate of strength），其制度价值尚未被系统理论化。本文旨在填补这一空白，为这一核心审计制度提供严格的理论定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递理论、威慑理论、Blackwell信息比较理论（Blackwell's ordering）、瓶颈/凸性理论（bottleneck/convex doctrine）、机制设计理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析：构建双通道（强调+勤勉记录）的信息传递模型，比较不同法律赔偿责任制度（liability doctrine）下的均衡行为，通过配置组合分析（45种配置）评估制度绩效，并对发表本身进行博弈论定价。
AI.findings: （1）KAM制度在威慑上失败：45种配置中44种将威慑让位于无KAM基线；（2）作为检测透镜成功：转移检测提升3-8倍；（3）偏离者（deviating senders）会在瓶颈原则下隐藏弱项、在凸性原则下展示强项；（4）诚实发送者在Blackwell排序惩罚坦率时会拒绝该制度；（5）"盾牌"分配而非保护：弱防御将能力毁灭集中在被强调项目中；（6）分离在利益低于模仿价格时能在选择性阅读中存活，且强制架构在任何复杂性下都能存活。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将KAM制度理论化为"强项证明"（certificate of strength），与既有"弱点证明"形成对称性分析，但证明二者并非对称——证明勤勉只需"说"而不需"重新塑造"；（2）发现该制度存在三个逃逸值（escape values）之下的"第三档"（恰好为零）；（3）建立威慑失效的一般性定理（44/45配置失败率）；（4）揭示"盾牌"的分配功能而非保护功能这一反直觉理论洞见；（5）为制度发表本身提供博弈论定价框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者提供KAM制度威慑效力的系统评估，表明其在威慑目的上的失效性；（2）展示KAM作为信息"透镜"在检测方面的实用价值（3-8倍检测提升）；（3）为审计报告制度的强制架构设计提供理论依据——强制架构在所有复杂度下都能存活；（4）提示监管者在制定赔偿责任原则时需考虑审计师"注视方向"所反映的制度信念。

title: Reconstructing Türkiye's Pre-Planning Economy: An Annual 9-Sector Input-Output Dataset and Structural Path Decomposition, 1950-1960

detail.title: Reconstructing Türkiye's Pre-Planning Economy: An Annual 9-Sector Input-Output Dataset and Structural Path Decomposition, 1950-1960

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Historical research on structural transformation is often constrained by benchmark statistics that describe selected years but do not provide a continuous representation of the production system. This article reconstructs an annual nine-sector input-output dataset for Türkiye covering 1950-1960, immediately preceding the institutionalization of national development planning. The series is anchored in Uğur Korum's archival 1959 input-output table and reconciled with historical macroeconomic and sectoral controls through RAS-based balancing. The harmonized classification comprises Agriculture, Industry, Construction, Trade, Transportation, Financial Services, Services, Housing, and Public Services. The resulting open dataset contains eleven annual transaction matrices, technical coefficients, Leontief inverses, backward and forward linkages, macroeconomic and sectoral consistency checks, and the digitized archival benchmark with English sector labels. Accounting validation shows effectively exact consistency with the imposed historical control totals. To demonstrate the analytical value of the reconstructed series, the article applies structural path decomposition to 1950, 1955, and 1960. Decomposing the Leontief system into successive propagation orders shows that the first five production rounds account for more than 99 percent of the nonidentity multiplier structure in all three benchmark years. The direct-requirement share declines from 63.8 percent in 1950 to 58.8 percent in 1960, while higher-order contributions increase, indicating a gradual deepening of intersectoral production chains. The evidence is interpreted descriptively rather than causally. The dataset provides a reusable historical infrastructure for research on structural change, industrialization, production networks, and the transition to development planning in Türkiye.

AI.tldr: 本文重建了土耳其1950-1960年九部门年度投入产出数据集，以Korum的1959年投入产出表为锚点，通过RAS平衡法与历史宏观经济和部门控制数据校准，并运用结构路径分解展示生产链的逐步深化，为研究土耳其结构转型和发展规划过渡提供了可复用的历史基础设施。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个连续、一致的土耳其1950-1960年年度部门间投入产出数据集，以弥补基准统计仅覆盖选定年份而缺乏生产系统连续表征的局限？
AI.motivation: 历史结构转型研究常受限于仅描述选定年份的基准统计数据，无法提供生产系统的连续表征，制约了关于结构变化、产业化和生产网络的历史实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投入产出分析框架、RAS平衡法、结构路径分解（structural path decomposition）、Leontief逆矩阵与乘数结构理论。
AI.method: 以Korum档案1959年投入产出表为锚定基准，结合历史宏观和部门控制数据，通过RAS平衡法进行调和校准，构建1950-1960年九部门（农业、工业、建筑业、贸易、运输、金融、服务、住房、公共服务）年度交易矩阵、技术系数、Leontief逆矩阵、前向与后向关联指标，并进行会计验证与结构路径分解分析。
AI.findings: 数据集与施加的历史控制总量高度精确一致；在1950、1955、1960三个基准年份中，前五轮生产传播解释了非恒等乘数结构的99%以上；直接需求份额从1950年的63.8%下降到1960年的58.8%，而高阶贡献增加，表明部门间生产链逐步深化。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将RAS平衡法与结构路径分解结合应用于历史投入产出数据重建，展示了连续年度投入产出序列对分析长期生产网络深化和结构转型的理论价值，为非因果性的描述性历史分析提供了方法框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个开放获取的1950-1960年土耳其年度九部门投入产出数据集（含11个年度交易矩阵、技术系数、Leontief逆矩阵、关联指标及数字化档案基准表），可作为研究土耳其结构变化、产业化、生产网络和发展规划过渡的可复用历史基础设施。

title: Computative Economics: An Empirically Grounded Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance
affiliations: University of St. Thomas - School of Law (Minnesota)

detail.title: Computative Economics: An Empirically Grounded Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance
detail.abstract: Five research programs supply the load-bearing propositions of modern economic analysis: general-equilibrium theory, growth theory, behavioural economics, information economics, and the New Institutional Economics. This Article argues that each contains a foundational proposition whose domain contracts when computation makes ideation, evaluation, and coordination abundant. The Arrow-Debreu price system coordinates scarcity. Romer locates growth in the scarce discovery of ideas. Simon treats computation as the constraint on choice. Akerlof treats information asymmetry as a durable market condition. The incomplete-contracts tradition assigns residual control because verification is unavailable. Computative Economics supplies a successor framework for the margins on which those premises no longer bind. Its elements are the computative agent tuple (C, O, M, G, R, E), a recursive equilibrium defined over the update operator rather than a fixed commodity space, and five architectural conditions under which that construction can be implemented. The fixed-point results are conditional propositions. The current implementation does not prove contraction or equilibrium convergence. The empirical record is likewise layered. Published Paper 3 reports the completed discovery and confirmation study. The broader Stage 4 comparison remains registered forward work. Interim Stage 5 records show that state can persist across a generation boundary, that selection can recompose a lineage, and that the resulting trajectory is measurable. The aggregate performance slopes are positive but uncertain and do not establish an advantage over drift. The evidence therefore supports observability and endogenous population transition within an externally provisioned experiment. It does not establish autonomous economic persistence, production performance, or recursive equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"计算经济学"（Computative Economics）作为现代经济分析五大研究纲领的继承框架。文章论证，当计算使思想创造、评估与协调变得充裕时，五大纲领的核心命题（稀缺性定价、思想稀缺、计算约束、信息不对称、不完全契约）的适用域均发生收缩，并提出基于计算主体元组与递归均衡的新框架，同时对其理论边界与实证证据进行了审慎评估。
AI.research_question: 当计算能力使思想创造、评估与协调变得充裕时，现代经济分析的五大研究纲领（一般均衡理论、增长理论、行为经济学、信息经济学、新制度经济学）的哪些基础命题不再适用？能否构建一个替代性框架（计算经济学）来承接这些失效的边界？
AI.motivation: 五大经济分析研究纲领各自包含一个奠基性命题，但当计算使思想创造、评估和协调变得充裕时，这些命题的适用范围发生收缩（domain contracts），需要一个新的分析框架来处理这些不再成立的边界情形。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计算经济学框架，包含：（1）计算主体元组（C, O, M, G, R, E）；（2）定义在更新算子上的递归均衡（而非固定商品空间上的均衡）；（3）五个可实现该构造的架构条件。
AI.method: 理论构建与实证验证相结合。理论层面：提出计算主体元组、递归均衡与五个架构条件，基于不动点定理给出条件性命题。实证层面：分阶段记录（Stage 4对比研究、Stage 5中期记录），检验状态跨代际持久性、选择对谱系的重组及轨迹可测性。
AI.findings: （1）不动点结果仅为条件性命题，当前实现未证明压缩性或均衡收敛；（2）已发表论文3报告了完成的发现与确证研究，但更广泛的Stage 4对比研究仍为预注册的未来工作；（3）Stage 5中期记录显示：状态可跨代际边界持久、选择可重组谱系、结果轨迹可测；（4）总体绩效斜率正向但不确定，未确立相对漂移的优势；（5）证据支持外部供给实验中的可观测性与内生群体转换，但不支持自主经济持续性、生产绩效或递归均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）识别并明确了五大经济分析纲领中因计算充裕而失效的奠基性命题边界；（2）提出"计算经济学"作为继承性框架，将均衡定义从固定商品空间转移到更新算子上；（3）提出计算主体元组（C,O,M,G,R,E）与五个架构条件，为计算充裕环境下的经济分析提供新的概念工具；（4）对自身理论边界保持审慎——明确区分了已证实命题与条件性命题。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为计算充裕环境下（如人工智能驱动的经济系统）的经济分析提供操作性框架；（2）通过分阶段实证记录，展示如何在外部供给实验条件下检验状态持久性、谱系重组与轨迹可测性；（3）明确了当前证据的边界，避免将尚无充分证据的主张当作既定结论。

title: The Economics of Feng Shui: A Theory of Culturally Transmitted Beliefs in Asset Markets
affiliations: Columbia University

detail.title: The Economics of Feng Shui: A Theory of Culturally Transmitted Beliefs in Asset Markets
detail.abstract: When can a belief with no objective payoff consequences become permanently embedded in asset prices? I couple intergenerational preference transmission to a competitive asset market where an attribute yields utility only to those who believe it does; parents exert costly effort to pass belief or skepticism to their children. The attribute's price capitalizes the belief's future prevalence and feeds back on transmission. When the belief is rare, believers scarcely compete for the attribute and believing is nearly free, so transmission revives; when it is widespread, the premium taxes believing children, discouraging their parents from transmitting the belief, and enlarges the visible overpayment, mobilizing skeptical parents to transmit skepticism to their children, so the belief recedes. The market taxes the belief but cannot eliminate it: every equilibrium path converges to a unique, globally stable interior steady state with a permanent premium. Cultural parameters determine how many believe; the interest rate determines only what believing costs. Payoff-based selection alone would render premia transient, so their persistence among the native-born identifies the transmission mechanism itself. In extensions, cheaper supply-side accommodation of a belief spreads it, and verifying intermediaries capture the speculative component of its price. The framework rationalizes superstition premia in housing markets, its motivating application, and applies to any heritable taste attached to a tradable asset.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个代际偏好传递与竞争性资产市场相结合的模型，探讨为何没有客观收益后果的信念（如迷信）能够永久嵌入资产价格。研究发现市场会对信念征税但无法消除它，每个均衡路径都收敛到唯一、全局稳定的内点稳态，存在永久溢价。
AI.research_question: 没有客观收益后果的信念何时能够永久嵌入资产价格？即信念如何通过代际传递与资产市场反馈的相互作用而持续存在？
AI.motivation: 现实中的迷信溢价（如住房市场中的迷信价格溢价）在纯基于收益的选择机制下本应是暂时的，但其持久性表明存在文化传递机制。作者试图解释这一现象并提供一个通用分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际偏好传递理论（父母付出代价地向子女传递信念或怀疑）、竞争性资产市场定价、文化演化与市场均衡的耦合反馈机制。
AI.method: 构建代际偏好传递与竞争性资产市场的耦合理论模型。父母付出努力向子女传递信念或怀疑；资产价格资本化信念的未来普及度并反馈于传递过程；分析均衡路径的稳定性与收敛性。
AI.findings: (1) 当信念稀少时，相信者很少竞争该资产，相信成本几乎为零，传递得以复兴；(2) 当信念普遍时，溢价对相信的子女征税，抑制父母传递信念，同时扩大的过度支付动员怀疑型父母传递怀疑，信念因此消退；(3) 每个均衡路径收敛到唯一、全局稳定的内点稳态，存在永久溢价；(4) 文化参数决定多少人相信，利率只决定相信的成本；(5) 扩展分析显示供给端更便宜的信念适应会扩散信念，验证中介捕获其价格的投机成分。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 证明纯基于收益的选择只能使溢价暂时存在，其持久性可识别传递机制本身；(2) 揭示市场对信念征税但无法消除信念的机制；(3) 将文化传递理论与资产定价理论耦合，提供分析可遗传品味附着于可交易资产的一般框架。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为住房市场中的迷信溢价（本文的激励应用）提供理论解释；(2) 框架可应用于任何附着于可交易资产的可遗传品味；(3) 对理解信念持久性、市场与文化互动的公共政策和资产定价实践有启示意义。

title: The Three-Way Complementarity Between Automation, Profit Sharing, and Training: Theory and Evidence
affiliations: University of Parma - Dipartimento di Scienze Economiche e Aziendali, University of Turin and Università di Parma

detail.title: The Three-Way Complementarity Between Automation, Profit Sharing, and Training: Theory and Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the complementarity between automation, profit sharing, and digital training. We develop a team-theoretic model in which a principal manages two technologically interdependent tasks, one of which can be automated. Because only joint output can be observed, incentives must be provided through profit sharing. By improving team performance, automation increases the cost of incentive provision under profit sharing, generating a tension between the two practices. Training counteracts this effect by increasing the marginal productivity of effort, thereby reducing the cost of incentive provision. Three predictions follow: training and automation are always complementary, profit sharing and automation may be either complements or substitutes, and the three practices are jointly complementary. Reduced-form evidence from a sample of Italian firms supports these predictions: blue-collar profit sharing and digital training are individually associated with robot adoption, but part of these associations is captured by their interaction. The interaction disappears for non-IT training, white-collar profit sharing, and a wide range of non-automation technologies, indicating a complementarity specific to human-machine production.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自动化、利润分享和数字培训三者之间的互补关系。通过团队理论模型证明：自动化通过提升团队绩效增加了利润分享下的激励成本，而数字培训通过提高努力的边际生产率来抵消这一效应，从而三者形成互补关系。意大利企业数据的实证分析支持了这一预测。
AI.research_question: 自动化、利润分享和数字培训这三种管理实践之间是否存在互补性？其内在机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 企业在推行自动化的同时，往往同时采用利润分享和数字培训等实践，但现有理论对这些实践之间的互补关系缺乏系统性解释，特别是自动化与激励制度之间的张力尚未被理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 团队理论（Team Theory）与激励理论，核心关注在只能观察联合产出的情境下利润分享的激励成本问题。
AI.method: 理论建模（团队理论模型）+ 意大利企业样本的简化形式（reduced-form）实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）培训与自动化总是互补的；（2）利润分享与自动化可能是互补或替代关系；（3）三种实践联合互补。实证上，蓝领利润分享和数字培训分别与机器人采用正相关，但部分关联被两者的交互项捕捉；该交互效应在非IT培训、白领利润分享和非自动化技术中不存在，表明互补性特异于人机生产。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从团队理论视角系统揭示了自动化与激励实践的潜在张力，并阐明了数字培训作为调节机制的互补逻辑，为管理实践的互补性理论提供了新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业同时推进自动化、利润分享和数字培训的协同实施提供了理论依据和实证支持，提示管理者在自动化转型中应将激励设计和技术培训统筹考虑。

title: When Is a Price a Probability in Prediction Markets?  A Structural Estimation of Risk, Beliefs, and Contract Incompleteness

detail.title: When Is a Price a Probability in Prediction Markets?  A Structural Estimation of Risk, Beliefs, and Contract Incompleteness
detail.abstract: Prediction market prices are treated as measures of probabilities, but a price need not equal the physical probability of the event. We develop a framework that separates the gap between price and probability into risk compensation, heterogeneous beliefs, latent regimes, contract incompleteness, and venue frictions. We use prediction market data to identify the channels. Estimation on Polymarket shows collateral carry is near zero and cannot explain the favorite longshot pattern, while contract incompleteness is priced consistently with spanning failures. The results clarify when prediction market prices can be interpreted as probabilities and when they should be viewed as market valuations.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个框架，将预测市场价格与物理概率之间的差距分解为风险补偿、异质信念、潜在制度、合约不完备性和场所摩擦五个渠道，并利用Polymarket数据进行估计，发现抵押品成本接近零无法解释热门-冷门偏差，而合约不完备性定价与跨期失败一致，从而厘清了预测市场价格何时可被解读为概率、何时应被视为市场估值。
AI.research_question: 预测市场价格是否等同于事件的物理概率？如果不相等，价格与概率之间的差距由哪些渠道构成，各渠道的相对重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 预测市场价格常被当作概率的直接度量，但价格未必等于物理概率。理解价格与概率之间的系统性差距对于正确解读预测市场信息至关重要，需要提供一个可识别的理论框架来分解这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将价格与概率的差距分解为五个渠道：风险补偿（risk compensation）、异质信念（heterogeneous beliefs）、潜在制度（latent regimes）、合约不完备性（contract incompleteness）和场所摩擦（venue frictions）。
AI.method: 建立理论框架对价格-概率差距进行分解，并利用Polymarket预测市场数据对各渠道进行计量识别和估计。
AI.findings: Polymarket数据估计显示：抵押品携带成本（collateral carry）接近于零，无法解释热门-冷门偏差（favorite longshot pattern）；合约不完备性定价与跨期失败（spanning failures）一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个系统性框架，将预测市场价格与概率的差距分解为可识别的理论渠道，为预测市场价格解读提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者厘清了预测市场价格何时可被视为概率（直接用于决策）以及何时应被视为市场估值（需谨慎解读），对预测市场数据的合理使用具有指导意义。

title: When Local Markets Close but the World Keeps Trading: Global Information Absorption at Market Reopening
affiliations: and

detail.title: When Local Markets Close but the World Keeps Trading: Global Information Absorption at Market Reopening
detail.abstract: What happens to global information when a local equity market is closed but foreign markets continue to trade? We use exchange-calendar differences to construct UTC-stamped information windows from the last local close before a closure to the local reopening. Verified closure episodes are compared with continuously traded pseudo-closure windows of identical calendar length, matched on the magnitude and sign of the foreign shock, global risk, seasonality, and pre-event domestic volatility. In 809 matched episodes for the Nikkei 225, FTSE 100, DAX, and S&P 500, the closure-by-foreign-return interaction is 0.631 (standard error 0.064) for the reopening-day return but-0.018 (0.062) for the cumulative calendarequivalent return. Closure therefore changes when information enters local prices in every audited market, although the magnitude differs. The pooled cumulative effect is near zero, but formal heterogeneity shows attenuation outside Japan (-0.184, p=0.005) and a positive Nikkei differential (0.293, p=0.005). In the audited DAX-Nikkei opening subsample, the differential reopening loading splits between the opening gap (0.367) and the subsequent session (0.390). Absolute foreign variation also raises the absolute reopening response; the interaction is 0.260 (0.080) and survives multiplicity adjustment and conditional permutation diagnostics. The evidence supports deferred price discovery and uncertainty concentration, but not general temporal insulation. The timing result survives synchronized-closure, weekend-structure, and within-year calendar falsifications. Because a prespecified delayed-foreign-return diagnostic rejects, however, the estimates are interpreted as timing and predictive evidence rather than a causal welfare effect of closure.

AI.tldr: 本文利用交易所日历差异构建UTC时间戳信息窗口，通过809个匹配事件（Nikkei 225、FTSE 100、DAX和S&P 500），发现市场休市改变了本地价格吸收外国信息的时点——休市期间积累的外国收益在复市首日集中反映（交互项0.631），但累计日历等值收益接近零，表明信息只是推迟而非被隔离，支持"延迟价格发现"和"不确定性集中"假说，而非"时间隔离"假说。
AI.research_question: 当本地股票市场休市而外国市场继续交易时，全球信息如何进入本地价格？休市是延迟了信息的价格发现过程，还是完全隔离了信息，抑或其他效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对市场休市期间信息处理机制存在争议：一种观点认为休市提供了"时间隔离"（temporal insulation），使本地市场免受外部冲击；另一种观点认为信息只是被推迟而非被消灭。本文旨在通过严格的匹配方法区分"延迟价格发现"、"不确定性集中"和"时间隔离"三种竞争性假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 延迟价格发现（deferred price discovery）、不确定性集中（uncertainty concentration）与时间隔离（temporal insulation）三种竞争性理论框架。
AI.method: 利用不同交易所的日历差异构造UTC时间戳信息窗口；将真实休市事件与相同日历长度的连续交易"伪休市"窗口进行匹配，匹配变量包括外国冲击的大小和符号、全球风险、季节性及事件前本地波动率；采用双向固定效应回归和形式化异质性检验；辅以多重性调整和条件置换诊断。
AI.findings: （1）在809个匹配事件中，休市×外国收益交互项对复市日收益为0.631（标准误0.064），但对累计日历等值收益为-0.018（标准误0.062），表明休市改变了信息进入价格的时点而非总量；（2）累积效应总体接近零，但存在异质性：日本以外市场衰减-0.184（p=0.005），日经指数正差异0.293（p=0.005）；（3）绝对外国波动也提高绝对复市反应（交互项0.260，标准误0.080），且通过多重性校正；（4）结果通过同步休市、周末结构和年内日历的证伪检验；（5）但预先设定的延迟外国收益诊断被拒绝，故结果被解释为时机和预测证据而非休市的因果福利效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 在经验上区分了"延迟价格发现"、"不确定性集中"和"时间隔离"三种理论机制，提供了支持前两者、拒绝后者的稳健证据；发现信息处理存在跨国异质性（日本与非日本市场的差异），丰富了关于市场微观结构和信息效率的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易所、监管者和投资者提供了关于市场休市期间信息处理机制的实证依据；表明休市主要改变信息进入价格的时点而非信息量本身，有助于设计更有效的交易日历安排和风险管理制度。

title: Long-Horizon Forecasting of Complete Financial Statements with Forma
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin, , The University of Texas at Austin, TX, USA, The University of Texas at Austin, TX, USA, The University of Texas at Austin, TX, USA and The University of Texas at Austin, TX, USA

detail.title: Long-Horizon Forecasting of Complete Financial Statements with Forma

declarations.funderStatement: We thank Quent Capital, the Langston Family Wealth Management Center, and the AIM Investment Center for financial support.

detail.abstract: Specialist training beats generalist scale when forecasting financial statements. To our knowledge, no prior work jointly forecasts complete financial statements beyond one year, yet in a discounted-cash-flow valuation most firm value sits past that window. We release ProForma-20Q, a reproducible benchmark for forecasting 78 statement line items 1-20 quarters ahead, for anonymized firms, from past statements and an industry code, scored by change-space R2. On it, Forma, a transformer that reads statements as sets of (account, quarter, value) tuples and maximizes a masked-tuple Gaussian likelihood, beats every competitor we field: classical machine learning, chained gradient boosting, a zero-shot time-series foundation model, and frontier large language models. Its lead widens with horizon, where valuation needs accuracy most, and its Gaussian predictive intervals never undercover. Forma's forecasts nearly satisfy accounting identities; exact coherence is recoverable at no statistically significant accuracy cost. Its tuple interface supports scenario analysis without retraining, and we show that pinning future revenue paths sharpens the rest of the statement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ProForma-20Q基准测试和Forma模型，用于预测财务报表78个线项未来1-20个季度。Forma是一种将报表视为(账户,季度,数值)三元组集合的Transformer，通过掩码三元组高斯似然进行训练，在预测准确度上超越了经典机器学习、梯度提升、零样本时序基础模型和前沿大语言模型，且预测区间校准良好，近似满足会计恒等式。
AI.research_question: 如何超越一年预测窗口，实现完整财务报表未来20个季度的高精度联合预测，并满足会计恒等式约束？
AI.motivation: 在折现现金流估值中，大部分企业价值位于一年预测窗口之外，但现有工作没有联合预测超过一年的完整财务报表，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Transformer架构、高斯似然估计、会计恒等式约束、折现现金流估值理论
AI.method: 构建ProForma-20Q基准（78个线项、1-20季度前瞻、匿名企业、基于历史报表和行业代码）；提出Forma模型，将报表编码为(账户,季度,数值)三元组，使用掩码三元组高斯似然训练；与经典机器学习、梯度提升、零样本时序基础模型及前沿大语言模型进行对比评估，使用变化空间R2作为评分指标。
AI.findings: Forma在所有对比模型中表现最佳，优势随预测期限延长而扩大；其高斯预测区间从未欠覆盖；预测几乎满足会计恒等式，且强制精确一致性不带来显著的统计显著精度损失；元组接口支持无需重训练的情景分析，固定未来收入路径可提升报表其余部分的预测精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实现超过一年的完整财务报表联合预测；提出将财务报表建模为三元组集合的Transformer方法；展示了专业训练模型优于通用规模模型的证据；提出了可复现的ProForma-20Q基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为估值分析提供长期（20个季度）的财务报表预测工具；模型支持情景分析（如设定未来收入路径）而无需重新训练，便于投资者和分析师进行假设检验；提供了可复现的基准数据集供实务界使用。

title: When is a Price a Probability in Prediction Markets?  A Structural Estimation of Risk, Beliefs, and Contract Incompleteness

detail.title: When is a Price a Probability in Prediction Markets?  A Structural Estimation of Risk, Beliefs, and Contract Incompleteness

keywords: Replication Package Containing the Estimation-Ready Panels

detail.abstract: Prediction-market prices are increasingly used as real-time probabilities for economically important events, but a market price need not equal the physical likelihood of the event. We develop and estimate a structural framework that separates the economic forces behind this price–probability wedge—risk compensation, heterogeneous beliefs, latent regimes, contract incompleteness, and venue frictions—while taking the standard asset-pricing P-to-Q mapping as the benchmark. Using Polymarket transactions, we find that collateral carry is bounded near zero in a belief-free design, rejecting the funding explanation of the favorite–longshot wedge. The incompleteness hazard is priced at a rate consistent with realized spanning failures. The results show when prediction-market prices can be read as probabilities and, when they cannot, which economic force drives the wedge.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并估计了一个结构性框架，用以分离预测市场价格与物理概率之间楔形（price–probability wedge）背后的经济力量——风险补偿、异质信念、潜在制度、合约不完整性和场所摩擦，并以标准资产定价的P到Q映射为基准。利用Polymarket交易数据，研究发现抵押品持有成本在无信念设计中接近零，否定了融资解释对热门–冷门偏差的作用；不完整性风险定价与已实现的跨界失败率一致。
AI.research_question: 预测市场的价格何时可以等同于事件发生的物理概率？当二者不等价时，究竟是哪种经济力量驱动了价格–概率楔形？
AI.motivation: 预测市场价格越来越被用作经济重要事件的实时概率，但市场价格并不必然等于事件的物理概率。理解并定量分离驱动这一楔形的各种经济力量，对于正确解读预测市场价格至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准资产定价的P-to-Q映射；结构性框架区分风险补偿、异质信念、潜在制度、合约不完整性、场所摩擦五种力量。
AI.method: 开发并估计一个结构性框架，利用Polymarket交易数据；采用无信念设计（belief-free design）检验抵押品成本，估计不完整性风险定价。
AI.findings: 抵押品持有成本在无信念设计中接近零，否定了融资（funding）解释对热门–冷门偏差的作用；不完整性风险定价与已实现的跨界失败率一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的定量框架，首次将多种经济力量在同一结构模型下分离，明确了各种力量对价格–概率楔形的相对贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了判断预测市场价格何时可直接读作概率、何时不能的准则，并指出了当价格不可靠时驱动楔形的具体经济力量。

title: Teaching Mediation Analysis with Published Open Data: A Two-Stage Shiny Workflow and Its Verification
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: Teaching Mediation Analysis with Published Open Data: A Two-Stage Shiny Workflow and Its Verification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available, anonymized secondary data released by the original authors under a CC BY licence; no new data were collected from human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Mediation analysis is the standard statistical framework for investigating mechanisms in research on health and well-being; however, teaching it involves two obstacles unrelated to mediation itself: the software configuration for structural equation modeling and the model-specification syntax. This article reports on a teaching unit that removed them in sequence, together with the verification of their materials against a published study. The unit rests on two open-source Shiny applications: a simulator that converts structural choices into a path diagram and ready-to-run lavaan syntax, and an estimation application that accepts CSV data and free-text syntax to estimate the models and generate bilingual reports. Between these, the unit is treated as a conceptual core, binding the abstract structure to the concepts and measured variables of an actual study. Students first reproduced a published analysis from its shared data file then drafted a mediation study of their own. To verify the materials, the full sequence was run by Hou et al. (2020), whose data on 1,472 health care workers were openly deposited. The workflow reproduced the published fit indices, factor loadings, structural paths, and indirect and total effects almost exactly and identified a transposed digit in one published descriptive statistic. The exercise also revealed four properties of the applications that their built-in examples had not exposed, these are reported here rather than repaired. Reanalyzing published open data serves as a student assignment and an acceptance check for teaching materials.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一套基于两个开源Shiny应用的中介分析教学单元，该单元通过模拟器和估计应用分别解决了结构方程建模的软件配置和模型语法两大教学障碍，并以Hou等(2020)的公开数据验证了教学材料，几乎精确复现了发表的结果。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一套能够降低中介分析教学门槛（消除软件配置和模型语法两大障碍）的教学单元，并验证其教学材料的有效性？
AI.motivation: 中介分析是健康与福祉研究中的标准统计框架，但其教学存在两个与中介本身无关的障碍：结构方程建模的软件配置复杂以及模型规范语法难以掌握。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中介分析统计框架（Mediation Analysis）、结构方程建模（Structural Equation Modeling, SEM）
AI.method: 开发两个开源Shiny应用（一个模拟器将结构选择转换为路径图和可运行的lavaan语法，一个估计应用接受CSV数据和自由文本语法估计模型并生成双语报告）；以教学单元形式实施教学，并用Hou等(2020)对1,472名医疗保健工作者的公开数据进行材料验证。
AI.findings: 工作流程几乎精确复现了已发表的拟合指数、因子载荷、结构路径、间接效应和总效应，并识别出已发表描述性统计中的一个数字转置错误；练习还揭示了应用内置示例未暴露的四个属性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将中介分析概念抽象结构与实际研究变量相连接的教学设计框架，展示了开放数据复现分析作为教学材料验收检查的方法论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套开源、可复用的中介分析教学工具（两个Shiny应用），降低了软件配置和语法学习的门槛；验证了复现公开发表研究作为学生作业和教学材料质量检验的可行做法。

title: Market Structure, Regulatory Quality, and MSME Resilience: Extending Industrial Organization Through Competitive Capability

detail.title: Market Structure, Regulatory Quality, and MSME Resilience: Extending Industrial Organization Through Competitive Capability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, personal, or institutional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the preparation or publication of this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this manuscript is a conceptual study based exclusively on published literature and does not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Micro, small, and medium enterprises operate under structural and regulatory conditions that shape their ability to compete, adapt, and survive. Yet MSME resilience is often explained through internal resources, innovation, digitalization, or dynamic capabilities, with limited attention to industry structure and regulation. This conceptual paper extends Industrial Organization by examining how market structure and regulatory quality shape MSME resilience through competitive capability. Drawing on a structured conceptual synthesis of research on entry barriers, buyer power, institutional quality, capabilities, and organizational resilience, the framework positions regulatory quality as an upstream condition influencing market structure and competitive capability. A more contestable market structure can improve access to customers, resources, information, and strategic alternatives while reducing exclusionary barriers and asymmetric dependence. Competitive capability is defined as the capacity to sense market changes, protect and appropriate value, reconfigure resources, and respond strategically. Market structure is proposed to affect MSME resilience directly and indirectly through competitive capability, establishing partial mediation. The paper contributes to Industrial Organization by extending its outcome domain toward firm resilience, incorporating buyer power alongside seller power, specifying a firm level capability mechanism, and treating regulatory quality as an industry structuring condition. It provides a foundation for longitudinal, multilevel, and comparative research on when contestability, bargaining conditions, and regulatory quality enable MSMEs to maintain operational continuity and preserve viable market participation.

AI.tldr: 这篇概念性论文通过产业组织理论视角，提出市场结构和监管质量通过竞争能力塑造中小微企业（MSME）韧性的理论框架。论文将监管质量视为上游条件，影响市场结构和竞争能力；更具竞争性的市场结构既能直接影响MSME韧性，也能通过竞争能力间接影响（部分中介效应）。
AI.research_question: 市场结构和监管质量如何通过竞争能力塑造中小微企业的组织韧性？
AI.motivation: 现有MSME韧性研究过度聚焦于内部资源、创新、数字化和动态能力，忽视了产业结构和监管等外部结构性条件对MSME韧性塑造的重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业组织理论（Industrial Organization），涵盖进入壁垒、买方势力、制度质量、能力理论与组织韧性等概念的综合。
AI.method: 结构化概念综合法（structured conceptual synthesis），整合进入壁垒、买方势力、制度质量、能力和组织韧性的相关研究文献。
AI.findings: 提出一个理论框架：监管质量作为上游条件影响市场结构和竞争能力；更具竞争性的市场结构可改善客户、资源、信息和战略替代方案的获取，同时减少排斥性壁垒和不对称依赖；市场结构通过竞争能力对MSME韧性产生部分中介效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 第一，将产业组织理论的结果域扩展到企业韧性；第二，在卖方势力基础上纳入买方势力；第三，明确了企业层面的能力机制；第四，将监管质量视为产业结构的塑造性条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为纵向、多层次和比较研究奠定基础，帮助理解在何种竞争性、议价条件和监管质量下，MSME能够维持运营连续性和可行的市场参与。

title: Will Asia Dominate the Global Economy in the Future?

detail.title: Will Asia Dominate the Global Economy in the Future?
detail.abstract: The global economic landscape is undergoing a dramatic transformation, with the center of gravity shifting steadily from the West toward the East. Asia, home to more than 4.7 billion people and some of the fastest-growing economies on the planet, is increasingly seen as the engine of future global growth. This research paper investigates whether Asia will dominate the global economy in the coming decades by examining key economic indicators, demographic trends, technological innovation, trade dynamics, and structural challenges facing the continent. Drawing on data from the International Monetary Fund (IMF), World Bank, McKinsey Global Institute, PwC, the Asian Development Bank (ADB), and United Nations agencies, the paper provides a nuanced analysis that goes beyond simplistic projections. While the evidence strongly suggests that Asia will become the single largest economic bloc by 2040, true "dominance" depends on the region's ability to navigate demographic headwinds, geopolitical tensions, inequality, and institutional reform. The paper concludes that Asia's economic ascent is not a question of "if" but "how," and outlines the conditions under which the continent could either solidify or squander its historic opportunity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨亚洲是否将在未来几十年主导全球经济。基于IMF、世界银行、麦肯锡等机构数据，研究发现亚洲到2040年将成为全球最大经济板块，但真正"主导"取决于其应对人口逆风、地缘政治紧张、不平等和制度改革的能力。亚洲的经济崛起不是"是否"的问题，而是"如何"的问题。
AI.research_question: 亚洲是否会在未来几十年主导全球经济？
AI.motivation: 全球经济重心正从西方转向东方，亚洲拥有超过47亿人口和全球增长最快的一些经济体，被视为未来全球增长的引擎。需要超越简单预测，对亚洲经济前景进行全面细致的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济指标、人口趋势、技术创新、贸易动态和结构性挑战等多维度分析框架，融合IMF、世界银行、麦肯锡、普华永道、亚开行和联合国机构的数据视角。
AI.method: 多源数据综合分析，利用IMF、世界银行、麦肯锡全球研究院、普华永道、亚洲开发银行及联合国机构的数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 证据强烈表明亚洲将在2040年前成为全球最大的经济板块；但"主导"取决于亚洲应对人口逆风、地缘政治紧张、不平等和制度改革的能力；亚洲的经济崛起取决于"如何"实现而非"是否"实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个超越简单线性预测的细致分析框架，揭示了亚洲经济崛起从"是否"到"如何"的范式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业界提供关于亚洲能否巩固或浪费其历史性机遇的识别条件，帮助理解亚洲经济崛起的关键变数。

title: Balance of Power and Its Self-Poisoning Dynamics: A Memetic-Structural Theory of GDMC Regimes
affiliations: Kunisawa Statistical Information Bureau

detail.title: Balance of Power and Its Self-Poisoning Dynamics: A Memetic-Structural Theory of GDMC Regimes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research received no external funding and was conducted independently, without any commercial or financial relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest. The author has no personal or institutional affiliations that influenced the design, analysis, or conclusions of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a purely theoretical, deductive study. It involves no human participants, no patients, no personal data, and no empirical data collection of any kind. All results follow analytically from the stated assumptions; therefore, ethics approval is not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Balance of Power (BoP) is traditionally understood as a stabilizing mechanism that prevents hegemonic dominance in international relations. This paper demonstrates that when BoP logic is internalized within centralized ruling structures, its stabilizing function reverses. We introduce the Generational Dominance Methodology Collective (GDMC) as a memetic-structural governance formation in which secrecy, fragmentation, and loyalty-based control reproduce across actors and generations. Under these conditions, BoP becomes self-poisoning: a high-cost internal balancing process that accelerates political entropy rather than reducing systemic risk. Using concepts from complexity science, political economy, organizational theory, and structuraldemographic dynamics, we develop a unified framework explaining how GDMC regimes generate multi-exponential instability. Core mechanisms include exponential competence decay under loyalty selection, information bottlenecks produced by secrecy escalation, super-linear administrative burdens resulting from fragmentation, the collapse of cooperative equilibria among elites, and strategic overextension caused by internalized BoP logic. These mechanisms interact through seven mutually reinforcing causal loops, creating a positive-feedback architecture that drives systems toward administrative exhaustion and eventual collapse. The analysis shows that GDMC regimes do not fail primarily due to external shocks, leadership errors, or discrete crises. Instead, collapse emerges endogenously from the structural incentives embedded in their governance memeplex. By reframing governance fragility as a function of information ecology and memetic replication, this study offers a new explanatory model for understanding instability in late-stage empires, secrecy-dependent bureaucracies, and modern hegemonic systems. In doing so, it speaks directly to the reconfiguration of power and agency under global uncertainty: the very strategies through which centralized authorities attempt to preserve control become the mechanisms that erode their adaptive capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"世代主导方法论集体"（GDMC）这一概念，论证当传统上被视为稳定机制的实力均衡（BoP）逻辑被内化于中央集权统治结构时，其稳定功能会逆转，演变为加速政治熵增、导致系统性崩溃的"自我毒化"过程。研究通过七个相互强化的因果循环，揭示了GDMC体制的崩溃源于其治理"迷因复合体"内嵌的结构性激励，而非外部冲击。
AI.research_question: 当实力均衡逻辑被内化于中央集权统治结构中时，它如何从稳定机制转变为破坏性力量？GDMC体制的结构性治理机制如何内生地导致系统崩溃？
AI.motivation: 传统国际关系理论将实力均衡视为防止霸权统治的稳定机制，但现有研究忽视了当该逻辑被内化于集权结构中时的功能逆转。作者旨在解释为何某些晚期帝国、秘密依赖型官僚体系及现代霸权系统展现出多指数级的不稳定性，并提出一个统一的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合运用复杂性科学、政治经济学、组织理论与结构人口动力学，提出"迷因-结构治理"框架，将治理脆弱性重新定义为信息生态与迷因复制（meme replication）的函数。
AI.method: 概念性理论建构与跨学科集成分析。通过识别五种核心机制（忠诚选择下的指数能力衰减、保密升级导致的信息瓶颈、碎片化带来的超线性行政负担、精英间合作均衡的崩溃、内化BoP逻辑导致的战略过度扩张），并分析其七个相互强化的因果循环，构建正反馈架构模型。
AI.findings: GDMC体制的崩溃并非主要源于外部冲击、领导失误或分散危机，而是从治理"迷因复合体"中嵌入的结构性激励内生地产生。BoP内化于集权结构中会产生自我毒化效应——高成本的内部平衡过程加速政治熵增而非降低系统性风险，最终导致行政耗竭与体系崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了实力均衡理论的适用范围与边界条件，揭示了其在集权结构中的功能逆转机制；提出了"迷因-结构性治理"视角，将组织理论、复杂性科学与政治学融合，开辟了理解治理脆弱性的新解释模型；将政府脆弱性问题重新概念化为信息生态与迷因复制的函数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解晚期帝国、秘密官僚体系和现代霸权系统的不稳定性提供了诊断框架；揭示了中央集权权威试图维持控制所采用的策略恰恰成为侵蚀其适应能力的机制，对全球不确定性下权力与行动力的重新配置具有直接启示。

title: References to the Court of Justice of the European Union: Experiences of a National Judge 2004-2019

detail.title: References to the Court of Justice of the European Union: Experiences of a National Judge 2004-2019
detail.abstract: This article presents the experiences of one national judge of 14 preliminary references made by the High Court of England and Wales to the Court of Justice of the European Union in intellectual property cases during the period from 2004 to 2019. The references are discussed in chronological order, and some conclusions are then drawn concerning the roles both of national courts and of the CJEU.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了一位英国高等法院国家法官在2004年至2019年间向欧盟法院提交的14件知识产权案件初步裁决请求的经验，按时间顺序讨论这些案件，并就国家法院和欧盟法院的角色得出结论。
AI.research_question: 英国高等法院在2004至2019年间向欧盟法院提交的知识产权初步裁决请求有何经验与规律？国家法院和欧盟法院在此过程中分别扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 通过一位亲身参与的国家法官的第一手视角，系统总结和反思英国法院与欧盟法院在知识产权领域通过初步裁决机制互动的实践经验，丰富对这一合作机制运行的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟初步裁决机制（Preliminary Ruling Procedure）下的法院间对话理论，涉及国家法院与欧盟法院之间的司法合作与分工框架。
AI.method: 基于一位国家法官的个人经验，对2004至2019年间14件知识产权案件初步裁决请求进行按时间顺序的案例回顾与质性分析，并从中归纳结论。
AI.findings: 通过对14件案件的逐一梳理，发现国家法院与欧盟法院在初步裁决机制中各自承担着不同的角色：国家法院负责筛选和界定需要裁决的法律问题，欧盟法院则提供统一解释；两者之间存在动态的互动与分工关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过法官一手经验，深化了对初步裁决机制中"国家法院—欧盟法院"二元司法互动模式的理解，补充了从裁判者视角审视这一机制运行细节的学术文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法实践者（特别是国家法官）如何有效利用初步裁决机制、如何界定和表述参考问题提供了实操经验参考；同时有助于理解英国脱欧前后与欧盟司法体系关系的变迁背景。

title: The Constitutional Turn: Balancing Copyright and Freedom of Expression in English Law

detail.title: The Constitutional Turn: Balancing Copyright and Freedom of Expression in English Law
detail.abstract: This article considers case law from the courts of England and Wales on the balance between copyright and freedom of expression and how this has developed over the last 50 years or so. Although there has been no fundamental change in the approach of the English courts to this issue, the enactment of the Human Rights Act 1998 and the jurisprudence of the Court of Justice of the European Union have led to an acceptance that decisions in cases involving conflicts between copyright and freedom of expression need to be grounded in the European human rights framework. Like the CJEU, the English courts have generally preferred to treat human rights considerations as influencing the interpretation and application of the internal mechanisms in copyright law rather than as supplying an external corrective mechanism. In that sense progress has been made towards the constitutionalisation of copyright law even if some would argue that there is further to go.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了英格兰和威尔士法院过去50年来关于版权与言论自由之间平衡的判例法发展。虽然英国法院的基本方法没有根本改变，但1998年《人权法》的颁布和欧盟法院的判例法已使法院认识到，涉及版权与言论自由冲突的案件需要以欧洲人权框架为基础进行裁决。与欧盟法院类似，英国法院倾向于将人权考量内化为版权法内部机制的司法解释，而非作为外部纠正机制，这表明版权法的宪法化已取得进展。
AI.research_question: 过去50年来，英格兰和威尔士法院如何处理版权与言论自由之间的平衡？这一方法是如何发展的？
AI.motivation: 版权与言论自由的冲突是知识产权法领域的重要议题，特别是在《人权法1998》颁布和欧盟法院判例法影响下，英国法院如何处理这一平衡值得系统梳理和分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲人权框架（《欧洲人权公约》）、版权法的宪法化理论、欧盟法院判例法中的比例原则和人权考量方法
AI.method: 判例法分析（doctrinal legal analysis），系统梳理英格兰和威尔士法院过去50年的相关案例。
AI.findings: 1) 英国法院处理版权与言论自由冲突的基本方法没有发生根本性变化；2) 但《人权法1998》和欧盟法院判例法促使英国法院接受此类案件裁决需以欧洲人权框架为基础；3) 英国法院倾向于将人权考量融入版权法的内部机制（如解释和适用）而非作为外部纠正手段；4) 版权法的宪法化已取得进展但仍未完全实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 为版权法宪法化理论提供了英国判例法层面的实证支持，揭示了英国法院在处理版权与言论自由冲突时从外部纠正向内部机制转型的路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者理解和预测英国法院在处理版权与言论自由冲突案件时的裁判逻辑提供参考，有助于人权法与版权法交叉领域的司法实践。

title: Broad Specifications and Intent to Use: Is the EU Trade Mark System Credible?

detail.title: Broad Specifications and Intent to Use: Is the EU Trade Mark System Credible?
detail.abstract: An assessment of the credibility of the EU trade mark system in the light of the ruling of the Court of Justice of the European Union in Case C-371/18 Sky v SkyKick leads to the following conclusions: the decisions that lack of clarity and precision of specifications of goods and services is not a ground of invalidity and that partial bad faith when applying to register a trade mark leads to partial invalidity are unsurprising; the decision that applying to register a trade mark without intending to use it can amount to bad faith, at least in some circumstances, is an important step forward that gives national courts a tool with which to combat unjustifiably broad specifications of goods and services; but the jury is still out with regard to the EU trade mark system's acceptance of broad terms such as "computer software" in specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了欧盟法院在Sky v SkyKick案（C-371/18）判决对欧盟商标制度可信度的影响，分析了该判决在商标规范不清晰、部分恶意申请以及无使用意图申请商标等问题的处理及其意义。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法院在Sky v SkyKick案中的判决如何影响欧盟商标制度的可信度，特别是关于商标注册规范的清晰度、部分恶意及无使用意图申请商标等问题？
AI.motivation: 欧盟商标制度面临商标规范过于宽泛、恶意申请泛滥等信任危机，Sky v SkyKick案是欧盟法院首次系统回应这些问题的重要判例，需要评估其制度影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟商标法理论与实践，涉及商标注册规范明确性要求、恶意注册的认定标准、商标使用义务等制度框架。
AI.method: 判例分析法，对欧盟法院C-371/18号判决进行法律解释与评估。
AI.findings: 1. 判决认定商标规范缺乏清晰度和精确性不构成无效理由；2. 部分恶意申请导致商标部分无效；3. 无使用意图的商标注册申请可构成恶意（至少在某些情形下），这是重要的制度进步；4. 但对于"计算机软件"等宽泛术语能否在欧盟商标制度中被接受，仍存疑。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了商标注册中"善意"与"恶意"的界限，明确了部分恶意申请的法律后果，为商标规范明确性要求与无效宣告制度的关系提供了判例法指引。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家法院提供了打击不合理宽泛商标规范的工具，有助于遏制恶意商标注册行为，平衡商标权人利益与市场竞争秩序。

title: Replacing Council Tax With a Land Value Tax: A Household-Level Microsimulation for the UK
affiliations: and

detail.title: Replacing Council Tax With a Land Value Tax: A Household-Level Microsimulation for the UK
detail.abstract: We develop a household-level microsimulation framework for land value tax reform in the United Kingdom, using PolicyEngine UK on the Enhanced Family Resources Survey, and apply it to replacing council tax, which is still assessed on 1991 valuations and is sharply regressive in property value. Land values are imputed to every household and benchmarked against ONS national balance sheet aggregates. We simulate a family of scenarios: rates from 0.5 to 5 per cent, a citizen's dividend, an exempt band, and packages also replacing stamp duty, anchored by a budget-neutral scenario in which replacing £58.5 billion of net council tax revenue requires a 0.79 per cent rate. Two thirds of households gain under the central incidence treatment (63 to 76 per cent across defensible alternatives), and incidence is organised by wealth rather than income: against the wealth ranking, council tax's Kakwani index of-0.523 becomes-0.032, and the top wealth decile loses £5,871 a year. Incomeranked statistics register little; the fall in after-housing-costs poverty holds only under fixed rents and reverses under substantial rent pass-through. Evaluating property tax reform on income-based statistics alone misses most of what it does.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个英国家庭层面的微观模拟框架来评估土地价值税改革，利用PolicyEngine UK和Enhanced Family Resources Survey数据，模拟用土地价值税替代市政税（council tax）的效果。研究发现，在预算中性情景下，替代585亿英镑净市政税收入需要0.79%的税率；约三分之二的家庭在改革中获益；税负分配主要按财富而非收入组织——相对于财富排名，市政税的Kakwani指数从-0.523变为-0.032，最富有的财富十分位家庭每年损失5,871英镑。仅基于收入统计评估房产税改革会错过其大部分影响。
AI.research_question: 用土地价值税替代英国市政税（council tax）会如何影响家庭福利分配，以及仅基于收入而非财富的统计评估会遗漏什么？
AI.motivation: 英国市政税仍基于1991年的房产估值，在房产价值上呈严重累退性。现有政策评估大多基于收入统计，但房产税的实际负担与分配效应主要与财富相关，仅看收入统计会低估或误判改革的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地价值税理论、税收归宿与累进性分析（Kakwani指数）、家庭微观模拟框架、财富与收入双维度的税收公平分析
AI.method: 利用PolicyEngine UK微观模拟模型，基于Enhanced Family Resources Survey数据，为每户家庭推算土地价值，并与ONS国家资产负债表总量对标校准；模拟0.5%-5%的多档税率、公民红利、免税档次及替代印花税等情景，并以预算中性情景为基准，从收入与财富两个维度评估税负分配。
AI.findings: 预算中性替代585亿英镑市政税收入需要0.79%的土地价值税率；中央情形下63-76%的家庭获益；相对于财富排名，市政税Kakwani指数从-0.523改善至-0.032；最富财富十分位家庭每年损失5,871英镑；收入排名统计几乎不显示变化；扣除住房成本后的贫困下降仅在固定租金假设下成立，在显著租金转嫁下会逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证了评估房产税（财富相关税种）改革必须同时考虑财富维度而不仅仅依赖收入维度；揭示了仅基于收入统计评估会系统性遗漏财富分配效应，为税收累进性评估方法提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国土地价值税改革提供了具体的政策模拟工具和量化证据：0.79%的预算中性税率建议、家庭获益情况、财富分配影响，以及租金转嫁对减贫效果的重要制约，为政策制定者提供了可操作的改革方案评估框架。

reference: De Nederlandsche Bank Working Paper No. 866
title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Green and Brown Government Spending
affiliations: De Nederlandsche Bank, European Central Bank (ECB) and De Nederlandsche Bank

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Consequences of Green and Brown Government Spending

publicationDetails.detailsText: De Nederlandsche Bank Working Paper No. 866
publicationDetails.journalName: De Nederlandsche Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper estimates the macroeconomic effects of green and brown government spend-ing using public procurement data, focusing on how spending composition reshapes the energy sector. Classifying around 171,000 contracts by product codes, we con-struct a quarterly panel of green and brown procurement for ten Eurozone economies (2011–2023). We identify spending shocks using the institutional timing of contract award announcements, which is plausibly orthogonal to the business cycle, and es-timate impulse responses with panel local projections. Green and brown procure-ment have near mirror-image effects on the energy sector: green procurement lowers energy prices, reduces energy-sector output, and cuts oil import dependence, while brown procurement raises energy prices and depresses innovation, especially green patenting. These differences extend to aggregate output: the cumulative GDP multi-plier of green procurement is about 0.7 on impact and exceeds 1 within one and two years, whereas the brown multiplier remains statistically indistinguishable from zero over the first two years.

AI.tldr: 本文利用公共采购数据估计绿色与棕色政府支出的宏观经济效应，通过分类约171,000份合同构建2011-2023年欧元区十国的季度面板，利用合同授予公告的制度性时点识别支出冲击，发现绿色与棕色采购对能源部门具有近乎镜像的影响：绿色采购降低能源价格、减少能源部门产出并降低石油进口依赖，而棕色采购推高能源价格并抑制创新（尤其绿色专利）；绿色采购的累计GDP乘数在冲击当期约0.7且在一至两年内超过1，而棕色采购乘数在前两年统计上与零无异。
AI.research_question: 绿色与棕色政府支出的结构差异如何影响能源部门及宏观经济？两种支出的财政乘数是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将政府支出视为同质总量，缺乏对绿色与棕色采购结构性差异的宏观效应识别；理解政府支出构成（绿色vs棕色）如何重塑能源部门和影响宏观经济乘数，对气候财政政策的有效设计至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政乘数理论、绿色增长理论与能源转型经济学、创新/专利经济学
AI.method: 利用公共采购数据按产品代码分类约171,000份合同，构建绿色与棕色采购的季度面板（2011-2023，欧元区十国）；利用合同授予公告的制度性时点识别支出冲击（与商业周期正交），采用面板局部投影法估计脉冲响应。
AI.findings: 绿色与棕色采购对能源部门具有近乎镜像的影响：绿色采购降低能源价格、减少能源部门产出、降低石油进口依赖；棕色采购推高能源价格并抑制创新尤其是绿色专利。绿色采购的累计GDP乘数在冲击当期约0.7，一到两年内超过1；棕色采购乘数在前两年统计上与零无差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将政府支出按绿色/棕色结构分解并估计其异质性宏观效应，拓展了财政乘数异质性文献；揭示了绿色与棕色支出对能源部门、创新活动的差异化传导机制，为绿色财政政策研究提供了微观到宏观的证据链。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供绿色采购经济效应的量化证据（GDP乘数远高于棕色采购），支持将公共采购作为气候转型工具；有助于优化政府支出结构，在实现能源转型与低碳目标的同时获得更强的短期宏观刺激效果。

reference: Forthcoming   The European Journal of the History of Economic Thought, Fall 2026
title: Writing the History of Applied Fields in Economics: Why? How?
affiliations: CNRS and GREDEG CNRS

detail.title: Writing the History of Applied Fields in Economics: Why? How?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no conflict of interest

keywords: historiography of science JEL codes: B00

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming   The European Journal of the History of Economic Thought, Fall 2026

detail.abstract: In this paper, we ask why historians of economics have largely neglected the history of applied fields-such as labor, urban, or health economics-despite their centrality to how economists research, teach, recruit in the twentieth century. We survey why and how economists themselves have engaged with field histories, how sociologists and historians of science have studied disciplinary structures, and how historians of economics have covered specific fields. We argue that writing field history requires confronting two core methodological tensions: distinctiveness (what sets a field apart intellectually and institutionally) and permanence (why some specializations endure while others remain fleeting topics).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了为何经济学史学家在很大程度上忽略了应用经济学领域（如劳动、城市或健康经济学）的历史，尽管这些领域在20世纪经济学家研究、教学和招聘中占据核心地位。作者提出，撰写领域历史需要面对两个核心方法论张力：独特性（什么使一个领域在智识和制度上与众不同）和持久性（为什么某些专业化长存而其他只是短暂议题）。
AI.research_question: 为什么经济学史学家在很大程度上忽视了应用经济学领域（如劳动、城市或健康经济学）的历史？撰写这些领域的历史需要面对哪些方法论挑战？
AI.motivation: 应用经济学领域在20世纪经济学家的研究、教学和招聘中占据核心地位，但经济学史学界却对其历史关注甚少，这种忽视与研究对象的中心性形成鲜明对比。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴科学社会学和科学史对学科结构的研究，以及经济学史学家对各具体领域的既有覆盖，形成跨学科的分析框架。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，系统审视经济学家自身对领域历史的参与、社会学家和科学史家对学科结构的研究，以及经济学史学家对具体领域的覆盖情况。
AI.findings: 撰写领域历史需要面对两个核心方法论张力：一是独特性——什么使一个领域在智识和制度上独立成域；二是持久性——为什么某些专业化能够长期存续而另一些只是转瞬即逝的议题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济学领域史研究提供了一个方法论框架，识别了撰写领域历史所需解决的核心张力和分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来的经济学应用领域历史研究提供研究议程和方法论指引，填补经济学史研究中的一个重要空白。

detail.abstract: Firms increasingly incorporate non-financial information when selecting supply chain partners, yet little is known about how they trade it off against financial performance. Using a discrete choice experiment with 3,172 German firm representatives, we show that firms value partners' strong financial performance almost five times more than strong environmental performance. However, consistent with unraveling disclosure theory, firms prefer environmental disclosure to non-disclosure, even when the disclosed performance is weak. The trade-off between financial and environmental performance varies with the characteristics of the selecting firm. Among firms intentionally committed to a sustainability strategy and among downstream firms, strong environmental performance of potential business partners partly offsets weak financial performance. Firms preparing for sustainability reporting exhibit stronger environmental preferences only when both the regulatory environment becomes more stringent and stakeholder pressure is present. This pattern suggests that reporting regulation is associated with persistent sustainability improvements only alongside market forces.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项包含3,172名德国企业代表的离散选择实验，探讨企业在选择供应链伙伴时如何在财务绩效与环境绩效之间进行权衡。研究发现企业重视合作伙伴强劲财务绩效的程度约为重视强劲环境绩效的五倍；但根据「揭露揭开理论」，企业即使面对弱环境绩效，也偏好披露而非不披露。这一权衡因选择企业的特征而异。
AI.research_question: 企业在选择供应链合作伙伴时，如何在合作伙伴的财务绩效与非财务（环境）信息之间进行权衡？这种权衡如何因企业特征（如可持续战略承诺、供应链位置、监管环境与利益相关者压力）而异？
AI.motivation: 企业越来越多地将非财务信息纳入供应链伙伴选择，但关于它们如何将非财务信息与财务绩效进行权衡的认知十分有限。理解这一权衡机制对供应链管理和可持续性研究具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 揭开披露理论（Unraveling Disclosure Theory）；可持续供应链管理理论
AI.method: 离散选择实验（Discrete Choice Experiment），样本为3,172名德国企业代表
AI.findings: （1）企业重视合作伙伴财务绩效的程度约为环境绩效的近五倍；（2）即使披露的环境绩效较弱，企业仍偏好披露而非不披露（符合揭开披露理论）；（3）在有意承诺可持续战略的企业和下游企业中，合作伙伴的强环境绩效可部分抵消弱财务绩效；（4）只有在监管环境更严格且存在利益相关者压力的情况下，准备进行可持续性报告的企业才会表现出更强的环境偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过实验方法量化企业对供应链伙伴财务与环境绩效的权衡程度；为揭开披露理论在供应链选择情境中的适用性提供了实证支持；揭示了报告监管与市场力量在推动可持续性改善中的协同作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于可持续性报告监管有效性的证据——仅靠监管不足以改变企业环境偏好，须与市场力量相结合；为企业管理者选择供应链合作伙伴及制定可持续采购策略提供参考依据。

detail.abstract: Canada’s continuing shortage of facility-based long-term care has shifted needs toward care delivered at home. This article assesses the full-time attendant at home tax credit and the home accessibility tax credit and finds that current design features—namely, non-refundability and the home ownership requirement—systematically underserve low-income seniors and their informal caregivers. The author recommends making the credits refundable for low-income seniors and caregivers, extending eligibility to senior renters, and introducing landlord incentives for accessibility retrofits.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了加拿大的两项家庭照护税收抵免政策（全职居家照护者税收抵免和居家无障碍改造税收抵免），发现其设计特征——不可退还性和房屋所有权要求——系统性地未能充分服务于低收入老年人及其非正式照护者。作者建议使这些税收抵免对低收入老年人及照护者可退还，将资格扩展到老年租房者，并为房东引入无障碍改造激励措施。
AI.research_question: 加拿大现行的家庭照护税收抵免政策（全职居家照护者税收抵免和居家无障碍改造税收抵免）是否以及如何未能充分服务于低收入老年人及其非正式照护者？
AI.motivation: 加拿大设施型长期照护持续短缺，照护需求正在向居家照护转移，因此需要评估现有支持居家照护的政策工具是否公平有效地覆盖了最需要帮助的低收入群体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收政策设计与公平性理论，涉及税收抵免的不可退还性对低收入群体的排除效应，以及住房产权要求对租房者的制度性歧视。
AI.method: 政策分析与评估方法，对两项税收抵免的政策设计特征进行系统性审查与评估。
AI.findings: 两项税收抵免的现行设计——不可退还性和房屋所有权要求——系统性地未能充分服务于低收入老年人及其非正式照护者。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了税收抵免政策设计中不可退还性与住房所有权要求对低收入群体的系统性排除机制，为税收政策公平性理论提供了具体政策案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项具体政策建议：将税收抵免改为低收入老年人及照护者可退还；将资格扩展到老年租房者；为房东引入无障碍改造激励措施。

detail.abstract: Canada’s publicly funded health-care system faces growing fiscal pressures, which are prompting governments to explore tax-based instruments to encourage healthier behaviour. This article evaluates a provincial tax credit introduced in Newfoundland and Labrador to promote participation in physical activity as a Pigouvian-style subsidy intended to support public health objectives. Using regression analysis based on a difference-in-differences design, the study analyzes Canadian provincial panel data to estimate the effect of the credit on fitness-related industry activity following its introduction. The results show no statistically significant effect of the tax credit on industry outcomes, suggesting that the policy did not materially alter behaviour relative to trends in other provinces. These findings are consistent with earlier evidence on other health-related fitness tax credits and highlight ongoing challenges in using provincial tax measures to influence behaviour. The article concludes by discussing alternative policy frameworks for promoting health-related behavioural change within provincial public policy.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了加拿大纽芬兰与拉布拉多省推出的健身税收抵免政策（作为庇古式补贴）对健身相关行业活动的影响。基于双重差分设计的回归分析显示，该税收抵免对行业产出没有统计学上的显著影响，说明该政策未能实质性改变民众行为，与以往其他健康相关健身税收抵免的研究证据一致。
AI.research_question: 省级健身税收抵免政策是否有效地促进了参与体育活动的行为，从而改善公共健康目标？
AI.motivation: 加拿大公共资助的医疗体系面临日益增长的财政压力，政府正在探索以税收为基础的工具来鼓励更健康的行为。评估现有政策工具的有效性对于决策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 庇古式补贴（Pigouvian-style subsidy）理论，即通过税收激励手段纠正健康行为的正外部性，以支持公共健康目标。
AI.method: 基于双重差分（difference-in-differences）设计的回归分析，使用加拿大省级面板数据，估计税收抵免引入后对健身相关行业活动的影响。
AI.findings: 税收抵免对行业产出没有统计学上的显著影响，表明该政策并未实质性改变行为（相对于其他省份的趋势而言）。这些结果与以往关于其他健康相关健身税收抵免的证据一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过严格的准实验方法（DID）检验了庇古式税收补贴在健康行为激励领域的有效性，为行为经济学与公共财政理论的交叉领域提供了经验证据，表明税收激励工具在改变健康行为方面的效力有限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大省级政策制定者提供了关于税收抵免作为健康行为干预工具有效性的实证依据，并讨论了促进健康行为改变的替代性政策框架，帮助决策者调整政策方向。

title: The Kakeya Conjecture, Dimensional Rigidity, and Quantum Spacetime Constraints: A Multidisciplinary Framework for Multidimensional Analysis of Discrete Financial Markets
affiliations: Huaqiao University and

detail.title: The Kakeya Conjecture, Dimensional Rigidity, and Quantum Spacetime Constraints: A Multidisciplinary Framework for Multidimensional Analysis of Discrete Financial Markets
detail.abstract: Traditional financial analysis has long relied on dimensionality-reduction modeling, achieving model tractability by simplifying variables, compressing dimensions, and eliminating microscopic noise. However, this analytical framework breaks down systematically amid extreme market shocks, quantitative model malfunctions, and trend inflection points. This paper establishes its mathematical foundation on the dimensional rigidity principles of the Kakeya conjecture, incorporates the latest rigidity theorems for three-dimensional Kakeya sets, and introduces the physical constraints of Planck-scale quantum spacetime to construct a three-tier cross-disciplinary analytical framework: "mathematical tool modeling-physical rule safeguarding-financial market implementation." The core extended conclusion of this paper is: mathematics serves only as a descriptive tool for reality, while physics encapsulates the fundamental laws governing real-world systems. Purely mathematical continuum idealizations can construct minimalist models but cannot replicate the multidimensional rigidity constraints of real discrete systems. Only by superimposing the hierarchical, discrete, and fluctuational nature of quantum spacetime can one explain the fundamental reasons why dimensionality-reduction analysis in financial markets inevitably fails. On this basis, this paper maps the stock market onto a three-dimensional rigid Kakeya system, derives the structural deficiencies of traditional onedimensional and two-dimensional financial analyses, and establishes a multidimensional assessment framework and quantitative risk control logic suited to discrete financial spacetime, providing a novel foundational paradigm for quantitative trading, trend identification, and systemic risk early warning.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Kakeya猜想的三维刚性定理和普朗克尺度量子时空的物理约束，构建"数学工具建模-物理规则护航-金融市场落地"的三层跨学科分析框架，论证传统降维金融分析在极端市场冲击、量化失灵和趋势拐点必然失效的根本原因，并提出多维评估与量化风控的新范式。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统降维金融分析在极端市场条件下必然失效？如何构建适用于离散金融时空的多维分析框架？
AI.motivation: 传统金融分析依赖降维建模，在正常市场条件下可行，但在极端市场冲击、量化模型失灵和趋势拐点处系统性崩溃，需要从更根本的数学与物理层面解释其失效机理并构建替代框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kakeya猜想及其三维刚性定理（维度刚性原理）、普朗克尺度量子时空的层级性/离散性/涨落性、降维分析的数学基础。
AI.method: 跨学科理论构建方法：以Kakeya猜想刚性原理为数学底座，叠加量子时空物理约束，将股票市场映射为三维刚性Kakeya系统，推导一维、二维分析的缺陷并建立多维评估框架。
AI.findings: 数学仅是现实描述工具，物理学才封装现实系统的基本规律；纯数学连续统理想化无法复现真实离散系统的多维刚性约束；叠加量子时空的层级性、离散性与涨落性才能解释降维分析必然失败的根源；降维金融分析存在结构性缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Kakeya猜想刚性定理引入金融分析，建立数学-物理-金融三层跨学科分析框架；提出"数学描述现实、物理封装规律"的本体论观点；为金融分析失效提供量子时空物理层面的深层解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 建立适合离散金融时空的多维评估框架和量化风险控制逻辑，为量化交易、趋势识别和系统性风险预警提供新的基础范式。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, and Open Models: Who Will Capture AI's Economic Gains?
affiliations: Lantyer Educacional

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, and Open Models: Who Will Capture AI's Economic Gains?
detail.abstract: Public debate about artificial intelligence often rests on two claims that sit uneasily together: AI is expected to deliver unprecedented abundance, yet any displacement of human labor is treated as evidence of technological failure. This article examines that tension through a critical, interdisciplinary narrative review of economic, historical, sociological, technological, and legal scholarship, together with official productivity series, workplace studies, labor-market evidence, competition-authority reports, and regulatory materials. Its argument is twofold. First, material abundance requires sustained productivity growth. Some task substitution and occupational displacement are therefore likely, but permanent net unemployment does not follow as a matter of economic logic. Productivity can also rise through complementarity, error reduction, organizational learning, demand expansion, and the creation of previously infeasible goods and services. Second, the central distributive risk may not be an AI system that automates too much, but one that produces modest aggregate gains while entrenching control over the bottlenecks through which those gains must pass: advanced chips, cloud infrastructure, models, data, and distribution channels. Open ecosystems can reduce entry costs, switching costs, and technological dependence, but open weights are not necessarily open source, and openness at the model layer does not dissolve concentration elsewhere in the stack. The socially preferable outcome therefore combines genuine productivity growth with diffusion, interoperability, competitive market structure, worker voice, public capacity, and institutions capable of broadening access to the resulting surplus. Open models are an important part of that architecture, but they are not a substitute for it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过跨学科叙事性综述，批判性地审视AI关于"丰裕"与"劳动力替代"之间的张力，提出两个核心论点：一是物质丰裕需要持续的生产率增长，任务替代和职业位移不可避免但不会导致永久性净失业；二是AI的核心分配风险不是过度自动化，而是少数主体通过控制芯片、云基础设施、模型、数据和分发渠道等瓶颈节点攫取大部分收益。文章主张将生产率增长与扩散、互操作性、竞争性市场结构、工人话语权、公共能力及制度保障相结合，开放模型是重要组成部分但并非替代方案。
AI.research_question: AI社会影响的核心张力——即AI承诺前所未有的物质丰裕，但劳动力被替代又被视为技术失败的证据——如何从多学科视角进行调和？AI的真正分配风险是什么，以及开放模型在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 公众关于AI的辩论中同时存在两种矛盾的叙述：一方面期待AI带来前所未有的丰裕，另一方面将任何劳动力替代视为技术失败。这种紧张关系缺乏系统性的跨学科审视。此外，政策讨论过度聚焦于"AI自动化是否过多"的问题，而忽视了更核心的分配瓶颈问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合经济学（生产率增长理论、就业经济学）、历史学（历次技术革命的经验）、社会学（劳动与权力分配）、技术研究（AI堆栈架构与开放性）以及法学（竞争法与监管）等多学科视角的分析框架。
AI.method: 批判性、跨学科的叙事性综述（narrative review），综合了经济、历史、社会、技术和法律学术文献，以及官方生产率序列、工作场所研究、劳动力市场证据、竞争主管机构报告和监管材料。
AI.findings: 第一，永久性净失业并不符合经济逻辑——生产率增长可通过互补性、减少错误、组织学习、需求扩张和创造此前不可行的商品和服务来实现。第二，AI核心分配风险在于少数主体通过控制芯片、云基础设施、模型、数据和分发渠道等瓶颈来攫取收益；开放权重不等于开源，模型层的开放并不能消除堆栈其他层面的集中。社会最优结果是生产率增长与扩散、互操作性、竞争性市场结构、工人话语权、公共能力和制度保障的结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"AI过度自动化"作为核心风险的流行叙事，将分析焦点从"自动化水平"转向"收益分配结构"。澄清了开放模型（open weights）与开放源码（open source）的区别，并揭示模型层开放无法解决整个AI堆栈中的集中问题。提出了将生产率增长与分配正义相结合的综合理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了超越"开放vs封闭"二元争论的指导：强调需要同时关注竞争政策、劳动力制度、公共能力建设和监管框架等多层面的综合策略。提醒关注AI产业链中的瓶颈控制问题（芯片、云、数据、分发渠道），而不仅仅关注模型层面的开放性。

title: Anomaly Exposure and Market Quality
affiliations: University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business and University of Utah - David Eccles School of Business

detail.title: Anomaly Exposure and Market Quality
detail.abstract: Using 153 anomalies from Jensen et al. (2023), we examine how exposure to anomalies affects market quality. We find that stocks with greater anomaly exposure exhibit wider quoted, effective, and realized spreads, higher volatility, and greater adverse selection. The effects are economically large: a one-standard-deviation increase in anomaly exposure is associated with approximately 13-14% wider quoted spreads and 26-27% higher intraday volatility. These effects are amplified when exposure to long and short positions is more balanced, consistent with greater ambiguity of information and higher information asymmetry. Our identification strategy exploits plausibly exogenous variation in anomaly exposure arising from anomaly publication and from stocks crossing extreme anomaly-decile boundaries. We show that both settings generate significant deteriorations in market quality despite little change in anomaly stocks' underlying fundamentals. These results suggest that the rapid growth of anomaly-based trading has important consequences for markets, as stocks heavily targeted by anomaly investors experience systematically worse liquidity, greater adverse selection, and substantially higher intraday volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Jensen等人（2023）的153个异象，研究发现股票对异象的暴露度越高，其买卖价差越宽、波动率越高、逆向选择越严重。通过两种拟自然实验识别策略（异象发表和股票跨越异象十分位边界），证实异象暴露导致市场质量恶化，且与基本面变化无关。
AI.research_question: 股票对异象的暴露程度如何影响市场质量（如买卖价差、波动率、逆向选择等）？
AI.motivation: 异象交易（基于异象的策略）近年来快速增长，但现有研究主要关注异象的收益预测能力，缺乏对异象暴露如何影响市场质量的系统研究。理解这一影响对于监管者和市场参与者至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、信息不对称理论、逆向选择理论
AI.method: 使用Jensen等人（2023）的153个异象构建股票异象暴露度量；采用面板回归检验异象暴露与市场质量指标的关系；利用异象发表外生事件和股票跨越异象十分位边界作为拟自然实验进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）异象暴露度更高的股票具有更宽的报价、有效和已实现价差，更高的波动率和更大的逆向选择；（2）效应在经济上显著：异象暴露每增加一个标准差，报价价差扩大约13-14%，日内波动率提高26-27%；（3）当多空头寸暴露更平衡时效应放大，与信息模糊性和信息不对称加大一致；（4）在两种拟自然实验设定下，异象暴露导致市场质量显著恶化，但异象股票的基本面几乎没有变化。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统性地将异象暴露与市场质量联系起来，拓展了市场微观结构与资产定价交叉领域的研究；（2）通过外生识别策略提供了异象交易影响市场质量的因果证据，深化了对信息不对称和逆向选择形成机制的理解；（3）揭示了多空平衡暴露加剧信息模糊性的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者理解异象交易增长的市场影响提供实证依据；（2）提示市场参与者关注被异象投资者大量瞄准的股票的流动性风险和交易成本；（3）对市场设计和高频交易监管具有参考价值。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 26-14
title: How did Trump's 2025 Trade War Affect the Decoupling of US-China Supply Chains?
affiliations: Peterson Institute for International Economics

detail.title: How did Trump's 2025 Trade War Affect the Decoupling of US-China Supply Chains?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 26-14
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Are foreign supply chains that service the US market still decoupling from China? If so, where are the new chains forming, how quickly is the process happening, and why is it unfolding the way it is? This paper provides an initial empirical assessment of the changing nature of product-level sourcing of US imports in the wake of the tariffs President Donald J. Trump imposed in 2018–19 and 2025. It establishes numerous stylized facts. For example, US imports of many consumer electronics—including smartphones, laptops, monitors, and video game consoles—did not decline sharply in 2025 despite US tariffs hitting Chinese production for the first time. Multinational firms had established alternative supply chains in India and Vietnam which they quickly sourced from instead. In contrast, US importers of clothing and footwear did not reorient their supply chains, in part perhaps because the resulting difference between US tariff increases on China and on third countries for those products was too small to motivate them to do so. Finally, much of the longer-term shift of US import sourcing toward Taiwan and Mexico reflected the increasing economic importance of imported inputs for the data center buildout for artificial intelligence, and not strictly decoupling supply chains with China.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2018-19及2025年特朗普关税政策，实证评估了美国进口产品层面采购来源的变化。研究发现：消费电子行业（智能手机、笔记本电脑等）已快速转向印度和越南等替代供应链；服装鞋类行业因关税差异不足未调整供应链；而美国对台湾和墨西哥采购份额的长期上升主要源于人工智能数据中心建设的投入品需求增长，而非单纯的对华脱钩。
AI.research_question: 服务美国市场的外国供应链是否仍在与中国脱钩？新的供应链在哪里形成、速度快慢如何、以及为何如此演变？
AI.motivation: 在2018-19年和2025年特朗普两轮关税政策冲击下，需要实证评估美国进口在产品层面的采购来源变化，以理解中美供应链脱钩的真实程度与路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易中的供应链重构理论、关税转嫁与采购转移理论
AI.method: 基于美国进口产品层面的实证数据分析，通过多个典型化事实（stylized facts）进行描述性统计与比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）消费电子产品（智能手机、笔记本电脑、显示器、游戏机）未因2025年关税大幅下降，跨国公司已快速转向印度和越南的替代供应链；（2）服装鞋类进口商未调整供应链，原因是美国对中国与第三方国家关税差过小，不足以激励转移；（3）美国对台湾和墨西哥采购份额的长期上升主要反映人工智能数据中心建设对进口投入品的需求增长，而非严格意义上的对华脱钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"脱钩"与"供应链多元化"的不同驱动因素，揭示了AI产业需求对美国进口来源变化的独立影响，丰富了关税冲击下供应链重构的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解关税政策的实际效果提供实证依据，帮助企业识别可快速调整与难以调整的供应链环节，并对AI产业引发的贸易格局变化提供参考。

title: Prototype Implementation and Experimental Validation of an Electric Suzuki Super Carry Conversion for Rural Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: Stellenbosch University, Students, Stellenbosch University, Students and Stellenbosch University - Faculty of Engineering

detail.title: Prototype Implementation and Experimental Validation of an Electric Suzuki Super Carry Conversion for Rural Sub-Saharan Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None to declare
declarations.funderStatement: Western Cape GMT contributed to the research. HYDAC and Balancell funded equipment.

detail.abstract: This paper presents the prototype implementation and experimental evaluation of an electric Suzuki Super Carry conversion developed for light-duty rural mobility in Sub-Saharan Africa. The donor vehicle was converted from internal combustion to battery-electric propulsion using a central-motor rear-wheel-drive layout, three series-connected lithium iron phosphate battery packs, a high-voltage power distribution unit, and a low-voltage control architecture based on a vehicle control unit communicating over CAN. Custom mechanical and electrical integration was required to package the traction system within the existing chassis, while battery dimensions necessitated load-bed mounting. The completed vehicle achieved a kerb mass of 1270 kg, increasing vehicle mass by 420 kg and reducing payload capacity from 750 kg to 330 kg. Experimental vehicle data were used to calibrate drivetrain losses and road-load parameters before validating the model against measured highway, urban, and dirt-road drive cycles. The drivetrain-loss model achieved an 𝑅 2 of 0.978, while paved-road calibration yielded 𝐶 𝑑 = 0.548 and 𝐶 𝑟𝑟 = 0.0204. Across the three validation cycles, speed tracking exceeded 𝑅 2 = 0.997, and cumulative energy-efficiency errors were 0.12%, 9.77%, and 0.47% for the highway, urban, and dirt-road cycles, respectively. The strongest agreement was obtained for the highway and dirt-road cases, while the urban cycle showed lower accuracy because of low-speed sensitivity and repeated transients. The results demonstrate that the conversion is technically feasible and that the realised vehicle behaviour can be reproduced with good accuracy under both paved and unpaved operating conditions. At the same time, the study highlights the practical trade-offs of retrofit electrification for rural SSA, particularly battery-packaging constraints and reduced payload, and provides an experimentally grounded benchmark for future light-duty EV conversions.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一辆电动铃木Super Carry原型车的开发与实验评估，该车是为撒哈拉以南非洲农村轻型运输而改装的。车辆从内燃机改装为电池电动驱动，采用中央电机后轮驱动布局、三组串联磷酸铁锂电池、高压配电单元和基于CAN总线的低压控制系统。改装后整车质量1270kg，较原车增加420kg，有效载荷从750kg降至330kg。通过实验数据校准传动系统损耗和道路负载参数，模型在公路、城市和土路驾驶循环中速度跟踪R²均超过0.997，能量效率误差分别为0.12%、9.77%和0.47%，证明了改装技术可行且模型精度良好。
AI.research_question: 将燃油铃木Super Carry改装为电动驱动在技术上是否可行？改装后的车辆能否被精确建模？改装对农村交通的实际影响和权衡是什么？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区缺乏适合轻型运输的电动车辆，现有电动车方案往往不适合当地路况和载货需求。通过改装现有轻型商用车（而非全新设计），可降低电气化成本并利用现有车辆存量，为农村地区提供可行的电动交通方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 车辆动力学模型、传动系统损耗模型、道路负载参数（空气阻力系数Cd和滚动阻力系数Crr）校准方法。
AI.method: 原型改装实验：将内燃机铃木Super Carry改装为电动驱动（中央电机后驱+三组磷酸铁锂电池），通过实验数据校准传动系统损耗和道路负载参数，再分别在城市、公路和土路三种驾驶循环中验证模型的预测精度（R²和能量效率误差）。
AI.findings: 改装车辆整车质量1270kg，载荷从750kg降至330kg。传动损耗模型R²=0.978；路面校准确认Cd=0.548、Crr=0.0204。三种验证循环中速度跟踪R²均超过0.997，累积能量效率误差分别为公路0.12%、城市9.77%、土路0.47%。公路和土路工况吻合度最佳，城市工况因低速灵敏性和频繁瞬态精度较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个基于实验数据的轻型商用车电动改装基准模型，验证了传动系统损耗建模和道路负载校准方法在电动改装车辆上的适用性，并揭示了城市驾驶循环中低速瞬态对能量效率预测的挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了在撒哈拉以南非洲农村背景下轻型商用车电动改装的技术可行性（含土路工况验证），明确了改装的核心权衡——电池安装占用了载货空间并显著降低有效载荷（750kg→330kg），为未来轻型电动改装车提供了实验验证的设计参考基准。

title: Adapting in the Shadows: The Dual Nature of Post-Disaster Informal Economies and Implications for Climate Resilience in the Global South and China

detail.title: Adapting in the Shadows: The Dual Nature of Post-Disaster Informal Economies and Implications for Climate Resilience in the Global South and China
detail.abstract:
Background: Climate change is intensifying extreme weather events globally. Over 2015 - 2025, climate - related disasters affected millions, with 2024 alone documenting over 80 million affected and economic losses exceeding USD 100billion. International adaptation finance covers only 8%of developing country needs. When formal relief fails, affected communities spontaneously develop informal economic responses - conceptualized here as the Shadow Adaptation Economy (SAE).

Objective: This study argues that SAE exhibits a fundamental duality, serving positive survival functions while generating negative environmental consequences, tested across five global south disasters with China as a high - capacity control.

Methods: A qualitative multi - case analysis examines Pakistan floods (2022), Cyclone Idai in Mozambique (2019), Horn of Africa drought (2020 - 2024), Cyclone Amphan in Bangladesh (2020), Typhoon Haiyan in the Philippines (2013) and China’s Henan floods (2020). Data derives from PDNAs, humanitarian reports and ILO, UNEP, EY, EM-DAT and World Bank sources (2024-2025). A Shadow adaptation Intensity Index (SAII) is constructed using five components scored via systematic rubic. Analytical frameworks are conceptual not econometric.

 

Findings: Across cases, SAE performs five positive functions: emergency services, rapid livelihood, decentralized distribution, community resilience and environmental services. Negative consequences include environmental degradation (5/6 cases), universal tax revenue loss and regulatory vacuums SAE activities persist beyond recovery due to lock -in -mechanisms. SAII reveals high intensity in low - capacity contexts (Horn of Africa: 9.0; Mozambique: 7.4; Pakistan: 7.4) and moderate in China (4.2). exploratory correlation (r=0.81, n=6) supports theoretical expectations. China functions as structural substitute in weak states, adaptive complement in high - capacity settings.

Conclusion: SAE represents an expanding structural survival response. A Recognize- Regulate - Formalize framework with context - dependent pathways is proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"影子适应经济"(SAE)概念，指代正式救济失败后社区自发形成的非正式经济应对机制。通过对六个全球南方灾害案例（巴基斯坦、莫桑比克、非洲之角、孟加拉国、菲律宾及中国河南对照组）的质性多案例分析，揭示SAE具有双重性——既发挥五项积极生存功能，又产生环境退化、税收流失和监管真空等负面后果。研究构建了"影子适应强度指数"(SAII)，并基于"识别-规范-正规化"框架提出情境依赖的政策路径。
AI.research_question: 当正式气候适应援助失效时，受灾社区自发形成的非正式经济应对机制（影子适应经济）如何运作？其积极功能与负面后果的双重性如何体现？在不同国家治理能力情境下有何差异？
AI.motivation: 气候灾害日益加剧（2024年超8000万人受灾，损失超1000亿美元），但国际适应融资仅覆盖发展中国家需求的8%。正式救济体系存在系统性失灵，而社区自发的非正式经济应对机制（SAE）被学术界和政策界严重忽视，亟需系统化的理论构建与实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 影子适应经济（SAE）概念框架；适应性治理理论；非正式经济理论；锁入效应（lock-in mechanisms）理论；国家能力与国家-社会关系理论
AI.method: 质性多案例分析方法。六个案例：巴基斯坦洪水(2022)、莫桑比克气旋伊代(2019)、非洲之角干旱(2020-2024)、孟加拉国气旋安攀(2020)、菲律宾海燕台风(2013)及中国河南洪水(2020)作为高能力控制组。数据来源于PDNA、人道主义报告及ILO/UNEP/EY/EM-DAT/世界银行等机构（2024-2025）。构建五组分影子适应强度指数(SAII)并通过系统化评分标准打分，采用解释性相关性分析（非计量经济模型）。
AI.findings: SAE在六个案例中均表现出五项积极功能（应急服务、快速生计恢复、去中心化分配、社区韧性、环境服务）和负面后果（5/6案例存在环境退化、普遍的税收流失和监管真空）。SAII得分显示低能力情境下强度高（非洲之角9.0、莫桑比克7.4、巴基斯坦7.4），高能力情境下中等（中国4.2）。探索性相关分析(r=0.81, n=6)支持理论预期。中国在高能力情境下作为适应性补充，在弱国家中作为结构性替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统化提出"影子适应经济"(SAE)概念，为气候适应研究提供新的分析框架；揭示灾难应对中非正式经济活动的结构性双重性；构建"影子适应强度指数"(SAII)作为可操作的测量工具；提出"识别-规范-正规化"三阶段政策框架；深化了国家能力与制度替代关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供SAE情境依赖的治理路径建议；通过SAII指数为国际组织和各国政府提供评估灾害应对中非正式经济的量化工具；有助于国际适应融资的重新分配与监管设计；为发展中国家在正式救济失灵时提供社区韧性建设的实操指导。

title: Lifting the Export Fog: A Conceptual Framework for Expanding MSME Export Participation in Indonesia

detail.title: Lifting the Export Fog: A Conceptual Framework for Expanding MSME Export Participation in Indonesia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants or animal subjects. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Many firms with the potential to export never do. Existing explanations of export underparticipation have 
developed in separate literatures on information frictions, search costs, fixed entry costs, and compliance 
burdens, but none fully accounts for firms that abandon entry before the actual barrier is tested. This paper 
introduces the concept of Export Fog, integrating information costs, perception distortion, and coordination 
failure into a unified framework and positioning it against adjacent constructs. Two supporting constructs, 
Geographic Cost and Trader as Institution, extend it to spatial incidence and intermediation. The paper is 
conceptual and illustrated with evidence from Indonesia, where micro, small, and medium enterprises generate 
about 61 percent of gross domestic product and 97 percent of employment yet account for only some 15.7 
percent of exports, a share that has moved little despite sustained public support. Comparative reflection on 
Japanese and Korean catch-up suggests that several institutions of that period functioned as fog-lifting 
mechanisms. The framework organises facilitation instruments, including public trade intelligence derived from 
aggregated customs data and graduated accreditation for entrant firms, as complementary responses to distinct 
dimensions of a single constraint. For customs administrations the distinction is practical: facilitation ordinarily 
serves firms that have already approached the border, whereas the population identified here requires pre-entry 
instruments. The paper concludes by proposing the Export Fog Index, composed of observable indicators 
capturing divergence between perceived and actual entry requirements, costs, and time, rendering the 
framework measurable and open to empirical falsification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"出口迷雾"（Export Fog）概念，将信息摩擦、感知扭曲与协调失败整合为一个统一框架，解释为何许多本可出口的企业在真正测试壁垒之前就放弃进入。该概念性论文以印尼微型、小型和中型企业出口参与度极低（仅占出口15.7%）的现象为证据，并对比日韩追赶时期的制度作为"除雾机制"，最后提出可测量的"出口迷雾指数"以供实证检验。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多具有出口潜力的企业从未尝试出口，且在真正遇到实际壁垒前就放弃进入？现有文献分散于信息摩擦、搜寻成本、固定进入成本和合规负担等不同领域，均无法完整解释这一现象，本文试图构建一个统一的理论框架。
AI.motivation: 现有关于出口参与不足的解释分散在不同文献传统中（信息摩擦、搜寻成本、固定进入成本、合规负担），但没有一个框架能完整解释企业在未测试实际壁垒前就放弃进入的现象。这一理论空白需要一个新的统一概念来填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出"出口迷雾"（Export Fog）概念，统一了信息成本、感知扭曲与协调失败三个维度；并发展出两个支撑性构念："地理成本"（Geographic Cost）和"作为制度的贸易商"（Trader as Institution），分别延伸至空间分布与中介机制。
AI.method: 概念性论文（Conceptual paper），以印尼的微中小型企业数据为经验例证（占GDP约61%、就业97%，但出口仅占15.7%且多年几乎未变），并通过与日韩追赶时期制度的比较反思来支持理论框架。
AI.findings: 出口迷雾框架能系统组织各类促进工具：基于海关汇总数据生成的公共贸易情报（应对信息成本）和针对新进入企业的分级认证（应对感知与协调障碍），是针对单一约束不同维度的互补性回应。对海关管理而言，常规便利化服务的是已接近边境的企业，而本文识别的人群需要"进入前"（pre-entry）工具。最后提出"出口迷雾指数"以实现可测性与经验证伪。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"出口迷雾"这一统一概念框架，整合了分散在四个独立文献传统中的解释变量（信息摩擦、搜寻成本、固定进入成本和合规负担）；发展了两个新构念（地理成本、作为制度的贸易商）以扩展框架的适用范围；提出了可操作化的出口迷雾指数，使概念框架可直接接受实证检验和证伪。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和海关管理机构提供了明确的操作性区分：常规贸易便利化服务的是已接近边境的企业，而真正需要关注的"迷雾"人群需要进入前干预工具；具体建议包括利用聚合海关数据生成公共贸易情报，以及为进入企业设计分级认证制度；日韩追赶时期的制度经验可作为"除雾机制"的政策借鉴。

title: The Future of Pension Systems in Greece: Key Findings and Policy Implications

detail.title: The Future of Pension Systems in Greece: Key Findings and Policy Implications

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was obtained as part of the doctoral research process at VERN University Zagreb / IBAS; participation was voluntary and informed consent was obtained from all survey respondents.

detail.abstract: Greece's pension system faces a structural mismatch between a rapidly ageing population and a system still financed predominantly on a pay-as-you-go basis. This independent working paper draws on the author's doctoral research-a mixed-methods stakeholder study (N = 68 Greek pension policymakers, insurance professionals, and public administrators)-and develops its findings, together with a comparative reading of pension reform in Italy, Portugal, and Germany, into a single, decision-relevant question: under what conditions could private insurers credibly take on a larger role in closing Greece's supplementary pension gap? The evidence points to a qualified answer. Stakeholders do not reject a larger role for private insurers in principle, but their support is conditional on product simplicity, transparency, and consumer protection-and, more fundamentally, on a form of institutional trust that the present system has not yet earned and that this study could not fully measure. The comparative cases show that institutional depth, not private-sector enthusiasm alone, determines whether supplementary pillars actually close adequacy gaps. The paper closes with policy implications organised around three levers available to Greek and European decision-makers: product design, institutional trust-building, and phased implementation drawing on comparator experience.

AI.tldr: 本工作论文基于作者博士研究中的混合方法利益相关者研究（N=68名希腊养老金政策制定者、保险专业人士和公共管理者），并结合意大利、葡萄牙和德国的养老金改革比较分析，探讨私营保险公司在何种条件下能够可信地承担更大角色以填补希腊补充养老金缺口。研究发现，利益相关者原则上不排斥私营保险公司发挥更大作用，但其支持是有条件的，取决于产品简单性、透明度和消费者保护，以及制度信任的建立。比较案例表明，制度深度而非私营部门热情本身决定补充支柱能否真正弥补充足性缺口。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，私营保险公司能够可信地承担更大角色以填补希腊补充养老金缺口？
AI.motivation: 希腊养老金体系面临人口快速老龄化与现收现付制融资模式之间的结构性错配，亟需探索补充养老金支柱的改革路径，但私营保险机构能否及如何发挥更大作用尚缺乏系统证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合方法研究结合制度信任理论、养老金支柱改革理论以及跨国比较制度分析框架。
AI.method: 混合方法：包含68名希腊养老金相关利益相关者的定性访谈/调研，并结合意大利、葡萄牙和德国的养老金改革比较案例研究。
AI.findings: 利益相关者原则上接受私营保险公司发挥更大作用，但支持是有条件的，取决于产品简单性、透明度和消费者保护，以及目前系统尚未建立的制度信任。比较案例表明制度深度比私营部门热情更能决定补充支柱能否弥补充足性缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了私营部门参与补充养老金的条件性边界，阐明了制度信任作为私营养老金角色扩大的先决条件这一理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为希腊和欧洲决策者提供三个政策杠杆：产品设计、制度信任建设，以及借鉴比较经验的渐进式实施路径。
