title: Beyond Six Versus Twelve: Kian v. Florida and the Design of the Criminal Jury
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Law School

detail.title: Beyond Six Versus Twelve: Kian v. Florida and the Design of the Criminal Jury

publicationDetails.detailsText: Minnesota Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Minnesota Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Kian v. Florida asks whether the Sixth and Fourteenth Amendments require twelve-person juries in serious criminal cases. The case has revived a debate that began with Williams v. Florida, where the Supreme Court concluded that reducing jury size from twelve to six would not materially impair the jury's functions. Critics of Williams contend that subsequent social science disproved that premise, while defenders point to competing evidence concerning the performance of smaller juries. This Article argues that the debate rests on an incomplete premise. The effect of jury size on the performance of criminal adjudication hinges upon other features of the jury system. Its consequences depend on the voting rule, the standard of proof, probability of retrials after a hung jury, prosecutorial selection and other factors determining which cases reach juries in the first place. A larger jury may improve representation and deliberation while also affecting decisiveness and the distribution of adjudicatory outcomes. These interactions matter in assessing jury size. Social science cannot substitute for constitutional interpretation, but institutional consequences may inform that inquiry without themselves becoming the source of constitutional meaning. Where such consequences are relevant, courts should evaluate the jury as an integrated adjudicatory system rather than treat jury size as an isolated design variable.

AI.tldr: 本文以Kian v. Florida案为背景，重新审视围绕Williams v. Florida案引发的关于陪审团规模的辩论，指出此前关于陪审团规模（十二人 vs 六人）的争论建立在一个不完整的前提之上——陪审团规模对刑事裁判表现的影响取决于投票规则、证明标准、悬而未决陪审团后的重审概率、检察官筛选等其他制度特征。文章主张法院应将陪审团视为一个整体的裁判系统来评估，而非将规模视为孤立的制度变量。社会科学虽不能替代宪法解释，但制度后果可以为宪法探究提供参考。
AI.research_question: 陪审团规模（十二人 vs 六人）对严重刑事案件裁判表现的影响，是否以及如何取决于陪审团系统的其他制度特征？法院应如何评估陪审团规模的宪法意义？
AI.motivation: Kian v. Florida案复活了Williams v. Florida案以来关于陪审团规模的争论。批评者认为后续社会科学研究推翻了Williams案中"缩小陪审团规模不会实质损害陪审团功能"的前提，而辩护者则援引相反证据。作者认为这场争论建立在不完整的前提之上，因为陪审团规模的效果并非孤立存在，而是与陪审团系统其他特征相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度系统论视角——将陪审团视为一个整体裁判系统，陪审团规模是其中的一个设计变量，其效果受投票规则、证明标准、重审概率、检察官案件筛选等因素的调节。同时涉及宪法解释与社会科学证据关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合制度层面的理论推理与交叉学科（法律与社会科学交叉）论证。
AI.findings: 陪审团规模的效果不能孤立评估：更大的陪审团可能在改善代表性和审议质量的同时，影响裁判的决定性和裁判结果的分布。这些交互作用在评估陪审团规模时至关重要。法院应将陪审团视为一个整体裁判系统来评估，而非将规模作为隔离的设计变量处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了以往关于陪审团规模之争的简化前提，提出了陪审团作为整合裁判系统的分析框架，并厘清了社会科学证据在宪法解释中的角色定位——社会科学可以告知宪法探究，但不能替代宪法解释本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院在类似Kian v. Florida等案件中评估陪审团规模问题提供了方法论指引，提示法院在评估陪审团制度后果时应超越单一的规模维度，综合考虑与规模交互作用的各类制度特征。

title: Receivables Timing, Liquidity Buffers, and Short-Term Debt in Manufacturing Firms: Firm-Quarter Evidence and Counterfactual Implications for Programmable Digital Settlement

detail.title: Receivables Timing, Liquidity Buffers, and Short-Term Debt in Manufacturing Firms: Firm-Quarter Evidence and Counterfactual Implications for Programmable Digital Settlement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available corporate financial statement data from OpenDART and does not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or experimental interventions. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: This study examines how working-capital timing is associated with subsequent liquidity buffers and short-term debt reliance among Korean listed manufacturing firms and estimates the mechanical liquidity capacity of modestly faster programmable settlement. The analysis uses a validated quarterly OpenDART panel covering 2019Q1-2025Q4. The primary short-term-debt specification contains 6,371 firm-quarter observations from 462 firms, while the primary cash specification contains 7,726 observations from 516 firms. Days sales outstanding (DSO), days inventory outstanding (DIO), and days payable outstanding (DPO) are constructed using average balance-sheet stocks and trailing-four-quarter operating flows. The principal models use firm and calendar-quarter fixed effects and firm-clustered standard errors. A ten-day within-firm increase in TTM-based DSO is associated with an approximately 0.172-percentage-point increase in the next-quarter short-term debt ratio (p = 0.011), conditional on prespecified financial controls. No statistically precise average relationship is identified between DSO and subsequent cash holdings. DPO is positively associated with subsequent short-term debt and negatively associated with cash holdings in the primary specifications, while the aggregate cash conversion cycle is not statistically significant for either principal outcome. The DSO-debt relationship remains statistically precise under two-way clustering but weakens under alternative denominator definitions and sample windows and is therefore interpreted as a conditional rather than causal or universally robust association. A separate counterfactual applies paymentprocessing reductions of 0.25-2 days to eligible-flow shares of 5%-50% of observed trailing-four-quarter sales. Under the prespecified base case of a 10% eligible-flow share and a 0.5-day reduction, aggregate gross liquidity release across 1,519 firms in 2025Q4 is approximately KRW 299.7 billion, while the median firm-level release is approximately KRW 18.7 million, equivalent to about 0.103% of cash holdings. At a 5% annual funding rate, a half-day acceleration produces financing value of approximately 0.685 basis points of eligible flow. The results distinguish contractual trade-credit duration from technologically removable payment-processing time and show that faster settlement alone is unlikely to justify costly infrastructure migration in many settings. The revised Manufacturing Digital Treasury Framework is consequently developed as a controlled institutional architecture for eligible transactions, programmable payment triggers, regulated settlement assets, bank-linked redemption, treasury reconciliation, compliance, and operational-risk management rather than as a broad digital-asset allocation framework.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2019Q1-2025Q4韩国上市制造业企业的季度面板数据（含7,726个现金观测和6,371个短期债务观测），考察营运资本周期（DSO、DIO、DPO）与后续流动性缓冲及短期债务依赖的关系，并通过反事实分析估算可编程结算加速带来的机械性流动性释放。研究发现TTM-DSO每增加10天与下一季度短期债务比率上升0.172个百分点相关（p=0.011），但被解释为条件性关联而非因果关系；同时估算了0.25-2天结算加速对1,519家企业在2025Q4的流动性释放（基准情形约2,997亿韩元），并据此提出修订版制造业数字司库框架。
AI.research_question: 1) 韩国上市制造企业的营运资本管理（应收、存货、应付账款的周转天数）如何影响其后续的流动性缓冲（现金持有）和短期债务依赖？2) 更快的可编程结算（payment settlement）能在多大程度上机械性地释放企业流动性？
AI.motivation: 营运资本管理与公司流动性之间的关系在理论和实务中均备受关注，但现有研究较少基于高频验证数据区分合同性贸易信用期限与技术性支付处理时间。此外，随着可编程结算和央行数字货币等基础设施发展，需要量化评估更快结算对企业流动性的实际影响，以避免过度投资于昂贵的基础设施迁移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营运资本管理理论（现金转换周期CCC）、流动性缓冲理论（precautionary motive）、贸易信用理论（trade credit duration）、数字司库框架（Digital Treasury Framework）
AI.method: 基于韩国OpenDART验证的季度面板数据（2019Q1-2025Q4），构建DSO、DIO、DPO指标（使用平均资产负债存量与滚动四季度经营流量），采用企业固定效应和日历季度固定效应模型，企业层面聚类标准误，并辅以双向聚类和替代口径的稳健性检验。此外进行反事实模拟，评估结算处理时间缩减0.25-2天对合格流量份额5%-50%的流动性释放效应。
AI.findings: 1) TTM-DSO每增加10天（企业内）与下一季度短期债务比率上升约0.172个百分点相关（p=0.011）；2) DSO与后续现金持有之间无统计上精确的平均关系；3) DPO与后续短期债务正相关、与现金持有负相关；4) 现金转换周期（CCC）对两个主要结果均不显著；5) DSO-债务关系在双向聚类下稳健但在替代分母定义和样本窗口下减弱，被解释为条件性关联；6) 反事实分析显示，基准情形（10%合格流量份额、0.5天缩减）下2025Q4共有1,519家企业的总流动性释放约2,997亿韩元，中位数企业释放约1,870万韩元（约占现金持有的0.103%）；7) 按5%年融资成本计算，半天加速产生的融资价值约为合格流量的0.685个基点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 区分了合同性贸易信用期限（contractual trade-credit duration）与技术性可移除的支付处理时间（technologically removable payment-processing time）两个概念，丰富了营运资本与流动性管理理论；2) 对DSO与短期债务关系提供了企业内条件的经验证据，但明确界定其为条件性关联而非因果或普遍稳健关系，体现了严谨的推断边界；3) 提出了可编程结算流动性释放的定量估算框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业在结算加速基础设施投资决策中提供了量化依据——在多数情境下，仅靠更快结算难以证明高昂的基础设施迁移成本是合理的；2) 开发了修订版"制造业数字司库框架"（Manufacturing Digital Treasury Framework），将其定位为受控的制度架构，涵盖合格交易、可编程支付触发、受监管结算资产、银行链接赎回、司库对账、合规和操作风险管理，而非宽泛的数字资产配置框架。

title: Who Pays for Proof-of-Work? Allocating Carbon Responsibility Across Crypto-Asset Markets

detail.title: Who Pays for Proof-of-Work? Allocating Carbon Responsibility Across Crypto-Asset Markets
detail.abstract: Proof-of-Work crypto-assets generate measurable environmental costs, yet their decentralised architecture makes conventional environmental liability unusually difficult to apply. This article argues that decentralisation does not eliminate legal responsibility; it fragments the causal chain. Law should therefore move away from the search for a single fictional polluter and allocate distinct forms of responsibility according to each actor's position of control. The framework developed here distinguishes miners' physical contribution to electricity consumption and emissions, protocols' architectural control over consensus design, and exchanges' gatekeeping capacity over access to regulated markets. Drawing on comparative legal analysis of the European Union, China, Kazakhstan, the United States and Vietnam, the article evaluates sustainability disclosure, mining restrictions and levies, climate-causation doctrine, DAO legal personality and listing-stage environmental due diligence. It proposes a tiered model combining source-sensitive environmental charges for miners, disclosure and narrowly framed design responsibility for protocols, and gatekeeping duties for exchanges. Where legally cognisable harm is established but individual contribution cannot reasonably be traced, the article favours residual proportionate several liability based on causally relevant contribution evidence rather than trading volume alone. Vietnam provides a particularly useful case study: its emerging crypto-asset market framework now operates alongside an increasingly developed environmental, greenhouse-gas and carbon-market architecture, but the two systems remain largely disconnected. Connecting them would allow environmental externalities to be addressed before carbon-intensive crypto-asset practices become institutionally entrenched.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了工作量证明（PoW）加密资产的去中心化架构虽使传统环境责任难以适用，但去中心化并未消除法律责任，而是碎片化了因果链。法律应放弃寻找单一虚拟污染者，转而根据各行为主体的控制地位分配不同类型责任，并提出了针对矿工、协议和交易所的分层责任模型。
AI.research_question: 在PoW加密资产的去中心化架构下，如何重新构建环境法律责任框架以应对其带来的环境外部性？
AI.motivation: PoW加密资产产生可测量的环境成本，但其去中心化架构使传统环境责任机制难以适用。去中心化并未消除法律责任，而是碎片化了因果链，需要新的责任分配框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 责任分配理论（根据不同行为主体的控制地位分配责任）；因果链碎片化理论；比较法分析框架（欧盟、中国、哈萨克斯坦、美国、越南）
AI.method: 比较法律分析，涵盖欧盟、中国、哈萨克斯坦、美国和越南的法规，评估可持续发展披露制度、采矿限制和征税、气候因果关系理论、DAO法律人格及上市阶段环境尽职调查。
AI.findings: 提出分层责任模型：对矿工适用来源敏感的环境收费；对协议适用披露义务和狭义设计责任；对交易所适用准入把关义务。在法律可认知的损害成立但无法合理追溯个人贡献时，依据因果相关贡献证据而非交易量适用残余比例连带责任。越南案例表明其加密资产市场框架与环境、温室气体和碳市场架构脱节，需加以连接。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"去中心化碎片化因果链"的核心理论观点，摒弃单一虚拟污染者的传统法律思维，构建了基于控制地位的多主体分层责任框架，并为DAO法律人格和气候因果关系理论提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了针对矿工、协议和交易所的分层环境责任政策工具；以越南为案例展示了将加密资产市场框架与环境监管架构相连接的具体路径，有助于在碳密集型加密资产实践制度化之前解决环境外部性问题。

title: CEO Compensation and Firm-Level Climate Change Discourse
affiliations: Indiana University Kokomo - School of Business and Indiana University Kokomo - School of Business

detail.title: CEO Compensation and Firm-Level Climate Change Discourse
detail.abstract: This paper examines how the structure of CEO compensation and the gender of the CEO are associated with attention to climate change issues at the firm level, as measured by the share of climate-related discussion in corporate earnings conference calls. Using a panel of over two thousand U.S. publicly traded firms, we find that higher total CEO compensation is associated with greater climate change exposure and stronger positive sentiments towards climate change. Furthermore, a higher proportion of both equity-based and performance-based compensation in total CEO pay is significantly associated with greater climate change exposure and positive sentiments. The findings suggest that compensation incentives motivate CEO focus on the emerging opportunities posed by climate change. We also report that firms led by female CEOs are more likely to engage in climate-related discourse. The results contribute to the growing literature on climate finance and corporate governance by highlighting the role of executive pay incentives in shaping a firm's strategic focus on climate-related issues.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了CEO薪酬结构与性别如何影响企业对气候变化问题的关注度（以财报电话会议中气候相关讨论占比衡量）。基于2000多家美国上市公司的面板数据，发现CEO总薪酬越高，气候变化的暴露度和正面情绪越强；股权和绩效薪酬占比越高，同样与更大的气候暴露度和正面情绪显著相关；女性CEO领导的企业更倾向于参与气候相关讨论。
AI.research_question: CEO薪酬结构（总薪酬水平、股权与绩效薪酬比例）以及CEO性别如何影响企业对气候变化议题的关注程度？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化日益成为企业战略核心议题，理解何种治理因素（尤其是高管薪酬激励）会驱动管理层战略性地关注气候变化问题，对气候金融和公司治理文献具有重要价值，但目前相关实证证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论（薪酬激励与管理者关注度）、高管注意力理论（管理层注意力配置决定企业战略重点）以及公司治理与气候金融交叉视角。
AI.method: 基于2000多家美国上市公司面板数据，以财报电话会议中气候相关讨论占比作为企业对气候变化关注度的代理变量，采用回归分析检验CEO薪酬结构与性别对气候关注度的影响。
AI.findings: （1）CEO总薪酬越高，企业气候变化暴露度和正面情绪越强；（2）股权薪酬和绩效薪酬占总薪酬比例越高，气候暴露度和正面情绪越显著；（3）女性CEO领导的企业更倾向于参与气候相关讨论。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高管薪酬激励与气候变化战略关注联系起来，拓展了气候金融与公司治理交叉领域的理论研究，为委托代理理论在可持续性议题下的应用提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事会设计CEO薪酬契约以引导企业战略性关注气候变化提供实证依据；同时也表明CEO"性别多样性"在企业气候治理中具有实践意义。

title: The Misdiagnosis at the Centre of AI Transformation: Why Adaptive Leadership Capacity, Not Technical Deficit, Explains the AI Transformation Gap
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Misdiagnosis at the Centre of AI Transformation: Why Adaptive Leadership Capacity, Not Technical Deficit, Explains the AI Transformation Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an executive coach and leadership advisor whose practice includes some individuals interviewed for this research. Interview participation was voluntary and confidential, and did not require or imply any commercial engagement. No interviewee was compensated for participation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is based on structured interviews with senior executives conducted with participant consent. Named interviewees have provided explicit consent for attribution of quotes used in this paper. No institutional ethics board review was required, as this is confidential practitioner research rather than a clinical or human-subjects study requiring IRB oversight.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Research consistently shows that AI transformation fails at rates that cannot be explained by technical deficit or financial underinvestment. Drawing on 105 structured interviews with Chief AI Officers, CTOs, and senior technology executives across healthcare, financial services, government, technology, and the nonprofit sector, this paper argues that the prevailing industry diagnosis-insufficient training, unclear use cases, governance frameworks that lag deployment-misidentifies the nature of the challenge. AI transformation presents as a technical problem but functions, for the leaders navigating it, as an adaptive one in Heifetz's sense: it requires leaders to change not what they do but how they think and, in some cases, who they understand themselves to be. Thematic analysis of the interview corpus identifies six recurring tensions leaders face (use cases vs. genuine transformation, individual mastery vs. ecosystem intelligence, cost reduction vs. revenue creation, deployment speed vs. organizational absorption, human work vs. human-agent collaboration, and having answers vs. designing systems that discover them) and a common underlying pattern the paper terms the "defended expert identity"-a largely unconscious investment in a definition of expertise that AI transformation has rendered insufficient. The paper draws on Kegan's work on adult development and hidden competing commitments, and Edmondson's research on psychological safety, to argue that closing the AI transformation gap requires leadership development targeted at this adaptive, identity-level constraint rather than additional technical capability-building alone.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对105位首席AI官、CTO及高级技术高管的结构化访谈，提出AI转型的失败不能仅归因于技术或资金不足，而本质上是Heifetz意义上的"适应性挑战"——领导者需要改变思维方式和自我认知，而非仅仅改变行为。研究识别出领导者面临的六种紧张关系，并提出"防御性专家身份"这一核心概念，认为弥合AI转型差距需要针对身份层面的领导力发展。
AI.research_question: 为什么AI转型在企业中持续以无法用技术缺陷或资金不足解释的高比率失败？领导者在AI转型中面临的根本性挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有行业主流诊断（培训不足、用例不清、治理框架滞后）未能准确识别AI转型失败的本质。作者认为AI转型表面上呈现为技术问题，但在领导者层面实际上是一个适应性挑战，需要重新审视其背后的心理和身份层面的约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: Heifetz的适应性领导理论（区分技术性挑战与适应性挑战）；Kegan的成人发展阶段理论与隐藏竞争承诺；Edmondson的心理安全研究。
AI.method: 对105位来自医疗、金融服务、政府、技术及非营利部门的Chief AI Officers、CTOs和高级技术高管进行结构化访谈，并对访谈语料进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 识别出领导者面临的六种反复出现的紧张关系：（1）用例vs.真正的转型；（2）个人精通vs.生态系统智能；（3）降低成本vs.创造收入；（4）部署速度vs.组织吸收能力；（5）人类工作vs.人机协作；（6）拥有答案vs.设计能发现答案的系统。并发现共同的潜在模式——"防御性专家身份"，即领导者对专家定义的无意识投资，而这种定义已被AI转型所削弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"防御性专家身份"这一新概念，将AI转型失败重新框定为适应性挑战而非技术性挑战；将成人发展理论和心理安全研究整合应用于AI领导力研究领域，为理解AI转型中领导者的身份层面约束提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计AI转型领导力发展项目提供了新的方向——应针对适应性、身份层面的约束进行干预，而非仅增加技术能力建设；帮助高管识别自身在转型中面临的紧张关系模式，促进领导力转型。

title: Chain of Reasoning and Thought: Sequential Beta-Dirichlet Updating in Large Language Models
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Chain of Reasoning and Thought: Sequential Beta-Dirichlet Updating in Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Dalal and Misra (2024) model a large language model as a compact representation of an enormous multinomial transition matrix and show that next-token generation behaves like Bayesian updating: the pre-trained model supplies a Dirichlet prior, the prompt supplies a likelihood, and the emitted distribution is the posterior. Their analysis is single-step and the prompt is exogenous. This paper extends the framework to multi-step generation, in which the model conditions on text it has itself produced, and in doing so separates two things that the phrase "chain of thought" runs together. A chain of thought is ancestral sampling from the model's own predictive law; in Bayesian terms it performs marginalisation over a latent trace and is a Monte Carlo device. A chain of reasoning conditions on a relation certified outside the model-an arithmetic identity, a retrieved fact, a verifier score-and performs conditioning, supplying a likelihood the model could not have written down. Under self-conditioning the Beta-Bernoulli update becomes a Pólya urn, so the posterior mean of any reasoning mode is a bounded martingale: thinking cannot move the expected probability of being correct, only its dispersion. The nominal posterior nevertheless contracts at rate t-1 while the trace carries exactly zero information about the truth, giving an overconfidence factor 1 + 2t/(α + β), and a Fano bound caps the accuracy of any chain by its exogenous information content. What decomposition does buy is coverage, the relocation of each prediction to a densely visited row of the transition matrix, which holds only within a band [T * , T * * ] of compositional depths. Along the way the Schur-concavity result of Dalal and Misra (2024) generalises to a martingale dilation whose entropy drop equals I(A; Z 1:T | Q); Beta heterogeneity produces a power-law test-time scaling law; self-consistency obeys a Sanov exponent with a bias floor; verified reasoning is sequential importance sampling, with weight degeneracy as its characteristic failure; and optimal chain length obeys a square-root law in the cost of thinking. Three further results sharpen the picture. A Murphy decomposition shows that a thought chain and a reasoning chain generate the same belief movement Var(θ t), but that in the first it is entirely reliability error and in the second entirely resolution. Under an intrinsic time change the chain converges to a Wright-Fisher diffusion run for the finite time 1/(α + β), so belief movement saturates after O(α + β) steps however long the chain is made. And when attention discounts earlier steps at rate γ, the martingale becomes an ergodic process that reverts to the pre-training mean at rate (1γ) 2 (α + β)/{(1γ)(α + β) + 1}, which replaces lock-in by a second pathology, perpetual regression to prior defaults. All parameters of the framework are identified from logged next-token probabilities, and we give closed-form moment estimators.

AI.tldr: 本文在Dalal和Misra (2024)的贝叶斯框架基础上，将大语言模型（LLM）的推理过程从单步扩展至多步生成，严格区分了"思维链"（ancestral sampling/marginalisation）与"推理链"（conditioning on externally certified relations）两种机制。核心发现是：在自条件化下，后验均值是有界鞅，思维不能改变期望正确率，只能改变离散度；名义后验以t^-1速率收缩而轨迹携带零信息，产生过度自信因子1+2t/(α+β)。分解的价值在于覆盖率（将预测重定位到转移矩阵的密集访问行），但仅在一定组构深度带[T*,T**]内成立。论文还推导了鞅膨胀、Wright-Fisher扩散极限、Murphy分解等系列理论结果，并给出闭式矩估计器。
AI.research_question: 在多步生成条件下，LLM的"思维链"与"推理链"在贝叶斯机制上有何本质区别？自条件化对模型预测的信念动态、准确率和覆盖率的理论影响是什么？
AI.motivation: Dalal和Misra (2024)的框架仅分析了单步生成且提示词外生，但实际LLM推理是多步的、模型会基于自身产出继续生成。"思维链"（chain of thought）这一术语将两种截然不同的机制混为一谈，需要严格的理论分离与刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯更新框架（Dirichlet先验、Beta-Bernoulli更新）、Pólya urn模型、鞅理论、Wright-Fisher扩散过程、Schur凹性、Sanov定理（大偏差）、Fano不等式、Murphy分解、序贯重要性采样、遍历理论
AI.method: 理论分析：将LLM多步生成建模为自条件化过程，推导Beta-Bernoulli更新在自条件化下退化为Pólya urn；利用鞅收敛定理、熵分析、扩散逼近等方法推导信念动态、过度自信因子、链长最优律等；提供闭式矩估计器用于实证识别。
AI.findings: (1) 自条件化下后验均值为有界鞅，思维不改变期望正确率，只增加离散度；(2) 名义后验以t^-1速率收缩但轨迹零信息，过度自信因子为1+2t/(α+β)；(3) Fano界表明任何链的准确率受外生信息量上限约束；(4) 分解带来覆盖率增益但仅在组构深度带[T*,T**]内有效；(5) Murphy分解显示想法链与推理链产生相同信念移动Var(θt)，但前者全是可靠性误差、后者全是分辨率；(6) 内在时间变换下链收敛到Wright-Fisher扩散，信念移动在O(α+β)步后饱和；(7) 注意力折扣下鞅变为遍历过程，回归先验均值，以(1-γ)²(α+β)/{(1-γ)(α+β)+1}的速率；(8) Beta异质性产生幂律测试时扩展律；自一致性服从带偏置下限的Sanov指数；验证推理等价于序贯重要性采样（有权重退化）；最优链长服从成本平方根律。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将Dalal和Misra的单步贝叶斯框架推广到多步/自条件化情形；(2) 严格区分"思维链"（Monte Carlo边际化）与"推理链"（外部认证的条件化）两种机制；(3) 推广Schur凹性结果为鞅膨胀，熵降等于互信息I(A;Z1:T|Q)；(4) 建立了推理链长与扩散极限、遍历回归等新的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供所有参数的闭式矩估计器，可从记录的next-token概率中识别模型参数；(2) 给出最优链长的平方根律，指导推理成本-收益权衡；(3) 揭示推理链的权重退化和过度自信问题，为验证机制设计和校准提供理论依据；(4) 指明覆盖率收益有深度上限，指导"想多久"的实操边界。

title: Sovereign Compute: Why Nations that Miss the AI × ADM Window will Become the Third World of the 21st Century

detail.title: Sovereign Compute: Why Nations that Miss the AI × ADM Window will Become the Third World of the 21st Century
detail.abstract:
This strategic white paper argues that the transition from human-in-the-loop infrastructure management to the integration of Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Dynamic Machines — formalized as the Cedres Integral of Autonomy — represents a foundational geopolitical transition equivalent in consequence to the electrification of the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

Nations that build and control sovereign hyperscale compute infrastructure, secure the materials to sustain it, power it with reliable domestic energy, and deploy autonomous physical execution systems at national scale will compound structural economic, military, and geopolitical advantages across the next fifty to one hundred years. Nations that fail to do so will follow the structural trajectory of nations that missed the electrification window — not immediately, but gradually and for some, irreversibly.

The paper presents five sovereign recommendations: classifying the AI × ADM stack as strategic national infrastructure; building data centers responsibly with proper cost allocation, grid priority, transparency, and nuclear waste accountability; transitioning critical economic operations to zero-latency autonomous control; mobilizing national industrial capacity for autonomous physical systems; and securing material sovereignty across the critical minerals supply chain.

The author draws on over three decades of experience at the intersection of national security, critical infrastructure resilience, and autonomous systems architecture, including 22 years at the U.S. Department of Energy. Prior to that served as both, military and civilian, at the Department of Defense. This white paper represents independent analysis and does not reflect the positions of any government agency or former employer.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份战略白皮书，主张从"人在环内"的基础设施管理向人工智能与自主动态机器（ADM）的融合转变——即"Cedres自主积分"——代表了与19世纪末20世纪初电气化同等重要的地缘政治转折。未能构建主权超大规模计算基础设施、保障关键材料、可靠能源和全国规模自主物理执行系统的国家，将逐步且部分不可逆地走向结构性衰落。论文提出五项主权建议，涵盖战略基础设施分类、数据中心建设责任、零延迟自主控制、国家工业能力动员和关键矿产材料主权保障。
AI.research_question: 人工智能与自主动态机器（AI × ADM）基础设施的整合如何构成地缘政治转型，各国应如何构建主权能力以在这一转型中保持竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 作者认为AI与ADM的整合在战略意义上等同于19世纪的电气化革命，但许多国家尚未认识到这一转型的结构性、长期性影响。基于三十年国家安全和关键基础设施领域的经验，作者旨在提出一个战略框架，帮助国家理解并应对这一地缘政治转折。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以历史类比（电气化转型）为基础的战略转型理论框架，提出"自主积分"（Integral of Autonomy）概念，将主权计算基础设施、能源、材料与自主物理执行系统整合为一个不可分割的战略复合体。强调结构性国家竞争优势的复合增长逻辑。
AI.method: 战略分析与政策建议型白皮书。基于作者在国家能源部22年和国防部的实践经验，采用历史类比分析（电气化窗口期类比）和主权能力框架构建的方法，提出五项政策建议。
AI.findings: 掌控主权超大规模计算、关键材料、可靠国内能源和全国规模自主物理执行系统的国家将在未来50-100年内获得结构性经济、军事和地缘政治优势；错过这一窗口期的国家将沿着类似错过电气化国家的结构性衰退轨迹发展，且部分衰退不可逆。论文还提出了五项具体主权建议以应对这一转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"自主积分"（Cedres Integral of Autonomy）这一新概念，将AI与自主执行系统整合为一个可分析的地缘政治变量；建立了电气化历史类比的分析框架，将基础设施转型与长期国家竞争力联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供五项可操作的主权战略建议：将AI × ADM栈列为战略国家基础设施；负责任地建设数据中心（成本分配、电网优先级、透明度和核废料问责）；将关键经济运营过渡到零延迟自主控制；动员国家工业能力支持自主物理系统；确保关键矿产供应链的材料主权。这些建议直接服务于国家层面的战略规划与政策制定。

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based entirely on publicly available regulatory texts, policy documents, and academic literature, and did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This article evaluates the global evolution of sustainability due diligence requirements using a systematic comparative approach. By evaluating the regulatory developments from 2010 to 2024, a pattern of ‘structured divergence’ was identified in which core substantive elements of due diligence regulations show synergies while procedural requirements remain jurisdictionally different. Regulatory Convergence Theory is used as the primary theoretical lens to analyze how different jurisdictions adopt increasingly similar regulatory approaches over time while distinct implementation characteristics are maintained. The analysis shows that European approaches demonstrate higher strictness, reach, and Triple Bottom Line balance compared to North American frameworks, which reflects deeper differences in regulatory philosophy. This research offers theoretical insights into how global regulatory convergence shapes sustainability governance.

AI.tldr: 本文采用系统性比较方法，评估了2010至2024年间全球可持续性尽职调查要求的演变，识别出"结构化分化"模式，即尽职调查法规的核心实质性要素存在协同性，而程序性要求则因司法管辖区而异。
AI.research_question: 不同司法管辖区的可持续性尽职调查法规在2010至2024年间如何演变？全球监管趋同如何塑造可持续性治理？
AI.motivation: 可持续性尽职调查已成为全球监管的重要议题，但各国法规的相似性与差异性尚未被系统性比较分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管趋同理论（Regulatory Convergence Theory）
AI.method: 系统性比较方法（systematic comparative approach），评估2010至2024年的监管发展
AI.findings: 识别出"结构化分化"模式：核心实质性要素呈现协同性，而程序性要求保持司法管辖区差异；欧洲方法在严格性、覆盖范围和三重底线平衡方面高于北美框架，反映更深层的监管理念差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 为全球监管趋同如何塑造可持续性治理提供理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和跨国企业理解不同司法管辖区可持续性尽职调查要求的异同提供参考。

title: The Human-Constant AI Implementation Model™
affiliations: Tall Oak Solutions, Tall Oak Solutions

detail.title: The Human-Constant AI Implementation Model™

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: Completely funded by the author

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is advancing faster than most organizations can absorb it. Leaders are
being asked to prepare for technologies whose future direction, dominant platforms, and
effects on work remain uncertain. Too often, implementation begins with the tool and then
reorganizes people around what the tool can do. This paper argues that leaders should begin
in the opposite place. Human behavior varies across individuals, cultures, incentives,
relationships, and circumstances, but the basic concerns that shape behavior—autonomy,
competence, identity, belonging, status, fairness, security, trust, and meaning—are far more
durable than any current AI platform. The Human-Constant AI Implementation Model™,
developed by Mark Alexander as part of the broader Human-in-Complexity Framework™,
uses those enduring human realities as the design anchor for AI implementation. Grounded
in sociotechnical systems theory, self-determination theory, psychological safety,
organizational learning, and human-automation research, the model offers six principles for
leaders: understand the real human work system, define the objective before choosing the
tool, establish the intended human-AI relationship, preserve human agency and competence,
treat implementation as a continuing learning process, and measure what happens to the
organization as well as what happens to the process. The model is intended to help leaders
use AI to increase capacity and decision quality without making judgment, accountability,
and human development secondary to the technology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Human-Constant AI Implementation Model™"（人性恒定AI实施模型），主张领导者应以持久的人类基本需求（如自主性、胜任感、身份认同、公平等）而非工具本身作为AI实施的锚点，通过六项原则帮助组织在引入AI时保持人类判断力、责任感和发展的优先地位。
AI.research_question: 领导者应如何在技术和未来方向高度不确定的背景下实施AI，使其不仅提升组织能力，同时不损害人类判断力、责任心和发展？
AI.motivation: AI技术发展速度快于组织的吸收能力，许多组织实施AI时往往从工具出发，围绕工具能力重组人员。然而AI平台的未来方向、主导平台尚不确定，这种方法存在根本性缺陷。领导者需要一种以持久人性为锚点的AI实施路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论（sociotechnical systems theory）、自我决定理论（self-determination theory）、心理安全感（psychological safety）、组织学习（organizational learning）、人机自动化研究（human-automation research）
AI.method: 理论模型构建与概念性论述，提出包含六项原则的规范性框架。
AI.findings: 提出六项实施原则：（1）理解真实的人类工作系统；（2）先定义目标再选择工具；（3）确立预期的人机关系；（4）保持人类能动性与胜任力；（5）将实施视为持续学习过程；（6）同时衡量对组织和流程的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会技术系统理论与自我决定理论等整合为面向AI实施的规范性框架，提出"人性恒定"作为应对技术不确定性的设计锚点，拓展了人机交互与组织变革的理论交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供了具体的六项实施原则，帮助组织在AI部署中确保人的判断力、问责制和发展不被技术边缘化，提供了一套以人为中心的AI实施路线图。

title: The 5:30 Filing Cliff: Administrative Deadlines, Disclosure Timing, and Event-Time Measurement
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: The 5:30 Filing Cliff: Administrative Deadlines, Disclosure Timing, and Event-Time Measurement
detail.abstract: Public disclosure is not governed by a single timestamp. In the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's EDGAR system, the time a submission is accepted, the date legally assigned to it, and the time it becomes publicly available can diverge. For most forms, a direct transmission begun after 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time is assigned the next business day's filing date and is not disseminated until that day. I document this administrative discontinuity and study a 5 February 2024 reform that extended same-day treatment for Schedules 13D and 13G to 10:00 p.m. In a pilot covering 500 large current U.S.-listed issuers, Schedule 13G filings increased their post-5:30 share from 2.62% to 11.07%, while 8-K, 10-Q, and 10-K filings were nearly unchanged. A differencein-differences design with issuer, calendar month-day, and form fixed effects estimates a 12.71 percentage-point increase (CR1 two-way clustered standard error 6.88 points; p=0.066). The estimate is driven substantially by the annual February filing concentration: omitting February reduces it to 3.73 points (p=0.252), and none of six postaudit exploratory alternatives survives Holm adjustment. A daily-price illustration further shows that assigning shifted earnings filings to the acceptance date moves returns and volume away from the economically relevant availability date. The institutional evidence establishes a form-specific source of event-time measurement error; the behavioral estimate is economically large but statistically suggestive. The evidence does not support a maintained claim that firms use the cutoff to conceal bad news.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国SEC EDGAR系统中公共披露时间戳的不一致性——即提交接受时间、法定档案日期和公开可用时间之间的差异。作者记录了这一行政中断现象，并分析了2024年2月5日的一项改革（将13D和13G表格的同日处理延长至晚上10点）。通过双重差分设计发现，13G表格在下午5:30后的提交比例从2.62%升至11.07%，但统计显著性较弱，且主要由2月份的集中申报驱动。文章还通过每日价格示例说明，将延迟的盈利公告分配到接受日期会导致回报和交易量偏离经济相关的可用日期。总体而言，证据表明存在特定表格的事件时间测量误差，但不支持企业利用这一截止时间来掩盖坏消息的说法。
AI.research_question: 美国SEC EDGAR系统中公共披露的时间戳不一致性（接受时间、法定日期、公开可用时间之间）如何影响事件时间的测量？2024年2月5日的改革（延长13D/13G表格的同日处理截止时间至晚上10点）对申报行为产生了什么影响？企业是否利用下午5:30截止时间来掩盖坏消息？
AI.motivation: 公共披露并非由单一时间戳控制，EDGAR系统中提交接受时间、法定分配日期和公开可用时间可能存在分歧。这种行政中断导致事件时间测量误差，影响基于日期的实证研究。此外，2024年2月5日的改革提供了自然实验机会，可检验企业是否主动利用行政截止时间来策略性地安排信息披露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件时间测量误差理论、信息披露策略理论（企业是否利用行政规则时机来战略性披露信息）
AI.method: 描述性统计：记录13G和13D表格在改革前后的下午5:30后提交比例变化；双重差分设计（DID）：使用发行人、日历月-日、表格固定效应；稳健性检验：排除2月数据、六种审计后探索性替代方案、Holm调整；每日价格示例：比较将延迟的盈利申报分配到接受日期与公开可用日期下的回报和交易量。
AI.findings: 1. 改革的试点覆盖500家大型美国上市发行人，13G表格下午5:30后的提交份额从2.62%升至11.07%，而8-K、10-Q和10-K表格几乎不变。2. DID估计得出12.71个百分点的增幅（CR1双向聚类标准误6.88点，p=0.066），统计上较弱。3.该估计主要由2月份的年度申报集中驱动：排除2月后降至3.73点（p=0.252），且六种探索性替代方案无一种通过Holm调整。4.每日价格示例显示，将延迟的盈利申报分配到接受日期会使回报和交易量偏离经济相关的可用日期。5.证据不支持企业利用截止时间来掩盖坏消息的假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文建立了特定表格来源的事件时间测量误差理论框架，揭示了公共披露时间戳不一致性对实证研究的影响。同时，通过改革自然实验，提供了企业是否利用行政截止时间进行信息披露策略行为的因果证据，但其系统性结论为统计上仅属提示性而非确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 对实务界（研究者、投资者、监管者）而言，本文提示在使用EDGAR数据时需关注时间戳差异所导致的事件日期分配问题；对监管改革（如延长截止时间）的效果提供了初步评估，表明改革在特定表格上改变了申报行为，但对信息披露的操纵性动机未提供支持证据。

title: Governing Global Partnerships: Multi-Stakeholder Knowledge Exchange and Cross-sectoral Capacity Building in Higher Education
affiliations: Swiss International University SIU

detail.title: Governing Global Partnerships: Multi-Stakeholder Knowledge Exchange and Cross-sectoral Capacity Building in Higher Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article is a conceptual analysis of published scholarly literature. It involved no human participants, no animal subjects and no primary data collection, and ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Two decades of guidance on equitable international partnership have coincided with little movement in the distribution of authorship, funding custody and agenda control across higher education collaborations. This article explains that persistence by separating two classes of governance instrument. Procedural instruments-memoranda, steering committees, consultation rounds, codes of conduct, equity checklists, reflexivity statements-regulate voice, visibility and process. Allocative instruments transfer custody of one of the four goods a partnership actually distributes: agenda authority, resource custody, epistemic authority, and the direction in which accountability runs. The article develops this distinction into a framework and uses it to specify a condition it calls participatory settlement, a stable state in which procedural instruments raise satisfaction with process and perceived legitimacy while leaving all four goods where they were, and in which the raised legitimacy then reduces pressure for allocative change. The account reconciles two literatures that have talked past each other, one treating partnership failure as a problem of design and the other treating design as an instrument of legitimation. Five propositions specify when a procedural instrument converts into an allocative one: when allocation is the default rather than the request, when a party outside the partnership holds enforcement standing, when transfers cannot be reversed within a funding cycle, when agenda authority and resource custody move together, and when evaluation measures allocation rather than process. The framework is conceptual, derived from published evidence, and offered for empirical test.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了程序性工具和分配性工具两类治理工具，解释了国际高等教育合作中尽管有大量公平指导原则，但作者署名、资金管理和议程控制权分配几乎没有变化的现象。文章提出"参与性解决"（participatory settlement）这一稳定状态概念，说明程序性工具如何通过提升过程满意度和合法性感知来降低分配变革压力，并给出程序性工具转化为分配性工具的五个条件命题。
AI.research_question: 为什么过去的二十年中，尽管国际伙伴关系的公平指导原则层出不穷，但高等教育合作中的作者署名、资金托管和议程控制权分配几乎没有发生变化？
AI.motivation: 两套文献（将伙伴关系失败视为设计问题 vs 将设计视为合法化工具）一直在各说各话，缺乏整合框架来解释国际合作中持久的不平等现象，本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理工具二元分类框架：程序性工具（procedural instruments）与分配性工具（allocative instruments）；参与性解决（participatory settlement）概念；基于四种商品（议程权威、资源托管权、知识权威、问责方向）的分配分析。
AI.method: 概念性框架研究，基于已发表的实证证据进行理论构建，提出五个可检验的命题。
AI.findings: 程序性工具仅调节声音、可见性和过程，而分配性工具才真正转移四种伙伴关系商品（议程权威、资源托管、知识权威、问责方向）的托管权。当程序性工具提升过程满意度和合法性感知时，会形成"参与性解决"稳定状态，进而减少对分配变革的压力。文章提出五个使程序性工具转化为分配性工具的条件命题。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了"设计失败"与"设计即合法化"两套相互脱节的文献，提供了程序性与分配性治理工具的清晰概念区分，提出了"参与性解决"这一新的稳定状态概念来解释不平等的持久性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际高等教育合作伙伴关系的公平治理提供诊断工具：帮助识别程序性改革何时只是象征性的，何时能真正推动分配性变革，并指明实现公平分配的制度条件。

title: Sustainability visibility in hospitality: Assessing online communication through a benchmarking index and a destination-level scorecard
affiliations: International Hellenic University (IHU)

detail.title: Sustainability visibility in hospitality: Assessing online communication through a benchmarking index and a destination-level scorecard

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Hospitality and Tourism Insights, volume 9, issue 11, 2026[10.1108/JHTI-12-2025-1471]

detail.abstract:
Purpose

This study examines how hotels communicate sustainability practices across digital channels and develops two complementary tools, the Practical Visibility Index (PVI) and the Sustainability Visibility Scorecard (SVS), to assess the visibility, clarity, and thematic breadth of sustainability communication in hospitality.

 

Design/methodology/approach

A quantitative content analysis of 120 eco-certified hotels across five major Greek tourism regions was conducted, supported by descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and illustrative regression analysis. Presence, Clarity, and Richness were systematically coded from hotel websites and complemented by qualitative insights from published expert statements. The PVI was constructed as a theory-informed composite benchmarking index, while the SVS was designed as an applied scorecard for hotel and destination-level use.

 

Findings
Chain-affiliated hotels tend to communicate more comprehensively but often shift sustainability disclosure to corporate reports, whereas many independent properties rely on generic claims, with notable website omissions. Eco-labels enhance visibility only when supported by specific, multi-theme communication. The SVS complements the PVI by offering an assessment framework and illustrating the visibility of sustainability across digital platforms.

 

Practical implications

The PVI and SVS provide managers and destination authorities with operational tools to diagnose communication gaps, enhance transparency, and support more coherent and credible sustainability messaging, improving strategic alignment and competitive positioning outcomes.

 

Originality/value

This study contributes a signaling theory–informed, measurable framework for evaluating sustainability visibility and introduces the SVS as a benchmarking tool for hoteliers and destinations for online sustainability communication.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察酒店如何通过数字渠道传播可持续发展实践，开发了两个互补工具——实践可见性指数（PVI）和可持续性可见性记分卡（SVS），用于评估酒店业可持续发展沟通的可见性、清晰度和主题广度。通过对希腊五大旅游区域120家生态认证酒店的定量内容分析，研究发现连锁酒店沟通更全面但常将披露移至企业报告，而独立酒店多依赖笼统声明。生态标签只有在有具体多主题沟通支持下才能提升可见性。
AI.research_question: 酒店如何通过数字渠道传播可持续发展实践？如何评估和提升这种传播的可见性、清晰度和主题广度？
AI.motivation: 酒店业可持续发展沟通存在可见性不足、信息模糊和主题碎片化的问题，缺乏系统性工具来评估和提升酒店在线可持续性传播的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Signaling Theory）
AI.method: 对希腊五大旅游区域120家生态认证酒店进行定量内容分析，编码了存在性（Presence）、清晰度（Clarity）和丰富度（Richness）三个维度，辅以描述性统计、相关分析和示例性回归分析，并结合专家公开声明的定性洞察。
AI.findings: 连锁酒店倾向于更全面地沟通但常将可持续性披露转移至企业报告；许多独立酒店使用笼统声明且网站存在显著遗漏；生态标签只有在有具体、多主题沟通支持时才能增强可见性；SVS通过提供评估框架补充了PVI。
AI.theory_contributions: 贡献了一个基于信号理论的、可测量的可持续性可见性评估框架，并引入了SVS作为酒店和目的地在线可持续性沟通的基准工具。
AI.practical_contributions: PVI和SVS为管理者和目的地当局提供了操作性工具，用于诊断沟通差距、增强透明度、支持更连贯可信的可持续性信息传达，改善战略一致性并提升竞争定位。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Transport Networks for Resilient Supply Chain Management A Study from the Logistics and Supply Chain Perspective
affiliations: and St.Joseph college of Engineering & Technology

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Transport Networks for Resilient Supply Chain Management A Study from the Logistics and Supply Chain Perspective
detail.abstract: Global transport networks are being reshaped by artificial intelligence (AI), which is increasingly embedded in demand forecasting, route planning, fleet management, and disruption response across logistics operations. As supply chains face growing exposure to geopolitical shocks, extreme weather, port congestion and demand volatility, the ability of AI-enabled transport systems to anticipate, absorb and recover from disruption has become a central strategic concern for firms of every size. This study examines how AI-driven transport network capabilities-predictive demand forecasting, route and delivery optimisation, risk mitigation and disruption response, and cost and resource optimisation-are perceived to influence supply chain resilience from the standpoint of logistics and supply chain professionals. Primary data were collected through a structured questionnaire and analysed using descriptive statistics, chi-square tests of association, and stepwise multiple regression. The findings indicate that all four AI-enabled capabilities are positively associated with perceived supply chain resilience, with predictive demand forecasting and disruption-response capability emerging as the strongest determinants, while demographic factors such as gender and age show no significant association with perceived resilience outcomes. The study offers practical direction for logistics managers and policymakers seeking to prioritise AI investment for supply chain robustness.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨人工智能驱动的运输网络能力（预测性需求预测、路线与配送优化、风险缓解与中断响应、成本与资源优化）如何影响供应链韧性。通过结构化问卷收集物流与供应链专业人士的数据，采用描述性统计、卡方检验和逐步多元回归分析，发现四种AI能力均与感知供应链韧性正相关，其中预测性需求预测和中断响应能力是最强决定因素。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的运输网络能力如何影响供应链韧性？具体而言，预测性需求预测、路线与配送优化、风险缓解与中断响应、成本与资源优化这四种AI能力对感知供应链韧性的影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: 全球运输网络正面临地缘政治冲击、极端天气、港口拥堵和需求波动等日益增长的风险，供应链韧性成为各规模企业的核心战略关切。然而，对于AI驱动的运输能力如何具体影响供应链韧性，缺乏基于从业者视角的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链韧性理论（预测、吸收、恢复能力框架）；AI能力与组织绩效理论
AI.method: 结构化问卷收集一手数据；描述性统计；卡方检验（检验关联性）；逐步多元回归分析（识别最强预测因素）
AI.findings: 四种AI驱动的能力（预测性需求预测、路线与配送优化、风险缓解与中断响应、成本与资源优化）均与感知供应链韧性呈正相关；其中预测性需求预测和中断响应能力是最强的决定因素；性别和年龄等人口统计因素与感知韧性结果无显著关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI能力细分为四个维度，实证检验了各维度对供应链韧性的差异化影响，揭示了预测性需求预测与中断响应能力的核心地位，丰富了AI与供应链韧性交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物流管理者和政策制定者提供AI投资优先级的实践指导，帮助企业在资源有限的情况下将投资集中于对供应链韧性影响最大的AI能力（预测性需求预测和中断响应）。

title: Audit Gatekeeping and the Argumentative Cost of Principles-based Departures: Evidence from the True and Fair Override in Brazil
affiliations: University of São Paulo (USP), University of São Paulo - School of Economics, Business and Accounting and University of São Paulo (USP)

detail.title: Audit Gatekeeping and the Argumentative Cost of Principles-based Departures: Evidence from the True and Fair Override in Brazil

keywords: Brazil Provide your feedback on BizChat

detail.abstract: IAS 1 paragraph 19 permits departure from a specific IFRS requirement when compliance would be so misleading that it would conflict with the objective of financial statements, while confining such departures to extremely rare circumstances. Rather than treating rarity as an anomaly, we examine the professional process through which a principles-based departure becomes difficult to defend. Drawing on 23 semi-structured interviews with senior preparers, auditors, controllers, technical advisors and academics in Brazil, we develop the concept of argumentative cost asymmetry: textual compliance can ordinarily be justified by reference to the standard itself, whereas departure requires the preparer to construct and sustain a position before auditors, governance bodies and regulators. A focus group of twelve final-year accounting undergraduates is used only to examine how this asymmetry is anticipated and reproduced through professional formation. We complement the interview evidence with documentary analysis of COPASA (2021) and, as a subsequent case arising after the interview phase, Brava Energia (2024). Five themes show how global audit-firm methodologies, limited interpretive precedent, residual legalistic habits and professional education raise the relative cost of principles-based departure. Our contribution is not to argue that the override should be common, but to theorise argumentative cost as a mechanism through which principles-based accounting instruments can generate rule-oriented outcomes in practice. The findings are contextually grounded in Brazil and offer an analytically transferable mechanism for research on other high-judgment accounting decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过23个半结构化访谈、焦点小组、档案分析及两个案例（COPASA 2021和Brava Energia 2024），提出"论证成本不对称"（argumentative cost asymmetry）概念，解释在IFRS原则导向框架下，偏离准则（override）为何在实践中极为罕见——因为合规可以被标准本身直接证成，而偏离则需要编制者构造并持续维护论证立场，面临来自审计师、治理机构和监管者的更高论证成本，从而使原则导向的会计准则在实务中产生规则导向的结果。
AI.research_question: 在IAS 1第19段允许"极其罕见"地偏离IFRS具体要求的背景下，原则导向的偏离为何在实践中变得难以辩护？哪些专业过程机制使这种偏离被系统性抑制？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将"极其罕见"的偏离视为异常现象，而忽略了其背后的专业过程机制。作者希望理解原则导向规则在实务中如何被转化为规则导向的实践结果，从而揭示IFRS灵活性在专业实践中被制度化约束的深层逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论证成本不对称（argumentative cost asymmetry）概念；整合了专业判断、职业形成（professional formation）、原则导向与规则导向会计的理论视角。
AI.method: 定性研究：23个巴西高级编制者、审计师、财务总监、技术顾问和学者的半结构化访谈；12名会计本科毕业生的焦点小组（检验不对称性如何通过职业形成被预期和再生产）；COPASA（2021）和Brava Energia（2024）两份档案案例的文档分析。
AI.findings: 识别出五个主题：全球审计公司方法论、有限解释先例、残余的法律主义习惯和专业教育共同提高了原则导向偏离的相对成本，从而使偏离在实务中几乎不可行，形成论证成本不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"论证成本不对称"作为理论机制，解释原则导向会计工具如何产生规则导向的实务结果；提供了一个可分析性转移的机制，适用于其他高判断性会计决策研究；不主张override应当普遍化，而是理论化其被抑制的运作机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 对准则制定者、审计师和监管者揭示专业实践对IFRS灵活性的制度性约束；为理解全球审计方法论、监管环境和职业培训如何共同塑造会计实务提供洞见；研究背景植根于巴西但机制具有跨国适用性。

title: From Journalism Website to Scholarly Infrastructure: Governance, Accountability and Procedural Fairness in Retraction Watch
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: From Journalism Website to Scholarly Infrastructure: Governance, Accountability and Procedural Fairness in Retraction Watch

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No external funding was received.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable.

detail.abstract: Retraction Watch is a journalism website published by the Center for Scientific Integrity (CSI), a United States non-profit organisation, rather than a statutory regulator, university investigation body or elected scientific authority. Its activities now extend beyond reporting because the Retraction Watch Database is maintained under an agreement with Crossref, distributed through Crossref services and incorporated into Web of Science and other scholarly systems. This transition from reporting website to data infrastructure gives privately curated classifications wider institutional and reputational consequences. Using a critical narrative review of public material available through 23 July 2026, this Perspective examines organisational mandate, governance, funding disclosure, editorial independence, role convergence within CSI, story selection, rankings, anonymous sourcing, rights of reply, corrections, database classification, provenance, downstream propagation and institutional reliance. The reviewed materials identify leadership, board membership, funding sources, tax returns, an editorial-independence statement, a comments policy and database documentation, but they did not reveal a prominently described independent appeals mechanism, external editorial ombudsperson, comprehensive public corrections register, systematic story-level recusal reporting or complete record-level correction-propagation procedure. This finding is limited to publicly discoverable material and does not establish that internal procedures are absent. The article argues that visibility, repeated citation, partnerships and technical integration do not confer adjudicative authority, and it proposes proportionate safeguards for source verification, conflict disclosure, correction, review and status labelling. It makes no allegation of improper motive or misconduct by Retraction Watch, CSI, their personnel, funders or partners.

AI.tldr: 本文通过关键性叙事综述，审视了Retraction Watch从新闻报道网站转型为数据基础设施的过程，指出其私人策展分类在机构性和声誉性方面产生了更广泛的影响。文章审查了其组织授权、治理、资金披露、编辑独立性等，发现缺乏独立上诉机制、外部编辑监察员、全面公开更正登记等程序，并提议在信息验证、利益冲突披露、更正、审查和状态标示方面制定相称的保障措施。
AI.research_question: Retraction Watch从新闻报道网站转型为学术数据基础设施后，其组织治理、编辑独立性和数据分类是否具备与其日益增长的制度性影响力相匹配的问责机制？
AI.motivation: Retraction Watch通过Crossref协议、Web of Science等系统融入学术基础设施，其私人策展分类对学术声誉和机构决策产生广泛影响，但其治理和问责机制的有效性尚未被系统审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识基础设施理论、编辑问责制理论、机构权威与合法性的批判视角。
AI.method: 关键性叙事综述（critical narrative review），基于截至2026年7月23日的公开材料进行分析。
AI.findings: 公开材料未揭示独立上诉机制、外部编辑监察员、全面公开更正登记、系统性故事级回避报告或完整的记录级更正传播程序；可见性、引证、合作和技术整合并不赋予裁决性权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出可见性、引证和基础设施融合不能自动转化为裁决权威的论点，拓展了对私人数据策展机构问责机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提议建立来源验证、利益冲突披露、更正、审查和状态标示等相称保障措施，为类似数据基础设施机构提供治理改进参考。

title: Where does Advantage Reside? Competitive Strategy in Corporate Health Plans

detail.title: Where does Advantage Reside? Competitive Strategy in Corporate Health Plans
detail.abstract: This paper examines where sustainable sources of competitive advantage reside for health insurance operators in the Brazilian corporate group segment, drawing on Besanko et al. (2012), Barney (1991), and Peteraf (1993). Design/methodology/approach: Industry structural analysis is combined with empirical evidence extracted from the National Health Insurance Beneficiaries Information System (SIB/ANS) for the state of São Paulo with 73.6 million records of inactive policyholders in pure corporate group plans, processed using survival analysis techniques (Kaplan-Meier, Nelson-Aalen, and Cox regression), implemented with the lifelines package for Python (Davidson-Pilon et al., 2019). Employment tenure data from the Annual Social Information Report (RAIS/MTE) for the period 2015-2023, accessed via Base dos Dados (2024) through Google BigQuery, are used for comparative purposes. Findings: The median survival time is 63 months and 62.76% of cancellations correspond to compulsory terminations due to job loss, revealing that the primary retention force in the segment is structural, derived from the employment bond and equally available to all operators, rather than strategic. Compared to the median employment tenure of 11.1 months for terminated formal jobs in São Paulo in 2023, policyholders remain in the health plan approximately five times longer, a ratio stable across the nine-year series analyzed. This gap is not evidence of loyalty but, it reflects the recirculation of workers between firms contracting the same operator, a labormarket network effect that no operator deliberately built. Constructed retention, operating on the Human Resources (HR) manager of the contracting firm through operational integration, accumulated population knowledge, and geographic network specificity, constitutes the genuine source of sustainable competitive advantage. Cox regression estimates a hazard ratio of 1.50 (95% CI: 1.32-1.70; p = 5.5 x 10-10) for voluntary cancellation among beneficiaries who arrived via portability, documenting that prior migration predicts future migration. Research implications: The paper proposes the distinction between structural retention and constructed retention as an original conceptual contribution to strategy research in regulated health markets. It operationalizes VRIO criteria within a sector where product differentiation is institutionally constrained and demonstrates that the primary retention mechanism fails the rarity criterion. Future research should use longitudinal employer-beneficiary matching data to establish causal estimates of switching-cost accumulation. Practical implications: Operators that confound structural inertia with built switching costs systematically overestimate their competitive position. The strategic question is not which product to offer given that the minimum is set by regulation but, which population to know better than any competitor, and how to translate that knowledge into an integration with the HR manager that raises switching costs over time. Social implications: Artificial intelligence amplifies analytical advantages for operators who have already built longitudinal data trajectories but also enables sophisticated adverse selection. The paper highlights a current regulatory gap in Brazil regarding AI use in health insurance pricing and beneficiary selection, with reference to the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) and the Brazilian AI Legal Framework (Law 21.538/2025). Originality/value: This is the first study to apply survival analysis at this scale (73.6 million records) to corporate group health plan data in Brazil, and the first to crossvalidate plan tenure against employment tenure using public RAIS microdata. The structural retention/constructed retention distinction provides a theoretically grounded diagnostic tool for strategy in regulated insurance markets.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Besanko等人（2012）、Barney（1991）和Peteraf（1993）的理论框架，研究了巴西企业团体健康保险细分市场中可持续竞争优势的来源。通过分析圣保罗州7360万条纯企业团体计划记录（采用Kaplan-Meier、Nelson-Aalen和Cox回归等生存分析方法），发现中位生存时间为63个月，62.76%的退保源于失业导致的强制性终止，表明该细分市场主要的保留力量是源于雇佣关系的结构性因素（所有运营商同等可用），而非战略性因素。文章提出"结构性保留"与"建构性保留"的区分——建构性保留（通过对签约企业人力资源经理的操作整合、累积人口知识和地理网络特异性来实现）才是真正的可持续竞争优势来源。Cox回归显示，通过可携性（portability）进入的受益人自愿退保的风险比（hazard ratio）为1.50（95% CI: 1.32-1.70），说明先前的迁移行为能预测未来的迁移行为。
AI.research_question: 巴西企业团体健康保险细分市场中，可持续竞争优势的来源究竟在哪里？
AI.motivation: 在受监管的健康保险市场中，产品差异化受到制度性约束，运营商的竞争优势来源尚不明确。本研究试图厘清哪些保留机制是结构性的（所有运营商均等可得），哪些是真正建构性的（可构成可持续竞争优势）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）——Barney（1991）的VRIO框架、Peteraf（1993）的竞争优势理论、Besanko等人（2012）的行业结构分析
AI.method: 行业结构分析与实证数据相结合。使用SIB/ANS系统圣保罗州7360万条纯企业团体计划退保记录，采用生存分析技术（Kaplan-Meier、Nelson-Aalen、Cox回归），通过Python的lifelines包实现。并用RAIS/MTE的2015-2023年就业年限数据进行交叉验证（通过Base dos Dados/Google BigQuery访问）。
AI.findings: 1) 中位生存时间为63个月，62.76%的退保源于失业导致的强制性终止，主要保留力量是结构性（源于雇佣关系）而非战略性；2) 与2023年圣保罗正式工作岗位中位就业年限11.1个月相比，保单持有人留在健康计划的时间约为其5倍，且在九年序列中比例稳定；3) 这种差距不是忠诚度的证据，而是反映工人在这家运营商签约的不同企业之间循环流动的劳动力市场网络效应；4) Cox回归估计可携性进入者的自愿退保风险比为1.50（95% CI: 1.32-1.70；p = 5.5 x 10^-10），表明先前迁移可预测未来迁移。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"结构性保留"与"建构性保留"的区分，作为受监管健康市场中战略研究的原创概念贡献。在制度性限制产品差异化的行业中操作化VRIO标准，并证明主要保留机制（结构性保留）未通过稀缺性（rarity）标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提醒运营商不要将结构性惯性误认为已建构的转换成本，否则会系统性高估自身竞争地位；2) 战略问题不是提供什么产品（最低标准由监管设定），而是比任何竞争对手更了解哪个人群，以及如何将这种知识转化为与人力资源经理的整合，随时间提升转换成本；3) 指出AI在巴西健康保险定价和受益人选择方面的监管空白，对比欧盟AI法案（Regulation 2024/1689）和巴西AI法律框架（Law 21.538/2025）。

title: The Missing Explanation: Why Middle Managers are Seldom Asked How they Read the Goal, and Why that can Destroy Organizations
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Missing Explanation: Why Middle Managers are Seldom Asked How they Read the Goal, and Why that can Destroy Organizations
detail.abstract:
Organizational management rests on a foundational assumption: that clearly stated goals, translated into well-designed performance indicators, will guide behavior toward desired outcomes. This assumption has failed repeatedly-and spectacularlyin cases ranging from Boeing's 737 MAX certification to Wells Fargo's cross-selling scandal. In each instance, goals were reasonable, indicators were met, and yet organizations drifted systematically toward failure. 

The paradox has a simple, overlooked institutional cause. Goal-setters-CEOs, boards, politicians-are required to explain their goals upward (to boards, parliaments, shareholders). Indicator designers-control functions-are required to justify their metrics (to audit, compliance). But middle managers-who translate abstract goals into operational logic and shape the indicators that follow-are subject to no institutional obligation to explain to anyone how they read the Goal, how they translated it, or why they designed indicators the way they did. In practice, they are seldom asked to do so. This missing obligation is the weak link in every management chain. The Subjective Reading (SR) that mediates between Goals and Indicators is the one thing almost no one is required to articulate-and that institutional silence is where the seeds of organizational failure are sown. 

This paper proposes GSI (Goal-Subjective Reading-Indicator) theory to resolve the paradox. We argue that organizational behavior is driven neither by formal Goals nor by performance Indicators, but by the SR that middle managers construct. The SR is a motivated, selective interpretation shaped by five identifiable sources: risk and blame avoidance, local adaptation, anticipated resistance, professional boundary maintenance, and organizational influence. Indicators subsequently quantify the SR, not the Goal-and because the SR is seldom explained, audited, or held accountable, its drift remains structurally invisible. The result is stable organizational failure: indicators improve, goals recede, accountability collapses, and almost no one in the chain is ever asked to explain the translation that caused it all. 

GSI makes two core contributions. First, it identifies the missing institutional obligation-the requirement to explain one's SR-as the structural blind spot in organizational management. Second, it proposes the GSI Pre-Alignment Meeting as a mechanism that creates precisely that obligation: middle managers must explain their SR to top management before execution begins. By reframing management as fundamentally a problem of semantic alignment-and by institutionalizing an explanation that is seldom required-GSI redirects organization theory from optimizing indicators to governing interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GSI（目标-主观解读-指标）理论，解释组织为何在目标合理、指标达标的情况下仍系统性走向失败。核心论点：中间管理者的主观解读（SR）是驱动组织行为的真正力量，但这一解读在制度上无人要求其解释，形成结构性盲点。论文提出GSI预对齐会议作为制度机制，强制中层管理者在执行前向高层说明其主观解读，从而将组织管理从指标优化转向语义对齐治理。
AI.research_question: 为什么在目标明确合理、绩效指标均被满足的情况下，组织仍会系统性地偏离预期结果而走向失败？
AI.motivation: 波音737 MAX认证和富国银行交叉销售丑闻等案例表明，管理链条中普遍存在"目标合理、指标达标、组织却失败"的悖论，而现有管理理论无法解释这一系统性现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: GSI理论（Goal-Subjective Reading-Indicator）：认为组织行为由中层管理者构建的主观解读（SR）驱动，SR受五种来源塑造：风险与责备规避、局部适应、预期阻力、专业边界维护和组织影响力。指标量化的不是目标本身，而是主观解读。
AI.method: 理论构建论文，基于多案例的悖论分析，提出GSI理论框架及制度性机制（GSI预对齐会议）。
AI.findings: 中层管理者在目标与指标之间扮演主观解读者的角色，但制度上不要求其向任何人解释其解读过程。目标是向上解释的，指标是向下验证的，唯独中间的主观解读缺乏制度性问责义务，导致解读漂移在结构上不可见，最终形成"指标改善、目标退隐、问责崩塌"的稳定组织失败模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 第一，识别出缺失的制度义务——要求解释主观解读——是组织管理的结构性盲点；第二，将管理重新定义为根本上的语义对齐问题，将组织理论的关注点从优化指标转向治理解释。提出GSI预对齐会议作为将该义务制度化的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供GSI预对齐会议作为可操作的制度机制，要求中层管理者在执行前向高层说明其主观解读，从而在翻译环节建立问责链条，防止组织因解读漂移而系统性失败。

title:
The Critical Few: Designing Manageable KPI Portfolios and Rethinking Managerial Span of
Control
affiliations: Swiss Management Centre University (Switzerland)

detail.title:
The Critical Few: Designing Manageable KPI Portfolios and Rethinking Managerial Span of
Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: My own work
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract: Organisations often seek a universal answer to how many key performance indicators (KPIs) a manager should own. This conceptual paper argues that the search for a fixed number is misguided. KPI manageability depends on strategic relevance, causal clarity, controllability, measurement frequency, interdependence, decision authority and the cognitive and analytical capacity available to the responsible manager. Drawing on performance-measurement, balanced-scorecard, attention and span-of-control perspectives, the paper distinguishes true KPIs from diagnostic and operational metrics and proposes a layered KPI-portfolio model. At organisational level, a limited set of outcome and driver indicators communicates strategic priorities; at managerial level, each indicator is assigned to an owner with authority to influence it; and supporting metrics are retained for diagnosis without being presented as equal priorities. Digital dashboards and intelligent alerts can widen information-processing capacity but do not eliminate managerial limits. Indeed, automation may increase overload when it makes weak measures easier to produce. The paper proposes that KPI portfolios should be evaluated by decision usefulness and behavioural consequences rather than numerical conformity. It offers design principles, propositions and an audit process for aligning indicator responsibility with managerial span of control.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了组织普遍追求的"管理者应拥有多少个KPI"的固定答案。文章认为KPI的可管理性取决于战略相关性、因果清晰度、可控性、测量频率、相互依赖性、决策权限以及管理者可用的认知和分析能力。文章提出分层KPI组合模型：组织层面设置有限的结果和驱动指标以沟通战略重点；管理者层面每个指标分配有影响力的负责人；支持性指标保留用于诊断但不作为同等优先级呈现。数字仪表盘和智能警报可扩展信息处理能力但不能消除管理限制，甚至可能因使弱指标更易生成而增加过载。KPI组合应以决策有用性和行为后果为评估标准，而非数字数量的一致性。
AI.research_question: 管理者应该拥有多少个关键绩效指标（KPI）？或者说，是否存在一个通用的固定KPI数量答案，以及如何设计合理的KPI组合/组合管理原则？
AI.motivation: 组织普遍在寻找"管理者应拥有多少个KPI"的固定答案，但这种追求被认为是有误导性的。需要一个更系统的概念框架来替代数字化的简单回答。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绩效测量、平衡计分卡、注意力理论和控制跨度（span of control）等理论视角。
AI.method: 概念性论文（conceptual paper），通过理论综合提出分层KPI组合模型、设计原则、命题和审计流程。
AI.findings: KPI可管理性不能以固定数量衡量，需考虑战略相关性、因果清晰度、可控性、测量频率、相互依赖性、决策权限及认知分析能力等多维因素；提出分层组合模型区分真KPI、诊断指标和运营指标；数字工具可扩展信息处理容量但不能消除管理局限，甚至可能增加过载；应通过决策有用性和行为后果评估KPI组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力理论和控制跨度理论引入KPI管理领域，挑战了追求固定KPI数量的传统观念，提出了分层KPI组合模型作为新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供KPI组合设计原则、命题和审计流程，帮助管理者按控制跨度合理分配指标责任，避免数字化工具导致的信息过载。

detail.title: The state of public sector and privatization in Russia in 2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors have no any personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not require ethics approval
