detail.title: Flags in Relation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Raven: A Journal of Vexillology, forthcoming

detail.abstract: Analysis of the aesthetics of flag design should extend beyond considering flags in isolation. It should also appreciate how flags function in conjunction with other flags. Specifically, flags should be understood 1) as representatives of flag design genres; 2) in their hierarchical or functional connections; 3) as constituent parts of physical ensembles of multiple flags; and 4) for their place in historical movements of flag design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出旗帜设计的美学分析不应仅限于孤立地审视单一旗帜，而应将其置于更广泛的语境中理解，包括作为设计类型代表、层级或功能联系、多旗物理组合的组成部分，以及旗计设计历史运动中的位置。
AI.research_question: 旗帜设计的美学分析如何超越孤立视角，在更广泛的语境中理解旗帜的功能与意义？
AI.motivation: 传统旗帜设计分析往往将旗帜视为独立个体进行审美评判，忽略了旗帜在实际使用中总是与其他旗帜共同出现、相互关联的现实，因此需要建立一种更具语境化的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旗帜设计美学理论、设计类型学、符号学与语境分析方法
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析方法，提出四个维度的分析框架
AI.findings: 旗帜设计的美学分析应从四个维度扩展：（1）旗帜作为设计类型的代表；（2）旗帜间的层级或功能联系；（3）多旗物理组合的构成部分；（4）旗帜在历史设计运动中的位置。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种超越孤立视角的旗帜设计美学分析框架，将旗帜置于类型学、功能关系、物理组合和历史运动四种语境中进行理解，丰富了旗帜设计的理论研究维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旗帜设计师、策展人和研究者提供了更全面的分析工具，帮助他们在设计和评价旗帜时考虑多层次的语境因素。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Assisted Quantum-Inspired Evolutionary Algorithm for Cyber Risk-Aware Autonomous Ambulance Allocation and Routing: A 2025 Los Angeles Wildfire Case Study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tecnológico de Monterrey - Escuela de Ingenieria y Ciencias, University of Ottawa and Tecnológico de Monterrey

detail.title: Reinforcement Learning-Assisted Quantum-Inspired Evolutionary Algorithm for Cyber Risk-Aware Autonomous Ambulance Allocation and Routing: A 2025 Los Angeles Wildfire Case Study
detail.abstract: The rise of autonomous vehicles (AVs) in transportation holds promise for revolutionizing emergency healthcare logistics. Ambulance allocation and routing is a real-time, dynamic, NP-hard problem complicated further by cyber-physical vulnerabilities that may disrupt communication and operational reliability. This study formulates the cyber risk-aware Autonomous Ambulance Allocation and Routing Problem (AARP) as a weighted multi-objective optimization problem, minimizing a composite of patient service completion times and delay penalties across priority tiers, while accounting for cyber-induced service interruptions through a robust disruption-budget model grounded in reliability engineering parameters. To solve this problem, we propose Q2GA, a reinforcement learning-assisted quantum-inspired genetic algorithm that dynamically tunes rotation-gate parameters via an ε-greedy Q-learning controller, enhancing exploration and exploitation without manual parameter scheduling. Unlike fixed-angle quantum genetic algorithms, Q2GA adapts its rotation policy based on population diversity and fitness signals, enabling more effective navigation of complex solution spaces. Benchmarked against a standard GA, Simulated Annealing, and a baseline QGA across three instance scales, Q2GA achieves the best mean solution quality on the small and medium instances; on the large instance its mean is statistically indistinguishable from that of simulated annealing, and its advantage shifts from mean fitness to run-to-run consistency. Sensitivity analysis reveals that disruption scope has a larger system-wide impact than recovery duration, a finding with direct implications for fleet cyber-resilience strategy. A simulation case study based on the 2025 Los Angeles Palisades Fire, combining real road-network geometry and reported infrastructure outages with simulated patients, triage classes and disruptions, evaluates the framework under geographically heterogeneous disruption conditions, where Q2GA exhibits the least performance degradation among all algorithms. The source code and simulation metadata are openly available; see the Data Availability statement.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种网络风险感知的自主救护车分配与路径规划问题（AARP），将其建模为加权多目标优化问题，并设计了Q2GA——一种强化学习辅助的量子启发遗传算法，该算法通过ε-greedy Q-learning控制器动态调整旋转门参数。在多个实例规模和2025年洛杉矶Palisades火灾案例研究中，Q2GA展现出优越或相当的求解性能，并揭示了扰动范围比恢复时长对系统影响更大的关键发现。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个考虑网络物理安全风险的自主救护车分配与路径规划框架，以在信息物理系统脆弱性下优化紧急医疗物流效率？
AI.motivation: 救护车分配与路径规划是实时、动态的NP-hard问题，且网络物理漏洞可能干扰通信和运行可靠性。现有研究缺乏对网络风险的系统建模与感知，需要开发既能处理复杂优化又能应对网络中断的鲁棒解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加权多目标优化理论；可靠性工程中的鲁棒扰动预算模型；量子遗传算法（QGA）与Q-learning强化学习理论。
AI.method: 将AARP建模为加权多目标优化问题；提出Q2GA算法，利用ε-greedy Q-learning控制器动态调整量子旋转门参数；与标准GA、模拟退火和基线QGA在三种实例规模上进行基准对比；基于真实路网和基础设施中断数据开展2025年洛杉矶Palisades火灾仿真案例研究。
AI.findings: Q2GA在小和中型实例上取得最佳平均解质量；在大型实例上平均性能与模拟退火统计上无显著差异，优势从均值转向运行一致性；敏感性分析显示扰动范围比恢复时长具有更大的系统级影响；在Palisades火灾案例中Q2GA的性能退化最小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将网络物理风险感知整合到自主救护车分配与路径规划问题中；提出动态自适应旋转角机制的量子遗传算法，超越固定角度QGA；建立了扰动范围与恢复时长对系统影响差异的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为紧急医疗物流的舰队网络韧性问题提供直接战略启示（优先控制扰动范围）；开源代码和仿真元数据便于实际部署与复现；在真实灾害场景（Palisades火灾）中验证了框架的可行性与鲁棒性。

title: Structural Origination and Creation Capability: Authoring Competitive Terrain in an AI-Driven World
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Structural Origination and Creation Capability: Authoring Competitive Terrain in an AI-Driven World
detail.abstract:
The most consequential strategic question in a world of continuous structural transformation is not whether organizations can recognize emerging competitive logics or respond to them effectively. It is whether they can author the governing premises of the next structural plane before others define it — and in doing so determine the logic within which competition subsequently unfolds. Existing strategy and organization theory has built substantial explanatory power around the problem of response: how organizations sense, adapt, reconstruct, and reposition once structural change becomes recognizable. What this tradition does not specify is the prior condition that determines whether adaptation is the only option available or whether authorship remains structurally possible.

Building on the Integrating Structure and Life Energy (ISLE) framework, the article establishes that structural transformation originates prior to field-level recognition — as ideational variation within perceptual systems — and that the interval between origination and field-level visibility is the only interval in which the governing premises of the next structural plane remain open for construction rather than adaptation. It introduces interpretive foresight as the structural condition — not a cognitive capability but an emergent architectural property — that determines whether a perceptual entity can engage that interval before it closes. Interpretive foresight is perishable: it is continuously eroded by the same consolidation processes that generate organizational success, making its deliberate construction and preservation a prior strategic imperative.

Interpretive foresight creates a foresight decision point that existing theory does not specify: a temporally bounded bifurcation between perpetuation — directing developmental capacity toward reconstructing interpretive authority within the plane others are constructing — and exploration — using the foresight window to originate a structural plane that renders the emerging competitive terrain a secondary contest. The article develops structural origination as the capacity to construct the governing premises of a structural plane that does not yet exist, specifies the Perpetuator and Explorer as categorically distinct archetypes, and introduces creation capability — high sensing intelligence, high permeability, and flexible structures anchored in purpose rather than premises — as the organizational configuration under which structural origination becomes possible.

Artificial intelligence intensifies the asymmetry between these orientations. For Perpetuator-archetype entities, AI reinforces incumbent premises while compressing the reconstruction interval on which perpetuation depends. For Explorer-archetype entities with maintained interpretive elasticity, AI functions as the primary instrument of construction itself — enabling second-order origination: the capacity to construct a new structural plane while designing the conditions for that plane's own future reconstruction. Under conditions of AI-driven continuous structural transformation — in which structural planes may be generated faster than any single plane can consolidate — response-based competitive advantage reaches its structural limit. Creation capability shifts under these conditions from a source of competitive advantage to the condition of sustained competitive existence.

AI.tldr: 本文基于ISLE框架提出"解释性预见"（interpretive foresight）作为结构性条件，决定组织能否在结构转型被领域识别之前"编写"下一个结构平面的治理前提而非被动适应。文章引入"结构创生"（structural origination）概念，区分Perpetuator与Explorer两类原型组织，并论证在AI驱动的持续结构转型下，创造能力从竞争优势来源转变为持续竞争生存的条件。
AI.research_question: 组织能否在他人定义下一个结构平面之前，编写其治理前提并决定竞争展开的逻辑？什么结构性条件决定了"作者身份"（authorship）在结构上仍然可能，而非仅剩适应（adaptation）这一选项？
AI.motivation: 现有战略与组织理论在"回应"问题上建立了强大解释力（感知、适应、重构、重新定位），但未阐明一个前提条件：什么决定了适应是否是唯一选择，或是作者身份在结构上仍然可能。这一理论空白在AI驱动的持续结构转型时代变得尤为关键。
AI.theoretical_framework: ISLE框架（整合结构与生命能量）、解释性预见（interpretive foresight）作为涌现性架构属性、结构创生（structural origination）、Perpetuator与Explorer原型、二阶创生（second-order origination）、创造能力（creation capability）
AI.method: 理论构建/概念性论文：基于ISLE框架进行理论演绎，引入新概念（解释性预见、结构创生、创造能力）并构建原型分类（Perpetuator vs. Explorer），分析AI情境下的理论含义。
AI.findings: （1）结构转型起源于领域级识别之前——作为感知系统内的观念变异，起源与可见性之间的间隔是治理前提仍开放的唯一窗口；（2）解释性预见是可腐坏的，被产生组织成功的同一巩固过程持续侵蚀；（3）AI加剧两类原型的非对称性：对Perpetuator强化既有前提并压缩重建间隔，对具有解释弹性的Explorer则成为构造工具本身；（4）在AI驱动的持续结构转型下，基于回应的竞争优势达到结构性极限，创造能力从竞争优势来源转变为持续竞争存在的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将战略理论从"回应"问题前移至"作者身份"问题，填补了现理论未指定的前提条件；（2）引入解释性预见作为结构性条件（而非认知能力），拓展了战略理论的架构维度；（3）提出结构创生与二阶创生概念，为理解持续结构转型下的竞争提供了新理论框架；（4）明确Perpetuator与Explorer作为范畴上不同的原型，丰富了组织战略类型学；（5）将创造能力重新定位为持续竞争生存的条件而非竞争优势来源。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为组织领导者提供了"预见决策点"（foresight decision point）的识别框架，帮助其在结构窗口关闭前做出战略选择；（2）阐明了保持解释性弹性（可渗透性、目的锚定的灵活结构）的组织设计原则；（3）提示AI时代Perpetuator型组织的战略风险及其被压缩的重建间隔；（4）为AI情境下的战略制定提供了从"响应竞争"转向"结构创生"的实践指导。

title: Two-Phase Phase-Type Queues: Closed-Form Distributions and the Numerical Accuracy Landscape of BuTools

detail.title: Two-Phase Phase-Type Queues: Closed-Form Distributions and the Numerical Accuracy Landscape of BuTools

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Two-phase phase-type (P H 2) queues occupy a unique position in queueing theory: flexible enough to capture both low-and high-variability service processes, yet structured enough to admit complete algebraic characterization. Despite their prevalence in telecommunications, healthcare, and manufacturing, their explicit steady-state and sojourn-time distributions have not been collected in a single treatment with systematic numerical validation. We derive closed-form queuelength distributions p n = A 1 r n 1 + A 2 r n 2 and sojourn-time densities for the complete M/P H 2 /1 family (Erlang-2, hypoexponential-2, hyperexponential-2, and Coxian-2), with all coefficients given as explicit functions of system parameters. Comprehensive validation against BuTools maps the numerical accuracy landscape of matrix-analytic computation: queue-length evaluation achieves machine-precision accuracy across extreme parameter ranges (ρ up to 0.999, C 2 s exceeding 10,000), while sojourn-time evaluation via the matrix exponential loses up to 10 significant digits when high traffic intensity and high service variability act jointly. The symbolic expressions enable analytical operations inaccessible to numerical output: exact sensitivity analysis, closed-form threshold optimization, and rigorous tail-probability guarantees. We prove that P H 2 marks the boundary of algebraic tractability: even the simplest three-phase queue (M/E 3 /1) has a universally negative discriminant, forcing complex roots at every traffic intensity, so that its distribution cannot be expressed as a sum of real geometric terms. For k ≥ 5 phases, the Abel-Ruffini theorem precludes radical solutions entirely. The results serve as a ready-to-use reference for two-phase service models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地推导了完整M/PH2/1队列族（包括Erlang-2、hypoexponential-2、hyperexponential-2和Coxian-2）的闭式队列长度分布和逗留时间密度，所有系数均为系统参数的显式函数。通过与BuTools的全面验证，绘制了矩阵解析计算的数值精度图谱：队列长度评估在极端参数范围（ρ高达0.999，C2s超过10,000）内达到机器精度，而逗留时间评估在高流量强度和高服务变异性联合作用时最多损失10位有效数字。本文还证明了PH2标志着代数可处理性的边界：M/E3/1的判别式普遍为负，而k≥5阶段时Abel-Ruffini定理排除了根式解。
AI.research_question: 如何系统地推导完整的M/PH2/1队列族的闭式稳态分布和逗留时间分布，并刻画矩阵解析计算的数值精度边界以及PH2在代数可处理性中的理论边界？
AI.motivation: 尽管PH2队列在电信、医疗和制造业中广泛应用，但其显式稳态分布和逗留时间分布尚未在单一文献中以系统数值验证的方式完整收集。现有矩阵解析方法无法提供闭式表达式，限制了精确灵敏度分析、阈值优化和尾部概率保证等解析操作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 队列理论中的PH2（双阶段相型）分布理论、矩阵解析计算（Matrix-Analytic Methods）、代数判别式理论、Abel-Ruffini定理。
AI.method: 推导M/PH2/1队列的闭式解（以p_n = A1*r1^n + A2*r2^n形式给出队列长度分布），计算逗留时间密度函数；利用BuTools工具包进行系统数值验证，绘制数值精度图谱；通过判别式分析和Abel-Ruffini定理证明PH2的代数可处理性边界。
AI.findings: （1）完整推导了M/PH2/1家族四种子模型（Erlang-2、hypoexponential-2、hyperexponential-2、Coxian-2）的闭式分布，所有系数均为系统参数的显式函数；（2）队列长度评估在极值参数范围内达到机器精度，但逗留时间评估在ρ和C2s同时增大时最多损失10位有效数字；（3）证明了M/E3/1的判别式对所有流量强度均为负，分布无法表示为实数几何项之和；（4）k≥5阶段时，Abel-Ruffini定理排除了根式解的存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在单一文献中系统且完整地收集了M/PH2/1家族所有子模型的闭式分布；严格证明了PH2是代数可处理性的精确边界（M/E3/1判别式普遍为负）；通过Abel-Ruffini定理为k≥5阶段情形提供了不可解性证明。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接使用的双阶段服务模型参考手册；使精确灵敏度分析、闭式阈值优化和严格尾部概率保证成为可能；为实践者在矩阵解析计算中选择合适方法提供了数值精度指南（尤其是在高流量强度和高变异性的场景下）。

title: A Benchmark for Measuring How Much a Strategy’s Performance Moves When the Market Environment Is Varied, Rather Than How High It Is on the One Environment That Happened to Occur

detail.title: A Benchmark for Measuring How Much a Strategy’s Performance Moves When the Market Environment Is Varied, Rather Than How High It Is on the One Environment That Happened to Occur
detail.abstract: A backtest is one draw from a distribution of histories that never got run. Indian equity markets over our study window contain roughly one pandemic crash, one full rate cycle and one structural liquidity shift, so a claim that a strategy is “robust across regimes” rests on a handful of effective observations no matter how many sessions were simulated. Paper 1 of this programme asked whether a machine-written strategy is real. The survivors it handed forward survived one sequence of events, and that is a weaker claim than it looks. We release RegimeStress: a benchmark for measuring how much a strategy’s performance moves when the environment changes. It provides a causally-labelled regime series over 1,233 sessions, estimated by expanding-window refits with a forward-only decode so that no label uses information from after the session it describes; Counterfactual Regime Resampling, a stationary block bootstrap conditioned on regime label that manufactures plausible histories that did not happen; a moment-validation suite those synthetic histories must pass; two stress tiers of very different cost; and a frozen strategy population whose exclusion rules were fixed before any stress path was run. The central methodological result: a shortcut reproduced performance and did not reproduce fragility. Resampling a strategy’s realised returns agrees with full counterfactual re-simulation at Spearman 0.897 on mean performance but only 0.620 on fragility (n = 125), and fragility is the quantity of interest. A second shortcut, measured the same way, holds at 0.963 and is adopted. Shortcut safety is an experiment here, not a design decision. The benchmark’s first prediction task is a null, and we diagnose it rather than report it bare. Fragility cannot be predicted from strategy characteristics at this sample size: five models on identical folds reach an out-of-sample R2 of +0.024 across 109 strategies and 26 features. A permutation test nonetheless rejects the null for the ranking while failing to reject it for the level. Trained unchanged and applied to 60 strategies from three frontier models as held-out data, the predictor reaches R2 = −0.004: no better than a constant. The failure is a property of the problem, not of one small model’s output. Fragility itself proved generator-independent, every frontier arm’s median landing within a sixth of the local corpus’s, while one measured pathology did not recur at all.

AI.tldr: 本文发布RegimeStress基准，用于衡量策略性能随环境变化的脆弱性。通过因果标注的制度序列、反事实制度重采样和矩验证套件，构建了可产生"从未发生的历史"的测试环境。核心方法论发现：性能捷径可以复现性能但无法复现脆弱性（Spearman相关性仅0.620），而另一种捷径达到了0.963并被采纳。基准的第一个预测任务是零假设检验——脆弱性在该样本量下无法从策略特征预测（OOS R²=0.024），排列检验拒绝排名零假设但未拒绝水平零假设，表明这是问题本身的属性而非模型缺陷。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量策略在制度变化下的脆弱性？脆弱性是否可以从策略特征中预测？
AI.motivation: 印度股票市场研究窗口内仅包含约一次疫情崩盘、一个完整利率周期和一次结构性流动性转变，声称策略"跨制度稳健"仅基于少数有效观测。需要更严格的基准来衡量策略对环境的敏感性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反事实分析、制度切换模型、平稳块自助法（stationary block bootstrap）、排列检验、零假设检验
AI.method: 构建RegimeStress基准，包含：(1) 1,233个交易日的因果标注制度序列（扩展窗口重拟合+前向解码）；(2) 反事实制度重采样（按制度标签条件化的平稳块自助法）；(3) 矩验证套件；(4) 两个成本悬殊的压力层级；(5) 冻结的策略种群。比较两种捷径与全反事实重模拟的相关性，并对脆弱性预测进行交叉验证和排列检验。
AI.findings: (1) 性能捷径在均值性能上达到Spearman 0.897，但在脆弱性上仅0.620，而第二种捷径达到0.963并被采用；(2) 脆弱性无法从26个策略特征预测（OOS R²=0.024）；(3) 排列检验拒绝排名零假设但未拒绝水平零假设；(4) 应用于3个前沿模型的60个策略时R²=-0.004；(5) 脆弱性本身与生成器无关，所有前沿分支的中位数落点均在本地语料的六分之一范围内。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"捷径安全"应作为实验而非设计决策；证明性能可复制不等于脆弱性可复制；揭示脆弱性预测失败是问题固有属性而非方法缺陷；区分排名可预测性与水平不可预测性的统计差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布RegimeStress开源基准，提供因果标注制度序列、反事实重采样工具和冻结策略种群，便于研究者以标准化方式评估策略面临制度变化的脆弱性。

title: Caring across cultures: A qualitative study of the workforce challenges and organizational issues of CALD aged care workers in Australia’s residential aged care sector
affiliations: Fudan University

detail.title: Caring across cultures: A qualitative study of the workforce challenges and organizational issues of CALD aged care workers in Australia’s residential aged care sector

keywords.keywords: Cultural diversity in the Australian residential aged care workforce: Challenges and opportunities.

detail.abstract: The elderly care workforce in Australia is becoming more culturally and linguistically diverse, underscoring the need to understand better the viewpoints of Culturally and Linguistically Diverse (CALD) workers in residential aged care. This qualitative descriptive study used semi-structured interviews with 38 CALD aged care providers across four Australian states. The findings show that organizational structures, cultural differences, and language barriers are important determinants of daily care practices and interactions with CALD patients. Cultural misunderstandings that caused emotional anguish and tiredness, and communication problems that affected the quality of therapy, were cited by respondents. The biggest barriers to culturally sensitive treatment were severe workloads, staff shortages, inflexible workplace policies, and limited access to culturally appropriate training. Employees also highlighted more fundamental structural concerns, such as a lack of funds and insufficient government policies to encourage culturally inclusive aged care services. Participants indicated the need for greater organizational support, more flexible person-centered care practices, and more cultural competence training. The report recommends measures to address labor shortages, workplace discrimination and legislative barriers to support CALD workers and improve the cultural safety and quality of elder care services in Australia.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对澳大利亚四个州38名文化和语言多样（CALD）养老护理人员进行半结构化访谈，探讨其在住宿式养老护理中的护理实践与互动体验。研究发现组织结构、文化差异和语言障碍是影响日常护理实践的重要因素，文化误解导致情感痛苦和疲惫，沟通问题影响护理质量。系统层面的障碍包括严重的工作量、人员短缺、僵化的工作政策以及缺乏文化适切培训；更深层问题涉及资金不足和政府政策缺失。参与者呼吁加强组织支持、更灵活的以人为本护理实践和更多文化能力培训。
AI.research_question: 文化和语言多样化（CALD）养老护理人员在澳大利亚住宿式养老护理中的护理实践和互动体验如何？哪些因素影响其日常护理实践和对CALD患者的照护质量？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚养老护理劳动力日益呈现文化和语言多样性，但对该群体在住宿式养老护理中的观点和经历理解不足，需要更好地理解CALD工人的视角以改善养老服务质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质性描述性研究（qualitative descriptive study）方法论框架
AI.method: 采用质性描述性研究设计，对澳大利亚四个州的38名CALD养老护理人员进行半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: （1）组织结构、文化差异和语言障碍是日常护理实践和患者互动的重要决定因素；（2）文化误解导致情感痛苦和疲惫，沟通问题影响护理质量；（3）文化敏感性照护的主要障碍包括严重工作负荷、人员短缺、僵化工作政策和缺乏文化适切培训；（4）更深层的结构性问题是资金不足和缺乏鼓励文化包容养老服务的政府政策；（5）参与者呼吁更多组织支持、灵活的以人为本护理实践和文化能力培训。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了文化多样化劳动力和跨文化护理领域的质性研究，系统揭示了CALD养老护理人员面临的多层次（个人、组织、政策）障碍，为理解文化安全和养老护理质量提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出解决劳动力短缺、工作场所歧视和立法障碍的具体建议，以支持CALD工人并改善澳大利亚养老护理服务的文化安全性和质量，为政策制定者和养老机构管理层提供实践指导。

title: From Deep Learning to Real-World Surveillance: A Case Study of Flock Safety's Automated License Plate Recognition Network

detail.title: From Deep Learning to Real-World Surveillance: A Case Study of Flock Safety's Automated License Plate Recognition Network

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This case study examines automated license plate recognition (ALPR) as a real-world application of deep learning, using Flock Safety, the largest ALPR provider in the United States, as the primary example. It first explains how convolutional neural networks (CNNs) make high-volume, unstructured image recognition possible, then examines how the technology has actually been used since its nationwide rollout. The study documents three governance failures: the use of local camera data for federal immigration enforcement without the knowledge or consent of the cities that installed the cameras; documented cases of individual officers using the system to track romantic partners and other private citizens; and weak transparency structures that allowed both problems to persist largely undetected until victims or journalists uncovered them independently. It also examines the company's response to these incidents, the resulting wave of contract cancellations and lawsuits, and the more informal public backlash that has included direct destruction of camera hardware. The study argues that the model's core technical performance is not the source of these harms; the harms stem from a governance and accountability gap between what the system is technically capable of and the safeguards built around its use. It concludes with concrete recommendations for closing that gap, drawing on prior work on purpose limitation and algorithmic auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文以Flock Safety（美国最大的自动车牌识别系统提供商）为案例，研究ALPR技术在现实中的应用。研究发现该技术存在三项治理失败：地方摄像头数据被联邦移民执法未经同意使用、个别警察滥用系统跟踪私人关系对象、以及透明度结构薄弱导致问题长期未被发现。论文主张技术本身并非伤害根源，治理与问责机制的缺失才是核心问题，并提出基于目的限制和算法审计的具体改进建议。
AI.research_question: 自动车牌识别（ALPR）技术作为深度学习在现实世界的应用，其治理失败的原因是什么？如何弥合技术能力与安全防护之间的问责缺口？
AI.motivation: ALPR已在全国范围内大规模部署，但实际治理情况缺乏系统性研究。该案例揭示了技术先进性与治理滞后之间的巨大落差，对AI治理研究具有典型意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目的限制原则（purpose limitation）、算法审计（algorithmic auditing）、技术治理与问责框架
AI.method: 案例研究法，以Flock Safety为单一案例，涵盖事件记录分析、公司响应梳理、法律诉讼与合同取消情况以及公众反应（包括硬件被破坏事件）的文献与档案分析。
AI.findings: 1) ALPR技术存在三项治理失败：数据被联邦移民执法未经同意使用、警察个体滥用追踪私人、透明度不足。2) 公司核心技术性能并非伤害源头，伤害源于治理与问责缺口。3) 公众反弹包括合同取消、法律诉讼及对摄像头硬件的直接破坏。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理框架（目的限制与算法审计）应用于真实世界深度学习的典型案例，论证了技术性能与治理防护之间的脱节是系统性伤害的根本原因，而非技术本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的治理改进建议，包括强化目的限制机制和建立算法审计制度，为ALPR及其他类似监控技术的部署机构提供可操作的政策参考。

title: Praxeology and Analytic Philosophy of Action
affiliations: Queen's University Belfast and University of Warsaw

detail.title: Praxeology and Analytic Philosophy of Action
detail.abstract: This chapter reconstructs Tadeusz Kotarbiński's praxeology as a systematic and original contribution to analytic philosophy of action. Rather than treating praxeology as a marginal or historical doctrine of efficiency, the chapter presents it as a philosophical framework for analysing rational and purposive action. Its full import becomes visible only when set alongside later debates that, independently arrived at, converge on questions that praxeology had already posed. It begins by distinguishing three historical traditions: the French project of a general science of action, the Austrian school, and the Polish school developed by Kotarbiński, the most systematic and philosophically advanced of the three. The chapter then places Kotarbiński's praxeology within the intellectual context of the Lvov-Warsaw School. It shows how its ideals of clarity and rigor, together with Kotarbiński's ontology, informed his account of agency-and how this account carries an ethical dimension, expressed in the ideals of good work and the reliable guardian (that have no equivalent in the French or Austrian traditions). By reading Kotarbiński together with Anscombe, Davidson, and Bratman, the chapter shows that praxeology anticipates and converges in striking ways with later debates about the nature of action, while preserving its distinctive normative orientation. The chapter concludes that praxeology can enrich philosophy of action and contribute to organisation theory by addressing the long-recognised gap between theory and practice.

AI.tldr: 本章将Tadeusz Kotarbiński的实践学重构为分析行动哲学中一个系统且原创的贡献。通过与后期Anscombe、Davidson、Bratman等学者的行动理论对话，展示实践学在行动本质问题上先见性地预见了当代辩论，并保留了其独特的规范性取向（好工作与可靠守护者的伦理理想），同时指出实践学对组织理论中理论与实践鸿沟的潜在贡献。
AI.research_question: 如何将Kotarbiński的实践学重构为分析行动哲学中系统而原创的理论框架，并评估其对当代行动哲学与组织理论的贡献？
AI.motivation: 实践学长期被视为边缘性或历史性的效率学说，其哲学价值被低估。本章旨在恢复其作为理性与目的性行动分析框架的完整意义，并通过与后期独立发展但趋同的哲学辩论对照来彰显其前瞻性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kotarbiński的实践学；利沃夫-华沙学派的清晰性与严格性理想；Kotarbiński的本体论；行动哲学中Anscombe、Davidson、Bratman的理论传统
AI.method: 历史-哲学比较分析：区分法国、奥地利与波兰三个行动科学传统；将Kotarbiński置于利沃夫-华沙学派的知识语境中；通过跨文本对读将实践学与后期分析行动哲学进行系统比较。
AI.findings: 实践学在行动本质、理性行动结构等问题上独立地预见了后期分析哲学的辩论方向；Kotarbiński的实践学包含独特的伦理维度（好工作与可靠守护者），此为法国与奥地利传统所无；实践学可为行动哲学与组织理论贡献价值，尤其有助于弥合理论与实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.theory_contributions: 将实践学从边缘学说重新定位为分析行动哲学中系统而先进的哲学框架；揭示实践学与Anscombe、Davidson、Bratman等当代行动理论的惊人趋同性；强调实践学独特的规范性取向是对主流分析行动哲学的重要补充。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织理论提供行动哲学基础，帮助解决理论与实践长期脱节的问题；通过"好工作"与"可靠守护者"的伦理理想为组织实践提供规范性指导。

title: Trust and Social Networks: Citius, Altius, Fortius
affiliations: , University of Arizona, and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Trust and Social Networks: Citius, Altius, Fortius

declarations.funderStatement: This chapter was supported by the National Science Foundation under CAREER Award 1943688 to Oliver Schilke.

detail.abstract: Trust and social networks are deeply intertwined. Yet the two literatures have developed largely in parallel. Trust research has remained largely focused on dyads, network research on structure. This introductory chapter makes the case for integration. Trust scholarship gains when trust relations are treated as structurally embedded rather than socially isolated. Network scholarship, on the other hand, gains a relational mechanism that converts structural opportunity into meaningful social action. To clarify the interface and provide a systematic foundation for cumulative inquiry, we offer a tripartite typology of trust-network theorizing: (1) trust as a network property; (2) the co-evolution of trust and networks; and (3) the interdependent effects of trust and networks. We close by using the typology to organize the contributions to this Handbook and to identify opportunities for research at the nexus of trust and networks.

AI.tldr: 本文是《信任与网络手册》的导论章节，主张将信任研究与网络研究进行整合。信任研究长期聚焦于二元关系（dyads），而网络研究聚焦于结构，两者平行发展。作者提出一个三部分类型学来系统化信任-网络理论化研究：（1）信任作为网络属性；（2）信任与网络的共同演化；（3）信任与网络的相互依赖效应。该类型学为本手册各章节提供了组织框架，并指出了信任与网络交叉领域的研究机会。
AI.research_question: 信任研究与网络研究如何实现整合？具体而言，信任关系如何被视为结构性嵌入的，以及网络研究如何通过关系机制将结构机会转化为有意义的社会行动？
AI.motivation: 信任与社会网络紧密交织，但两个研究领域长期平行发展——信任研究聚焦于二元关系，网络研究聚焦于结构。这种割裂限制了两者的理论发展，亟需一个系统化的框架来弥合鸿沟并推动累积性研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出一个"信任-网络理论化"的三部分类型学作为核心理论框架：（1）信任作为网络属性；（2）信任与网络的共同演化；（3）信任与网络的相互依赖效应。
AI.method: 本文属于理论综述/导论类论文，通过梳理信任与社会网络两个文献领域的发展脉络，提出概念性类型学框架，并以此组织手册各章节内容。方法论上以理论综合与框架构建为主。
AI.findings: 信任研究在将信任关系视为结构性嵌入（而非社会孤立）时获益；网络研究在获得将结构机会转化为有意义社会行动的关系机制时获益。三部分类型学为信任-网络交叉研究提供了系统化的组织框架，并识别了该交叉领域的研究机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合性的三部分类型学框架，为信任与网络研究的整合提供了系统化基础；阐明了两个领域各自的增益方向——信任研究获得结构洞见，网络研究获得关系机制，从而推动两个文献的交叉对话与累积性知识构建。
AI.practical_contributions: 作为手册导论，为从事信任与网络交叉领域研究的学生和学者提供了清晰的理论地图和研宄议程，指导后续研究者在该交叉领域定位自己的研究并发现新的研究机会。

title: Distributionally Robust Dynamic Optimization for Urban Water Recycling Operations
affiliations: , Zhejiang University - School of Management and Wilfrid Laurier University - School of Business & Economics

detail.title: Distributionally Robust Dynamic Optimization for Urban Water Recycling Operations
detail.abstract: Urban water-recycling systems dynamically balance wastewater recycling and primary water production to ensure efficient and reliable water supply. However, this task faces prominent supply-demand mismatches driven by fluctuating demand, volatile wastewater inflows, and persistent environmental conditions. Methodology/results: We formulate these operational decisions by a finite-horizon dynamic model under distributional ambiguity. We capture environmental signals using exogenous Markov covariates (e.g., rainfall, streamflow, and temperature), and decompose demand and wastewater inflows into covariate-dependent predictions with uncertain residuals. Analytically, we show that the worst-case distribution is countermonotonic and can be computed offline, thereby reducing the robust dynamic problem to a standard dynamic program. Furthermore, the optimal robust policy retains a covariate-dependent threshold structure. Practically, using Melbourne Water data, we show that our approach reallocates precautionary production across environmental regimes while hedging against residual distributional ambiguity and adverse demand-inflow dependence. As a result, it substantially reduces average out-of-sample operating costs and exposure to extreme-cost outcomes while mitigating severe shortages. Managerial implications: As current system states and decisions shape the ability to absorb future demand-inflow mismatches, day-today operating decisions for water production and recycling are inherently forward-looking. Observable environmental signals can be used to position the system ahead of adverse regimes, while distributional robustness further protects the resulting dynamic plan against residual uncertainty. Our framework shows that such robust and efficient decisions can be implemented dynamically through simple and interpretable policies. More importantly, beyond its environmental benefits, water recycling creates operational value as an intertemporal buffer that helps managers prepare for future misalignment between recyclable supply and service demand.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了城市水循环系统在分布不确定性下的动态运营决策问题。作者构建了一个有限时域动态模型，结合外生马尔可夫协变量（如降雨、流量、温度）来刻画环境信号，并将需求和废水入流分解为协变量相关预测和不确定残差。理论上证明了最坏情形分布是逆单调的且可离线计算，将鲁棒动态问题简化为标准动态规划；最优鲁棒策略具有协变量依赖的阈值结构。利用墨尔本水务数据验证表明，该方法能跨环境状态重新分配预防性生产，显著降低平均样本外运营成本和极端成本暴露，同时缓解严重短缺。
AI.research_question: 在城市水循环系统中，如何在需求波动、废水入流不确定性和环境条件持续变化的多重不确定性下，制定高效且可靠的水循环与一次供水生产的动态运营决策？
AI.motivation: 城市水循环系统面临突出的供需不匹配问题，这些不匹配由波动的需求、不稳定的废水入流和持续变化的环境条件驱动。传统的运营决策方法未能充分处理分布模糊性（distributional ambiguity）以及需求与废水入流之间的不利依赖关系，需要一种既能利用环境信号又对残差不确定性具有鲁棒性的动态决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 分布鲁棒优化（Distributionally Robust Optimization）；2) 有限时域动态规划；3) 外生马尔可夫协变量模型；4) 逆单调性（countermonotonicity）理论；5) 阈值策略（threshold policy）结构。
AI.method: 1) 构建有限时域动态模型，以外部马尔可夫协变量（降雨、流量、温度）刻画环境信号；2) 将需求与废水入流分解为协变量依赖的预测部分和不确定残差部分；3) 在分布模糊集下求解最坏情形分布（证明其为逆单调且可离线计算）；4) 将鲁棒动态问题简化为标准动态规划；5) 使用墨尔本水务的实际数据验证方法有效性。
AI.findings: 1) 最坏情形分布是逆单调的且可离线计算，从而将鲁棒动态问题化简为标准动态规划问题；2) 最优鲁棒策略具有协变量依赖的阈值结构，策略简洁且可解释；3) 在墨尔本水务数据上，该方法能跨环境状态重新分配预防性生产；4) 显著降低了平均样本外运营成本和极端成本结果暴露；5) 有效缓解了严重短缺情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 理论上证明了在分布模糊情形下最坏情形分布的逆单调性质，并展示了可将鲁棒动态问题化简为标准动态规划；2) 证明了最优鲁棒策略具有协变量依赖的阈值结构，为分布鲁棒动态运营决策提供了可解析的理论刻画；3) 将环境协变量引入分布鲁棒动态模型，拓展了分布鲁棒优化在水资源管理领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一个可直接实施的动态运营决策框架，能够利用可观测的环境信号提前将系统定位在不利状态之前；2) 通过分布鲁棒性保护动态计划免受残差不确定性影响，显著降低运营成本和极端成本暴露；3) 揭示了水循环作为跨期缓冲的价值——不仅能带来环境效益，还能为管理者应对未来可回收供给与服务需求之间的错位提供运营弹性；4) 策略具有简单可解释的结构，便于实际系统的实施。

reference: Robert Diab, "Is There a Constitutional Right to a Human Decision in Canada?" (2026) 35:1 Constitutional Forum 19.
title: Is There a Constitutional Right to a Human Decision in Canada?
affiliations: Thompson Rivers University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Is There a Constitutional Right to a Human Decision in Canada?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Robert Diab, "Is There a Constitutional Right to a Human Decision in Canada?" (2026) 35:1 Constitutional Forum 19.

detail.abstract: In the mid-2010s, government interest in and uptake of automated decision-making prompted debate over law and policy on point. At issue were forms of AI that did not give reasons and relied on algorithms of varying degrees of opacity. Canada's Treasury Board Directive on Automated Decision-Making and Guide on the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence follow the EU's GDPR and AI Act in recognizing rights to a human decision and to an explanation of automated decision-making, thereby limiting the use of AI in high-impact cases. But recent advances in AI challenge the assumptions underlying this approach. Language models can generate reasons for a decision comparable in quality to those of a human-prompting a need to look beyond existing law and policy toward constitutional limits on use of this technology. This article outlines the contours of Charter rights to a human decision and an explanation, which, for the foreseeable future, preclude significant reliance on language models in high-impact administrative cases regardless of their capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了加拿大在自动化决策（尤其是语言模型）应用于行政决策时的宪法限制。文章指出，尽管近期AI技术（如语言模型）能生成与人类相当质量的决策理由，但基于加拿大《权利与自由宪章》所确立的"人类决策权"和"解释权"，在可预见的未来，语言模型在重大行政案件中的实质性使用仍应被排除，无论其技术能力如何。
AI.research_question: 语言模型的快速发展是否以及如何在宪法层面限制其在重大行政决策中的使用？加拿大《权利与自由宪章》所保障的人类决策权和解释权的内容与边界是什么？
AI.motivation: 2010年代中期以来，加拿大政府逐步采纳自动化决策系统，引发法律政策争论。欧盟GDPR和AI法案已确立人类决策权与解释权，加拿大财政部指令也随此趋势。然而，语言模型能生成与人类相当质量的理由，这挑战了现有法律政策的前提假设，亟需从宪法层面审视其使用边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加拿大《权利与自由宪章》所保障的人类决策权与解释权的宪法框架，结合欧盟GDPR和AI法案的比较法视角。
AI.method: 规范性法学分析，包括对加拿大财政部自动化决策指令、欧盟GDPR和AI法案的文本分析，以及对加拿大《权利与自由宪章》相关条款的宪法解释与论证。
AI.findings: 加拿大《权利与自由宪章》保障人类决策权和解释权，这些权利在可预见的未来排除了语言模型在重大行政案件中的实质性依赖，即使语言模型的推理能力已接近人类水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次系统勾勒了加拿大《权利与自由宪章》下人类决策权与解释权的宪法轮廓，为自动化决策的宪法限制提供了理论框架，超越了现有法律政策层面的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大政府机构和决策者在重大行政案件中设定语言模型使用的宪法边界，提示政策制定者即使是能力强大的AI系统也不能替代人类的实质性决策角色。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Scientific Search, and Symmetric Standards
affiliations: Åbo Akademi University, Finland

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Scientific Search, and Symmetric Standards
detail.abstract:
This article develops a theory of scientific search and symmetric standards for comprehensive artificial-intelligence cooperation in research. It is not an empirical evaluation of a particular AI system, but a theoretical account of how scientific work should be assessed when AI contributes substantively to question formation, hypothesis generation, cross-disciplinary comparison, criticism, epistemic salvage, verification design, and scholarly expression.

The central claim is that AI’s scientific importance lies not only in accelerating existing tasks, but in changing what becomes practically investigable under finite resources. Restricting available analytical capacity is therefore itself a research strategy, with opportunity costs and foregone scientific value. The framework distinguishes generation, pursuit, warrant, and portfolio allocation, allowing broad exploratory search while preserving exact standards for final claims.

The article argues for symmetric scientific standards: evaluation should follow claim type, consequence, risk, evidential basis, and method-specific vulnerability rather than the degree of AI contribution. A3-level contribution is treated as a descriptive classification, not a scientific defect. Extensive AI contribution may require fuller disclosure, but it should not create an independent quality penalty.

The governing norm is disciplined ambition: use available analytical capacity at the level that best advances consequential inquiry under symmetric substantive standards and complete human responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种科学搜索理论和全面AI研究合作的对称标准。文章论证AI的科学价值不仅在于加速现有任务，更在于改变在有限资源下什么成为可实际研究的问题。框架区分了生成、追求、确证和组合分配四个阶段，主张评估应基于主张类型、后果、风险、证据基础和方法特定脆弱性，而非AI贡献程度，最终以"纪律性雄心"作为主导规范。
AI.research_question: 当AI对科学研究的多个实质性环节（问题提出、假设生成、跨学科比较、批评、认识论补救、验证设计和学术表达）做出贡献时，科学工作应如何被评估？
AI.motivation: 传统科学研究评估标准假设人类是知识生产的主要或唯一主体，但随着AI在研究中发挥越来越实质性的作用，需要重新审视评估框架。本文不是对特定AI系统的实证评估，而是提供理论性答案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科学搜索理论；对称科学标准框架；生成-追求-确证-组合分配的四阶段区分框架
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性论证方法，非实证研究。
AI.findings: AI的科学重要性在于改变在有限资源下什么成为可实际研究的问题；限制可用分析能力本身是一种研究策略并有机会成本；评估应遵循对称标准——基于主张类型、后果、风险、证据基础和方法特定脆弱性，而非AI贡献程度；A3级贡献是描述性分类而非科学缺陷；主导规范为"纪律性雄心"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI科研合作的系统理论框架；论证了"对称科学标准"——即AI贡献程度不应成为独立的质量惩罚因素；区分了研究过程的生成、追求、确证和组合分配四个维度，为AI参与科研的评估提供了理论基石。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术期刊、资助机构和研究机构评估AI辅助研究提供了标准参考；主张广泛的探索性搜索与最终主张的精确标准可以并存；提出了在利用AI分析能力时应遵循的规范原则（纪律性雄心）和披露要求。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12904
title: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
affiliations: University of Southern California

detail.title: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
detail.abstract: This paper examines the labor market effects of overtime coverage in the United States, where salaried workers are covered for overtime if their base pay falls below a legislated salary threshold. Using an event-study design with administrative payroll data and state-level threshold changes from 2014-2021, I find evidence against conventional models of overtime. Contrary to the historical intent of policymakers, firms do not increase employment by substituting more workers for fewer hours. However, contrary to compensating differential models, firms also do not offset the costs of overtime by lowering workers' base pays. Instead, employers raised salaries above the threshold to keep workers exempt from overtime, indicating that monitoring and adjusting workers' hours is costly for firms. Taken together, these results suggest that expanding overtime coverage increases workers' earnings without negatively impacting employment.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2014-2021年美国各州加班工资覆盖门槛的变化和行政薪资数据，采用事件研究法考察加班覆盖对劳动力市场的影响。研究发现，企业并未通过雇佣更多工人替代减少工时来增加就业，也未通过降低基本工资来抵消加班成本，而是通过将薪资提高到门槛以上来保持员工免于加班覆盖，表明监控和调整工时的成本对企业而言较高。总体而言，扩大加班覆盖在不损害就业的同时提高了工人收入。
AI.research_question: 美国加班工资覆盖（overtime coverage）如何影响劳动力市场，特别是就业和工人收入？
AI.motivation: 传统的加班模型和补偿性差异模型对加班覆盖的政策效果有不同预测，而现有证据有限。理解加班覆盖的真实效应对于政策制定（如是否扩大加班保护范围）至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统加班模型（企业增加雇佣以替代工时）和补偿性差异模型（企业通过降低基本工资抵消加班成本）
AI.method: 事件研究设计（event-study design），使用行政工资数据，利用2014-2021年各州薪资门槛变化作为识别策略
AI.findings: 1) 企业并未通过以更多工人替代更少工时来增加就业（与传统加班模型相悖）；2) 企业也未通过降低基本工资来抵消加班成本（与补偿性差异模型相悖）；3) 企业通过将员工薪资提高到门槛以上以保持其免于加班覆盖；4) 扩大加班覆盖提高了工人收入且未对就业产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文对传统加班模型和补偿性差异模型均提出了经验证据的反驳，提出了"监控和调整工时成本高昂"的解释，丰富了加班经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于扩大加班覆盖范围的经济效应的实证证据，表明扩大加班保护可以在不损害就业的情况下提高工人收入，支持相关政策。

title: Outsourcing to Poland: Cost Advantages, Strategic Opportunities, and Challenges for U.S. Companies
affiliations: University of Central Asia (UCA)

detail.title: Outsourcing to Poland: Cost Advantages, Strategic Opportunities, and Challenges for U.S. Companies
detail.abstract: This study examines the outsourcing practices of U.S. companies operating in Poland, with particular attention to the cost-saving advantages, strategic opportunities, and operational challenges involved. Outsourcing has traditionally been understood primarily as a cost-cutting strategy; however, over the past two decades it has evolved into a more complex practice through which firms seek specialized talent, service quality, and favorable strategic positioning. Poland has emerged as a significant outsourcing hub, offering not only cost savings but also strategic access to the European market. Using a qualitative-descriptive research design supported by secondary quantitative data, this study compares wages, operational expenses, and businessenvironment indicators between the United States and Poland. The findings show that U.S. firms can achieve substantial labor-cost savings, reaching as much as 62% in some industries, alongside the benefits of Poland's well-developed information and communication technology (ICT) sector, high literacy rate, and favorable trading environment. At the same time, outsourcing to Poland is associated with challenges such as regulatory complexity, rising electricity costs, and cultural differences. The study concludes that Poland represents an attractive outsourcing destination, particularly for knowledge-intensive industries, provided that firms plan carefully to mitigate entry barriers and operational risks. These findings contribute to the academic literature on international outsourcing and offer practical guidance for managerial decision-making in global outsourcing strategy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨美国企业在波兰的外包实践，发现波兰不仅提供显著的劳工成本节省（某些行业高达62%），还具备成熟的ICT部门、高识字率和有利的贸易环境，但同时也面临监管复杂性、电费上涨和文化差异等挑战。研究结论认为波兰是知识密集型行业具有吸引力的外包目的地，但需要企业精心规划以克服准入壁垒和运营风险。
AI.research_question: 美国企业在波兰外包实践中的成本节省优势、战略机会和运营挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 外包已从单纯的降低成本策略演变为更复杂的战略实践（寻求专业人才、服务质量和战略定位），而波兰作为新兴外包枢纽的地位尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际外包理论——将外包从传统的成本削减视角扩展至包含战略定位、人才获取和服务质量的多维框架。
AI.method: 定性-描述性研究设计，辅以二手定量数据，对比美国和波兰之间的工资、运营费用和商业环境指标。
AI.findings: 美国企业可节省高达62%的劳工成本（部分行业）；波兰拥有发达的ICT部门、高识字率和有利的贸易环境；但存在监管复杂性、电费上涨和文化差异等挑战。波兰特别适合知识密集型行业的外包。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国际外包的学术文献，将外包研究从单纯的成本视角扩展至包含战略优势和运营挑战的综合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球外包战略中的管理决策提供实践指导，帮助企业评估波兰作为外包目的地的可行性及其风险规避策略。

title: Optimal Mechanisms with Hierarchically Interdependent Values
affiliations: Northwestern University - Department of Managerial Economics and Decision Sciences (MEDS)

detail.title: Optimal Mechanisms with Hierarchically Interdependent Values
detail.abstract:
I study optimal allocation under hierarchical interdependence. In the
baseline model, an incumbent observes a signal that affects both her value and
an entrant's value, while the entrant privately observes an additional
own-value component. I consider a planner whose objective is a weighted sum of
agents' utilities and collected payments. I characterize the optimal ex post
incentive-compatible and individually rational mechanism for every nonnegative
payment weight. When collected payments receive at least as much weight as
agents' utilities, the optimal mechanism is a score-based auction in which the
entrant's report determines an endogenous threshold for the incumbent and the
incumbent's report remains relevant when she loses. When payments are costly
to the planner, the optimal mechanism instead has a payment-free region in which the
entrant always receives the asset and a screening region in which the agents
compete through a monotone cutoff. For the valuable-payments case, the
score-based characterization extends to environments with multiple agents.
With one incumbent and several entrants,
the optimal mechanism compares the incumbent with the strongest entrant
alternative even when the incumbent's report changes the entrants' ranking. In
a longer ordered hierarchy, the characterization extends under a local virtual
single-crossing condition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究层级相互依赖下的最优分配机制设计问题。在基准模型中，在位者观察到影响自身和进入者价值的信号，而进入者私下观察到额外的自身价值成分。计划者的目标是最小化（或加权）代理效用和收取支付的加权和。作者对每个非负支付权重刻画了最优的事后激励相容且个体理性机制：当收取支付至少与代理效用同样重要时，最优机制是基于评分的拍卖；当支付对计划者有成本时，最优机制包含一个无支付区域和一个筛选区域。
AI.research_question: 在层级相互依赖环境下（在位者的信号同时影响自身和进入者的价值），最优分配机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统的分配机制设计通常假设代理的价值是独立的或仅影响自身。但在现实场景中（如资源分配、资产出售），一个代理的信号可能同时影响多个代理的估值，即存在层级相互依赖（hierarchical interdependence）。这种结构下，标准拍卖机制可能不再最优，需要刻画新的最优机制形式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论；事后激励相容（ex post incentive compatibility）；个体理性（individual rationality）；最优拍卖理论；虚拟价值（virtual value）；单交叉条件（single-crossing condition）
AI.method: 理论模型分析。作者设定一个计划者最大化工（最小化）代理效用与收取支付的加权和，在所有非负支付权重下刻画最优机制特征。分别分析：支付有价值的情形（支付权重≥代理效用权重）和支付有成本的情形。并通过扩展分析多进入者和长层级结构下的普适性。
AI.findings: (1) 当收取支付至少与代理效用同等重要时，最优机制是基于评分的拍卖：进入者的报告决定在位者的内生阈值，在位者即使在输掉时其报告仍然相关。(2) 当支付对计划者有成本时，最优机制包含一个无支付区域（进入者总是获得资产）和一个筛选区域（代理通过单调阈值竞争）。(3) 支付有价值时，评分机制可扩展到多代理环境：一个在位者与多个进入者时，最优机制将在位者与最强进入者比较，即使在位者报告改变进入者排序也适用。(4) 更长的有序层级中，在局部虚拟单交叉条件下特征仍然成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次系统地刻画了层级相互依赖环境下的最优分配机制，填补了相互依赖估值与层级结构交叉领域的理论空白。扩展了最优拍卖理论到非对称估值依赖结构，并提供了多代理与长层级结构的可处理扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源分配、资产出售等实际场景提供了可操作的机制设计指导：当支付重要时采用评分拍卖；当支付成本高时采用支付豁免与筛选相结合的机制。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-12
title: Made with China: Global Supply Chains and the Limits of US Decoupling
affiliations: Syracuse University Maxwell School and Peterson Institute for International Economics

detail.title: Made with China: Global Supply Chains and the Limits of US Decoupling

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Policy Brief 26-12
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using Asian Development Bank multiregional input-output tables for 2007–24, this Policy Brief traces Chinese value added throughout the US import basket. It argues that genuine US economic security requires a more disciplined strategy—identifying actual chokepoints, building competitive alternative suppliers and the infrastructure connecting them to markets, and cooperating with allies rather than forcing them into separate supply chains. The appendix explains the method and databases that the authors used in their analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文利用亚洲开发银行2007-24年多区域投入产出表，追踪中国增加值在美国进口篮中的分布，主张美国真正的经济安全需要更严谨的战略：识别真正的瓶颈点、建立有竞争力的替代供应商及连接市场的基础设施，并与盟友合作而非迫使其建立独立供应链。
AI.research_question: 美国进口篮中中国增加值究竟如何分布？美国应如何制定更有效的经济安全战略？
AI.motivation: 现有美国对华经济安全政策可能过于笼统，缺乏对中国增加值在进口供应链中实际位置的精确识别，导致政策效果不佳甚至适得其反。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多区域投入产出分析（MRIO）、全球价值链理论、经济安全与供应链韧性理论
AI.method: 基于亚洲开发银行多区域投入产出表（2007-2024年），追踪中国增加值在美国进口篮中的流动与分布，并辅以附录说明方法和数据库。
AI.findings: 中国增加值在美国进口篮中的实际分布可能与传统认知不同；美国真正需要的是识别关键瓶颈、培育竞争性替代供应商及必要基础设施，并通过盟友合作而非强行分割供应链来实现经济安全。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多区域投入产出分析应用于经济安全政策研究，为理解中国在全球价值链中的实际地位提供了更精细的实证视角，挑战了笼统的"对华脱钩"叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国决策者提供了基于数据的经济安全战略建议：准确识别瓶颈点、建设替代供应商和基础设施、加强盟友合作，以替代低效的供应链强制拆分策略。

title: Pakistan Women's Experience in Business Entrepreneurship

detail.title: Pakistan Women's Experience in Business Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract: This paper examines phenomenology as a qualitative research methodology for understanding the lived experiences of Pakistani women entrepreneurs. It focuses on how gender roles, cultural norms, Islamic beliefs, family expectations, and structural barriers shape women's entrepreneurial experiences. The paper reviews descriptive and interpretive phenomenology and explains the relevance of Heidegger's hermeneutic approach to understanding experiences within their social, historical, cultural, and religious contexts. It also outlines the use of purposive sampling, semi-structured interviews, participant language choice, and thematic analysis. Particular attention is given to Islamic influence on business decisions, family support, gender roles, access to finance, mobility restrictions, and work-life balance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了现象学作为质性研究方法论，用于理解巴基斯坦女性企业家的生活经验，重点关注性别角色、文化规范、伊斯兰信仰、家庭期望和结构性障碍如何塑造她们的创业经历。文章回顾了描述性和诠释性现象学，阐述了海德格尔诠释学方法在理解社会、历史、文化和宗教背景下的经验中的适用性，并概述了目的性抽样、半结构化访谈、参与者语言选择和主题分析等研究方法。
AI.research_question: 如何运用现象学方法论深入理解巴基斯坦女性企业家的生活经验，特别是性别角色、文化规范、伊斯兰信仰、家庭期望和结构性障碍如何塑造她们的创业经历？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦女性企业家面临独特的文化、宗教和结构性的挑战，传统定量研究方法可能无法充分捕捉她们复杂的生活经验和主观感受，需要一种能够深入理解这些经验本质的质性研究方法论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现象学方法论，包括描述性现象学（胡塞尔传统）和诠释性现象学（海德格尔诠释学方法），强调在具体的社会、历史、文化、宗教背景下理解个体经验。
AI.method: 质性的现象学方法：采用目的性抽样选取参与者，使用半结构化访谈收集数据，允许参与者选择自己的语言进行交流，采用主题分析法进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 研究重点关注了伊斯兰信仰对商业决策的影响、家庭支持的作用、性别角色的影响、融资渠道获取、行动自由限制以及工作与生活平衡等关键主题。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文展示了诠释性现象学（特别是海德格尔方法）在非西方文化背景下的适用性和价值，为在特定文化宗教环境中研究边缘群体创业经验提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解巴基斯坦女性创业者的真实经历提供了深入洞察，有助于政策制定者和支持机构设计更具针对性的干预措施，考虑文化、宗教和性别因素在创业支持中的作用。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12905
title: The Friendship Paradox: Causal Evidence of Its Behavioral Consequences
affiliations: University of London - Royal Holloway College, University of Malaga, Stanford University - Department of Economics and Max Planck Institute for Behavioral Economics

detail.title: The Friendship Paradox: Causal Evidence of Its Behavioral Consequences
detail.abstract: We provide a first causal analysis of the behavioral consequences of the friendship paradox—the fact that people’s friends in a network have more connections than average. We find that people’s behavior is biased by their network position: they do not best respond to what they should infer the average behavior of the population to be, but instead simply to the average behavior of their friends. Moreover, we find that they fail to learn to overcome such a bias when relocated within the network, varying their observational environment. In these games of complements, the friendship paradox generates a systematic upward distortion in actions, increases behavioral dispersion, and persists despite learning opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对"友谊悖论"的行为后果进行了因果分析，发现人们的行为会受到其网络位置的偏差影响：他们不是根据对总体平均行为的推断来做最佳回应，而是简单地根据朋友的平均行为来行动。即使网络位置发生变化（观测环境改变），人们也无法学会克服这种偏差。在互补性博弈中，友谊悖论会导致行为的系统性向上扭曲、增加行为离散度，并且这种偏差在学习机会存在的情况下依然持续。
AI.research_question: 友谊悖论（人们在网络中的朋友拥有比平均水平更多的连接）对个体行为决策是否产生因果影响？人们是否会因为仅仅依据朋友的平均行为而非总体平均行为来做决策，从而导致系统性行为偏差？
AI.motivation: 友谊悖论是社会网络中的一个经典现象，但此前关于其对行为影响的研究主要停留在理论层面（如Jackson, 2019），缺乏严谨的因果证据。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过因果分析揭示网络位置如何系统性影响个体行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 友谊悖论理论（Friendship Paradox）、最佳回应理论（Best Response）、社会学习理论、互补性博弈（Games of Complements）
AI.method: 因果分析方法，包含网络位置重定位（relocation）的实验设计，通过改变参与者的观测环境来检验其行为偏差是否可以被学习所克服。
AI.findings: （1）人们不依据对总体平均行为的推断做最佳回应，而是直接依据朋友的平均行为行动；（2）当参与者被重新置于网络中的不同位置（观测环境变化）时，无法学会克服这种偏差；（3）在互补性博弈中，友谊悖论导致行为系统性向上扭曲；（4）行为离散度增加；（5）即使存在学习机会，这种偏差依然持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为友谊悖论的行为后果提供因果证据，将网络结构理论与个体行为决策理论联系起来，揭示了社会网络位置对经济行为的重要影响，扩展了对行为偏差持续性（persistence）的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对网络平台设计、社会网络干预政策、信息传播与行为引导具有实践意义——表明仅改变个体的观测环境（网络位置）不足以纠正行为偏差，需要更有力的政策干预。

title: Who Chooses to Judge? Endogenous Participation and the Limits of Bridging in Crowd
affiliations: and Georgia State University - Department of Computer Information Systems

detail.title: Who Chooses to Judge? Endogenous Participation and the Limits of Bridging in Crowd
detail.abstract: Crowd-based governance systems depend not only on how individual judgments are aggregated but also on which individuals choose to contribute those judgments. We examine this participation problem in X’s Community Notes, a crowd fact-checking system that uses a bridging algorithm to identify support across evaluators with contrasting rating histories. Using ratings of the same notes generated through two participation pathways—ordinary endogenous participation and randomized platform requests—we assess whether voluntarily produced judgments generalize to a broader evaluator sample. Our primary sample includes 9,853 notes, 2,660,703 endogenous ratings, and 706,135 platform-sampled ratings. Endogenous evaluators rate the same notes 0.0400 points less favorably, on average, than platform-sampled evaluators. We develop an evaluator-note selection framework and apply an exact symmetric decomposition to distinguish differences in relational composition from differences in conditional judgment within aligned and opposed evaluator-note relations. Endogenous participation produces a more aligned relational composition, which alone would make endogenous assessments more favorable. However, this compositional advantage is more than offset by substantially more critical conditional judgment, concentrated primarily within opposed evaluator-note relations. The conditional-judgment component also corresponds much more closely to cross-pathway differences in Community Notes helpfulness scores than does relational composition. These findings show that bridging across observed perspectives does not eliminate selection in the production of algorithmic inputs. More broadly, crowd-based platforms must evaluate both which perspectives participate and whether the judgments expressed within those perspectives generalize beyond voluntary contributors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了X平台Community Notes众包事实核查系统中参与选择问题，通过对比内源性参与和平台随机邀请两种途径的评分数据，发现自愿参与者的评分系统性地低于平台抽样评估者，且条件判断差异（而非关系组成差异）是导致跨路径差异的主要原因，表明桥接算法并不能消除算法输入生产中的选择偏差。
AI.research_question: 众包治理系统中，自愿参与的判断能否推广到更广泛的评估者样本？具体而言，Community Notes中内源性参与的评估者与平台随机抽样的评估者在评分上是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 众包治理系统不仅取决于个体判断如何聚合，还取决于哪些个体选择贡献判断。理解参与选择是否引入偏差对于评估此类系统的有效性至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对参与路径差异的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参与者-笔记选择框架（evaluator-note selection framework），精确对称分解方法（exact symmetric decomposition），区分关系组成差异与条件判断差异。
AI.method: 利用同一批笔记在两条参与路径（内源性自发参与 vs 平台随机请求）下产生的评分数据，构建评估者-笔记选择框架，采用精确对称分解方法将总差异分解为关系组成差异和条件判断差异。样本包括9,853条笔记、2,660,703条内源性评分和706,135条平台抽样评分。
AI.findings: 内源性评估者对相同笔记的平均评分比平台抽样评估者低0.0400分。内源性参与产生更一致的关系组成（单独效应会使评估更有利），但这种组成优势被显著更严格的条件判断所抵消，且主要集中在对立型评估者-笔记关系中。条件判断成分与Community Notes帮助度评分的跨路径差异的对应度远高于关系组成成分。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了桥接算法虽能跨越观察视角但并不能消除算法输入生产中的参与选择偏差；提出并应用了评估者-笔记选择框架和精确对称分解方法，为众包治理系统的参与选择问题提供了理论分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为众包平台设计提供了重要启示：不仅需要评估哪些视角参与，还需要评估在这些视角内表达的判断是否能推广到自愿贡献者之外的人群；对Community Notes等众包事实核查系统的算法设计和治理实践具有直接指导意义。

title: Agentic AI in the Age of Autonomy with Concepts and Case Studies
affiliations: Manisa Celal Bayar University, Muğla Sıtkı Koçman University - Department of Artificial Intelligence and International VISION University

detail.title: Agentic AI in the Age of Autonomy with Concepts and Case Studies
detail.abstract:
Artificial Intelligence is entering a new era in which systems are no longer limited to generating predictions or assisting users with isolated tasks. Agentic AI represents this transformation by enabling intelligent systems to perceive their environments, reason over complex objectives, plan multi-step actions, utilize external tools, collaborate with humans and other agents, and continuously adapt to changing conditions. As autonomous capabilities mature, Agentic AI is rapidly becoming one of the defining research and application areas of contemporary artificial intelligence.
This edited volume, Agentic AI in the Age of Autonomy with Concepts and Case Studies, has been prepared to provide a comprehensive perspective on this emerging paradigm. Rather than focusing solely on technical advances, the book brings together interdisciplinary contributions that examine the architectural foundations of agentic systems, human-agent collaboration, governance, domain-specific applications, and future research directions. The diversity of the chapters reflects our belief that the future of autonomous AI will be shaped not only by technological innovation but also by responsible design, societal acceptance, and practical deployment across different sectors.
The book begins by establishing the technical foundations of Agentic AI, explaining the layered architectures, reasoning mechanisms, orchestration strategies, and collaborative models that enable autonomous intelligent systems. It then explores issues of trust, governance, ethical responsibility, and social acceptance, highlighting the importance of balancing autonomy with transparency, accountability, and human oversight.
Building upon these conceptual foundations, the following chapters examine how autonomous AI agents are transforming software engineering from passive development tools into collaborative teammates, while also reviewing the growing role of AI agents in education through current architectures, opportunities, and pedagogical challenges. The educational perspective is further extended through the presentation of SymDevAI Edu, a supervised Agentic AI ecosystem that demonstrates how autonomous agents can support K-12 learning environments in real-world settings.
The volume continues with practical case studies illustrating the adoption of Agentic AI across diverse application domains. These include intelligent destination management supported by tourism dashboards, the interpretation of radiological images through large language models as decision-support systems in healthcare, neuro-symbolic autonomous governance for financial execution, and the coordination of autonomous swarm drones for adaptive wildfire prediction and disaster response. Together, these chapters demonstrate that Agentic AI is evolving beyond a theoretical concept into a versatile technological paradigm capable of addressing complex real-world challenges.
As editors, we hope that this book will serve as a valuable resource for researchers, graduate students, practitioners, policymakers, and technology leaders seeking to understand both the opportunities and the challenges presented by increasingly autonomous intelligent systems. By combining theoretical perspectives with practical implementations, this volume aims to encourage interdisciplinary collaboration and inspire future research on trustworthy, explainable, and human-centered Agentic AI.
Finally, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all chapter authors for sharing their expertise and contributing their valuable research to this volume. We also extend our appreciation to the Izmir Academy Association Publishing House for its continuous support in promoting open-access, interdisciplinary scientific publications through the Future Tech Horizons e-book series. We hope this book contributes to the ongoing global dialogue on the responsible development and deployment of autonomous intelligent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是《Agentic AI in the Age of Autonomy with Concepts and Case Studies》编辑卷的序言，系统介绍了代理式人工智能（Agentic AI）这一新兴范式。该书集结多学科贡献，涵盖代理系统的架构基础、人机协作、治理、领域应用和未来研究方向，并通过多个案例展示Agentic AI从理论概念走向解决现实世界复杂问题的成熟技术范式。
AI.research_question: 代理式人工智能（Agentic AI）如何从理论上和技术上实现自主智能系统，并在多领域应用中平衡自主性与透明度、问责制及人类监督之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正进入新纪元，系统不再局限于生成预测或辅助孤立任务，Agentic AI能够感知环境、推理复杂目标、规划多步行动、利用外部工具、与人类及其他智能体协作并持续适应变化。然而，该领域的未来发展不仅要依靠技术创新，还需要负责任的设计、社会接受度以及跨行业的实际部署，因此需要一本综合性的跨学科著作来全面审视这一新兴范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本书涵盖多学科理论框架，包括：代理系统的分层架构理论、推理机制、编排策略、协作模型，以及信任、治理、伦理责任和社会接受度相关理论，强调自主性与透明度、问责制、人类监督之间的平衡。
AI.method: 编辑卷方法，汇集多章节跨学科贡献，包括概念性论述与案例研究相结合。案例涵盖旅游智能管理、医疗放射影像解读、金融神经符号自主治理、野火预测与灾响应的自主无人机群协调等实际应用领域。
AI.findings: Agentic AI正从理论概念演变为能够解决复杂现实挑战的多功能技术范式。在软件工程中，AI代理从被动开发工具转变为协作队友；在教育领域，AI代理通过如SymDevAI Edu等监督式生态系统支持K-12学习环境；在多个应用领域（旅游、医疗、金融、灾害响应）均展现出实际部署价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Agentic AI提供了综合性的跨学科理论视角，将技术架构、人机协作、治理伦理和领域应用整合为一个系统的知识框架，推动了值得信赖、可解释、以人为本的Agentic AI研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过多个真实世界案例（旅游仪表盘、医疗决策支持系统、金融自治治理、无人机野火预测与灾害应对）展示了Agentic AI的实际部署流程和应用价值，为研究人员、研究生、从业者、政策制定者及技术领导者提供了实践参考和资源。

title: Resilytics: A Decision-Intelligence Platform and Revenue Durability Index for Small and Medium Businesses

detail.title: Resilytics: A Decision-Intelligence Platform and Revenue Durability Index for Small and Medium Businesses
detail.abstract: Small and medium businesses (SMBs) in emerging markets generate rich transactional data but rarely convert it into forward-looking decisions. Business-intelligence dashboards describe what happened; they do not tell a founder what is about to break. We present Resilytics, a decision-intelligence platform designed for Indian SMBs operating between ₹50 lakh and ₹50 crore in annual revenue. The system ingests raw sales data through a canonicalschema pipeline into a multi-tenant star-schema warehouse, computes a portfolio of key performance indicators, and condenses them into a single interpretable measure-the Revenue Durability Index (RDI)-composed of five risk dimensions: growth, stability, concentration, geographic spread, and operational balance. An intelligence layer adds explainability through percomponent contribution and sensitivity analysis, drift detection, forecasting, Monte Carlo shock simulation, and a policy engine that ranks concrete actions. A hybrid AI copilot combines deterministic tools with a large language model behind a validated intent-plan-tool pipeline, so that every answer remains grounded in the tenant's own warehouse data and the system degrades gracefully to deterministic-only operation. We describe the architecture, the RDI methodology, the guardrail design of the copilot, and our validation approach on a synthetic two-phase benchmark dataset covered by 377 automated tests. We report engineering lessons on silent LLM degradation and test-fixture integrity, and we discuss limitations and the path to field validation with pilot deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Resilytics，一个专为印度中小型企业（SMB）设计的决策智能平台。该系统通过规范化的数据管道将原始销售数据整合到多租户星型模式数据仓库中，计算关键绩效指标，并将其整合为一个可解释的单一指标——收入持久性指数（RDI），该指数由增长、稳定性、集中度、地理分布和运营平衡五个风险维度组成。系统还包含可解释性层、预测、蒙特卡洛冲击模拟和策略引擎，以及结合确定性工具与大型语言模型的混合AI副驾驶系统。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够将新兴市场中小企业的丰富交易数据转化为前瞻性决策支持的决策智能平台？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场的中小企业产生丰富的交易数据，但很少将其转化为前瞻性决策。现有的商业智能仪表板只描述过去发生了什么，无法告知企业主即将出现的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策智能理论、关键绩效指标体系、多维度风险评估框架（RDI的五维风险模型）
AI.method: 系统架构设计方法，包括：canonical schema数据管道、多租户星型模式数据仓库、RDI指标体系构建、混合AI副驾驶（确定性工具+LLM的意图-计划-工具流水线）、合成两阶段基准数据集上的377个自动化测试验证
AI.findings: 系统通过混合AI架构确保每个答案都基于租户自身的仓库数据，并在LLM失效时优雅降级为纯确定性操作。还报告了有关LLM静默性能退化和测试夹具完整性的工程经验教训。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将多维KPI压缩为单一可解释指标（RDI）的方法论框架，以及混合AI副驾驶中确保结果可追溯性和可靠性的架构设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场中小企业提供了切实可行的决策智能工具，能够将交易数据转化为可执行的前瞻性建议，包含敏感性分析、漂移检测、预测、蒙特卡洛模拟和策略推荐等功能。

title: The Two-Layer Economy of Intelligence III: The Internal Limits of Diminishing Returns — The Saturation of Scaling Laws and the Horizon of AI Capital

detail.title: The Two-Layer Economy of Intelligence III: The Internal Limits of Diminishing Returns — The Saturation of Scaling Laws and the Horizon of AI Capital
detail.abstract: The first two installments of this series established a two-layer economy of intelligence—a commoditizing Base Layer and a scarcity-preserving Apex Layer (Paper I)—and traced electricity cost as an external, physical constraint shaping that structure (Paper II). Both rest on an unstated premise: that Apex-Layer actors can perpetually renew their technical lead by continuing to pour in compute. This paper (Paper III) interrogates that premise from within, against one of the most widely observed empirical regularities in AI research—scaling laws—which imply diminishing returns: performance rises with compute, parameters, and data, but the marginal cost of each increment grows. We proceed not by original quantitative causal inference (the core data are proprietary to AI labs) but by (a) organizing the published scaling-law literature (Kaplan et al., 2020; Hoffmann et al., 2022; Caballero et al., 2023; Snell et al., 2024) and (b) reconsidering Paper I's premises through classical factor theory. Our position is that diminishing returns does not invalidate Paper I's central thesis but transforms the basis on which Apex-Layer power rests. We identify two asymmetries—a supply side, where rising acquisition costs raise entry barriers and entrench incumbents (read through the Specific Factors Model and differential rent), and a demand side, where inelastic frontier-task demand persists—and analyze them through the ambiguity decomposition (Krogh & Vedelsby, 1995), correcting an earlier draft's misattributed reliance on the Hong-Page theorem. Comparing Google, leading Chinese firms, and Anthropic, we distinguish a two-layer-integration path from a purification path. We are explicit throughout about the limitations: lab-reported figures, the metaphorical extension of a squared-error identity to generative outputs, and a preliminary, secondary-source firm comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文是系列论文的第三篇，从规模定律（diminishing returns）的内部视角审视前两篇提出的"双层智能经济"结构（基础层商品化、顶尖层维持稀缺性）的核心前提——即顶尖层行动者可以通过持续投入算力永久保持技术领先。作者通过整理规模定律文献并结合经典要素理论，论证边际收益递减并不会推翻核心论点，而是改变了顶尖层权力得以维持的基础：供给侧上升的获取成本提高进入壁垒并巩固在位者，需求侧前沿任务的需求缺乏弹性持续存在。通过模糊性分解方法，作者对比了谷歌、中国领先企业和Anthropic，区分了"双层整合路径"与"净化路径"两种战略选择。
AI.research_question: 当算力投入面临规模定律所揭示的边际收益递减时，顶尖层（Apex Layer）行动者依靠持续增加算力投入来维持技术领先的前提是否仍然成立？如果不成立，顶尖层权力得以维持的机制将如何转变？
AI.motivation: 系列前两篇论文隐含地假定顶尖层可以通过持续投入算力来不断更新技术领先地位，但这一前提从未被审视。规模定律（scaling laws）作为AI研究中最广泛观察到的经验规律，揭示了算力投入的边际收益递减问题，本文旨在从内部质疑并重新审视这一核心前提。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文整合了多重理论框架：（1）规模定律文献（Kaplan et al., 2020; Hoffmann et al., 2022; Caballero et al., 2023; Snell et al., 2024）；（2）经典要素理论，包括特定要素模型（Specific Factors Model）和级差地租理论；（3）模糊性分解方法（Krogh & Vedelsby, 1995）用于分析供需两侧的不对称性。作者还修正了早期草稿中对Hong-Page定理的错误依赖。
AI.method: 本文并非通过原创的定量因果推断（因为核心数据为AI实验室专有），而是采用：（1）系统整理已发表的规模定律文献；（2）通过经典要素理论重新审视前文前提；（3）运用模糊性分解方法分析供需两侧不对称性；（4）基于二手资料来源对谷歌、中国领先企业和Anthropic进行初步的跨公司比较。
AI.findings: 研究发现边际收益递减并未推翻前文核心论点，但转变了顶尖层权力维持的基础。识别出两种不对称性：供给侧方面，算力获取成本上升提高了进入壁垒、巩固了在位者地位；需求侧方面，前沿任务的弹性需求持续存在。通过模糊性分解分析，作者区分了谷歌和中国企业采用的"双层整合路径"与Anthropic采用的"净化路径"两种战略选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：（1）将经典经济学要素理论（特定要素模型、级差地租）引入AI产业结构的分析，为理解算力作为稀缺要素的配置机制提供了经济学基础；（2）纠正并规范了模糊性分解方法在该领域的应用（修正了此前对Hong-Page定理的误用）；（3）揭示了边际收益递减条件下顶尖层权力维持机制的转型，丰富了"双层智能经济"的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于：（1）为企业战略决策提供了"双层整合路径"与"净化路径"两种清晰的战略选择框架，帮助不同市场地位的AI企业明确自身定位；（2）通过对谷歌、中国领先企业和Anthropic的比较分析，为行业参与者提供竞争格局的洞见；（3）揭示了进入壁垒的动态变化，有助于新进入者和投资者理解AI产业竞争的本质。

detail.abstract: Autonomous artificial intelligence (AI) agents are transforming software systems from passive AI-assisted tools into active, goal-oriented software teammates capable of perceiving context, maintaining memory, planning tasks, selecting tools, and executing multi-step workflows. This chapter examines this transformation by distinguishing autonomous AI agents from prompt-driven applications, conversational chatbots, workflow automation, and conventional software components. It presents a structured six-layer agentic architecture comprising perception, memory, reasoning and planning, action, orchestration, and governance, providing an architectural perspective for integrating autonomous agents into software engineering environments. The chapter further explores multi-agent collaboration patterns in software development, IT operations, and data analysis, with particular attention to task decomposition, contextual memory, tool execution, coordination, and conflict resolution. To demonstrate the practical application of these concepts, a multi-agent Software Quality Companion is presented, integrating specialized agents for code review, test generation, architectural consistency analysis, technical debt monitoring, and orchestration. The chapter also examines systemic risks associated with increased autonomy, including controllability failures, unreliable actions, objective misalignment, security vulnerabilities, privacy risks, coordination failures, and excessive user reliance. A governance framework is proposed based on policy and permissions, action gating, observability, and continuous evaluation. Finally, the chapter discusses evaluation criteria covering review quality, productivity, reliability, operational safety, human oversight, maintainability, and architectural trust. The analysis highlights that successful adoption of autonomous agents depends not only on model capabilities but also on disciplined software architecture, explicit authority boundaries, measurable performance criteria, and auditable governance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地阐述了自主AI智能体如何将软件系统从被动AI辅助工具转变为主动的、以目标为导向的软件协作者。文章提出了一个包含感知、记忆、推理与规划、行动、编排和治理的六层智能体架构，探讨了多智能体协作模式，并展示了多智能体软件质量伴侣的实践应用。同时，文章分析了自主性增强带来的系统性风险，提出了治理框架，并讨论了评估标准。
AI.research_question: 自主AI智能体如何被系统地集成到软件工程环境中？其架构、协作模式、风险与治理机制分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着自主AI智能体的快速发展，软件系统正从被动辅助工具向主动的、目标导向的软件协作者转变。然而，这种转变缺乏清晰的架构视角和系统性分析，需要厘清自主智能体与其他软件形态的区别，并建立结构化的框架来理解其架构、风险、治理与评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六层智能体架构理论（感知、记忆、推理与规划、行动、编排、治理）、多智能体协作模式理论、自主性风险分类框架、治理框架（基于策略与权限、行动门控、可观测性、持续评估）
AI.method: 概念分析与架构设计：通过区分自主AI智能体与应用提示、对话聊天机器人、工作流自动化及传统软件组件，提出结构化六层架构，并基于多智能体协作模式设计实践案例（多智能体软件质量伴侣），同时构建风险分类与治理框架。
AI.findings: 成功采用自主智能体不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于规范的软件架构、明确的权限边界、可衡量的性能标准和可审计的治理机制。文章识别了包括可控性失败、不可靠行动、目标错位、安全漏洞、隐私风险、协调失败和过度用户依赖等系统性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统的六层智能体架构理论，为自主AI智能体在软件工程中的集成提供了结构化视角；建立了自主性风险分类体系和治理框架，填补了该领域的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了多智能体软件质量伴侣的实践案例，展示了智能体在代码审查、测试生成、架构一致性分析、技术债务监控等方面的实际应用；提出了基于政策权限、行动门控、可观测性和持续评估的治理框架，以及涵盖审查质量、生产力、可靠性等多维度的评估标准，为从业者提供了可操作的指导。
